-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id RTM007
-- @duration 6
-- @recommend text "ABCDE"
-- @title MT Bounce
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 3
--[[ @description
Compare ground and wall convenience APIs with the low-level X/Y solvers and
a standalone impact squash. Parameters are grouped by collision type.
]]

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local elapsed = ctx.time % 3.0

    if ctx.char_count >= 1 then
        mt.bounce_ground(ctx, ctx.chars[1], 0.32, {
            t = elapsed,
            start_mode = "absolute",
            start_y = 0.75,
            ground_mode = "absolute",
            gravity = 0.8,
            restitution = 0.55,
            squash = 0.18,
        })
    end

    if ctx.char_count >= 2 then
        mt.bounce_wall(ctx, ctx.chars[2], 0.72, {
            t = elapsed,
            start_mode = "absolute",
            start_x = 0.25,
            wall_mode = "absolute",
            acceleration = 0.8,
            restitution = 0.5,
            squash = 0.18,
        })
    end

    if ctx.char_count >= 3 then
        local bounce = mt.bounce_y({
            t = elapsed,
            ground_y = 0.35,
            start_y = 0.75,
            gravity = 0.8,
            restitution = 0.5,
        })
        local character = ctx.chars[3]
        character.stretch_x = bounce.stretch_x
        character.stretch_y = bounce.stretch_y
        mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, 0.45, bounce.y)
    end

    if ctx.char_count >= 4 then
        local bounce = mt.bounce_x({
            t = elapsed,
            wall_x = 0.72,
            start_x = 0.25,
            acceleration = 0.8,
            restitution = 0.5,
        })
        local character = ctx.chars[4]
        character.stretch_x = bounce.stretch_x
        character.stretch_y = bounce.stretch_y
        mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, bounce.x, 0.55)
    end

    if ctx.char_count >= 5 then
        local impactTime = math.floor(ctx.time) + 0.25
        local stretchX, stretchY, offsetCorrection = mt.impact_squash({
            t = ctx.time,
            impact_time = impactTime,
            squash = 0.25,
            stiffness = 22.0,
            damping = 10.0,
        })
        local character = ctx.chars[5]
        character.stretch_x = stretchX
        character.stretch_y = stretchY
        character.offset_y = 0.5 + offsetCorrection * character.geometry.bounds_height
    end
end

Compare ground and wall convenience APIs with the low-level X/Y solvers and
a standalone impact squash. Parameters are grouped by collision type.

name: RTM008_mt_timeline_chain.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id RTM008
-- @duration 6
-- @recommend text "A"
-- @title MT Timeline Chain
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 4
--[[ @description
Chain a Bezier entrance, hold, bounce, flexible idle, and outro. Each evaluator
receives the prior segment's final value, while remaining keeps the outro
anchored to the clip tail.
]]

local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kEnterDuration = 1.0
local kLandingHoldDuration = 0.25
local kBounceDuration = 1.4
local kOutroDuration = 0.6

local kEnterPath = {
    { x = 0.12, y = 0.25 },
    { x = 0.2, y = 0.85 },
    { x = 0.65, y = 0.9 },
    { x = 0.72, y = 0.7 },
}

local kInitialState = {
    x = kEnterPath[1].x,
    y = kEnterPath[1].y,
    stretch_x = 1.0,
    stretch_y = 1.0,
    opacity = 0.0,
}

local function evaluateEnter(segmentCtx, previous)
    local progress = mt.ease.out_cubic(segmentCtx.timeline.progress)
    local positionX, positionY =
        mt.path.bezier(kEnterPath[1], kEnterPath[2], kEnterPath[3], kEnterPath[4], progress)
    return {
        x = positionX,
        y = positionY,
        stretch_x = previous.stretch_x,
        stretch_y = previous.stretch_y,
        opacity = progress,
    }
end

local function evaluateBounce(segmentCtx, previous)
    local bounce = mt.bounce_y({
        t = segmentCtx.time,
        ground_y = 0.35,
        start_y = previous.y,
        gravity = 1.6,
        restitution = 0.48,
        squash = 0.2,
    })
    return {
        x = previous.x,
        y = bounce.y,
        stretch_x = bounce.stretch_x,
        stretch_y = bounce.stretch_y,
        opacity = previous.opacity,
    }
end

local function evaluateIdle(segmentCtx, previous)
    return {
        x = previous.x + math.sin(segmentCtx.time * 1.7) * 0.015,
        y = previous.y + math.sin(segmentCtx.time * 2.3) * 0.012,
        stretch_x = previous.stretch_x,
        stretch_y = previous.stretch_y,
        opacity = previous.opacity,
    }
end

local function evaluateOutro(segmentCtx, previous)
    local progress = mt.ease.in_cubic(segmentCtx.timeline.progress)
    return {
        x = previous.x + progress * 0.25,
        y = previous.y + progress * 0.35,
        stretch_x = mt.lerp(previous.stretch_x, 0.75, progress),
        stretch_y = mt.lerp(previous.stretch_y, 1.3, progress),
        opacity = previous.opacity * (1.0 - progress),
    }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count < 1 then
        return
    end

    local state = mt.timeline.chain(ctx, kInitialState, {
        { duration = kEnterDuration, evaluate = evaluateEnter },
        { hold = kLandingHoldDuration },
        { duration = kBounceDuration, evaluate = evaluateBounce },
        { duration = "remaining", evaluate = evaluateIdle },
        { duration = kOutroDuration, evaluate = evaluateOutro },
    }, {
        fallback_duration = kFallbackClipLength,
    })

    local character = ctx.chars[1]
    character.stretch_x = state.stretch_x
    character.stretch_y = state.stretch_y
    character.opacity = state.opacity
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, state.x, state.y)
end
description:
Chain a Bezier entrance, hold, bounce, flexible idle, and outro. Each evaluator

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id RTM009
-- @duration 5
-- @title MT Timeline Window Context
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Pass each character's local context to a context-driven bounce and reuse its
normalized progress for opacity.
]]

function OnLayout(ctx)
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local characterCtx = mt.timeline.window_ctx(ctx, (index - 1) * 0.12, 1.4)

        mt.bounce_ground(characterCtx, character, 0.3, {
            start_mode = "relative",
            ground_mode = "relative",
            align_to = "baseline",
            drop_height = 0.25,
            gravity = 2.5,
            restitution = 0.45,
            squash = 0.12,
        })

        character.opacity = mt.ease.out_cubic(characterCtx.timeline.progress)
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id RTM010
-- @duration 5
-- @title MT Stagger Progress
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Spread normalized intro and outro progress across characters while keeping a
shared completion time.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.8
local kOutroDuration = 0.8
local kStaggerSpan = 0.35
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(
            ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, {
        order = "center",
    }) do
        local appear = mt.ease.out_back(
            mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, info.progress, kStaggerSpan))
        local disappear = mt.ease.in_cubic(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, info.progress, kStaggerSpan))

        character.offset_y = 0.5 + (1.0 - appear) * 0.12
        character.scale = appear
        character.opacity = appear * (1.0 - disappear)
    end
end

name: BGD001_outline_fill_bands.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD001
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Outline Fill Bands
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "STAY HUNGRY\nKEEP MOVING\nNEVER STOP\nDREAM BIG\nDO MORE"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Row Length (chars)" default=64
-- @input number 4 "Scroll Speed (em/s)" default=2.5
-- @input number 5 "Outline Width (em)" default=0.04
-- @input color 1 "Fill Color" default={0.96,0.96,0.96,1}
-- @input color 2 "Outline Color" default={0.96,0.96,0.96,1}
--[[ @description
Each line of text repeats across the screen as a band, alternating filled and outlined rows that scroll in opposite directions.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
本文の1行を1本の帯として画面いっぱいに繰り返し、塗りと輪郭だけの帯を交互に並べて、1段ごとに逆向きへ流します。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途です。改行ごとの行が1段になり、同じ語を Row Length (chars) の文字数まで繰り返します。文字の大きさは Font Size、段の間隔は Line Spacing で決めます。大きくするときは画面を覆うよう Row Length (chars) を増やしてください。Scroll Speed (em/s) で流れる速さ、Outline Width (em) で輪郭の太さ、Fill Color と Outline Color で色を変えられます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。文字数の上限に収まるよう、段の長さは自動で縮めます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMaximumRows = 16
local kMinimumRowLength = 8
local kMaximumRowLength = 200
local kSeparator = "  "
local kMaximumSpeed = 20.0
local kMaximumOutline = 0.2

local unitLengths = {}

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local words = {}
    for line in ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local word = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if word ~= "" and #words < kMaximumRows then words[#words + 1] = word end
    end
    unitLengths = {}
    local budget = ctx.meta.limits.max_characters
    if #words > 0 then
        local rowLength = math.min(math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumRowLength, kMaximumRowLength)),
            math.floor(budget / #words))
        local rows, used = {}, 0
        for _, word in ipairs(words) do
            local unit = word .. kSeparator
            local unitLength = utf8.len(unit)
            local rowText = unit:rep(math.max(1, math.floor(rowLength / unitLength)))
            -- A row that does not fit whole is dropped: the host would otherwise cut the last rows mid-word.
            if used + utf8.len(rowText) > budget then break end
            used = used + utf8.len(rowText)
            rows[#rows + 1] = rowText
            unitLengths[#rows] = unitLength
        end
        ctx.global.text = table.concat(rows, "\n")
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local emWidth = (ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent) / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local outlineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, kMaximumOutline)
    for order, group in ipairs(mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)) do
        local unitLength = unitLengths[order]
        local items = group.items
        local period
        if unitLength and #items > unitLength then
            period = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, items[unitLength + 1]) - mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, items[1])
        end
        local shift = 0.0
        if period and period > 0.0 then
            local direction = order % 2 == 1 and -1.0 or 1.0
            -- Centered on zero so the row, which extends past the screen on both sides, always covers it.
            shift = direction * (((ctx.time * speed * emWidth) + period * 0.5) % period - period * 0.5)
        end
        local outlined = order % 2 == 0
        for _, character in ipairs(items) do
            local currentX, currentY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, currentX + shift, currentY)
            character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
            character.fill.use = true
            character.stroke.use = true
            if outlined then
                character.fill.color = { r = 0.0, g = 0.0, b = 0.0, a = 0.0 }
                character.stroke.width = outlineWidth
                character.stroke.color = ctx.inputs.colors[2]
            else
                character.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
                character.stroke.width = 0.0
            end
        end
    end
end

--[[ @description
Each line of text fills a row of a word wall; rows near the center scroll faster and shine brighter, giving the wall depth.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
本文の1行を1段として画面いっぱいの文字の壁を作ります。中央に近い段ほど速く流れて明るく、上下の端へ向かうほど遅く暗くなり、奥行きが出ます。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途です。改行ごとの行が1段になり、同じ語を Row Length (chars) の文字数まで繰り返します。文字の大きさは Font Size、段の間隔は Line Spacing で決めます。大きくするときは画面を覆うよう Row Length (chars) を増やしてください。Scroll Speed (em/s) は中央の段の速さ、Parallax で端の段との速度差、Edge Fade で端の段をどれだけ薄くするかを指定します。Center Color から Edge Color へ段ごとに色が移ります。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。文字数の上限に収まるよう、段の長さは自動で縮めます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMaximumRows = 16
local kMinimumRowLength = 8
local kMaximumRowLength = 200
local kSeparator = "  "
local kMaximumSpeed = 20.0

local unitLengths = {}

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local words = {}
    for line in ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local word = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if word ~= "" and #words < kMaximumRows then words[#words + 1] = word end
    end
    unitLengths = {}
    local budget = ctx.meta.limits.max_characters
    if #words > 0 then
        local rowLength = math.min(math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumRowLength, kMaximumRowLength)),
            math.floor(budget / #words))
        local rows, used = {}, 0
        for _, word in ipairs(words) do
            local unit = word .. kSeparator
            local unitLength = utf8.len(unit)
            local rowText = unit:rep(math.max(1, math.floor(rowLength / unitLength)))
            -- A row that does not fit whole is dropped: the host would otherwise cut the last rows mid-word.
            if used + utf8.len(rowText) > budget then break end
            used = used + utf8.len(rowText)
            rows[#rows + 1] = rowText
            unitLengths[#rows] = unitLength
        end
        ctx.global.text = table.concat(rows, "\n")
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local emWidth = (ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent) / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local parallax = mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[5])
    local fade = mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[6])
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for order, group in ipairs(groups) do
        -- 0 at the middle row, 1 at the first and last rows.
        local edge = #groups > 1 and math.abs((order - 1) / (#groups - 1) * 2.0 - 1.0) or 0.0
        local rowSpeed = speed * (1.0 - parallax * edge)
        local rowColor = mt.color.lerp_oklab(ctx.inputs.colors[1], ctx.inputs.colors[2], edge)
        local unitLength = unitLengths[order]
        local items = group.items
        local period
        if unitLength and #items > unitLength then
            period = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, items[unitLength + 1]) - mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, items[1])
        end
        local shift = 0.0
        if period and period > 0.0 then
            -- Centered on zero so the row, which extends past the screen on both sides, always covers it.
            shift = -(((ctx.time * rowSpeed * emWidth) + period * 0.5) % period - period * 0.5)
        end
        for _, character in ipairs(items) do
            local currentX, currentY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, currentX + shift, currentY)
            character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility * (1.0 - fade * edge)
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = rowColor
        end
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD003
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Diagonal Stripe Text
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "NEW ARRIVAL\nLIMITED EDITION\nSALE NOW ON\nDON'T MISS OUT\nSHOP TODAY\nFREE SHIPPING\nBEST SELLER"

-- @input number 4 "Scroll Speed (em/s)" default=1.5
-- @input number 5 "Angle (deg)" default=-20
-- @input color 1 "Stripe Color 1" default={1,0.35,0.45,1}
-- @input color 2 "Stripe Color 2" default={1,0.85,0.35,1}
--[[ @description
Each line of text becomes a tilted stripe; stripes alternate two colors and scroll in opposite directions.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
本文の1行を斜めの帯にして画面いっぱいに並べます。帯は2色を交互に使い、1本ごとに逆向きへ流れます。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途です。改行ごとの行が1段になり、同じ語を Row Length (chars) の文字数まで繰り返します。文字の大きさは Font Size、段の間隔は Line Spacing で決めます。大きくするときは画面を覆うよう Row Length (chars) を増やしてください。Scroll Speed (em/s) で流れる速さ、Angle (deg) で帯全体の傾き、Stripe Color 1・2 で帯の色を指定します。傾けると端が欠けやすいので、段数と Row Length (chars) を多めにしてください。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。文字数の上限に収まるよう、段の長さは自動で縮めます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMaximumRows = 16
local kMinimumRowLength = 8
local kMaximumRowLength = 200
local kSeparator = "  "
local kMaximumSpeed = 20.0
local kMaximumAngle = 90.0
local kCenter = 0.5

local unitLengths = {}

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local words = {}
    for line in ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local word = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if word ~= "" and #words < kMaximumRows then words[#words + 1] = word end
    end
    unitLengths = {}
    local budget = ctx.meta.limits.max_characters
    if #words > 0 then
        local rowLength = math.min(math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumRowLength, kMaximumRowLength)),
            math.floor(budget / #words))
        local rows, used = {}, 0
        for _, word in ipairs(words) do
            local unit = word .. kSeparator
            local unitLength = utf8.len(unit)
            local rowText = unit:rep(math.max(1, math.floor(rowLength / unitLength)))
            -- A row that does not fit whole is dropped: the host would otherwise cut the last rows mid-word.
            if used + utf8.len(rowText) > budget then break end
            used = used + utf8.len(rowText)
            rows[#rows + 1] = rowText
            unitLengths[#rows] = unitLength
        end
        ctx.global.text = table.concat(rows, "\n")
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local emWidth = (ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent) / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local angle = math.rad(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], -kMaximumAngle, kMaximumAngle))
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
    local aspect = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for order, group in ipairs(groups) do
        local direction = order % 2 == 1 and -1.0 or 1.0
        local rowColor = ctx.inputs.colors[order % 2 == 1 and 1 or 2]
        local unitLength = unitLengths[order]
        local items = group.items
        local period
        if unitLength and #items > unitLength then
            period = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, items[unitLength + 1]) - mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, items[1])
        end
        local shift = 0.0
        if period and period > 0.0 then
            -- Centered on zero so the row, which extends past the screen on both sides, always covers it.
            shift = direction * (((ctx.time * speed * emWidth) + period * 0.5) % period - period * 0.5)
        end
        for _, character in ipairs(items) do
            local currentX, currentY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
            -- Rotate the stripe layout about the screen center in aspect-corrected units.
            local offsetX, offsetY = (currentX + shift - kCenter) * aspect, currentY - kCenter
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, kCenter + (offsetX * cosine + offsetY * sine) / aspect,
                kCenter + (-offsetX * sine + offsetY * cosine))
            character.rotation = character.rotation + math.deg(angle)
            character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = rowColor
        end
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD004
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Bokeh Lights
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text ""
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6

--[[ @description
Out-of-focus points of light drift slowly upward in three depth layers, the far ones larger, softer and dimmer. The lights can take the shape of a circle, hexagon, heart or star.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
ピントの外れた光の玉が、奥・中・手前の3層でゆっくり昇っていく背景です。奥の層ほど大きく、強くぼけて、薄く見えます。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Bokeh Count で光の数、Size (%) で大きさの倍率、Softness でぼけの強さ、Rise Speed (Hz) で昇る速さ（負の値で降りてきます）を指定します。Shape で光の形を 1=円、2=六角形、3=ハート、4=星から選びます。どの形も同じ半径の円に収まるので、Size は形によらず同じ大きさになります。円以外は形が読み取れるよう、Size (%) を大きめにしてください。Background Color が下地、Far・Mid・Near Light Color が奥・中・手前の光の色です。光は画面の外から現れて外へ抜けます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを4つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 4
local kMaximumCount = 120
local kMinimumSize = 20.0
local kMaximumSize = 300.0
local kMaximumSpeed = 1.0
local kMaximumSoftness = 1.0
local kShapeCount = 4
local kStarInner = 0.45
local kPointSteps = 12
local kBlurScale = 2.2
-- Layers run bottom to top: the background, then the far, middle and near lights.
local kLayerBlur = { 0.0, 0.7, 0.4, 0.15 }
local kLayerOpacity = { 1.0, 0.5, 0.66, 0.86 }
local kLayerShare = { 0.25, 0.35, 0.40 }
local kLayerRadius = { 0.115, 0.07, 0.04 }
local kLayerSpeed = { 0.5, 0.8, 1.2 }
local kSwayShare = 0.4
local kEdgeMargin = 0.04
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
-- The factors are worked out once, because dense patterns call point() thousands of times a frame.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local middleX, middleY = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5, kScreenUnits * 0.5
    local divideX = ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x
    local divideY = ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX, differenceY = horizontal - middleX, vertical - middleY
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / divideX, (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / divideY
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

-- Every shape fits the circle of the given radius, so Size means the same for all of them.
local function shape(path, kind, centerX, centerY, radius)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        if kind == 1 then
            circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius)
        elseif kind == 2 then
            local points = {}
            for corner = 0, 5 do
                local angle = kTau * corner / 6.0 + kTau / 12.0
                points[#points + 1] = { x = centerX + math.cos(angle) * radius, y = centerY + math.sin(angle) * radius }
            end
            polygon(path, points)
        elseif kind == 3 then
            local points = {}
            for step = 0, kPointSteps * 4 - 1 do
                local angle = kTau * step / (kPointSteps * 4)
                local heartX = 16.0 * math.sin(angle) ^ 3
                local heartY = 13.0 * math.cos(angle) - 5.0 * math.cos(2.0 * angle) - 2.0 * math.cos(3.0 * angle) - math.cos(4.0 * angle)
                points[#points + 1] = { x = centerX + heartX / 17.0 * radius, y = centerY - (heartY - 2.0) / 17.0 * radius }
            end
            polygon(path, points)
        else
            local points = {}
            for corner = 0, 9 do
                local angle = kTau * corner / 10.0 - math.pi * 0.5
                local reach = (corner % 2 == 0) and radius or radius * kStarInner
                points[#points + 1] = { x = centerX + math.cos(angle) * reach, y = centerY + math.sin(angle) * reach }
            end
            polygon(path, points)
        end
    end
end

local function rectangle(path, left, top, width, height)
    polygon(path, { { x = left, y = top }, { x = left + width, y = top },
        { x = left + width, y = top + height }, { x = left, y = top + height } })
end
local function hash(first, second)
    local value = math.sin(first * 127.1 + second * 311.7) * 43758.5453
    return value - math.floor(value)
end
local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    return ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    local softness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, kMaximumSoftness) * kBlurScale * kLayerBlur[slot]
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = softness, softness
    layer.opacity = visibility * kLayerOpacity[slot]
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local total = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0, kMaximumCount))
    local scale = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], kMinimumSize, kMaximumSize) * 0.01
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local kind = mt.clamp(math.floor(ctx.inputs.numbers[7] + 0.5), 1, kShapeCount)
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    for depth = 1, 3 do
        for index = 1, math.ceil(total * kLayerShare[depth]) do
            local seed = depth * 1000 + index
            local radius = height * kLayerRadius[depth] * (0.7 + 0.6 * hash(seed, 1.3)) * scale
            -- A light enters fully below the screen and leaves fully above it, so wrapping never shows.
            local travel = (hash(seed, 2.1) + ctx.time * speed * kLayerSpeed[depth]) % 1.0
            local y = height + radius - travel * (height + radius * 2.0)
            local x = width * (kEdgeMargin + (1.0 - 2.0 * kEdgeMargin) * hash(seed, 3.7))
                + math.sin(kTau * (travel * 1.5 + hash(seed, 5.2))) * radius * kSwayShare
            shape(layers[depth + 1], kind, x, y, radius)
        end
    end
end

-- @author Mug

-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text ""

-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Firefly Count" default=40
-- @input number 4 "Size (%)" default=100
-- @input number 5 "Softness" default=0.5
-- @input number 6 "Drift Speed (Hz)" default=0.03
-- @input number 7 "Blink Speed (Hz)" default=0.12
-- @input color 1 "Background Color" default={0.02,0.05,0.07,1}
-- @input color 2 "Far Light Color" default={0.30,0.58,0.38,1}
-- @input color 3 "Mid Light Color" default={0.62,0.90,0.30,1}
-- @input color 4 "Near Light Color" default={1.0,0.98,0.48,1}
--[[ @description
Soft points of light wander slowly and blink on and off in three depth layers, like fireflies over a dark night field.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
やわらかい光の点が、奥・中・手前の3層でゆっくり漂いながら明滅する、夜の草むらの蛍のような背景です。奥の層ほど強くぼけて、薄く見えます。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Firefly Count で光の数、Size (%) で大きさの倍率、Softness でぼけの強さ、Drift Speed (Hz) で漂う速さ、Blink Speed (Hz) で明滅の速さを指定します。Background Color が下地、Far・Mid・Near Light Color が奥・中・手前の光の色です。光は点ごとにずれたタイミングで、小さく消えては大きく灯ります。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを4つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 4
local kMaximumCount = 120
local kMinimumSize = 20.0
local kMaximumSize = 300.0
local kMaximumSpeed = 1.0
local kMaximumBlinkSpeed = 3.0
local kMaximumSoftness = 1.0
local kBlurScale = 2.2
-- Layers run bottom to top: the background, then the far, middle and near lights.
local kLayerBlur = { 0.0, 0.7, 0.4, 0.15 }
local kLayerOpacity = { 1.0, 0.5, 0.66, 0.86 }
local kLayerShare = { 0.25, 0.35, 0.40 }
local kLayerRadius = { 0.05, 0.034, 0.022 }
local kLayerSpeed = { 0.5, 0.8, 1.2 }
-- How far a light wanders from its home, as a share of the screen height.
local kWanderShare = 0.12
local kEdgeMargin = 0.04
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
-- The factors are worked out once, because dense patterns call point() thousands of times a frame.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local middleX, middleY = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5, kScreenUnits * 0.5
    local divideX = ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x
    local divideY = ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX, differenceY = horizontal - middleX, vertical - middleY
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / divideX, (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / divideY
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function rectangle(path, left, top, width, height)
    polygon(path, { { x = left, y = top }, { x = left + width, y = top },
        { x = left + width, y = top + height }, { x = left, y = top + height } })
end
local function hash(first, second)
    local value = math.sin(first * 127.1 + second * 311.7) * 43758.5453
    return value - math.floor(value)
end
local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    return ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    local softness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, kMaximumSoftness) * kBlurScale * kLayerBlur[slot]
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = softness, softness
    layer.opacity = visibility * kLayerOpacity[slot]
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end

end

function OnPath(ctx)

    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local total = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0, kMaximumCount))
    local scale = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], kMinimumSize, kMaximumSize) * 0.01
    local drift = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD006
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title City Bokeh
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text ""
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Light Count" default=60
-- @input number 4 "Size (%)" default=100
-- @input number 5 "Softness" default=0.5
-- @input number 6 "Pan Speed (Hz)" default=0.02
-- @input number 7 "Band Center (% height)" default=60
-- @input number 8 "Band Height (% height)" default=34
-- @input color 1 "Background Color" default={0.02,0.03,0.08,1}
-- @input color 2 "Far Light Color" default={0.30,0.50,1.0,1}
-- @input color 3 "Mid Light Color" default={1.0,0.52,0.24,1}
-- @input color 4 "Near Light Color" default={1.0,0.84,0.62,1}
--[[ @description
Out-of-focus city lights gather in a horizontal band and pan slowly sideways in three depth layers, like a night street seen through a lens.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
ピントの外れた街の灯りが、横長の帯に集まり、奥・中・手前の3層でゆっくり横へ流れる、夜景のような背景です。奥の層ほど強くぼけて、薄く見えます。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Light Count で光の数、Size (%) で大きさの倍率、Softness でぼけの強さ、Pan Speed (Hz) で横に流れる速さ（負の値で逆向き）、Band Center (% height) で帯の中心の高さ、Band Height (% height) で帯の厚みを指定します。Background Color が下地、Far・Mid・Near Light Color が奥・中・手前の光の色です。光は画面の外から現れて外へ抜け、ゆっくり明るさが揺れます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを4つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 4
local kMaximumCount = 120
local kMinimumSize = 20.0
local kMaximumSize = 300.0
local kMaximumSpeed = 1.0
local kMaximumTwinkle = 0.3
local kMaximumSoftness = 1.0
local kBlurScale = 2.2
-- Layers run bottom to top: the background, then the far, middle and near lights.
local kLayerBlur = { 0.0, 0.7, 0.4, 0.15 }
local kLayerOpacity = { 1.0, 0.5, 0.66, 0.86 }
local kLayerShare = { 0.25, 0.35, 0.40 }
local kLayerRadius = { 0.085, 0.052, 0.03 }
local kLayerSpeed = { 0.4, 0.7, 1.1 }
local kTwinkleSpeed = 0.35
local kEdgeMargin = 0.04
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
-- The factors are worked out once, because dense patterns call point() thousands of times a frame.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local middleX, middleY = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5, kScreenUnits * 0.5
    local divideX = ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x
    local divideY = ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX, differenceY = horizontal - middleX, vertical - middleY
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / divideX, (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / divideY
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function rectangle(path, left, top, width, height)
    polygon(path, { { x = left, y = top }, { x = left + width, y = top },
        { x = left + width, y = top + height }, { x = left, y = top + height } })
end
local function hash(first, second)
    local value = math.sin(first * 127.1 + second * 311.7) * 43758.5453
    return value - math.floor(value)
end
local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    return ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end

        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    local softness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, kMaximumSoftness) * kBlurScale * kLayerBlur[slot]
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = softness, softness
    layer.opacity = visibility * kLayerOpacity[slot]
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local total = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0, kMaximumCount))
    local scale = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], kMinimumSize, kMaximumSize) * 0.01
    local pan = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local bandCenter = height * mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 100.0) * 0.01
    local bandHeight = height * mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 100.0) * 0.01
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    for depth = 1, 3 do
        for index = 1, math.ceil(total * kLayerShare[depth]) do
            local seed = depth * 1000 + index
            local radius = height * kLayerRadius[depth] * (0.6 + 0.8 * hash(seed, 1.3)) * scale
            -- A light enters fully past one edge and leaves fully past the other, so wrapping never shows.
            local travel = (hash(seed, 2.1) + ctx.time * pan * kLayerSpeed[depth]) % 1.0
            local x = -radius + travel * (width + radius * 2.0)
            -- Nearer lights spread over a taller part of the band, which reads as depth.
            local y = bandCenter + (hash(seed, 4.9) - 0.5) * bandHeight * (0.6 + 0.2 * depth)
            local twinkle = 1.0 - kMaximumTwinkle * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(kTau * (ctx.time * kTwinkleSpeed + hash(seed, 6.1))))
            circle(layers[depth + 1], x, y, radius * twinkle)
        end
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    local softness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, kMaximumSoftness) * kBlurScale * kLayerBlur[slot]
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = softness, softness
    layer.opacity = visibility * kLayerOpacity[slot]
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then

        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end

        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local total = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0, kMaximumCount))
    local scale = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], kMinimumSize, kMaximumSize) * 0.01
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local thickness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], kMinimumThickness, kMaximumThickness) * 0.01
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    for depth = 1, 3 do
        for index = 1, math.ceil(total * kLayerShare[depth]) do
            local seed = depth * 1000 + index
            local breath = 1.0 + kBreathShare * math.sin(kTau * (ctx.time * kBreathSpeed + hash(seed, 6.1)))
            local radius = height * kLayerRadius[depth] * (0.6 + 0.8 * hash(seed, 1.3)) * scale * breath
            -- A bubble enters fully below the screen and leaves fully above it, so wrapping never shows.
            local travel = (hash(seed, 2.1) + ctx.time * speed * kLayerSpeed[depth]) % 1.0
            local y = height + radius - travel * (height + radius * 2.0)
            local x = width * (kEdgeMargin + (1.0 - 2.0 * kEdgeMargin) * hash(seed, 3.7))
                + math.sin(kTau * (travel * 2.0 + hash(seed, 5.2))) * radius * kSwayShare
            -- The inner circle is a hole, so only a ring of the given thickness is filled.
            circle(layers[depth + 1], x, y, radius)
            circle(layers[depth + 1], x, y, radius * (1.0 - thickness), true)
        end
    end
end

--[[ @description
Snow falls in three depth layers and sways in the wind: the far flakes are small, faintly soft and dim, the near ones large, soft and bright.

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 4
local kMaximumCount = 400
local kMinimumSize = 20.0
local kMaximumSize = 300.0
local kMaximumSpeed = 1.0
local kMaximumSoftness = 1.0
local kBlurScale = 2.2
-- Layers run bottom to top: the background, then the far, middle and near flakes; the near ones are out of focus.
local kLayerBlur = { 0.0, 0.05, 0.08, 0.22 }
local kLayerOpacity = { 1.0, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0 }
local kLayerShare = { 0.5, 0.33, 0.17 }
local kLayerRadius = { 0.008, 0.014, 0.03 }
local kLayerSpeed = { 0.5, 0.8, 1.3 }

local kSwayCycles = 3.0

    if radius > kEpsilon then

        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
-- The factors are worked out once, because dense patterns call point() thousands of times a frame.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local middleX, middleY = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5, kScreenUnits * 0.5
    local divideX = ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x
    local divideY = ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX, differenceY = horizontal - middleX, vertical - middleY
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / divideX, (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / divideY
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function rectangle(path, left, top, width, height)
    polygon(path, { { x = left, y = top }, { x = left + width, y = top },
        { x = left + width, y = top + height }, { x = left, y = top + height } })
end
local function hash(first, second)
    local value = math.sin(first * 127.1 + second * 311.7) * 43758.5453
    return value - math.floor(value)
end
local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    return ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0

    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0

        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do

    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)

        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local total = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0, kMaximumCount))
    local scale = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], kMinimumSize, kMaximumSize) * 0.01
    local fall = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local wind = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    for depth = 1, 3 do
        for index = 1, math.ceil(total * kLayerShare[depth]) do
            local seed = depth * 1000 + index

            -- A flake enters fully above the screen and leaves fully below it, and wind carries it fully past

            local y = -radius + travel * (height + radius * 2.0)
            local across = (hash(seed, 3.7) + ctx.time * wind * kLayerSpeed[depth]) % 1.0
            local x = -radius + across * (width + radius * 2.0)

            circle(layers[depth + 1], x, y, radius)
        end
    end
end

end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    local softness = mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[5]) * kBlurPerSoftness
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = softness, softness
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height)
    local size = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumSize, kMaximumSize) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, kMaximumSpeed)
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
        local phase = kTau * (ctx.time * speed + slot / kLayerCount)
        local x = width * (0.5 + 0.32 * math.sin(phase * (1.0 + slot * 0.13) + slot))
        local y = height * (0.5 + 0.30 * math.cos(phase * (0.9 + slot * 0.11) + slot * 2.0))
        circle(layers[slot], x, y, size * 0.5)
    end
end
