source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD010
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Wagara Patterns
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text ""
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Pattern (1=Shippo 2=Seigaiha)" default=1
-- @input number 4 "Pattern Size (% height)" default=14
-- @input number 5 "Scroll Speed (Hz)" default=0.03
-- @input number 6 "Line Width (% of size)" default=7
-- @input color 1 "Background Color" default={0.10,0.16,0.38,1}
-- @input color 2 "Pattern Color" default={0.90,0.93,1.0,1}
-- @input color 3 "Accent Color" default={0.95,0.62,0.30,1}
--[[ @description
Traditional Japanese patterns, Shippo rings or Seigaiha waves, drift slowly across the screen in a calm two-tone design.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
七宝（円が重なる模様）や青海波（波を表す同心円の弧が重なる模様）といった和柄が、2色のおだやかな配色で、ゆっくり斜めに流れていく背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Pattern (1=Shippo 2=Seigaiha) で模様、Pattern Size (% height) で模様の大きさ、Scroll Speed (Hz) で流れる速さ（負の値で逆向き）、Line Width (% of size) で線の太さを指定します。Background Color が下地、Pattern Color が模様の線、Accent Color が七宝の交点の飾りと、青海波の一番内側の弧です。模様は画面の外まで敷かれて全体を覆い、1周期ぶん流れると、まったく同じ形に戻ります。青海波は弧が多いので、小さくしすぎても一定より細かくなりません。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを3つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 3
local kMinimumSize = 6.0
local kMinimumSeigaihaSize = 12.0
local kMaximumSize = 40.0
local kMaximumSpeed = 1.0
local kMaximumLineWidth = 30.0
local kMargin = 2
local kRingRadiusRatio = math.sqrt(0.5)
local kAccentRatio = 0.14
local kSeigaihaRadiusRatio = 0.6
local kSeigaihaRingShares = { 0.96, 0.72, 0.48 }
local kSeigaihaRowMargin = 4
local kQuarterTurn = math.pi * 0.5
local kFullTurn = math.pi * 2.0
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
-- The factors are worked out once, because dense patterns call point() thousands of times a frame.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local middleX, middleY = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5, kScreenUnits * 0.5
    local divideX = ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x
    local divideY = ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX, differenceY = horizontal - middleX, vertical - middleY
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / divideX, (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / divideY
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function rectangle(path, left, top, width, height)
    polygon(path, { { x = left, y = top }, { x = left + width, y = top },
        { x = left + width, y = top + height }, { x = left, y = top + height } })
end
-- A ring as one outline out and one back in, so overlapping rings never cancel one another under the nonzero rule.
local function ring(path, centerX, centerY, outer, inner)
    circle(path, centerX, centerY, outer)
    circle(path, centerX, centerY, inner, true)
end

-- One arc of a ring as a band: the outer edge forward and the inner edge back, wound like circle(). Each quarter turn
-- is one cubic, because a dense pattern has thousands of arcs and every point costs script time.
local function arcBand(path, centerX, centerY, inner, outer, from, to)
    local segments = math.max(1, math.ceil((to - from) / kQuarterTurn))
    local delta = (to - from) / segments
    local handle = 4.0 / 3.0 * math.tan(delta / 4.0)
    local cosines, sines = {}, {}
    for index = 0, segments do
        local angle = from + index * delta
        cosines[index], sines[index] = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
    end
    path:move_to(centerX + cosines[0] * outer, centerY + sines[0] * outer)
    for index = 1, segments do
        local previous = index - 1
        path:cubic_to(centerX + (cosines[previous] - sines[previous] * handle) * outer, centerY + (sines[previous] + cosines[previous] * handle) * outer,
            centerX + (cosines[index] + sines[index] * handle) * outer, centerY + (sines[index] - cosines[index] * handle) * outer,
            centerX + cosines[index] * outer, centerY + sines[index] * outer)
    end
    path:line_to(centerX + cosines[segments] * inner, centerY + sines[segments] * inner)
    for index = segments, 1, -1 do
        local previous = index - 1
        path:cubic_to(centerX + (cosines[index] + sines[index] * handle) * inner, centerY + (sines[index] - cosines[index] * handle) * inner,
            centerX + (cosines[previous] - sines[previous] * handle) * inner, centerY + (sines[previous] + cosines[previous] * handle) * inner,
            centerX + cosines[previous] * inner, centerY + sines[previous] * inner)
    end
    path:close()
end

-- The arcs of a ring that stay visible when discs of the given radius are drawn over it. Each disc hides the stretch
-- of the ring it contains, found from the law of cosines; the rest is the gaps between those stretches.
local function visibleArcs(centerX, centerY, radius, hiders, discRadius)
    local hidden = {}
    local covered = false
    for _, hider in ipairs(hiders) do
        local differenceX, differenceY = hider.x - centerX, hider.y - centerY
        local distance = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        local cosine = (radius * radius + distance * distance - discRadius * discRadius) / (2.0 * radius * distance)
        if cosine <= -1.0 then
            covered = true
        elseif cosine < 1.0 then
            local middle, half = math.atan(differenceY, differenceX), math.acos(cosine)
            local from, to = middle - half, middle + half
            if from < 0.0 then
                hidden[#hidden + 1] = { from + kFullTurn, kFullTurn }
                hidden[#hidden + 1] = { 0.0, to }
            elseif to > kFullTurn then
                hidden[#hidden + 1] = { from, kFullTurn }
                hidden[#hidden + 1] = { 0.0, to - kFullTurn }
            else
                hidden[#hidden + 1] = { from, to }
            end
        end
    end
    local arcs = {}
    if not covered then
        table.sort(hidden, function(first, second) return first[1] < second[1] end)
        local cursor = 0.0
        for _, interval in ipairs(hidden) do
            if interval[1] > cursor then arcs[#arcs + 1] = { cursor, interval[1] } end
            cursor = math.max(cursor, interval[2])
        end
        if cursor < kFullTurn then arcs[#arcs + 1] = { cursor, kFullTurn } end
    end
    return arcs
end
local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    return ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local pattern = math.floor(ctx.inputs.numbers[3] + 0.5)
    local minimum = pattern == 2 and kMinimumSeigaihaSize or kMinimumSize
    local size = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], minimum, kMaximumSize) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local lineShare = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, kMaximumLineWidth) * 0.01
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    -- One lattice step maps either pattern onto itself, so the scroll loops exactly when the travel wraps.
    local travel = (ctx.time * speed) % 1.0
    if pattern == 2 then
        -- Seigaiha: discs of radius R in rows R/2 apart, alternate rows shifted by R. Each is drawn over the discs
        -- above it, so only its upper part shows; its rings are cut where the discs of later rows cover them.
        local radius = size * kSeigaihaRadiusRatio
        local rowHeight = radius * 0.5
        local columns, rows = math.ceil(width / (radius * 2.0)) + kMargin, math.ceil(height / rowHeight) + kSeigaihaRowMargin
        local shiftX, shiftY = travel * radius, travel * rowHeight
        local halfLine = radius * lineShare * 0.5
        for row = -kSeigaihaRowMargin, rows do
            for column = -kMargin, columns do
                local centerX = column * radius * 2.0 + (row % 2) * radius + shiftX
                local centerY = row * rowHeight + shiftY
                -- A disc matters only where its upper part reaches the screen.
                if centerX > -radius and centerX < width + radius and centerY > -radius and centerY < height + radius then
                    local hiders = {}
                    for later = 1, 4 do
                        local laterRow = row + later
                        for offset = -1, 1 do
                            local hiderX = (column + offset) * radius * 2.0 + (laterRow % 2) * radius + shiftX
                            local hiderY = laterRow * rowHeight + shiftY
                            if math.sqrt((hiderX - centerX) ^ 2 + (hiderY - centerY) ^ 2) < radius * 2.0 then
                                hiders[#hiders + 1] = { x = hiderX, y = hiderY }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if lineShare > kEpsilon then
                        for ringIndex, share in ipairs(kSeigaihaRingShares) do
                            -- The innermost ring takes the accent color.
                            local path = ringIndex == #kSeigaihaRingShares and layers[3] or layers[2]
                            for _, arc in ipairs(visibleArcs(centerX, centerY, radius * share, hiders, radius)) do
                                arcBand(path, centerX, centerY, radius * share - halfLine, radius * share + halfLine, arc[1], arc[2])
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        local columns, rows = math.ceil(width / size) + kMargin, math.ceil(height / size) + kMargin
        local shift = travel * size
        local outer = size * kRingRadiusRatio
        local inner = math.max(outer - size * lineShare, 0.0)
        for row = -kMargin, rows do
            for column = -kMargin, columns do
                local x, y = column * size + shift, row * size + shift
                if lineShare > kEpsilon then ring(layers[2], x, y, outer, inner) end
                -- The four neighboring rings all cross at the middle of the cell, where the accent sits.
                circle(layers[3], x + size * 0.5, y + size * 0.5, size * kAccentRatio)
            end
        end
    end
end
description: Traditional Japanese patterns, Shippo rings or Seigaiha waves, drift slowly across the screen in a calm two-tone design.

descriptions.ja:
七宝（円が重なる模様）や青海波（波を表す同心円の弧が重なる模様）といった和柄が、2色のおだやかな配色で、ゆっくり斜めに流れていく背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Pattern (1=Shippo 2=Seigaiha) で模様、Pattern Size (% height) で模様の大きさ、Scroll Speed (Hz) で流れる速さ（負の値で逆向き）、Line Width (% of size) で線の太さを指定します。Background Color が下地、Pattern Color が模様の線、Accent Color が七宝の交点の飾りと、青海波の一番内側の弧です。模様は画面の外まで敷かれて全体を覆い、1周期ぶん流れると、まったく同じ形に戻ります。青海波は弧が多いので、小さくしすぎても一定より細かくなりません。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを3つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD011
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Floating Shapes
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text ""
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Shape Count" default=28
-- @input number 4 "Size (% height)" default=10
-- @input number 5 "Rise Speed (Hz)" default=0.08
-- @input number 6 "Spin" default=0.3
-- @input color 1 "Circle Color" default={0.98,0.62,0.66,1}
-- @input color 2 "Triangle Color" default={0.99,0.82,0.45,1}
-- @input color 3 "Square Color" default={0.55,0.78,0.95,1}
--[[ @description
Circles, triangles and squares drift up the screen, growing, spinning and shrinking away.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
円・三角・四角がゆっくり画面を昇りながら大きくなり、回って、また小さく消えていきます。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Shape Count で数、Size (% height) で大きさ、Rise Speed (Hz) で昇る速さ、Spin で回転の強さを指定します。形ごとに Circle Color・Triangle Color・Square Color を使います。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを3つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 3
local kMaximumCount = 80
local kMaximumSize = 30.0
local kMaximumRiseSpeed = 1.0
local kMaximumSpin = 2.0
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

local function hash(seed)
    local value = math.sin(seed * 127.1 + 311.7) * 43758.5453
    return value - math.floor(value)
end

local function shape(path, kind, centerX, centerY, radius, angle)
    if kind == 0 then
        circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius)
    else
        local corners = kind == 1 and 3 or 4
        local points = {}
        for corner = 0, corners - 1 do
            local direction = angle + corner / corners * kTau
            points[#points + 1] = { x = centerX + math.cos(direction) * radius, y = centerY + math.sin(direction) * radius }
        end
        polygon(path, points)
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height)
    local count = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0, kMaximumCount))
    local size = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, kMaximumSize) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local riseSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, kMaximumRiseSpeed)
    local spin = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, kMaximumSpin)
    for index = 1, count do
        local sizeShare, columnShare, speedShare, phaseShare, spinShare =
            hash(index), hash(index + 100), hash(index + 200), hash(index + 300), hash(index + 400)
        local travel = (phaseShare + ctx.time * riseSpeed * (0.5 + speedShare)) % 1.0
        -- The radius closes to zero at both ends of the rise, so the return from the top to the bottom is invisible.
        local radius = size * (0.4 + 0.6 * sizeShare) * math.sin(math.pi * travel)
        local sway = mt.saturate(columnShare + 0.05 * math.sin(kTau * (travel + spinShare)))
        local centerX = radius + (width - radius * 2.0) * sway
        local centerY = height - radius - (height - radius * 2.0) * travel
        local angle = kTau * spinShare + ctx.time * spin * (spinShare - 0.5) * kTau
        shape(layers[index % 3 + 1], index % 3, centerX, centerY, radius, angle)
    end
end

-- @author Mug

-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Tile Size (% height)" default=16
-- @input number 4 "Change Interval (s)" default=1.6

-- @input color 4 "Tile Color 3" default={0.13,0.30,0.68,1}
--[[ @description
A grid of geometric tiles keeps popping into new shapes and turns in a staggered wave, in a Bauhaus palette.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
四分円・半円・円・四角・三角のタイルが、時間差の波で次々に別の形や向きへ入れ替わるバウハウス風の背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Tile Size (% height) でタイルの大きさ、Change Interval (s) で入れ替わる間隔、Wave Delay でタイルごとの時間差を指定します。Background Color が下地、Tile Color 1〜3 がタイルの色です。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを4つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 4
local kMinimumTile = 6.0
local kMaximumTile = 40.0
local kMinimumInterval = 0.2
local kShapeCount = 5
local kArcSteps = 14
local kGrowShare = 0.2
local kShrinkShare = 0.15
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function hash(first, second)
    local value = math.sin(first * 127.1 + second * 311.7) * 43758.5453
    return value - math.floor(value)
end
local function rectangle(path, left, top, width, height)
    polygon(path, { { x = left, y = top }, { x = left + width, y = top },
        { x = left + width, y = top + height }, { x = left, y = top + height } })
end
-- Outlines of the tile shapes in a square of half-size `half` around the origin, before orientation.
local function shapeOutline(kind, half)
    local points = {}
    local function arc(centerX, centerY, radius, from, to)
        for step = 0, kArcSteps do
            local angle = mt.lerp(from, to, step / kArcSteps)
            points[#points + 1] = { x = centerX + math.cos(angle) * radius, y = centerY + math.sin(angle) * radius }
        end
    end
    if kind == 0 then
        points[1] = { x = -half, y = -half }
        arc(-half, -half, half * 2.0, 0.0, math.pi * 0.5)
    elseif kind == 1 then
        arc(0.0, 0.0, half, math.pi, kTau)
    elseif kind == 2 then
        arc(0.0, 0.0, half, 0.0, kTau - kTau / kArcSteps)
    elseif kind == 3 then
        points = { { x = -half, y = -half }, { x = half, y = -half }, { x = half, y = half }, { x = -half, y = half } }
    else
        points = { { x = -half, y = -half }, { x = half, y = -half }, { x = -half, y = half } }
    end
    return points
end
local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    return ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local tile = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumTile, kMaximumTile) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local interval = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], kMinimumInterval)
    local delay = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 1.0)
    local side = tile
    local rows, columns = math.ceil(height / side), math.ceil(width / side)
    -- The grid bleeds past the screen edges evenly instead of leaving a strip of background at them.
    local left, top = (width - columns * side) * 0.5, (height - rows * side) * 0.5
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    for row = 0, rows - 1 do
        for column = 0, columns - 1 do
            local clock = ctx.time / interval + (column + row) * delay
            local step, share = math.floor(clock), clock % 1.0
            local seed = column + row * 57 + step * 131
            local scale = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate(share / kGrowShare))
                * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((share - 1.0 + kShrinkShare) / kShrinkShare)))
            if scale > kEpsilon then
                local kind = math.floor(hash(seed, 1.7) * kShapeCount)
                local turns = math.floor(hash(seed, 5.3) * 4)
                local layer = layers[2 + math.floor(hash(seed, 9.1) * 3)]
                local angle = turns * math.pi * 0.5
                local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
                local centerX, centerY = left + (column + 0.5) * side, top + (row + 0.5) * side
                local points = {}
                for _, point in ipairs(shapeOutline(kind, side * 0.5 * scale)) do
                    points[#points + 1] = { x = centerX + point.x * cosine - point.y * sine,
                        y = centerY + point.x * sine + point.y * cosine }
                end
                polygon(layer, points)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD013
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Synthwave Horizon
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text ""
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Horizon (% height)" default=58
-- @input number 4 "Sun Size (% height)" default=26
-- @input number 5 "Grid Speed (Hz)" default=0.5
-- @input number 6 "Glow" default=0.7
-- @input color 1 "Sky Color" default={0.09,0.03,0.20,1}
-- @input color 2 "Sun Color" default={1.0,0.42,0.38,1}
-- @input color 3 "Grid Color" default={0.25,0.88,0.98,1}
-- @input color 4 "Glow Color" default={0.85,0.20,0.72,1}
--[[ @description
A striped retro sun sits on the horizon above a glowing perspective grid that streams toward the viewer.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
地平線に横縞の入った夕日が浮かび、手前へ流れてくる遠近法のグリッドが光る、シンセウェーブ風の背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Horizon (% height) で地平線の高さ、Sun Size (% height) で太陽の大きさ、Grid Speed (Hz) でグリッドの流れる速さ（負の値で奥へ）、Glow で太陽のにじみの強さを指定します。Sky Color が空と下地、Sun Color が太陽、Grid Color がグリッド、Glow Color がにじみの色です。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを4つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 4
local kMinimumHorizon = 30.0
local kMaximumHorizon = 80.0
local kMaximumSun = 50.0
local kMaximumGridSpeed = 4.0
local kGlowBlur = 1.8
local kGlowRadiusRatio = 1.5
local kStripeCount = 8
local kSliceSteps = 10
local kVerticalLines = 14
local kHorizontalLines = 12
local kPerspective = 0.45
local kLineWidthRatio = 0.006
local kSunLiftRatio = 0.3
local kMinimumGap = 0.08
local kMaximumGapShare = 0.6
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function rectangle(path, left, top, width, height)
    polygon(path, { { x = left, y = top }, { x = left + width, y = top },
        { x = left + width, y = top + height }, { x = left, y = top + height } })
end
-- The part of a disc between two heights, with the arcs sampled on both sides.
local function discSlice(path, centerX, centerY, radius, top, bottom)
    local points = {}
    local function halfWidth(y)
        return math.sqrt(math.max(radius * radius - (y - centerY) ^ 2, 0.0))
    end
    for step = 0, kSliceSteps do
        local y = mt.lerp(top, bottom, step / kSliceSteps)
        points[#points + 1] = { x = centerX + halfWidth(y), y = y }
    end
    for step = kSliceSteps, 0, -1 do
        local y = mt.lerp(top, bottom, step / kSliceSteps)
        points[#points + 1] = { x = centerX - halfWidth(y), y = y }
    end
    polygon(path, points)
end
-- Layers run bottom to top: sky, glow, sun, grid.
local kLayerColors = { 1, 4, 2, 3 }

local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    return ctx.inputs.colors[kLayerColors[slot]]
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    if slot == 2 then
        local glow = mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[6]) * kGlowBlur
        layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = glow, glow
        layer.opacity = visibility * mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[6])
    end
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local horizon = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumHorizon, kMaximumHorizon) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local radius = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, kMaximumSun) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], -kMaximumGridSpeed, kMaximumGridSpeed)
    local centerX = width * 0.5
    local sunCenterY = horizon - radius * kSunLiftRatio
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        circle(layers[2], centerX, sunCenterY, radius * kGlowRadiusRatio)
        -- Slices shrink toward the bottom while the gaps between them widen, which reads as the sun's stripes.
        local top = sunCenterY - radius
        local span = horizon - top
        local cursor = top
        for stripe = 0, kStripeCount - 1 do
            local share = stripe / kStripeCount
            local gap = span / kStripeCount * (kMinimumGap + kMaximumGapShare * share * share)
            local slice = span / kStripeCount - gap
            discSlice(layers[3], centerX, sunCenterY, radius, cursor, math.min(cursor + slice, horizon))
            cursor = cursor + slice + gap
        end
    end
    local floor = height - horizon
    local lineWidth = height * kLineWidthRatio
    for index = -kVerticalLines, kVerticalLines do
        local reach = lineWidth * 0.5
        local bottomX = mt.clamp(centerX + index * width / kVerticalLines * 0.5, reach, width - reach)
        polygon(layers[4], { { x = centerX - 0.2, y = horizon }, { x = centerX + 0.2, y = horizon },
            { x = bottomX + reach, y = height }, { x = bottomX - reach, y = height } })
    end
    local scroll = (ctx.time * speed) % 1.0
    for line = 0, kHorizontalLines do
        local depth = line - scroll
        if depth >= 0.0 then
            local near = 1.0 / (1.0 + depth * kPerspective * depth * 0.35)
            local y = horizon + floor * near
            local thickness = lineWidth * (0.3 + near)
            if y + thickness * 0.5 <= height and y - thickness * 0.5 >= horizon then
                rectangle(layers[4], 0, y - thickness * 0.5, width, thickness)
            end
        end
    end
end

    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local sides = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumSides, kMaximumSides) + 0.5)
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local twist = math.rad(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], -kMaximumTwist, kMaximumTwist))
    local spin = math.rad(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], -kMaximumSpin, kMaximumSpin))
    local centerRadius = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], kMinimumCenter, kMaximumCenter) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local centerX, centerY = width * 0.5, height * 0.5
    local reach = math.sqrt(centerX * centerX + centerY * centerY) * kOuterRatio
    local travel = (ctx.time * speed) % 2.0
    -- Two rings make one period of the colors, so the pattern repeats exactly when the travel wraps.
    local shift = travel % 1.0
    local parity = math.floor(travel)
    -- Rings stop shortly after they shrink below the center polygon, which hides them: no tiny, fast shapes, and
    -- no visible change where one ring takes over from the next.
    local ringCount = math.ceil(math.log(centerRadius / reach) / math.log(kShrinkRatio)) + kHiddenRings
    for ring = 0, ringCount - 1 do
        local outerScale = kShrinkRatio ^ (ring - shift)
        local innerScale = outerScale * kShrinkRatio
        local layerIndex = (ring + parity) % 2 + 1
        -- The lower layer reaches into its neighbors, which hides the antialiasing seam between bands.
        local grow = layerIndex == 1 and kSeamOverlap or 0.0
        local outerAngle = spin * ctx.time + twist * (ring - shift)
        local innerAngle = outerAngle + twist
        band(layers[layerIndex], regularPolygon(sides, reach * outerScale * (1.0 + grow), outerAngle),
            regularPolygon(sides, reach * innerScale * (1.0 - grow), innerAngle), centerX, centerY)
    end
    local cap = regularPolygon(sides, centerRadius, spin * ctx.time)
    for _, point in ipairs(cap) do point.x, point.y = centerX + point.x, centerY + point.y end
    polygon(layers[3], cap)
end
description: Nested polygons rush toward the viewer in alternating colors, twisting into an endless tunnel that ends in a calm, solid center.

descriptions.ja:
入れ子の多角形が2色を交互に使いながら手前へ迫り、ねじれながら続く無限のトンネルを作ります。中心には動かない多角形を置き、細かい図形が高速で動くのを避けます。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Sides で多角形の辺の数（3〜8）、Speed (rings/s) で進む速さ（負の値で奥へ）、Twist (deg) でリングごとのねじれ、Spin (deg/s) で全体の回転の速さ、Center Size (% height) で中心の多角形の大きさを指定します。Color 1・2 を交互に使い、Center Color が中心の色です。中心より小さくなるリングは描かず、外側のリングは画面の外へはみ出して画面全体を覆います。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを3つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD015
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Equalizer Bars
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text ""
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Layout (1=Top/Bottom 2=Frame 3=Ring)" default=1
-- @input number 4 "Bar Count" default=36
-- @input number 5 "Beat Rate (BPM)" default=110
-- @input number 6 "Height (% height)" default=20
-- @input color 1 "Bar Color" default={0.30,0.95,0.80,1}
-- @input color 2 "Tip Color" default={1.0,0.36,0.62,1}
-- @input color 3 "Background Color" default={0.05,0.06,0.13,1}
--[[ @description
Rounded bars bounce to a steady beat like a music equalizer, with a differently colored tip on each bar, along the top and bottom edges, around all four edges, or as a ring, keeping the middle clear for text.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
丸い端のバーが一定の拍に合わせて音楽のイコライザーのように弾み、先端が別の色になります。画面の上下の縁、四辺すべての縁（枠）、リング状から選べ、どれも中央を空けるので、本文を重ねても読めます。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。音は使わず、決まった式で拍と動きを作ります。Layout (1=Top/Bottom 2=Frame 3=Ring) で並べ方、Bar Count で1辺の本数、Beat Rate (BPM) で拍の速さ、Height (% height) で縁から伸びる最大の長さを指定します（画面の短い辺の30%まで）。Bar Color がバー、Tip Color がバーの先端、Background Color が下地です。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを3つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 3
local kMinimumBars = 4
local kMaximumBars = 96
local kMaximumBeatRate = 240.0
local kMaximumHeight = 60.0
local kMaximumLengthShare = 0.3
local kEdgeInsetShare = 0.04
local kBarShare = 0.58
local kTipShare = 0.25
local kCapsuleSteps = 8
local kMarginShare = 0.07
local kRingRadiusShare = 0.2
local kRingLengthShare = 0.25
local kLayoutFrame = 2
local kLayoutRing = 3
local kSecondsPerMinute = 60.0
local kFloorLevel = 0.12
local kKickDecay = 5.0
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

-- A rounded bar of the given overall length and thickness, centered on a point and turned by angle.
local function capsule(path, centerX, centerY, length, thickness, angle)
    local radius = thickness * 0.5
    local straight = math.max(length * 0.5 - radius, 0.0)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
    local points = {}
    for cap = 0, 1 do
        local sign = cap == 0 and 1.0 or -1.0
        for step = 0, kCapsuleSteps do
            local turn = -math.pi * 0.5 + step / kCapsuleSteps * math.pi + (cap == 0 and 0.0 or math.pi)
            local x, y = sign * straight + math.cos(turn) * radius * 1.0, math.sin(turn) * radius
            points[#points + 1] = { x = centerX + x * cosine - y * sine, y = centerY + x * sine + y * cosine }
        end
    end
    polygon(path, points)
end

local function amplitude(index, count, time, beatRate)
    local position = count > 1 and (index - 1) / (count - 1) or 0.5
    local beat = time * beatRate / kSecondsPerMinute
    local kick = math.exp(-kKickDecay * (beat % 1.0))
    local wobble = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(kTau * (time * 0.7 + position * 2.3 + index * 0.37))
    local shape = 1.0 - 0.55 * math.abs(position * 2.0 - 1.0) ^ 1.5
    return mt.saturate(shape * (kFloorLevel + 0.5 * wobble + 0.4 * kick * (1.0 - position * 0.4)))
end

-- Layers run bottom to top: background, bars, bar tips.
local kLayerColors = { 3, 1, 2 }

local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    return ctx.inputs.colors[kLayerColors[slot]]
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

-- A bar and its tip share one end, so the tip is a shorter bar of the same thickness laid over the far end of the bar.
local function barWithTip(layers, baseX, baseY, direction, angle, length, thickness)
    capsule(layers[2], baseX + direction.x * length * 0.5, baseY + direction.y * length * 0.5, length, thickness, angle)
    local tipLength = math.min(math.max(length * kTipShare, thickness), length)
    local tipCenter = length - tipLength * 0.5
    capsule(layers[3], baseX + direction.x * tipCenter, baseY + direction.y * tipCenter, tipLength, thickness, angle)
end

-- Bars stand on an edge and grow inward; `step` runs along the edge and `inward` points into the screen.
local function sideBars(layers, start, step, inward, count, metrics, time, beatRate)
    local angle = math.atan(inward.y, inward.x)
    for index = 1, count do
        local length = math.max(metrics.lengthRange * amplitude(index, count, time, beatRate), metrics.thickness)
        barWithTip(layers, start.x + step.x * (index - 0.5), start.y + step.y * (index - 0.5), inward, angle, length, metrics.thickness)
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local layout = math.floor(ctx.inputs.numbers[3] + 0.5)
    local count = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], kMinimumBars, kMaximumBars) + 0.5)
    local beatRate = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, kMaximumBeatRate)
    local shorter = math.min(width, height)
    local maximumLength = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, kMaximumHeight) * kScreenUnits * 0.01, shorter * kMaximumLengthShare)
    local centerX, centerY = width * 0.5, height * 0.5
    polygon(layers[1], { { x = 0, y = 0 }, { x = width, y = 0 }, { x = width, y = height }, { x = 0, y = height } })
    local usable = width * (1.0 - kMarginShare * 2.0)
    local slot = usable / count
    local metrics = { thickness = slot * kBarShare, lengthRange = maximumLength }
    if layout == kLayoutRing then
        local radius = shorter * kRingRadiusShare
        local lengthRange = math.min(maximumLength, shorter * kRingLengthShare)
        local thickness = math.min(metrics.thickness, kTau * radius / count * kBarShare)
        for index = 1, count do
            local angle = (index - 1) / count * kTau - math.pi * 0.5
            local length = math.max(lengthRange * amplitude(index, count, ctx.time, beatRate), thickness)
            local direction = { x = math.cos(angle), y = math.sin(angle) }
            barWithTip(layers, centerX + direction.x * radius, centerY + direction.y * radius, direction, angle, length, thickness)
        end
    else
        local inset = height * kEdgeInsetShare
        local left = width * kMarginShare
        sideBars(layers, { x = left, y = inset }, { x = slot, y = 0 }, { x = 0, y = 1 }, count, metrics, ctx.time, beatRate)
        sideBars(layers, { x = left, y = height - inset }, { x = slot, y = 0 }, { x = 0, y = -1 }, count, metrics, ctx.time, beatRate)
        if layout == kLayoutFrame then
            -- The side bars sit between the ends of the top and bottom bars so the corners never overlap.
            local reach = inset + maximumLength
            local sideSpan = height - reach * 2.0
            local sideCount = math.floor(sideSpan / slot)
            if sideCount >= 1 then
                local sideSlot = sideSpan / sideCount
                local sideStep = { x = 0, y = sideSlot }
                sideBars(layers, { x = inset, y = reach }, sideStep, { x = 1, y = 0 }, sideCount, metrics, ctx.time, beatRate)
                sideBars(layers, { x = width - inset, y = reach }, sideStep, { x = -1, y = 0 }, sideCount, metrics, ctx.time, beatRate)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD016
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Zoom Echo Type
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "MOTION"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Echo Count" default=9
-- @input number 4 "Zoom Speed (Hz)" default=0.06
-- @input number 5 "Growth" default=1.5
-- @input number 6 "Twist (deg)" default=2
-- @input number 7 "Outline Width (em)" default=0.035
-- @input number 8 "Fit Width (%)" default=22
-- @input color 1 "Inner Color" default={1,1,1,1}
-- @input color 2 "Outer Color" default={0.45,0.52,1,1}
--[[ @description
Outlined copies of the text grow outward from the center and fade away, endlessly zooming through the letters like a tunnel.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
本文の輪郭の複製が中心から外へ次々に大きく広がり、薄れて消えていく、文字のトンネルのような背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途です。短い語を入れてください（複数行でもまとめて複製します）。文字の大きさは Fit Width (%) で決めます。Echo Count で複製の数、Zoom Speed (Hz) で広がる速さ（負の値で奥へ縮みます）、Growth で複製ごとの大きさの比、Twist (deg) で複製ごとのねじれ、Outline Width (em) で輪郭の太さ、Fit Width (%) で一番内側の複製の幅を指定します。Inner Color から Outer Color へ複製ごとに色が移ります。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。文字数の上限に収まる数まで、複製を減らします。

]]

local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMaximumCopies = 48
local kMaximumOutline = 0.2
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0

local blockLength = 0
local copyCount = 0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

-- The whole text, repeated as one block per copy so every copy can be moved on its own.
function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local block = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    blockLength = utf8.len((block:gsub("\n", ""))) or 0
    copyCount = 0
    if blockLength > 0 then
        local requested = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 1, kMaximumCopies))
        copyCount = math.min(requested, math.floor(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters / blockLength))
        local copies = {}
        for copy = 1, copyCount do copies[copy] = block end
        ctx.global.text = table.concat(copies, "\n")
    end
end

-- Where the first copy was typeset, relative to its own center, and the point the whole stack is centered on.
local function readBlock(ctx)
    local everything, firstCopy = {}, {}
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do everything[index] = index end
    for index = 1, blockLength do firstCopy[index] = index end
    local whole = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, everything)
    local front = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, firstCopy)
    local block
    if whole ~= nil and front ~= nil then
        block = { offsetX = {}, offsetY = {}, anchorX = whole.center_x, anchorY = whole.center_y, width = front.width }
        for index = 1, blockLength do
            local x, y = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, ctx.chars[index])
            block.offsetX[index], block.offsetY[index] = x - front.center_x, y - front.center_y
        end
    end
    return block
end

-- Turn an offset about the anchor by an angle, in aspect-corrected units so the turn is a true rotation.
local function turned(ctx, offsetX, offsetY, angle)
    local aspect = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
    local x, y = offsetX * aspect, offsetY
    return (x * cosine + y * sine) / aspect, -x * sine + y * cosine
end

-- The stroke width is in em of the unscaled glyph, so a copy scaled up needs a proportionally wider stroke.
local function styleCopy(character, fill, color, outlineWidth, scale, opacity)
    character.fill.use = true
    character.stroke.use = true
    if fill then
        character.fill.color = color
        character.stroke.width = 0.0
    else
        character.fill.color = { r = 0.0, g = 0.0, b = 0.0, a = 0.0 }
        character.stroke.width = outlineWidth * scale
        character.stroke.color = color
    end
    character.opacity = character.opacity * opacity
end
local kMinimumGrowth = 1.1
local kMaximumGrowth = 2.0
local kMaximumSpeed = 1.0
local kMaximumTwist = 90.0
local kPeakOpacity = 0.95
local kFadeSharpness = 1.2

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if copyCount < 1 or ctx.char_count ~= blockLength * copyCount then return end
    local block = readBlock(ctx)
    if block == nil then return end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local growth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], kMinimumGrowth, kMaximumGrowth)
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local twist = math.rad(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], -kMaximumTwist, kMaximumTwist))
    local outlineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, kMaximumOutline)
    local baseScale = block.width > kEpsilon and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 1.0, 400.0) * 0.01 / block.width or 1.0
    -- Every copy is one step further along the zoom; as one leaves, the next takes its place exactly, so it loops.
    local phase = (ctx.time * speed) % 1.0
    for copy = 0, copyCount - 1 do
        local position = copy - phase
        local scale = baseScale * growth ^ position
        -- A bell over the copies: each fades in as it appears, is strongest mid-zoom, and fades out as it leaves.
        local fade = math.sin(math.pi * mt.saturate((position + 1.0) / copyCount)) ^ kFadeSharpness
        local color = mt.color.lerp_oklab(ctx.inputs.colors[1], ctx.inputs.colors[2], mt.saturate(position / math.max(copyCount - 1, 1)))
        for index = 1, blockLength do
            local character = ctx.chars[copy * blockLength + index]
            local offsetX, offsetY = turned(ctx, block.offsetX[index] * scale, block.offsetY[index] * scale, twist * position)
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, block.anchorX + offsetX, block.anchorY + offsetY)
            character.scale = character.scale * scale
            character.rotation = character.rotation + math.deg(twist * position)
            styleCopy(character, false, color, outlineWidth, scale, visibility * fade * kPeakOpacity)
        end
    end
end
