-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD017
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Layered Waves
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text ""
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Base Level (% height)" default=48
-- @input number 4 "Wave Height (% height)" default=9
-- @input number 5 "Speed (Hz)" default=0.1
-- @input number 6 "Wave Length (% width)" default=70
-- @input color 1 "Sky Color" default={1.0,0.85,0.68,1}
-- @input color 2 "Wave Color 1" default={0.98,0.58,0.55,1}
-- @input color 3 "Wave Color 2" default={0.78,0.36,0.62,1}
-- @input color 4 "Wave Color 3" default={0.42,0.24,0.58,1}
--[[ @description
Three layers of waves in soft sunset colors roll at different speeds, one in front of another.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
夕焼け色の波を3層、奥から手前へ重ね、層ごとに違う速さと波長で流す背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Base Level (% height) で奥の波の高さ、Wave Height (% height) で波の高さ、Speed (Hz) で流れる速さ（負の値で逆向き）、Wave Length (% width) で波長を指定します。Sky Color が空と下地、Wave Color 1〜3 が奥から手前の波の色です。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを4つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 4
local kMinimumLevel = 20.0
local kMaximumLevel = 80.0
local kMaximumHeight = 30.0
local kMaximumSpeed = 2.0
local kMinimumLength = 20.0
local kMaximumLength = 300.0
local kWaveCount = 3
local kSteps = 72
local kLevelStepShare = 0.3
local kSecondHarmonic = 0.35
local kLengthGrowth = 0.4
local kSpeedGrowth = 0.45
local kPhaseStep = 1.7
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function rectangle(path, left, top, width, height)
    polygon(path, { { x = left, y = top }, { x = left + width, y = top },
        { x = left + width, y = top + height }, { x = left, y = top + height } })
end
local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    return ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local level = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumLevel, kMaximumLevel) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local amplitude = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, kMaximumHeight) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local length = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], kMinimumLength, kMaximumLength) * width * 0.01
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    for wave = 1, kWaveCount do
        local base = level + (wave - 1) * (height - level) * kLevelStepShare
        local waveLength = length * (1.0 + kLengthGrowth * (wave - 1))
        local points = {}
        for step = 0, kSteps do
            local x = width * step / kSteps
            local phase = kTau * (x / waveLength + ctx.time * speed * (1.0 + kSpeedGrowth * (wave - 1)) + wave * kPhaseStep)
            local y = base + amplitude * (math.sin(phase) + kSecondHarmonic * math.sin(phase * 2.0 + wave))
            points[#points + 1] = { x = x, y = mt.clamp(y, 0.0, height) }
        end
        points[#points + 1] = { x = width, y = height }
        points[#points + 1] = { x = 0, y = height }
        polygon(layers[wave + 1], points)
    end
end

            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local rays = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumRays, kMaximumRays) + 0.5)
    local spin = math.rad(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], -kMaximumSpin, kMaximumSpin))
    local pulse = mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[5])
    local beatRate = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, kMaximumBeatRate)
    local centerX = width * mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[7] * 0.01)
    local centerY = height * mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[8] * 0.01)
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    local step = kTau / rays
    -- A smooth swell that peaks on each beat; a sudden jump in width would read as the rotation stuttering.
    local kick = (0.5 + 0.5 * math.cos(kTau * ctx.time * beatRate / kSecondsPerMinute)) ^ kKickSharpness
    local half = step * (kBaseShare + kPulseShare * pulse * kick) * 0.5

    local reach = math.sqrt(width * width + height * height) * kReachRatio / math.cos(half)
    for ray = 0, rays - 1 do
        local angle = ray * step + spin * ctx.time
        polygon(layers[2], { { x = centerX, y = centerY },
            { x = centerX + math.cos(angle - half) * reach, y = centerY + math.sin(angle - half) * reach },
            { x = centerX + math.cos(angle + half) * reach, y = centerY + math.sin(angle + half) * reach } })
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD019
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Orbit Rings
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text ""
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Ring Count" default=7
-- @input number 4 "Radius (% shorter side)" default=46
-- @input number 5 "Speed (deg/s)" default=22
-- @input number 6 "Thickness (% of gap)" default=38
-- @input color 1 "Ring Color" default={0.30,0.88,0.98,1}
-- @input color 2 "Dot Color" default={1.0,0.45,0.60,1}
-- @input color 3 "Background Color" default={0.04,0.06,0.14,1}
--[[ @description
Concentric broken rings turn at different speeds, each carrying a bright dot, like an orbit diagram.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
途切れのある同心円のリングがそれぞれ違う速さで回り、1つずつ光る点を載せた、軌道図のような背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Ring Count でリングの数、Radius (% shorter side) で一番外側の半径、Speed (deg/s) で回る速さ（リングごとに向きと速さが変わります）、Thickness (% of gap) でリングの太さを指定します。Ring Color がリング、Dot Color が点、Background Color が下地です。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを3つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 3
local kMinimumRings = 2
local kMaximumRings = 14
local kMaximumRadius = 49.0
local kMaximumSpeed = 360.0
local kArcSteps = 28
local kInnerShare = 0.18
local kDotRatio = 1.4
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function rectangle(path, left, top, width, height)
    polygon(path, { { x = left, y = top }, { x = left + width, y = top },
        { x = left + width, y = top + height }, { x = left, y = top + height } })
end
local function hash(first, second)
    local value = math.sin(first * 127.1 + second * 311.7) * 43758.5453
    return value - math.floor(value)
end
-- An annular sector, outer arc forward and inner arc back so every segment winds the same way.
local function arcBand(path, centerX, centerY, innerRadius, outerRadius, from, to)
    local points = {}
    for step = 0, kArcSteps do
        local angle = mt.lerp(from, to, step / kArcSteps)
        points[#points + 1] = { x = centerX + math.cos(angle) * outerRadius, y = centerY + math.sin(angle) * outerRadius }
    end
    for step = kArcSteps, 0, -1 do
        local angle = mt.lerp(from, to, step / kArcSteps)
        points[#points + 1] = { x = centerX + math.cos(angle) * innerRadius, y = centerY + math.sin(angle) * innerRadius }
    end
    polygon(path, points)
end
-- Layers run bottom to top: background, rings, dots.
local kLayerColors = { 3, 1, 2 }

local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    return ctx.inputs.colors[kLayerColors[slot]]
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0

    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}

        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },

        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do

        end

    end
end

    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5

    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0

    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end

        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local rings = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumRings, kMaximumRings) + 0.5)
    local outerRadius = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, kMaximumRadius) * math.min(width, height) * 0.01
    local speed = math.rad(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed))
    local thickness = mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[6] * 0.01)
    local centerX, centerY = width * 0.5, height * 0.5
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    local innermost = outerRadius * kInnerShare
    -- The last ring and its dot end exactly at the outer radius, so a large radius never leaves the screen.
    local gap = (outerRadius - innermost) / (rings - 1 + thickness * 0.5 * kDotRatio)
    for ring = 1, rings do
        local middle = innermost + (ring - 1) * gap
        local half = gap * thickness * 0.5
        local direction = ring % 2 == 1 and 1.0 or -1.0
        local turn = direction * speed * ctx.time * (0.6 + 0.12 * ring) + hash(ring, 3.1) * kTau
        local segments = 2 + ring % 3
        local span = kTau / segments
        for segment = 0, segments - 1 do
            local from = turn + segment * span
            arcBand(layers[2], centerX, centerY, middle - half, middle + half, from, from + span * (0.45 + 0.3 * hash(ring, segment)))
        end
        circle(layers[3], centerX + math.cos(turn) * middle, centerY + math.sin(turn) * middle, half * kDotRatio)
    end
end

    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local count = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0, kMaximumStars))
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local streak = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, kMaximumStreak)
    local size = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, kMaximumSize) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local centerX, centerY = width * 0.5, height * 0.5
    local reach = math.sqrt(centerX * centerX + centerY * centerY) * kReachRatio
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    for index = 1, count do
        local angle = hash(index, 1.3) * kTau
        local depth = (hash(index, 2.9) + ctx.time * speed) % 1.0
        local eased = depth ^ kAcceleration
        -- Stars appear a little way out from the middle and thicken from nothing, instead of all starting at one point.
        local fade = mt.saturate(depth / kFadeInDepth)
        fade = fade * fade * (3.0 - 2.0 * fade)
        local start = reach * (kInnerShare + (1.0 - kInnerShare) * eased)
        local finish = start + (streak * reach * kStreakShare * eased + size) * fade
        local halfWidth = size * (0.2 + depth) * 0.5 * fade
        local directionX, directionY = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
        local normalX, normalY = -directionY * halfWidth, directionX * halfWidth
        local nearX, nearY = centerX + directionX * start, centerY + directionY * start
        local farX, farY = centerX + directionX * finish, centerY + directionY * finish
        if halfWidth > kEpsilon then
            polygon(layers[index % kAccentEvery == 0 and 3 or 2], {
                { x = nearX + normalX, y = nearY + normalY }, { x = farX + normalX, y = farY + normalY },
                { x = farX - normalX, y = farY - normalY }, { x = nearX - normalX, y = nearY - normalY } })
        end
    end
end
description: Stars fade in a little way out from the center and stretch into streaks as they speed past, like a jump to hyperspace.

descriptions.ja:
中心から少し外側で現れた星が、だんだん太くなりながら手前へ加速し、線状に伸びていく、ハイパースペース風の背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Star Count で星の数、Speed (Hz) で流れる速さ（負の値で奥へ吸い込まれます）、Streak Length で線の長さ、Star Size (% height) で星の太さを指定します。Star Color が星、Accent Color が4つに1つの色違いの星、Space Color が下地です。星は画面の外まで流れ出します。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを3つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD021
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Memphis Pop
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text ""
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Cell Size (% height)" default=15
-- @input number 4 "Spin Speed" default=0.5
-- @input number 5 "Bob Amount" default=0.6
-- @input color 1 "Background Color" default={1.0,0.96,0.88,1}
-- @input color 2 "Shape Color 1" default={0.98,0.36,0.46,1}
-- @input color 3 "Shape Color 2" default={0.20,0.45,0.95,1}
-- @input color 4 "Shape Color 3" default={0.12,0.12,0.20,1}
--[[ @description
Dots, rings, crosses, triangles, zigzags and squiggles drift and turn across a pop pattern in the Memphis style.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
ドット・リング・十字・三角・ジグザグ・波線が、メンフィス風のポップな柄としてゆっくり回りながらゆらゆら動く背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Cell Size (% height) で柄の細かさ、Spin Speed で回る速さ、Bob Amount でゆらぎの大きさを指定します。Background Color が下地、Shape Color 1〜3 が柄の色です。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを4つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 4
local kMinimumCell = 8.0
local kMaximumCell = 40.0
local kMaximumSpin = 4.0
local kShapeKinds = 7
local kArcSteps = 14
local kRadiusShare = 0.33
local kBobShare = 0.06
local kEmptyChance = 0.15
local kRibbonSteps = 40
local kPulseDepth = 0.12
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function rectangle(path, left, top, width, height)
    polygon(path, { { x = left, y = top }, { x = left + width, y = top },
        { x = left + width, y = top + height }, { x = left, y = top + height } })
end
local function hash(first, second)
    local value = math.sin(first * 127.1 + second * 311.7) * 43758.5453
    return value - math.floor(value)
end
local function turned(points, centerX, centerY, angle)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
    local result = {}
    for _, point in ipairs(points) do
        result[#result + 1] = { x = centerX + point.x * cosine - point.y * sine, y = centerY + point.x * sine + point.y * cosine }
    end
    return result
end

-- A band whose center line is y = height(x) over [-extent, extent]; one outline, so nothing winds against itself.
local function ribbon(extent, thickness, height)
    local upper, lower = {}, {}
    for step = 0, kRibbonSteps do
        local x = mt.lerp(-extent, extent, step / kRibbonSteps)
        upper[#upper + 1] = { x = x, y = height(x) - thickness * 0.5 }
        lower[#lower + 1] = { x = x, y = height(x) + thickness * 0.5 }
    end
    for step = #lower, 1, -1 do upper[#upper + 1] = lower[step] end
    return upper
end

local function shapeOutline(kind, radius)
    local points = {}
    if kind == 2 then
        local arm, wide = radius, radius * 0.24
        points = { { x = -wide, y = -arm }, { x = wide, y = -arm }, { x = wide, y = -wide }, { x = arm, y = -wide },
            { x = arm, y = wide }, { x = wide, y = wide }, { x = wide, y = arm }, { x = -wide, y = arm },
            { x = -wide, y = wide }, { x = -arm, y = wide }, { x = -arm, y = -wide }, { x = -wide, y = -wide } }
    elseif kind == 3 then
        for corner = 0, 2 do
            local angle = -math.pi * 0.5 + corner / 3 * kTau
            points[#points + 1] = { x = math.cos(angle) * radius, y = math.sin(angle) * radius }
        end
    elseif kind == 4 then
        points = ribbon(radius, radius * 0.34, function(x) return (math.abs(((x / radius * 2.0 + 2.0) % 2.0) - 1.0) - 0.5) * radius * 0.9 end)
    elseif kind == 5 then
        points = ribbon(radius, radius * 0.32, function(x) return math.sin(x / radius * math.pi * 2.0) * radius * 0.28 end)
    elseif kind == 6 then
        for step = 0, kArcSteps do
            local angle = mt.lerp(math.pi, kTau, step / kArcSteps)
            points[#points + 1] = { x = math.cos(angle) * radius, y = math.sin(angle) * radius + radius * 0.5 }
        end
    end
    return points
end
local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    return ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local cell = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumCell, kMaximumCell) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local spin = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, kMaximumSpin)
    local bob = mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[5])
    local columns, rows = math.max(1, math.floor(width / cell)), math.max(1, math.floor(height / cell))
    local left, top = (width - columns * cell) * 0.5, (height - rows * cell) * 0.5
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    for row = 0, rows - 1 do
        for column = 0, columns - 1 do
            local seed = column + row * 41
            if hash(seed, 0.7) > kEmptyChance then
                local kind = math.floor(hash(seed, 1.9) * kShapeKinds)
                local layer = layers[2 + math.floor(hash(seed, 4.1) * 3)]
                local radius = cell * kRadiusShare * (1.0 + kPulseDepth * math.sin(ctx.time * 1.3 + hash(seed, 6.2) * kTau))
                local centerX = left + (column + 0.5) * cell
                local centerY = top + (row + 0.5) * cell + math.sin(ctx.time * 0.9 + hash(seed, 8.8) * kTau) * cell * kBobShare * bob
                local angle = hash(seed, 2.2) * kTau + ctx.time * spin * (hash(seed, 5.5) - 0.5) * 2.0
                if kind == 0 then
                    circle(layer, centerX, centerY, radius * 0.6)
                elseif kind == 1 then
                    circle(layer, centerX, centerY, radius * 0.7)
                    circle(layer, centerX, centerY, radius * 0.32, true)
                else
                    polygon(layer, turned(shapeOutline(kind, radius), centerX, centerY, angle))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD022
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Digital Rain
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "MUG0123456789"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Column Count" default=28
-- @input number 4 "Trail Length (chars)" default=14
-- @input number 5 "Fall Speed (rows/s)" default=7
-- @input number 6 "Row Gap (em)" default=0.15
-- @input color 1 "Trail Color" default={0.20,0.95,0.55,1}
-- @input color 2 "Head Color" default={0.85,1.0,0.90,1}
--[[ @description
Columns of characters from your text fall down the screen, each with a bright head and a fading trail.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
本文の文字を使った縦の列が画面を流れ落ち、先頭は明るく、後ろへ向かって薄れていくデジタルレイン風の背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途です。本文に入れた文字（空白を除く）から1文字ずつランダムに選んで並べます。本文が空のときは 0 と 1 を使います。文字の大きさは Font Size で決めます。Column Count で列の数、Trail Length (chars) で尾の長さ、Fall Speed (rows/s) で落ちる速さ（負の値で上へ）、Row Gap (em) で文字の間隔を指定します。Trail Color が尾、Head Color が先頭の色です。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。文字数の上限に収まるよう、列の数は自動で減らします。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMaximumColumns = 80
local kMinimumTrail = 2
local kMaximumTrail = 40
local kMaximumSpeed = 40.0
local kMaximumGap = 2.0
local kDefaultAlphabet = "01"
local kSpeedBase = 0.6
local kSpeedSpread = 0.8
local kFadeExponent = 1.4
local kEpsilon = 0.000001

local columnCount = 0
local trailLength = 0

local function hash(first, second)
    local value = math.sin(first * 127.1 + second * 311.7) * 43758.5453
    return value - math.floor(value)
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local alphabet = {}
    for _, codepoint in utf8.codes(ctx.global.text) do
        local character = utf8.char(codepoint)
        if not character:match("^%s$") then alphabet[#alphabet + 1] = character end
    end
    if #alphabet == 0 then
        for _, codepoint in utf8.codes(kDefaultAlphabet) do alphabet[#alphabet + 1] = utf8.char(codepoint) end
    end
    trailLength = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], kMinimumTrail, kMaximumTrail))
    columnCount = math.min(math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0, kMaximumColumns)), math.floor(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters / trailLength))
    if columnCount > 0 then
        local columns = {}
        for column = 1, columnCount do
            local letters = {}
            for step = 1, trailLength do letters[step] = alphabet[math.floor(hash(column, step) * #alphabet) + 1] end
            columns[column] = table.concat(letters)
        end
        ctx.global.text = table.concat(columns, "\n")
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if columnCount < 1 or ctx.char_count ~= columnCount * trailLength then return end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local rowStep = (ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent) * math.max(ctx.global.scale, kEpsilon) * (1.0 + mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, kMaximumGap))
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local cycle = 1.0 / rowStep + trailLength + 1.0
    for column = 1, columnCount do
        local headRow = (hash(column, 7.1) * cycle + ctx.time * speed * (kSpeedBase + kSpeedSpread * hash(column, 3.3))) % cycle - trailLength
        for step = 0, trailLength - 1 do
            local character = ctx.chars[(column - 1) * trailLength + step + 1]
            local screenY = (headRow - step + 0.5) * rowStep
            local fade = (1.0 - step / trailLength) ^ kFadeExponent
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, (column - 0.5) / columnCount, 1.0 - screenY)
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = step == 0 and ctx.inputs.colors[2] or ctx.inputs.colors[1]
            character.stroke.use = true
            character.stroke.width = 0.0
            character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility * fade
        end
    end
end
description: Columns of characters from your text fall down the screen, each with a bright head and a fading trail.

name: BGD023_tumbling_blocks.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD023
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Tumbling Blocks
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text ""
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Block Size (% height)" default=11
-- @input number 4 "Scroll Speed (Hz)" default=0.05
-- @input number 5 "Pulse" default=0.2
-- @input color 1 "Background Color" default={0.08,0.09,0.16,1}
-- @input color 2 "Block Color" default={0.40,0.55,0.98,1}
--[[ @description
A wall of isometric cubes scrolls diagonally, each block gently pulsing, with three shades per cube.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
アイソメ図の立方体が敷き詰められた壁が斜めに流れ、各ブロックがゆっくり脈動する背景です。立方体ごとに上・左・右の3段階の明るさで描きます。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途で、本文は空にして使います。Block Size (% height) でブロックの大きさ、Scroll Speed (Hz) で流れる速さ（負の値で逆向き）、Pulse で脈動の深さを指定します。Background Color が隙間と下地、Block Color を基準に上面を明るく、右面を暗くします。立方体は画面の外まで敷かれて全体を覆います。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。補助グリフを4つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ何も描きません。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kLayerCount = 4
local kMinimumBlock = 4.0
local kMaximumBlock = 30.0
local kMaximumSpeed = 2.0
local kHalfWidthRatio = math.sqrt(3.0) * 0.5
local kRowStepRatio = 1.5
local kMargin = 2
local kPulseDepth = 0.5
local kWaveStep = 0.17
local kPulseRate = 0.2
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function rectangle(path, left, top, width, height)
    polygon(path, { { x = left, y = top }, { x = left + width, y = top },
        { x = left + width, y = top + height }, { x = left, y = top + height } })
end
-- Layers run bottom to top: background, then the top, left and right faces shaded from the block color.
local kTopLift = 0.16
local kRightDrop = 0.16

local function shaded(color, change)
    local components = mt.color.to_okhsl(color)
    return mt.color.from_okhsl(components.hue, components.saturation, mt.saturate(components.lightness + change), components.alpha)
end

local function layerColor(ctx, slot)
    local block = ctx.inputs.colors[2]
    local result = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
    if slot == 2 then
        result = shaded(block, kTopLift)
    elseif slot == 3 then
        result = block
    elseif slot == 4 then
        result = shaded(block, -kRightDrop)
    end
    return result
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local layer = ctx.chars[index]
    layer.offset_x, layer.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.pivot_x, layer.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    layer.rotation, layer.yaw, layer.pitch, layer.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    layer.scale, layer.stretch_x, layer.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    layer.opacity = visibility
    layer.fill.use = true
    layer.fill.color = layerColor(ctx, slot)
    layer.stroke.use = true
    layer.stroke.width, layer.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.shadow.use = true
    layer.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    layer.blur.use = true
    layer.blur.amount_x, layer.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    layer.texture.use = true
    layer.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, layer, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareLayer(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        drawScreen(ctx, layers, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits, intro, outro)
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, intro, outro)
    local side = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumBlock, kMaximumBlock) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local pulse = mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[5])
    rectangle(layers[1], 0, 0, width, height)
    local cellWidth, rowStep = side * kHalfWidthRatio * 2.0, side * kRowStepRatio
    -- One diagonal lattice step maps the pattern onto itself, so the scroll loops exactly.
    local travel = (ctx.time * speed) % 1.0
    local shiftX, shiftY = travel * cellWidth * 0.5, travel * rowStep
    local columns, rows = math.ceil(width / cellWidth) + kMargin, math.ceil(height / rowStep) + kMargin
    for row = -kMargin, rows do
        for column = -kMargin, columns do
            local centerX = column * cellWidth + (row % 2) * cellWidth * 0.5 + shiftX
            local centerY = row * rowStep + shiftY
            local wave = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(kTau * (ctx.time * kPulseRate + (column + row) * kWaveStep))
            local scale = side * (1.0 - kPulseDepth * pulse * wave)
            local half = scale * kHalfWidthRatio
            local x, y = centerX, centerY
            polygon(layers[2], { { x = x, y = y - scale }, { x = x + half, y = y - scale * 0.5 },
                { x = x, y = y }, { x = x - half, y = y - scale * 0.5 } })
            polygon(layers[3], { { x = x - half, y = y - scale * 0.5 }, { x = x, y = y },
                { x = x, y = y + scale }, { x = x - half, y = y + scale * 0.5 } })
            polygon(layers[4], { { x = x, y = y }, { x = x + half, y = y - scale * 0.5 },
                { x = x + half, y = y + scale * 0.5 }, { x = x, y = y + scale } })
        end
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD024
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Letter Grid Wave
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "MOTION GRAPHICS"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Cell Size (% height)" default=14
-- @input number 4 "Wave Speed (Hz)" default=0.07
-- @input number 5 "Wave Amount" default=0.5
-- @input number 6 "Outline Width (em)" default=0.04
-- @input color 1 "Fill Color" default={1,1,1,1}
-- @input color 2 "Outline Color" default={0.45,0.52,1,1}
--[[ @description
The letters of your text tile the whole screen as a grid, alternating filled and outlined, and swell gently in a slow wave that spreads from the center.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
本文の文字が画面いっぱいのグリッドに敷き詰められ、塗りと輪郭が市松状に並び、中心から広がる遅い波で、少しずつ大きさが変わる背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途です。本文に入れた文字（空白を除く）を、左上から順に繰り返して並べます。文字の大きさは、マスの大きさに合わせるので、Font Size ではなく Cell Size (% height) で決めます。Wave Speed (Hz) で波の速さ（負の値で中心へ縮みます）、Wave Amount で大きさの変化の強さ（文字は消えません）、Outline Width (em) で輪郭の太さを指定します。Fill Color が塗りの文字、Outline Color が輪郭だけの文字です。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。文字数の上限に収まるよう、マスの数を自動で減らします。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMinimumCell = 5.0
local kMaximumCell = 40.0
local kMaximumSpeed = 1.0
local kMaximumOutline = 0.2
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kDefaultAlphabet = "TYPE"
local kFillShare = 0.8
local kMinimumSizeShare = 0.55
local kWaveLength = 1.1

local columnCount, rowCount = 0, 0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function lettersOf(text)
    local letters = {}
    for _, codepoint in utf8.codes(text) do
        local letter = utf8.char(codepoint)
        if not letter:match("^%s$") then letters[#letters + 1] = letter end
    end
    if #letters == 0 then
        for _, codepoint in utf8.codes(kDefaultAlphabet) do letters[#letters + 1] = utf8.char(codepoint) end
    end
    return letters
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local letters = lettersOf(ctx.global.text)
    local aspect = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local cell = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumCell, kMaximumCell) * 0.01
    local budget = ctx.meta.limits.max_characters
    columnCount, rowCount = math.max(1, math.floor(aspect / cell + 0.5)), math.max(1, math.floor(1.0 / cell + 0.5))
    if columnCount * rowCount > budget then
        -- Fewer, larger cells keep the grid whole instead of cutting it off.
        columnCount = math.max(1, math.floor(math.sqrt(budget * aspect)))
        rowCount = math.max(1, math.floor(budget / columnCount))
    end
    if columnCount * rowCount > budget then columnCount, rowCount = 0, 0 end
    if columnCount > 0 then
        local rows = {}
        for row = 1, rowCount do
            local line = {}
            for column = 1, columnCount do line[column] = letters[((row - 1) * columnCount + column - 1) % #letters + 1] end
            rows[row] = table.concat(line)
        end
        ctx.global.text = table.concat(rows, "\n")
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if columnCount < 1 or ctx.char_count ~= columnCount * rowCount then return end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local aspect = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local amount = mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[5])
    local outlineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, kMaximumOutline)
    -- A glyph is sized to its cell regardless of Font Size, from the em height it has now.
    local emHeight = math.max((ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent) * ctx.global.scale, kEpsilon)
    local fitScale = kFillShare / rowCount / emHeight
    for row = 0, rowCount - 1 do
        for column = 0, columnCount - 1 do
            local character = ctx.chars[row * columnCount + column + 1]
            local x, y = (column + 0.5) / columnCount, 1.0 - (row + 0.5) / rowCount
            local distance = math.sqrt(((x - 0.5) * aspect) ^ 2 + (y - 0.5) ^ 2)
            local wave = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(kTau * (distance / kWaveLength - ctx.time * speed))
            -- The size never falls below a share of the full glyph, so no letter disappears.
            local scale = fitScale * (1.0 - amount * (1.0 - wave) * (1.0 - kMinimumSizeShare))
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, x, y)
            character.scale = character.scale * scale
            character.fill.use = true
            character.stroke.use = true
            if (row + column) % 2 == 0 then
                character.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
                character.stroke.width = 0.0
            else
                character.fill.color = { r = 0.0, g = 0.0, b = 0.0, a = 0.0 }
                character.stroke.width = outlineWidth * scale
                character.stroke.color = ctx.inputs.colors[2]
            end
            character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        end
    end
end

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途です。本文に入れた文字（空白を除く）を、左上から順に繰り返して並べます。文字の大きさは、マスの大きさに合わせるので、Font Size ではなく Cell Size (% height) で決めます。Wave Speed (Hz) で波の速さ（負の値で中心へ縮みます）、Wave Amount で大きさの変化の強さ（文字は消えません）、Outline Width (em) で輪郭の太さを指定します。Fill Color が塗りの文字、Outline Color が輪郭だけの文字です。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。文字数の上限に収まるよう、マスの数を自動で減らします。

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD025
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Orbit Echo
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "MOTION"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Echo Count" default=12
-- @input number 4 "Spin (deg/s)" default=4
-- @input number 5 "Size Growth" default=0
-- @input number 6 "Step (deg)" default=20
-- @input number 7 "Outline Width (em)" default=0.04
-- @input number 8 "Fit Width (%)" default=50
-- @input number 9 "Spread Curve" default=2.0
-- @input number 10 "Cone Radius (% height)" default=22
-- @input color 1 "Echo Color" default={0.40,0.50,1,1}
--[[ @description
Outlined copies of the text fan out around the center like a cone, each turned a little further, larger and farther from the middle, slowly spinning into a vortex.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
本文の輪郭の複製が、中心のまわりに少しずつ回りながら大きく広がり、全体がゆっくり回転して渦を巻く背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途です。短い語を入れてください（複数行でもまとめて複製します）。文字の大きさは Fit Width (%) で決めます。Echo Count で複製の数、Spin (deg/s) で全体の回る速さ、Cone Radius (% height) で円錐の開き（複製の中心が、回る向きに沿って、中心から外へ螺旋状にずれていく距離。大きさは変わりません。0 ですべて同じ中心）、Size Growth で一番外側の複製の大きさの増え方（0 で大きさは変わりません）、Spread Curve で、円錐の開きと大きさの増え方が内側から外側へ広がる様子（1 で等間隔、大きいほど内側は密で外側ほど急に広がり、1未満だと内側から一気に広がります）、Step (deg) で複製ごとの回転角、Outline Width (em) で輪郭の太さ、Fit Width (%) で手前の語の幅を指定します。回転は速いと酔いやすいので、ゆっくりに保ってください。手前の文字は、Inspector の塗り・グラデーション・縁取りなどの設定をそのまま使います。Echo Color は複製の輪郭の色です。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。文字数の上限に収まる数まで、複製を減らします。

]]

local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMaximumCopies = 48
local kMaximumOutline = 0.2
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0

local blockLength = 0
local copyCount = 0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

-- The whole text, repeated as one block per copy so every copy can be moved on its own.
function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local block = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    blockLength = utf8.len((block:gsub("\n", ""))) or 0
    copyCount = 0
    if blockLength > 0 then
        local requested = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 1, kMaximumCopies))
        copyCount = math.min(requested, math.floor(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters / blockLength))
        local copies = {}
        for copy = 1, copyCount do copies[copy] = block end
        ctx.global.text = table.concat(copies, "\n")
    end
end

-- Where the first copy was typeset, relative to its own center, and the point the whole stack is centered on.
local function readBlock(ctx)
    local everything, firstCopy = {}, {}
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do everything[index] = index end
    for index = 1, blockLength do firstCopy[index] = index end
    local whole = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, everything)
    local front = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, firstCopy)
    local block
    if whole ~= nil and front ~= nil then
        block = { offsetX = {}, offsetY = {}, anchorX = whole.center_x, anchorY = whole.center_y, width = front.width }
        for index = 1, blockLength do
            local x, y = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, ctx.chars[index])
            block.offsetX[index], block.offsetY[index] = x - front.center_x, y - front.center_y
        end
    end
    return block
end

-- Turn an offset about the anchor by an angle, in aspect-corrected units so the turn is a true rotation.
local function turned(ctx, offsetX, offsetY, angle)
    local aspect = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
    local x, y = offsetX * aspect, offsetY
    return (x * cosine + y * sine) / aspect, -x * sine + y * cosine
end

-- An echo is an outline in the Echo Color. The stroke width is in em of the unscaled glyph, so a copy scaled up needs a
-- proportionally wider stroke. The front copy is left alone, so it keeps the Inspector's fill, gradient and stroke.
local function styleEcho(character, color, outlineWidth, scale, opacity)
    character.fill.use = true
    character.stroke.use = true
    character.fill.color = { r = 0.0, g = 0.0, b = 0.0, a = 0.0 }
    character.stroke.width = outlineWidth * scale
    character.stroke.color = color
    character.opacity = character.opacity * opacity
end
local kMaximumSpin = 45.0
local kMaximumStep = 90.0
local kMaximumGrowth = 2.0
local kMinimumCurve = 0.3
local kMaximumCurve = 5.0
local kMaximumCone = 50.0
local kGrowthPerStep = 0.12
local kEchoPeakOpacity = 1.0
local kFadeExponent = 0.9

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if copyCount < 1 or ctx.char_count ~= blockLength * copyCount then return end
    local block = readBlock(ctx)
    if block == nil then return end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local baseScale = block.width > kEpsilon and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 1.0, 400.0) * 0.01 / block.width or 1.0
    local spin = math.rad(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], -kMaximumSpin, kMaximumSpin))
    local sizeGrowth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, kMaximumGrowth)
    local step = math.rad(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], -kMaximumStep, kMaximumStep))
    local outlineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, kMaximumOutline)
    local curve = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], kMinimumCurve, kMaximumCurve)
    local cone = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, kMaximumCone) * 0.01
    local order = {}
    for copy = 0, copyCount - 1 do
        local share = copyCount > 1 and copy / (copyCount - 1) or 0.0
        local angle = spin * ctx.time + step * copy
        -- The outermost copy is always the Size Growth size; the curve sets how the copies in between spread toward it.
        local scale = baseScale * (1.0 + kGrowthPerStep * sizeGrowth * (copyCount - 1) * share ^ curve)
        -- Each copy's middle leaves the center along its own turn, farther the farther out it is, so the copies form a cone.
        local coneX, coneY = turned(ctx, cone * share ^ curve / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, 0.0, angle)
        for index = 1, blockLength do
            local character = ctx.chars[copy * blockLength + index]
            local offsetX, offsetY = turned(ctx, block.offsetX[index] * scale, block.offsetY[index] * scale, angle)
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, block.anchorX + offsetX + coneX, block.anchorY + offsetY + coneY)
            character.scale = character.scale * scale
            character.rotation = character.rotation + math.deg(angle)
            if copy == 0 then
                character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
            else
                styleEcho(character, ctx.inputs.colors[1], outlineWidth, scale, visibility * kEchoPeakOpacity * (1.0 - share) ^ kFadeExponent)
            end
        end
    end
    for copy = copyCount - 1, 0, -1 do
        for index = 1, blockLength do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | (copy * blockLength + index) end
    end
    ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
    ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order)
end
description: Outlined copies of the text fan out around the center like a cone, each turned a little further, larger and farther from the middle, slowly spinning into a vortex.

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id BGD026
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Type Horizon
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "MOTION\nGRAPHICS\nDESIGN"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Rows" default=12
-- @input number 4 "Scroll Speed (rows/s)" default=0.35
-- @input number 5 "Horizon (% height)" default=38
-- @input number 6 "Perspective" default=0.45
-- @input number 7 "Letter Size (% height)" default=24
-- @input color 1 "Near Color" default={1,1,1,1}
-- @input color 2 "Far Color" default={0.40,0.50,1,1}
--[[ @description
Each line of your text becomes a row that stretches away toward a horizon, shrinking and fading with distance; the lines repeat in order and stream slowly toward the viewer like a lettered floor.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
本文の各行が、1行ずつ順番に、地平線へ向かって小さく薄くなりながら奥へ伸びる行になり、手前へゆっくり流れてくる、文字の床のような背景です。

全画面の背景として別トラックで使う用途です。本文の改行ごとの行が、上から順に、手前の行から奥へ並び、行が尽きたら先頭の行へ戻って繰り返します（1行だけなら、同じ文字がすべての行に並びます）。文字の大きさは Letter Size (% height) で決めます。Rows で行数（本文の行数の倍数に切り上げます）、Scroll Speed (rows/s) で手前へ流れる速さ（負の値で奥へ）、Horizon (% height) で地平線の高さ、Perspective で奥へ向かう縮み方を指定します。Near Color から Far Color へ、奥ほど色が移ります。手前の行は消えながら流れ去り、奥の行は現れながら入ってきます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。文字数の上限に収まるよう、行数を本文の行数ずつ減らし、1周ぶんも収まらないときは本文をそのままにします。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 8.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMaximumLines = 12
local kMinimumRows = 4
local kMaximumRows = 24
local kMaximumSpeed = 4.0
local kMinimumHorizon = 10.0
local kMaximumHorizon = 80.0
local kMaximumPerspective = 2.0
local kMinimumLetter = 4.0
local kMaximumLetter = 40.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kDefaultLine = "TYPE"
local kFillShare = 0.9
local kNearFadeRows = 1.5
local kFarFadeRows = 2.5

local rowCount, lineCount = 0, 0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

-- Row k shows line k mod lineCount. The row count is a multiple of the line count, so when the rows have moved one place
-- each row shows what the row before it showed and the scroll never shows a jump.
function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local lines = {}
    for line in ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local trimmed = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if trimmed ~= "" and #lines < kMaximumLines then lines[#lines + 1] = trimmed end
    end
    if #lines == 0 then lines[1] = kDefaultLine end
    lineCount = #lines
    local oneRound = 0
    for _, line in ipairs(lines) do oneRound = oneRound + utf8.len(line) end
    local requested = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], kMinimumRows, kMaximumRows))
    local rounds = math.max(1, math.ceil(requested / lineCount))
    local budget = ctx.meta.limits.max_characters
    while rounds > 1 and (rounds * oneRound > budget or rounds * lineCount > kMaximumRows) do rounds = rounds - 1 end
    if rounds * oneRound > budget then
        rowCount = 0
    else
        rowCount = rounds * lineCount
        local rows = {}
        for row = 0, rowCount - 1 do rows[row + 1] = lines[row % lineCount + 1] end
        ctx.global.text = table.concat(rows, "\n")
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if rowCount < 1 then return end
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    if #groups ~= rowCount then return end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], -kMaximumSpeed, kMaximumSpeed)
    local horizon = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], kMinimumHorizon, kMaximumHorizon) * 0.01
    local perspective = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, kMaximumPerspective)
    local letter = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], kMinimumLetter, kMaximumLetter) * 0.01
    local emHeight = math.max((ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent) * ctx.global.scale, kEpsilon)

    -- A row keeps the spacing its letters were typeset with, measured from its own middle; read it before anything moves.
    local offsets, middles = {}, {}
    for row = 1, rowCount do
        local indices = {}
        for _, character in ipairs(groups[row].items) do indices[#indices + 1] = character.index end
        local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, indices)
        if bounds == nil then return end
        middles[row] = bounds.center_x
        offsets[row] = {}
        for index, character in ipairs(groups[row].items) do offsets[row][index] = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character) - bounds.center_x end
    end

    local travel = ctx.time * speed
    for row = 0, rowCount - 1 do
        -- Depth in rows: 0 at the viewer, rowCount at the far end. A row that leaves the viewer re-enters at the far end.
        local depth = (row - travel) % rowCount
        local size = 1.0 / (1.0 + depth * perspective)
        local screenY = horizon + (1.0 - horizon) * size
        local fade = mt.saturate(depth / kNearFadeRows) * mt.saturate((rowCount - depth) / kFarFadeRows)
        local color = mt.color.lerp_oklab(ctx.inputs.colors[1], ctx.inputs.colors[2], 1.0 - size)
        local scale = letter * kFillShare * size / emHeight
        for index, character in ipairs(groups[row + 1].items) do
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, 0.5 + offsets[row + 1][index] * scale, 1.0 - screenY)
            character.scale = character.scale * scale
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = color
            character.stroke.use = true
            character.stroke.width = 0.0
            character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility * fade
        end
    end
end
