-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id CAP001
-- @duration 6
-- @title Pop Captions
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "Sing with me"
-- @recommend lang en
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 7 "Cue Fade (s)" default=0.15
-- @input text 1 "Lyric Cues (start,end,first,last)" default="0.5,1.8,1,4;2.2,3.5,6,9;3.8,5.2,11,12"
-- @input color 1 "Accent Color" default={1.0, 0.7, 0.25, 1.0}
--[[ @description
Short captions pop into view and highlight the current phrase.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
短い字幕が弾んで現れ、現在のフレーズを強調します。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function parseCues(ctx)
    local cues = {}
    local sheet = ctx.inputs.texts[1]
    local valid = true
    for row in sheet:gmatch("[^;\r\n]+") do
        if row:match("%S") then
            local startText, endText, firstText, lastText =
                row:match("^%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+)%s*$")
            local startTime, endTime = tonumber(startText), tonumber(endText)
            local firstCharacter, lastCharacter = tonumber(firstText), tonumber(lastText)
            if startTime and endTime and firstCharacter and lastCharacter
                and startTime >= 0.0 and endTime > startTime and endTime < math.huge
                and firstCharacter >= 1 and lastCharacter >= firstCharacter
                and lastCharacter <= ctx.char_count
                and firstCharacter % 1 == 0 and lastCharacter % 1 == 0 then
                cues[#cues + 1] = {
                    start_time = startTime, end_time = endTime,
                    first_character = firstCharacter, last_character = lastCharacter,
                }
            else
                valid = false
            end
        end
    end
    if not valid then cues = {} end
    table.sort(cues, function(first, second)
        if first.start_time ~= second.start_time then return first.start_time < second.start_time end
        if first.end_time ~= second.end_time then return first.end_time < second.end_time end
        if first.first_character ~= second.first_character then return first.first_character < second.first_character end
        return first.last_character < second.last_character
    end)
    return cues
end

local function cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
    local duration = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0)
    duration = math.min(duration, (cue.end_time - cue.start_time) * 0.5)
    local envelope = 0.0
    if ctx.time >= cue.start_time and ctx.time < cue.end_time then
        envelope = 1.0
        if duration > 0.0 then
            envelope = mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, ctx.time - cue.start_time)
                * mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, cue.end_time - ctx.time)
        end
    end
    return envelope
end

local function tint(character, ctx, accent, strength)
    local base = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
    character.fill.use = true
    character.fill.color = { r = mt.lerp(base.r, accent.r, strength),
        g = mt.lerp(base.g, accent.g, strength), b = mt.lerp(base.b, accent.b, strength), a = base.a }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress))
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local cues = parseCues(ctx)
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local active = 0.0
        local selected = nil
        local completed = false
        for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            if index >= cue.first_character and index <= cue.last_character then
                local envelope = cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
                if envelope > active then active = envelope selected = cue end
                if ctx.time >= cue.end_time then completed = true end
            end
        end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        if #cues > 0 then
            character.opacity = character.opacity * active
            if selected then
                local progress = mt.saturate((ctx.time - selected.start_time) / 0.25)
                character.scale = character.scale * math.max(0.05, 1.0 + (mt.ease.out_back(progress) - 1.0) * amount)
                if amount > 0.0 then tint(character, ctx, ctx.inputs.colors[1], math.min(amount, 1.0)) end
            end
        end
    end
end
description: Short captions pop into view and highlight the current phrase.

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id CAP002
-- @duration 6
-- @title Word Swap
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "Sing with me"
-- @recommend lang en
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 7 "Cue Fade (s)" default=0.15
-- @input text 1 "Lyric Cues (start,end,first,last)" default="0.5,1.8,1,4;2.2,3.5,6,9;3.8,5.2,11,12"
--[[ @description
Words take turns at the same aligned position at their assigned cue times.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
指定時刻に単語が同じ配置基準へ入れ替わります。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function parseCues(ctx)
    local cues = {}
    local sheet = ctx.inputs.texts[1]
    local valid = true
    for row in sheet:gmatch("[^;\r\n]+") do
        if row:match("%S") then
            local startText, endText, firstText, lastText =
                row:match("^%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+)%s*$")
            local startTime, endTime = tonumber(startText), tonumber(endText)
            local firstCharacter, lastCharacter = tonumber(firstText), tonumber(lastText)
            if startTime and endTime and firstCharacter and lastCharacter
                and startTime >= 0.0 and endTime > startTime and endTime < math.huge
                and firstCharacter >= 1 and lastCharacter >= firstCharacter
                and lastCharacter <= ctx.char_count
                and firstCharacter % 1 == 0 and lastCharacter % 1 == 0 then
                cues[#cues + 1] = {
                    start_time = startTime, end_time = endTime,
                    first_character = firstCharacter, last_character = lastCharacter,
                }
            else
                valid = false
            end
        end
    end
    if not valid then cues = {} end
    table.sort(cues, function(first, second)
        if first.start_time ~= second.start_time then return first.start_time < second.start_time end
        if first.end_time ~= second.end_time then return first.end_time < second.end_time end
        if first.first_character ~= second.first_character then return first.first_character < second.first_character end
        return first.last_character < second.last_character
    end)
    return cues
end

local function cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
    local duration = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0)
    duration = math.min(duration, (cue.end_time - cue.start_time) * 0.5)
    local envelope = 0.0
    if ctx.time >= cue.start_time and ctx.time < cue.end_time then
        envelope = 1.0
        if duration > 0.0 then
            envelope = mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, ctx.time - cue.start_time)
                * mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, cue.end_time - ctx.time)
        end
    end

end

    local base = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color

        g = mt.lerp(base.g, accent.g, strength), b = mt.lerp(base.b, accent.b, strength), a = base.a }
end

    local targets = {}
    for index = first, last do targets[#targets + 1] = index end

end

    local horizontal = ctx.global.h_align
    local vertical = ctx.global.v_align
    local horizontalDelta = whole.center_x - range.center_x
    local verticalDelta = whole.center_y - range.center_y
    if horizontal == "left" then horizontalDelta = whole.left - range.left
    elseif horizontal == "right" then horizontalDelta = whole.right - range.right end
    if vertical == "top" then verticalDelta = whole.top - range.top
    elseif vertical == "bottom" or vertical == "baseline" then verticalDelta = whole.bottom - range.bottom end
    return horizontalDelta, verticalDelta
end

    local currentX, currentY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, currentX + horizontal, currentY + vertical)
end

    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress))
    local cues = parseCues(ctx)
    local whole = rangeBounds(ctx, 1, ctx.char_count)
    local shifts = {}
    if whole then
        for ordinal, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            local range = rangeBounds(ctx, cue.first_character, cue.last_character)
            if range then
                local horizontal, vertical = alignmentDelta(ctx, range, whole)
                shifts[cue] = { horizontal = horizontal, vertical = vertical, range = range, ordinal = ordinal }
            end
        end
    end
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local active = 0.0
        local selected = nil
        local completed = false
        for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            if index >= cue.first_character and index <= cue.last_character then
                local envelope = cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
                if envelope > active then active = envelope selected = cue end
                if ctx.time >= cue.end_time then completed = true end
            end
        end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        if #cues > 0 then
            character.opacity = character.opacity * active
            if selected and shifts[selected] then
                local shift = shifts[selected]
                shiftCharacter(ctx, character, shift.horizontal, shift.vertical)
            end
        end
    end
end

        return first.last_character < second.last_character
    end)
    return cues
end

local function cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
    local duration = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0)
    duration = math.min(duration, (cue.end_time - cue.start_time) * 0.5)
    local envelope = 0.0
    if ctx.time >= cue.start_time and ctx.time < cue.end_time then
        envelope = 1.0
        if duration > 0.0 then
            envelope = mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, ctx.time - cue.start_time)
                * mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, cue.end_time - ctx.time)
        end
    end
    return envelope
end

local function tint(character, ctx, accent, strength)
    local base = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
    character.fill.use = true
    character.fill.color = { r = mt.lerp(base.r, accent.r, strength),
        g = mt.lerp(base.g, accent.g, strength), b = mt.lerp(base.b, accent.b, strength), a = base.a }
end

local function rangeBounds(ctx, first, last)
    local targets = {}
    for index = first, last do targets[#targets + 1] = index end
    return mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, targets)
end

local function alignmentDelta(ctx, range, whole)
    local horizontal = ctx.global.h_align
    local vertical = ctx.global.v_align
    local horizontalDelta = whole.center_x - range.center_x
    local verticalDelta = whole.center_y - range.center_y
    if horizontal == "left" then horizontalDelta = whole.left - range.left
    elseif horizontal == "right" then horizontalDelta = whole.right - range.right end
    if vertical == "top" then verticalDelta = whole.top - range.top
    elseif vertical == "bottom" or vertical == "baseline" then verticalDelta = whole.bottom - range.bottom end
    return horizontalDelta, verticalDelta
end

local function shiftCharacter(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical)
    local currentX, currentY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, currentX + horizontal, currentY + vertical)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress))
    local cues = parseCues(ctx)
    local whole = rangeBounds(ctx, 1, ctx.char_count)
    local shifts = {}
    if whole then
        for ordinal, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            local range = rangeBounds(ctx, cue.first_character, cue.last_character)
            if range then
                local horizontal, vertical = alignmentDelta(ctx, range, whole)
                shifts[cue] = { horizontal = horizontal, vertical = vertical, range = range, ordinal = ordinal }
            end
        end
    end
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local active = 0.0
        local selected = nil
        local completed = false
        for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            if index >= cue.first_character and index <= cue.last_character then
                local envelope = cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
                if envelope > active then active = envelope selected = cue end
                if ctx.time >= cue.end_time then completed = true end
            end
        end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        if #cues > 0 then
            character.opacity = character.opacity * active
            if selected and shifts[selected] then
                local shift = shifts[selected]
                shiftCharacter(ctx, character, shift.horizontal, shift.vertical)
            end
        end
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    local slant = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0) * 0.18
    for index = 1, ctx.part_count do
        local part = ctx.paths:part(index)
        if part then
            part.path:map_points(function(horizontal, vertical)
                return horizontal - vertical * slant, vertical
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id DEC001
-- @duration 5
-- @title Lower Third
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.2
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "AKI TANAKA\nMotion Designer"
-- @recommend pos 0.5 0.18
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 7 "Padding (em)" default=0.15
-- @input color 1 "Accent Color" default={0.15, 0.3, 0.5, 0.9}
--[[ @description
A two-line name caption appears with a background band.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
名前と説明の二行テロップが背景帯とともに現れます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local rectangle = mt.drawing_path()
rectangle:move_to(-500, -500)
rectangle:line_to(500, -500)
rectangle:line_to(500, 500)
rectangle:line_to(-500, 500)
rectangle:close()
local marker = ""

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    marker = ""
    local count = utf8.len(ctx.global.text) or 0
    if count > 0 and count < ctx.meta.limits.max_characters then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = rectangle,
            advance_x = -ctx.global.tracking * 1000,
            advance_y = ctx.global.tracking * 1000,
            bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. marker
    end
end

local function rotatedCanvasPoint(ctx, horizontal, vertical)
    local centerX = (ctx.global.position_x + ctx.global.pivot_x - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local centerY = (1.5 - ctx.global.position_y - ctx.global.pivot_y) * ctx.canvas.height
    local displacementX = horizontal * ctx.canvas.width - centerX
    local displacementY = (1.0 - vertical) * ctx.canvas.height - centerY
    local rotation = math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(rotation), math.sin(rotation)
    return (centerX + cosine * displacementX - sine * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width,
        1.0 - (centerY + sine * displacementX + cosine * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
    local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local count = ctx.char_count
    local hasMarker = count > 0 and marker ~= "" and ctx.chars[count].text == marker
    local bodyCount = hasMarker and count - 1 or count
    local targets = {}
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx, { to = bodyCount }) do
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x - (1.0 - entrance + exit) * amount * 0.04
        targets[index] = index
    end
    if hasMarker then
        local background = ctx.chars[count]
        local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, targets, "character", "before_global_rotation")
        local backgroundBounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, { count }, "character", "before_global_rotation")
        background.opacity = 0.0
        if bounds and backgroundBounds and backgroundBounds.width > 0.0 and backgroundBounds.height > 0.0 then
            local padding = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 2.0) * ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
            background.stretch_x = background.stretch_x * (bounds.width + padding * 2.0 / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio) / backgroundBounds.width
            background.stretch_y = background.stretch_y * (bounds.height + padding * 2.0) / backgroundBounds.height
            local centerX, centerY = rotatedCanvasPoint(ctx, bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y)
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, background, centerX, centerY)
            background.fill.use = true
            background.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
            background.opacity = ctx.chars[1].opacity
        end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_text
        if ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and originalOrder:match("%S") then
            ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text({ count }) .. " " .. originalOrder
        else
            local order = { count }
            for index = 1, bodyCount do order[#order + 1] = index end
            ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order)
        end
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id DEC002
-- @duration 5
-- @title Label Badge
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.2
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "NEW RELEASE"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input boolean 3 "Fill" default=false
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 7 "Padding (em)" default=0.18
-- @input number 8 "Line Width (em)" default=0.035
-- @input number 9 "Corner Radius (em)" default=0.06
-- @input color 1 "Accent Color" default={0.15, 0.3, 0.5, 0.9}
-- @input color 2 "Fill Color" default={0.15, 0.3, 0.5, 0.25}
--[[ @description
A framed label appears with a short fade and pop.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
囲み付きラベルが短いフェードとポップで現れます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
    local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local accent = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
    local dimensionScale = 1.0
    -- Native 3D boxes inherit Global Scale through their layout-plane projection.
    if not ctx.meta.capabilities.has_3d or ctx.output.force_disable_3d_projection then
        dimensionScale = math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
    end
    local box = ctx.bounding_box
    box.enabled = true
    box.draw_top, box.draw_bottom, box.draw_left, box.draw_right = true, true, true, true
    box.width = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 0.5) * 100.0 * dimensionScale
    box.margin_x = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 2.0) * 100.0 * dimensionScale
    box.margin_y = box.margin_x
    box.corner_radius = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 2.0) * 100.0 * dimensionScale
    box.start_cap, box.end_cap = "butt", "butt"
    box.fill_offset_x, box.fill_offset_y = 0.0, 0.0
    box.stroke_offset_x, box.stroke_offset_y = 0.0, 0.0
    box.color = { r = accent.r, g = accent.g, b = accent.b, a = accent.a * visibility }
    box.fill_enabled = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
    box.fill_color = ctx.inputs.colors[2]
    box.fill_opacity = visibility
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        character.scale = character.scale * math.max(0.05, 1.0 + (mt.ease.out_back(intro) - 1.0) * 0.25 * amount)
    end
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id DEC003
-- @duration 5
-- @title Underline Draw
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.4
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "タイトル\n装飾アニメーション"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input boolean 3 "Align Within Line or Column" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.0
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.15
-- @input number 7 "Draw Mode (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center)" default=1
-- @input number 8 "Padding (em)" default=0.05
-- @input number 9 "Line Width (em)" default=0.04
-- @input number 10 "Gap (em)" default=0.1
-- @input text 1 "Target Characters (c2-c5, c8)" default=""
-- @input color 1 "Accent Color" default={0.2, 0.65, 1, 1}
--[[ @description
An underline draws beneath selected characters and erases on exit.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
指定した文字に下線を引き、退場時に消します。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kProgressEpsilon = 0.000000001
local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local drawDecoration
local marker = ""
local decorationIndex = 0
local decorationPath = mt.drawing_path()
local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
placeholder:close()

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local intro, outro = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
    if intro >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then intro = 1.0 end
    if outro >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then outro = 1.0 end
    return intro, outro
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    marker = ""
    local count = utf8.len(ctx.global.text) or 0
    if count > 0 and count < ctx.meta.limits.max_characters then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder,
            advance_x = -ctx.global.tracking * kUnitsPerEm,
            advance_y = ctx.global.tracking * kUnitsPerEm,
            bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. marker
    end
end

local function selectedCharacters(ctx, bodyCount)
    local selection = {}
    local specification = ctx.inputs.texts[1]
    if not specification:match("%S") then
        for index = 1, bodyCount do selection[index] = true end
    else
        for token in specification:lower():gmatch("[^,%s]+") do
            local first, last = token:match("^c?(%d+)%-c?(%d+)$")
            if not first then first = token:match("^c?(%d+)$"); last = first end
            if first then
                first, last = tonumber(first), tonumber(last)
                local start = math.max(1, math.min(first, last))
                local finish = math.min(bodyCount, math.max(first, last))
                for index = start, finish do selection[index] = true end
            end
        end
    end
    return selection
end

local function lineGroups(ctx, bodyCount)
    local groups = {}
    local selection = selectedCharacters(ctx, bodyCount)
    for _, line in ipairs(mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)) do
        local lineTargets = {}
        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            if character.index <= bodyCount and character.part_count > 0
                and mt.text.classify(character.text) ~= "space" then
                lineTargets[#lineTargets + 1] = character.index
            end
        end
        local targets = {}
        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            if character.index <= bodyCount and selection[character.index] then
                if character.part_count > 0 and mt.text.classify(character.text) ~= "space" then
                    targets[#targets + 1] = character.index
                end
            elseif #targets > 0 then
                groups[#groups + 1] = { targets = targets, lineTargets = lineTargets }
                targets = {}
            end
        end
        if #targets > 0 then groups[#groups + 1] = { targets = targets, lineTargets = lineTargets } end
    end
    return groups
end

local function rotatedCanvasPoint(ctx, horizontal, vertical)
    local centerX = (ctx.global.position_x + ctx.global.pivot_x - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local centerY = (1.5 - ctx.global.position_y - ctx.global.pivot_y) * ctx.canvas.height
    local displacementX = horizontal * ctx.canvas.width - centerX
    local displacementY = (1.0 - vertical) * ctx.canvas.height - centerY
    local rotation = math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(rotation), math.sin(rotation)
    return (centerX + cosine * displacementX - sine * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width,
        1.0 - (centerY + sine * displacementX + cosine * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
end

local function point(ctx, horizontal, vertical)
    local horizontalPixels = (horizontal - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local verticalPixels = (0.5 - vertical) * ctx.canvas.height
    local unitsPerPixel = kUnitsPerEm / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.canvas.height)
    return horizontalPixels / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) * unitsPerPixel,
        verticalPixels / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) * unitsPerPixel
end

local function rectangle(ctx, left, bottom, right, top)
    if right - left > kProgressEpsilon and top - bottom > kProgressEpsilon then
        local topLeftX, topLeftY = point(ctx, left, top)
        local topRightX, topRightY = point(ctx, right, top)
        local bottomRightX, bottomRightY = point(ctx, right, bottom)
        local bottomLeftX, bottomLeftY = point(ctx, left, bottom)
        decorationPath:move_to(topLeftX, topLeftY)
        decorationPath:line_to(topRightX, topRightY)
        decorationPath:line_to(bottomRightX, bottomRightY)
        decorationPath:line_to(bottomLeftX, bottomLeftY)
        decorationPath:close()
    end
end

local function segment(ctx, startX, startY, endX, endY, progress, thickness)
    if progress > kProgressEpsilon then
        local finishX = mt.lerp(startX, endX, progress)
        local finishY = mt.lerp(startY, endY, progress)
        local halfWidth = startX == endX and thickness * 0.5 / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio or 0.0
        local halfHeight = startY == endY and thickness * 0.5 or 0.0
        rectangle(ctx, math.min(startX, finishX) - halfWidth, math.min(startY, finishY) - halfHeight,
            math.max(startX, finishX) + halfWidth, math.max(startY, finishY) + halfHeight)
    end
end

local function span(startPosition, endPosition, progress, mode)
    local start, finish = startPosition, endPosition
    if mode == 2 then start = mt.lerp(endPosition, startPosition, progress)
    elseif mode == 3 then
        local center = (startPosition + endPosition) * 0.5
        start = mt.lerp(center, startPosition, progress)
        finish = mt.lerp(center, endPosition, progress)
    else finish = mt.lerp(startPosition, endPosition, progress) end
    return start, finish
end

local function lineProgress(ctx, progress, ordinal, count)
    local result = mt.stagger_progress(progress, mt.distribute(ordinal, count), mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9))
    if progress <= kProgressEpsilon then result = 0.0
    elseif progress >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then result = 1.0 end
    return result
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[decorationIndex]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == decorationIndex then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    local centerX, centerY = rotatedCanvasPoint(ctx, 0.5, 0.5)
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration, centerX, centerY)
    local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_text
    if ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and originalOrder:match("%S") then
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text({ decorationIndex }) .. " " .. originalOrder
    else
        local order = { decorationIndex }
        for index = 1, decorationIndex - 1 do order[#order + 1] = index end
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order)
    end
    ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationPath = mt.drawing_path()
    decorationIndex = 0
    local hasMarker = marker ~= "" and ctx.char_count > 0 and ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].text == marker
    local bodyCount = hasMarker and ctx.char_count - 1 or ctx.char_count
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local entrance, exit = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro), mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit)
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx, { to = bodyCount }) do
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
    end
    if hasMarker then ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].opacity = 0.0 end
    if hasMarker and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kProgressEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kProgressEpsilon then
        decorationIndex = ctx.char_count
        prepareDecoration(ctx, visibility)
        local groups = lineGroups(ctx, bodyCount)
        local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
        for ordinal, group in ipairs(groups) do
            local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, group.targets, "character", "before_global_rotation")
            if bounds and ctx.inputs.booleans[3] then
                local lineBounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, group.lineTargets, "character", "before_global_rotation")
                if lineBounds then
                    if ctx.global.vertical then
                        bounds.left, bounds.right = lineBounds.left, lineBounds.right
                        bounds.width = bounds.right - bounds.left
                    else
                        bounds.bottom, bounds.top = lineBounds.bottom, lineBounds.top
                        bounds.height = bounds.top - bounds.bottom
                    end
                end
            end
            local lineIntro = mt.ease.out_cubic(lineProgress(ctx, intro, ordinal, #groups))
            local lineOutro = mt.ease.in_cubic(lineProgress(ctx, outro, ordinal, #groups))
            local reveal = 1.0 - (1.0 - lineIntro * (1.0 - lineOutro)) * math.min(amount, 1.0)
            if bounds and bounds.width > kProgressEpsilon and bounds.height > kProgressEpsilon then
                drawDecoration(ctx, bounds, reveal, lineIntro, lineOutro, amount)
            end
        end
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(decorationIndex)) do
            part.path:assign(decorationPath)
        end
    end
end

drawDecoration = function(ctx, bounds, reveal)
    local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
    local padding = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 2.0) * emSize
    local thickness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 0.5) * emSize
    local gap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 2.0) * emSize

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id DEC004
-- @duration 5
-- @title Marker Highlight
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.4
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "タイトル\n装飾アニメーション"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input boolean 3 "Align Within Line or Column" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.0
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.15
-- @input number 7 "Draw Mode (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center)" default=1
-- @input number 8 "Padding (em)" default=0.08
-- @input text 1 "Target Characters (c2-c5, c8)" default=""
-- @input color 1 "Accent Color" default={1, 0.7, 0.1, 0.45}
--[[ @description
A translucent marker sweeps behind selected characters.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
指定した文字を半透明のマーカーで強調します。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kProgressEpsilon = 0.000000001
local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local drawDecoration
local marker = ""
local decorationIndex = 0
local decorationPath = mt.drawing_path()
local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
placeholder:close()

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local intro, outro = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
    if intro >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then intro = 1.0 end
    if outro >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then outro = 1.0 end
    return intro, outro
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    marker = ""
    local count = utf8.len(ctx.global.text) or 0
    if count > 0 and count < ctx.meta.limits.max_characters then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder,
            advance_x = -ctx.global.tracking * kUnitsPerEm,
            advance_y = ctx.global.tracking * kUnitsPerEm,
            bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. marker
    end
end

local function selectedCharacters(ctx, bodyCount)
    local selection = {}
    local specification = ctx.inputs.texts[1]
    if not specification:match("%S") then
        for index = 1, bodyCount do selection[index] = true end
    else
        for token in specification:lower():gmatch("[^,%s]+") do
            local first, last = token:match("^c?(%d+)%-c?(%d+)$")
            if not first then first = token:match("^c?(%d+)$"); last = first end
            if first then
                first, last = tonumber(first), tonumber(last)
                local start = math.max(1, math.min(first, last))
                local finish = math.min(bodyCount, math.max(first, last))
                for index = start, finish do selection[index] = true end
            end
        end
    end
    return selection
end

local function lineGroups(ctx, bodyCount)
    local groups = {}
    local selection = selectedCharacters(ctx, bodyCount)
    for _, line in ipairs(mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)) do
        local lineTargets = {}
        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            if character.index <= bodyCount and character.part_count > 0
                and mt.text.classify(character.text) ~= "space" then
                lineTargets[#lineTargets + 1] = character.index
            end
        end
        local targets = {}
        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            if character.index <= bodyCount and selection[character.index] then
                if character.part_count > 0 and mt.text.classify(character.text) ~= "space" then
                    targets[#targets + 1] = character.index
                end
            elseif #targets > 0 then
                groups[#groups + 1] = { targets = targets, lineTargets = lineTargets }
                targets = {}
            end
        end
        if #targets > 0 then groups[#groups + 1] = { targets = targets, lineTargets = lineTargets } end
    end
    return groups
end

local function rotatedCanvasPoint(ctx, horizontal, vertical)
    local centerX = (ctx.global.position_x + ctx.global.pivot_x - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local centerY = (1.5 - ctx.global.position_y - ctx.global.pivot_y) * ctx.canvas.height
    local displacementX = horizontal * ctx.canvas.width - centerX
    local displacementY = (1.0 - vertical) * ctx.canvas.height - centerY
    local rotation = math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(rotation), math.sin(rotation)
    return (centerX + cosine * displacementX - sine * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width,
        1.0 - (centerY + sine * displacementX + cosine * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
end

local function point(ctx, horizontal, vertical)
    local horizontalPixels = (horizontal - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local verticalPixels = (0.5 - vertical) * ctx.canvas.height
    local unitsPerPixel = kUnitsPerEm / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.canvas.height)
    return horizontalPixels / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) * unitsPerPixel,
        verticalPixels / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) * unitsPerPixel
end

local function rectangle(ctx, left, bottom, right, top)
    if right - left > kProgressEpsilon and top - bottom > kProgressEpsilon then
        local topLeftX, topLeftY = point(ctx, left, top)
        local topRightX, topRightY = point(ctx, right, top)
        local bottomRightX, bottomRightY = point(ctx, right, bottom)
        local bottomLeftX, bottomLeftY = point(ctx, left, bottom)
        decorationPath:move_to(topLeftX, topLeftY)
        decorationPath:line_to(topRightX, topRightY)
        decorationPath:line_to(bottomRightX, bottomRightY)
        decorationPath:line_to(bottomLeftX, bottomLeftY)
        decorationPath:close()
    end
end

local function segment(ctx, startX, startY, endX, endY, progress, thickness)
    if progress > kProgressEpsilon then
        local finishX = mt.lerp(startX, endX, progress)
        local finishY = mt.lerp(startY, endY, progress)
        local halfWidth = startX == endX and thickness * 0.5 / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio or 0.0
        local halfHeight = startY == endY and thickness * 0.5 or 0.0
        rectangle(ctx, math.min(startX, finishX) - halfWidth, math.min(startY, finishY) - halfHeight,
            math.max(startX, finishX) + halfWidth, math.max(startY, finishY) + halfHeight)
    end
end

local function span(startPosition, endPosition, progress, mode)
    local start, finish = startPosition, endPosition
    if mode == 2 then start = mt.lerp(endPosition, startPosition, progress)
    elseif mode == 3 then
        local center = (startPosition + endPosition) * 0.5
        start = mt.lerp(center, startPosition, progress)
        finish = mt.lerp(center, endPosition, progress)
    else finish = mt.lerp(startPosition, endPosition, progress) end
    return start, finish
end

local function lineProgress(ctx, progress, ordinal, count)
    local result = mt.stagger_progress(progress, mt.distribute(ordinal, count), mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9))
    if progress <= kProgressEpsilon then result = 0.0
    elseif progress >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then result = 1.0 end
    return result
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[decorationIndex]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == decorationIndex then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    local centerX, centerY = rotatedCanvasPoint(ctx, 0.5, 0.5)
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration, centerX, centerY)
    local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_text
    if ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and originalOrder:match("%S") then
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text({ decorationIndex }) .. " " .. originalOrder
    else
        local order = { decorationIndex }
        for index = 1, decorationIndex - 1 do order[#order + 1] = index end
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order)
    end
    ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationPath = mt.drawing_path()
    decorationIndex = 0
    local hasMarker = marker ~= "" and ctx.char_count > 0 and ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].text == marker
    local bodyCount = hasMarker and ctx.char_count - 1 or ctx.char_count
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local entrance, exit = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro), mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit)
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx, { to = bodyCount }) do
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
    end
    if hasMarker then ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].opacity = 0.0 end
    if hasMarker and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kProgressEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kProgressEpsilon then
        decorationIndex = ctx.char_count
        prepareDecoration(ctx, visibility)
        local groups = lineGroups(ctx, bodyCount)
        local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
        for ordinal, group in ipairs(groups) do
            local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, group.targets, "character", "before_global_rotation")
            if bounds and ctx.inputs.booleans[3] then
                local lineBounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, group.lineTargets, "character", "before_global_rotation")
                if lineBounds then
                    if ctx.global.vertical then
                        bounds.left, bounds.right = lineBounds.left, lineBounds.right
                        bounds.width = bounds.right - bounds.left
                    else
                        bounds.bottom, bounds.top = lineBounds.bottom, lineBounds.top
                        bounds.height = bounds.top - bounds.bottom
                    end
                end
            end
            local lineIntro = mt.ease.out_cubic(lineProgress(ctx, intro, ordinal, #groups))
            local lineOutro = mt.ease.in_cubic(lineProgress(ctx, outro, ordinal, #groups))
            local reveal = 1.0 - (1.0 - lineIntro * (1.0 - lineOutro)) * math.min(amount, 1.0)
            if bounds and bounds.width > kProgressEpsilon and bounds.height > kProgressEpsilon then
                drawDecoration(ctx, bounds, reveal, lineIntro, lineOutro, amount)
            end
        end
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(decorationIndex)) do
            part.path:assign(decorationPath)
        end
    end
end

drawDecoration = function(ctx, bounds, reveal)
    local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
    local padding = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 2.0) * emSize
    local left, right = bounds.left - padding / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, bounds.right + padding / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local bottom, top = bounds.bottom - padding, bounds.top + padding
    local mode = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 1.0, 3.0) + 0.5)
    if ctx.global.vertical then bottom, top = span(bottom, top, reveal, mode == 1 and 2 or mode == 2 and 1 or 3)
    else left, right = span(left, right, reveal, mode) end
    rectangle(ctx, left, bottom, right, top)
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id DEC006
-- @duration 5
-- @title Corner Frame
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.2
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "タイトル\n装飾アニメーション"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.0
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.15
-- @input number 7 "Corner Length (em)" default=0.4
-- @input number 8 "Padding (em)" default=0.18
-- @input number 9 "Line Width (em)" default=0.035
-- @input color 1 "Accent Color" default={0.2, 0.65, 1, 1}
--[[ @description
Corner lines extend around each text line.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
四隅の線が伸びて各行を囲みます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kProgressEpsilon = 0.000000001
local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local drawDecoration
local marker = ""
local decorationIndex = 0
local decorationPath = mt.drawing_path()
local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
placeholder:close()

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local intro, outro = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
    if intro >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then intro = 1.0 end
    if outro >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then outro = 1.0 end
    return intro, outro
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    marker = ""
    local count = utf8.len(ctx.global.text) or 0
    if count > 0 and count < ctx.meta.limits.max_characters then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder,
            advance_x = -ctx.global.tracking * kUnitsPerEm,
            advance_y = ctx.global.tracking * kUnitsPerEm,
            bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. marker
    end
end

local function lineGroups(ctx, bodyCount)
    local groups = {}
    for _, line in ipairs(mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)) do
        local targets = {}
        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            if character.index <= bodyCount and character.part_count > 0
                and mt.text.classify(character.text) ~= "space" then
                targets[#targets + 1] = character.index
            end
        end
        if #targets > 0 then groups[#groups + 1] = targets end
    end
    return groups
end

local function rotatedCanvasPoint(ctx, horizontal, vertical)
    local centerX = (ctx.global.position_x + ctx.global.pivot_x - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local centerY = (1.5 - ctx.global.position_y - ctx.global.pivot_y) * ctx.canvas.height
    local displacementX = horizontal * ctx.canvas.width - centerX
    local displacementY = (1.0 - vertical) * ctx.canvas.height - centerY
    local rotation = math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(rotation), math.sin(rotation)
    return (centerX + cosine * displacementX - sine * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width,
        1.0 - (centerY + sine * displacementX + cosine * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
end

local function point(ctx, horizontal, vertical)
    local horizontalPixels = (horizontal - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local verticalPixels = (0.5 - vertical) * ctx.canvas.height
    local unitsPerPixel = kUnitsPerEm / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.canvas.height)
    return horizontalPixels / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) * unitsPerPixel,
        verticalPixels / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) * unitsPerPixel
end

local function rectangle(ctx, left, bottom, right, top)
    if right - left > kProgressEpsilon and top - bottom > kProgressEpsilon then
        local topLeftX, topLeftY = point(ctx, left, top)
        local topRightX, topRightY = point(ctx, right, top)
        local bottomRightX, bottomRightY = point(ctx, right, bottom)
        local bottomLeftX, bottomLeftY = point(ctx, left, bottom)
        decorationPath:move_to(topLeftX, topLeftY)
        decorationPath:line_to(topRightX, topRightY)
        decorationPath:line_to(bottomRightX, bottomRightY)
        decorationPath:line_to(bottomLeftX, bottomLeftY)
        decorationPath:close()
    end
end

local function segment(ctx, startX, startY, endX, endY, progress, thickness)
    if progress > kProgressEpsilon then
        local finishX = mt.lerp(startX, endX, progress)
        local finishY = mt.lerp(startY, endY, progress)
        local halfWidth = startX == endX and thickness * 0.5 / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio or 0.0
        local halfHeight = startY == endY and thickness * 0.5 or 0.0
        rectangle(ctx, math.min(startX, finishX) - halfWidth, math.min(startY, finishY) - halfHeight,
            math.max(startX, finishX) + halfWidth, math.max(startY, finishY) + halfHeight)
    end
end

local function span(startPosition, endPosition, progress, mode)
    local start, finish = startPosition, endPosition
    if mode == 2 then start = mt.lerp(endPosition, startPosition, progress)
    elseif mode == 3 then
        local center = (startPosition + endPosition) * 0.5
        start = mt.lerp(center, startPosition, progress)
        finish = mt.lerp(center, endPosition, progress)
    else finish = mt.lerp(startPosition, endPosition, progress) end
    return start, finish
end

local function lineProgress(ctx, progress, ordinal, count)
    local result = mt.stagger_progress(progress, mt.distribute(ordinal, count), mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9))
    if progress <= kProgressEpsilon then result = 0.0
    elseif progress >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then result = 1.0 end
    return result
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[decorationIndex]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == decorationIndex then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    local centerX, centerY = rotatedCanvasPoint(ctx, 0.5, 0.5)
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration, centerX, centerY)
    local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_text
    if ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and originalOrder:match("%S") then
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text({ decorationIndex }) .. " " .. originalOrder
    else
        local order = { decorationIndex }
        for index = 1, decorationIndex - 1 do order[#order + 1] = index end
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order)
    end
    ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationPath = mt.drawing_path()
    decorationIndex = 0
    local hasMarker = marker ~= "" and ctx.char_count > 0 and ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].text == marker
    local bodyCount = hasMarker and ctx.char_count - 1 or ctx.char_count
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local entrance, exit = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro), mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit)
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx, { to = bodyCount }) do
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
    end
    if hasMarker then ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].opacity = 0.0 end
    if hasMarker and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kProgressEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kProgressEpsilon then
        decorationIndex = ctx.char_count
        prepareDecoration(ctx, visibility)
        local groups = lineGroups(ctx, bodyCount)
        local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
        for ordinal, targets in ipairs(groups) do
            local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, targets, "character", "before_global_rotation")
            local lineIntro = mt.ease.out_cubic(lineProgress(ctx, intro, ordinal, #groups))
            local lineOutro = mt.ease.in_cubic(lineProgress(ctx, outro, ordinal, #groups))
            local reveal = 1.0 - (1.0 - lineIntro * (1.0 - lineOutro)) * math.min(amount, 1.0)
            if bounds and bounds.width > kProgressEpsilon and bounds.height > kProgressEpsilon then
                drawDecoration(ctx, bounds, reveal, lineIntro, lineOutro, amount)
            end
        end
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(decorationIndex)) do
            part.path:assign(decorationPath)
        end
    end
end

drawDecoration = function(ctx, bounds, reveal)
    local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
    local padding = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 2.0) * emSize
    local thickness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 0.5) * emSize
    local length = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 2.0) * emSize
    local left, right = bounds.left - padding / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, bounds.right + padding / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local bottom, top = bounds.bottom - padding, bounds.top + padding
    local horizontal = math.min(length / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, (right - left) * 0.4)
    local vertical = math.min(length, (top - bottom) * 0.4)
    for _, corner in ipairs({ {left, top, 1, -1}, {right, top, -1, -1}, {right, bottom, -1, 1}, {left, bottom, 1, 1} }) do
        segment(ctx, corner[1], corner[2], corner[1] + corner[3] * horizontal, corner[2], reveal, thickness)
        segment(ctx, corner[1], corner[2], corner[1], corner[2] + corner[4] * vertical, reveal, thickness)
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id DIG001
-- @duration 5
-- @title Glitch
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
-- @input number 7 "Glitch Rate (Hz)" default=18
--[[ @description
Brief digital jumps and dropouts settle into readable text.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
短い位置ずれと欠落を挟んで、正常な文字へ戻ります。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id DIG003

-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4

-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25

-- @input number 7 "Sweep Frequency (Hz)" default=0.4
-- @input color 1 "Accent Color" default={1.0, 0.85, 0.55, 1.0}
--[[ @description
A soft highlight passes across the text without changing its base style.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
柔らかな光の帯が文字列を横切ります。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

local function tint(character, ctx, strength)
    local base = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
    local accent = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
    character.fill.use = true
    character.fill.color = { r = mt.lerp(base.r, accent.r, strength),
        g = mt.lerp(base.g, accent.g, strength), b = mt.lerp(base.b, accent.b, strength), a = base.a }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, info.progress)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        if ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and amount > 0.0 then
            local frequency = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0)
            local front = (ctx.time * frequency) % 1.0 * 1.6 - 0.3
            local distance = (info.progress - front) / 0.15
            local strength = math.exp(-distance * distance) * math.min(amount, 1.0)
            if strength > 0.001 then tint(character, ctx, strength) end
        end
    end
end

--[[ @description.ja

]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local progress = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local output = {}
    local count = utf8.len(ctx.global.text)
    local tick = math.floor(ctx.time * mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 1.0, 60.0))
    for index = 1, count do
        local character = mt.text.slice(ctx.global.text, index, index)
        local settled = index <= math.floor(progress * count + 1e-6)
        if not settled and mt.text.classify(character) ~= "space" then
            character = string.char(math.floor(mt.random_range(ctx.meta.instance_seed + index, tick, 33.0, 90.99)))
        end
        output[#output + 1] = character
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(output)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, info.progress)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)

    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id DPT002
-- @duration 5
-- @title Depth Reveal
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @required 3d
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
-- @input number 7 "Unit (1=Character 2=Word 3=Line)" default=1
--[[ @description
Text approaches from the distance and settles into place.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字が奥から近づき、定位置に収まります。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function orderedPosition(ctx, index, count)
    local position = mt.distribute(index, count)
    local order = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    if order == 2 then position = 1.0 - position
    elseif order == 3 then position = math.abs(position * 2.0 - 1.0)
    elseif order == 4 then position = mt.random_range(ctx.meta.instance_seed, index, 0.0, 1.0) end
    return position
end

local function collectGroups(ctx)
    local unit = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 1.0, 3.0) + 0.5)
    local groups = {}
    local previousLine = -1
    local insideWord = false
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local whitespace = mt.text.classify(character.text) == "space"
        if not whitespace then
            if unit == 1 or #groups == 0 or character.line_index ~= previousLine
                or (unit == 2 and not insideWord) then
                groups[#groups + 1] = { items = {}, first_index = index }
            end
            local group = groups[#groups]
            group.items[#group.items + 1] = character
            insideWord = true
        else
            insideWord = false
        end
        previousLine = character.line_index
    end
    for _, group in ipairs(groups) do
        local left, right, bottom, top = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
        for _, character in ipairs(group.items) do
            local geometry = character.geometry
            left = math.min(left, geometry.bounds_center_x - geometry.bounds_width * 0.5)
            right = math.max(right, geometry.bounds_center_x + geometry.bounds_width * 0.5)
            bottom = math.min(bottom, geometry.bounds_center_y - geometry.bounds_height * 0.5)
            top = math.max(top, geometry.bounds_center_y + geometry.bounds_height * 0.5)
        end
        group.center_x, group.center_y = (left + right) * 0.5, (bottom + top) * 0.5
        group.left, group.top = left, top
    end
    return groups
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    local groups = collectGroups(ctx)
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if mt.text.classify(character.text) == "space" then
            character.opacity = character.opacity * mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress)
                * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress))
        end
    end
    for index, group in ipairs(groups) do
        local position = orderedPosition(ctx, index, #groups)
        local intro = mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger)
        local outro = mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
        local entrance, exit = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro), mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        local residual = 1.0 - entrance + exit
        for _, character in ipairs(group.items) do
            character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
            if amount > 0.0 and (residual > 0.0) then
                character.z = character.z + residual * amount * 0.45
            end
        end
    end
end
description: Text approaches from the distance and settles into place.

descriptions.ja: 文字が奥から近づき、定位置に収まります。

author: Mug

end

            end
        end
    end

-- The right end of the ring, where each letter shows up.
local kGateAngle = math.pi * 0.5
-- The extra turn that feeds the letters in: it starts with the first letter at the gate and ends one full turn
-- later, which is where the finished ring rests.
local kFeedTurn = kGateAngle + kTwoPi

-- The ring turns in its own direction while the letters appear one after another at the gate and ride the turn
-- from the front around to the back, so the letters keep their places on the ring and never cross. A letter
-- shows once the feed has brought it to the gate; the other orders just change when each letter shows.
local function appearanceStart(ctx, index, count)
    local order = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local start = (index - 1) / count * kTwoPi / kFeedTurn
    if order ~= 1 then start = orderedPosition(ctx, index, count) * (1.0 - kTwoPi / count / kFeedTurn) end
    return start
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    local groups = collectGroups(ctx)
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if mt.text.classify(character.text) == "space" then
            character.opacity = character.opacity * mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress)
                * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress))
        end
    end
    local ringCenterX, ringCenterY = 0.0, 0.0
    for _, group in ipairs(groups) do
        ringCenterX, ringCenterY = ringCenterX + group.center_x, ringCenterY + group.center_y
    end
    ringCenterX, ringCenterY = ringCenterX / math.max(1, #groups), ringCenterY / math.max(1, #groups)
    local count = math.max(1, #groups)
    local gap = kTwoPi / count
    local spin = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and ctx.time * mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 2.0) * kTwoPi or 0.0
    -- 0 before the first letter shows, 1 once the ring is complete; the outro plays the same feed backwards.
    local feed = mt.saturate(mt.ease.in_out_sine(introProgress) - mt.ease.in_out_sine(outroProgress))
    local feedTurn = kGateAngle - kFeedTurn * feed
    local fadeWidth = gap / kFeedTurn * (1.0 + 4.0 * stagger)
    for index, group in ipairs(groups) do
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((feed - appearanceStart(ctx, index, count)) / fadeWidth))
        local phase = (index - 1) * gap + feedTurn - spin
        for _, character in ipairs(group.items) do
            character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
            if amount > 0.0 then
                groupPivot(ctx, character, group.center_x, group.center_y)
                local radius = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 10.0) * ctx.font.em_size
                local blend = math.min(1.0, amount)
                character.offset_x = character.offset_x + (ringCenterX - group.center_x + math.sin(phase) * radius * ctx.canvas.height / ctx.canvas.width) * blend
                character.offset_y = character.offset_y + (ringCenterY - group.center_y - math.cos(phase) * radius * 0.5) * blend
                character.z = character.z + (1.0 - math.cos(phase)) * radius * math.cos(math.rad(30.0)) * blend
                character.yaw = character.yaw - math.deg(phase) * blend
                character.pitch = character.pitch + 30.0 * blend
                character.opacity = character.opacity * (1.0 - (1.0 - math.cos(phase)) * 0.325 * blend)
            end
        end
    end
end
description: Text forms a rotating ring in three-dimensional space.

descriptions.ja: 文字を立体的な輪に並べ、ゆっくり回します。

title: 3D Text Ring
