name: DPT012_swing_3d.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id DPT012
-- @duration 5
-- @title 3D Swing and Bow
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @required 3d
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
-- @input number 7 "Unit (1=Character 2=Word 3=Line)" default=1
--[[ @description
Text swings forward and back before gently settling.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字が前後に揺れ、穏やかに静止します。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function orderedPosition(ctx, index, count)
    local position = mt.distribute(index, count)
    local order = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    if order == 2 then position = 1.0 - position
    elseif order == 3 then position = math.abs(position * 2.0 - 1.0)
    elseif order == 4 then position = mt.random_range(ctx.meta.instance_seed, index, 0.0, 1.0) end
    return position
end

local function collectGroups(ctx)
    local unit = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 1.0, 3.0) + 0.5)
    local groups = {}
    local previousLine = -1
    local insideWord = false
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local whitespace = mt.text.classify(character.text) == "space"
        if not whitespace then
            if unit == 1 or #groups == 0 or character.line_index ~= previousLine
                or (unit == 2 and not insideWord) then
                groups[#groups + 1] = { items = {}, first_index = index }
            end
            local group = groups[#groups]
            group.items[#group.items + 1] = character
            insideWord = true
        else
            insideWord = false
        end
        previousLine = character.line_index
    end
    for _, group in ipairs(groups) do
        local left, right, bottom, top = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
        for _, character in ipairs(group.items) do
            local geometry = character.geometry
            left = math.min(left, geometry.bounds_center_x - geometry.bounds_width * 0.5)
            right = math.max(right, geometry.bounds_center_x + geometry.bounds_width * 0.5)
            bottom = math.min(bottom, geometry.bounds_center_y - geometry.bounds_height * 0.5)
            top = math.max(top, geometry.bounds_center_y + geometry.bounds_height * 0.5)
        end
        group.center_x, group.center_y = (left + right) * 0.5, (bottom + top) * 0.5
        group.left, group.top = left, top
    end
    return groups
end

local function groupPivot(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical)
    local pivotX = 0.5 + horizontal - character.geometry.bounds_center_x
    local pivotY = 0.5 + vertical - character.geometry.bounds_center_y
    local deltaX = (pivotX - character.pivot_x) * ctx.canvas.width
    local deltaY = -(pivotY - character.pivot_y) * ctx.canvas.height
    local scaledX = deltaX * character.scale * character.stretch_x
    local scaledY = deltaY * character.scale * character.stretch_y
    local yaw, pitch, rotation = math.rad(character.yaw), math.rad(character.pitch), math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = math.cos(yaw) * scaledX + math.sin(yaw) * math.sin(pitch) * scaledY
    local rotatedY = math.cos(pitch) * scaledY
    local rotatedZ = math.cos(yaw) * math.sin(pitch) * scaledY - math.sin(yaw) * scaledX
    local transformedX = math.cos(rotation) * rotatedX - math.sin(rotation) * rotatedY
    local transformedY = math.sin(rotation) * rotatedX + math.cos(rotation) * rotatedY
    -- Compensate the existing Inspector transform before moving the shared 3D pivot.
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + (transformedX - deltaX) / ctx.canvas.width
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y - (transformedY - deltaY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.z = character.z + rotatedZ / ctx.canvas.height
    character.pivot_x, character.pivot_y = pivotX, pivotY
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    local groups = collectGroups(ctx)
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if mt.text.classify(character.text) == "space" then
            character.opacity = character.opacity * mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress)
                * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress))
        end
    end
    for index, group in ipairs(groups) do
        local position = orderedPosition(ctx, index, #groups)
        local intro = mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger)
        local outro = mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
        local entrance, exit = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro), mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        local residual = 1.0 - entrance + exit
        for _, character in ipairs(group.items) do
            character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
            if amount > 0.0 and (residual > 0.0) then
                groupPivot(ctx, character, group.center_x, group.top)
                local swing = math.cos(intro * math.pi * 3.0) * (1.0 - intro) ^ 2.0
                character.pitch = character.pitch + (swing + exit) * amount * 65.0
            end
        end
    end
end
description: Text swings forward and back before gently settling.

descriptions.ja: 文字が前後に揺れ、穏やかに静止します。

title: 3D Swing and Bow
author: Mug

name: DPT013_camera_orbit.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id DPT013
-- @duration 5
-- @title Camera Orbit Reveal
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @required 3d
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Elevation (deg)" default=18
-- @input number 9 "Target Travel (canvas heights)" default=0.08
-- @input number 10 "Zoom Pullback" default=0.25
-- @input number 5 "Direction (1=Right 2=Left)" default=1
-- @input number 7 "Orbit Angle (deg)" default=35
-- @input boolean 3 "Idle Motion" default=false
-- @input number 8 "Frequency (Hz)" default=0.15
--[[ @description
The camera sweeps around the text from above, then moves closer.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
カメラが文字の周囲を上から回り込み、近づきます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local entrance, exit = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro), mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local angle = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 80.0)
    local direction = ctx.inputs.numbers[5] < 1.5 and 1.0 or -1.0
    local idle = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and math.sin(ctx.time * mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 2.0) * math.pi * 2.0)
        * entrance * (1.0 - exit) * 0.2 or 0.0
    local motion = (1.0 - entrance + exit + idle) * amount
    local yawOffset = motion * angle * direction
    local elevation = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 60.0)
    local targetTravel = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 0.5)
    local pullback = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 1.0)
    local arc = motion * math.pi * 0.5
    ctx.camera.yaw = ctx.camera.yaw + yawOffset
    ctx.camera.pitch = ctx.camera.pitch + math.sin(arc) * elevation
    ctx.camera.target_x = ctx.camera.target_x + math.sin(math.rad(yawOffset))
        * targetTravel * ctx.canvas.height / ctx.canvas.width
    ctx.camera.target_y = ctx.camera.target_y + (1.0 - math.cos(arc)) * targetTravel * 0.5
    ctx.camera.zoom = ctx.camera.zoom * math.exp(-pullback * math.abs(motion))
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
    end
end

descriptions.ja: カメラが文字の周囲を上から回り込み、近づきます。

name: DPT014_vortex_spiral.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id DPT014
-- @duration 5
-- @title Vortex Spiral
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @required 3d
-- @recommend text "VORTEX"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.0
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
-- @input number 9 "Radius (canvas heights)" default=0.18
-- @input number 10 "Turns" default=0.75
-- @input number 5 "Direction (1=Clockwise 2=Counterclockwise)" default=1
-- @input number 7 "Spin (degrees)" default=240
-- @input number 8 "Depth (canvas heights)" default=1.8
--[[ @description
Characters rise from a deep vortex and spiral back into it.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字が奥行きのある渦から浮かび上がり、渦へ戻ります。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kProgressEpsilon = 0.000000001

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function orderedPosition(ctx, index, count, salt)
    local position = mt.distribute(index, count)
    local order = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    if order == 2 then position = 1.0 - position
    elseif order == 3 then position = math.abs(position * 2.0 - 1.0)
    elseif order == 4 then position = mt.random_range(ctx.meta.instance_seed, salt + index, 0.0, 1.0) end
    return position
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    local radiusAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 2.0)
    local turns = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 8.0)
    local direction = ctx.inputs.numbers[5] < 1.5 and -1.0 or 1.0
    local spin = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 1440.0)
    local depth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 5.0)
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local position = orderedPosition(ctx, index, ctx.char_count, 0)
        local intro = mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger)
        local outro = mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
        if introProgress >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then intro = 1.0 end
        if outroProgress >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then outro = 1.0 end
        local entrance, exit = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro), mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        local residual = 1.0 - entrance + exit
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        if amount > 0.0 and residual > 0.0 then
            local winding = residual * direction * amount
            local phase = mt.distribute(index, ctx.char_count) * math.pi * 2.0
            local sweep = winding * turns * math.pi * 2.0
            local radius = residual * radiusAmount * amount
            character.offset_x = character.offset_x + math.cos(phase + sweep) * radius * ctx.canvas.height / ctx.canvas.width
            character.offset_y = character.offset_y + math.sin(phase + sweep) * radius
            character.z = character.z + residual * depth * amount
            character.rotation = character.rotation + winding * turns * spin
        end
    end
end
description: Characters rise from a deep vortex and spiral back into it.

descriptions.ja: 文字が奥行きのある渦から浮かび上がり、渦へ戻ります。

title: Vortex Spiral
author: Mug

name: EFX001_emphasis_lines.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id EFX001
-- @duration 4.0
-- @title Emphasis Lines
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.12
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.16
-- @input number 3 "Line Count" default=24
-- @input number 4 "Line Length (em)" default=1.6
-- @input number 5 "Line Width (em)" default=0.14
-- @input number 6 "Gap (em)" default=0.35
-- @input number 7 "Boil Rate (fps)" default=10
-- @input color 1 "Line Color" default={1,1,1,0.9}
--[[ @description
Grouped manga speed lines snap around the title, hold their impact, and alternate between three ink drawings.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
長短・太さに強弱のある集中線が「バッ！」と現れ、3枚の描き替えで勢いを保つ演出です。

3本を1束として束の間に余白を作ります。Boil Rate (fps) は描き替えの速さで、0なら固定します。Line Width (em)・Line Length (em)・Gap (em) で太さ・長さ・本文との間隔を調整できます。本文の配置と見た目は変えず、線は本文の後ろに描きます。線1本につき文字の枠を1つ使います。
]]

local kFallbackClipLength = 4.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMaximumLineCount = 120
local kSeed = 63063
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kEmUnits = 1000.0
-- How far each line's angle and length wander between boil frames, as shares of the even spacing and of the length.
local kAngleJitter = 0.16
local kLengthJitter = 0.25
local kLinesPerCluster = 3
local kClusterSpread = 0.56
local kDrawingCount = 3
local kSecondaryLength = 0.55
local kSecondaryWidth = 0.45
-- Lines grow outward from the gap during the intro, and shrink back toward it during the outro.
local kGrowthEase = mt.ease.out_cubic

local marker = ""
local bodyCharacterCount = 0
local lineCount = 0

local function inputDuration(enabled, seconds)
    return enabled and mt.clamp(seconds, 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
end

-- A wedge along +X: a point at the inner end, the full width at the outer end. Rotating it per line
-- aims the point at the title, which is what makes the lines read as converging on it.
local function buildWedge(widthEm)
    local path = mt.drawing_path()
    local halfLength = 0.5 * kEmUnits
    local halfWidth = 0.5 * widthEm * kEmUnits
    path:move_to(-halfLength, 0.0)
    path:line_to(halfLength, -halfWidth)
    path:quad_to(halfLength + halfWidth, 0.0, halfLength, halfWidth)
    path:close()
    return path
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    bodyCharacterCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCharacterCount, 0)
    local requested = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, kMaximumLineCount))
    lineCount = bodyCharacterCount > 0 and math.min(requested, budget) or 0
    local widthEm = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0)
    marker = ""
    if lineCount > 0 and widthEm > 0.0 then
        -- On a line of their own with zero-area bounds: the bounds keep them out of the alignment box,
        -- and the tracking added after each one only widens their own line, never the title's.
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = buildWedge(widthEm), bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. "\n" .. string.rep(marker, lineCount)
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local bodyIndices, lineIndices = {}, {}
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        if marker ~= "" and ctx.chars[index].text == marker then
            lineIndices[#lineIndices + 1] = index
        else
            bodyIndices[#bodyIndices + 1] = index
        end
    end
    local bounds = #bodyIndices > 0 and mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, bodyIndices) or nil
    if #lineIndices == 0 or bounds == nil then
        for _, index in ipairs(lineIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
        return
    end

    local intro, outro = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx,
        inputDuration(ctx.inputs.booleans[1], ctx.inputs.numbers[1]),
        inputDuration(ctx.inputs.booleans[2], ctx.inputs.numbers[2]),
        kFallbackClipLength)
    local growth = kGrowthEase(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))

    -- Painted first means behind: list the lines before the title.
    local order = {}
    for _, index in ipairs(lineIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
    ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
    ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order)

    -- Distances are worked out in canvas heights so the ring stays round on any aspect ratio;
    -- em lengths follow the global scale because the measured title already includes it.
    local emHeight = ctx.font.em_size * math.max(ctx.global.scale, 0.0001)
    local aspect = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local radiusX = bounds.width * aspect * 0.5 + math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0) * emHeight
    local radiusY = bounds.height * 0.5 + math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0) * emHeight
    local lengthEm = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0)
    local boilRate = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0)
    local boilFrame = boilRate > 0.0 and math.floor(ctx.time * boilRate) or 0
    local boilSeed = kSeed + ctx.meta.instance_seed + boilFrame % kDrawingCount
    local color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]

    for slot, index in ipairs(lineIndices) do
        local line = ctx.chars[index]
        local spacing = kTau / #lineIndices
        local clusterSlot = (slot - 1) % kLinesPerCluster
        local clusterCenter = math.floor((slot - 1) / kLinesPerCluster) * kLinesPerCluster + 1
        local angle = (clusterCenter + (clusterSlot - 1) * kClusterSpread) * spacing
            + (mt.random(boilSeed, slot, "angle") - 0.5) * spacing * kAngleJitter
        local accent = clusterSlot == 1
        local length = lengthEm * (accent and 1.0 or kSecondaryLength)
            * (1.0 - kLengthJitter * mt.random(boilSeed, slot, "length")) * growth
        line.stretch_y = line.stretch_y * (accent and 1.0 or kSecondaryWidth)
        local directionX, directionY = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
        -- The ellipse point in this direction is where the gap ends and the line begins.
        local edge = 1.0 / math.sqrt((directionX / radiusX) ^ 2 + (directionY / radiusY) ^ 2)
        local centerDistance = edge + length * emHeight * 0.5
        -- Rotation is clockwise-positive, so the counterclockwise math angle is negated.
        line.rotation = line.rotation - math.deg(angle)
        line.stretch_x = line.stretch_x * math.max(length, 0.0001)
        line.opacity = line.opacity * (length > 0.0 and 1.0 or 0.0)
        -- Placed after posing: place_2d solves for the offset under the transforms already written.
        mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, line,
            bounds.center_x + directionX * centerDistance / aspect,
            bounds.center_y + directionY * centerDistance)
        line.fill.use = true
        line.fill.color = color
    end
end
description: Grouped manga speed lines snap around the title, hold their impact, and alternate between three ink drawings.

descriptions.ja:
長短・太さに強弱のある集中線が「バッ！」と現れ、3枚の描き替えで勢いを保つ演出です。

3本を1束として束の間に余白を作ります。Boil Rate (fps) は描き替えの速さで、0なら固定します。Line Width (em)・Line Length (em)・Gap (em) で太さ・長さ・本文との間隔を調整できます。本文の配置と見た目は変えず、線は本文の後ろに描きます。線1本につき文字の枠を1つ使います。

name: EFX002_floating_hearts.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id EFX002
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Floating Hearts
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Heart Count" default=8
-- @input number 4 "Heart Size (em)" default=0.7
-- @input number 5 "Rise Time (s)" default=2.4
-- @input number 6 "Rise Height (em)" default=2.2
-- @input number 7 "Sway (em)" default=0.18
-- @input number 8 "Plumpness" default=0.5
-- @input color 1 "Heart Color" default={1,0.36,0.55,1}
--[[ @description
Plump hearts pop in little groups, squash and stretch, then float above the title with a gentle sway.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
大小のハートが「ぽん、ぽぽん」と順番に弾み、ふわりと浮かび上がる演出です。

ハートは丸いふくらみと尖った先端を持つベジェ曲線です。Plumpnessでふくらみを調整できます。出現時には縦横につぶれたり伸びたりし、上昇中はゆっくり揺れます。Heart Count・Heart Size (em)・Rise Time (s) で個数・大きさ・浮かぶ時間を調整します。本文の配置と見た目は変えず、ハートは本文の後ろに描きます。ハート1つにつき文字の枠を1つ使います。
]]

local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMaximumHeartCount = 64
local kSeed = 64064
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kEmUnits = 1000.0
local kPopShare = 0.18
local kFadeShare = 0.22
local kHeartsPerGroup = 3
local kGroupDelay = 0.42
local kHeartDelay = 0.12
local kRestSeconds = 0.65
local kSwayCycles = 0.7
local kTiltDegrees = 12.0
local kCompanionTiltDegrees = 9.0
local kStartInset = 0.2
local kCompanionSpacing = 0.4
local kSquashAmount = 0.3
local kStretchAmount = 0.4
local kSizePattern = { 1.0, 0.72, 0.52 }

local marker = ""

local function inputDuration(enabled, seconds)
    return enabled and mt.clamp(seconds, 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
end

local function buildHeart(sizeEm, plumpness)
    local path = mt.drawing_path()
    local size = sizeEm * kEmUnits
    local shoulder = mt.lerp(0.42, 0.62, plumpness) * size
    path:move_to(0.0, -0.23 * size)
    path:cubic_to(-0.28 * size, -shoulder, -0.62 * size, -0.32 * size, -0.45 * size, 0.02 * size)
    path:cubic_to(-0.34 * size, 0.22 * size, -0.1 * size, 0.38 * size, 0.0, 0.52 * size)
    path:cubic_to(0.1 * size, 0.38 * size, 0.34 * size, 0.22 * size, 0.45 * size, 0.02 * size)
    path:cubic_to(0.62 * size, -0.32 * size, 0.28 * size, -shoulder, 0.0, -0.23 * size)
    path:close()
    return path
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local bodyCharacterCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCharacterCount, 0)
    local requested = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, kMaximumHeartCount))
    local heartCount = bodyCharacterCount > 0 and math.min(requested, budget) or 0
    local sizeEm = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0)
    marker = ""
    if heartCount > 0 and sizeEm > 0.0 then
        -- On a line of their own with zero-area bounds: the bounds keep them out of the alignment box,
        -- and the tracking added after each one only widens their own line, never the title's.
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({
            path = buildHeart(sizeEm, mt.saturate(ctx.inputs.numbers[8])),
            bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 },
        })
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. "\n" .. string.rep(marker, heartCount)
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local bodyIndices, heartIndices = {}, {}
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        if marker ~= "" and ctx.chars[index].text == marker then
            heartIndices[#heartIndices + 1] = index
        else
            bodyIndices[#bodyIndices + 1] = index
        end
    end
    local bounds = #bodyIndices > 0 and mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, bodyIndices) or nil
    if #heartIndices == 0 or bounds == nil then
        for _, index in ipairs(heartIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
        return
    end

    local intro, outro = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx,
        inputDuration(ctx.inputs.booleans[1], ctx.inputs.numbers[1]),
        inputDuration(ctx.inputs.booleans[2], ctx.inputs.numbers[2]),
        kFallbackClipLength)
    local presence = intro * (1.0 - outro)

    -- Painted first means behind: the hearts pass behind the title on their way up.
    local order = {}
    for _, index in ipairs(heartIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
    ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
    ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order)

    local emHeight = ctx.font.em_size * math.max(ctx.global.scale, 0.0001)
    local aspect = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local riseTime = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.05)
    local riseHeight = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0) * emHeight
    local sway = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0) * emHeight
    local seed = kSeed + ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]

    for slot, index in ipairs(heartIndices) do
        local heart = ctx.chars[index]
        local group = math.floor((slot - 1) / kHeartsPerGroup)
        local groupSlot = (slot - 1) % kHeartsPerGroup
        local period = riseTime + kRestSeconds + kGroupDelay * math.ceil(#heartIndices / kHeartsPerGroup)
        local clock = ctx.time - group * kGroupDelay - groupSlot * kHeartDelay
        local loop = math.floor(clock / period)
        local age = (clock % period) / riseTime
        local loopSeed = seed + loop * 7919
        local startX = bounds.left + mt.random(loopSeed, group, "x") * bounds.width
        local startY = bounds.top - emHeight * kStartInset
        local sizeVariation = kSizePattern[groupSlot + 1]
        local swayPhase = mt.random(loopSeed, slot, "sway") * kTau
        local swing = math.sin(age * kSwayCycles * kTau + swayPhase)

        local pop = mt.saturate(age / kPopShare)
        local bounce = math.sin(pop * math.pi * 2.0) * (1.0 - pop)
        local fade = 1.0 - mt.saturate((age - (1.0 - kFadeShare)) / kFadeShare)
        heart.rotation = heart.rotation + swing * kTiltDegrees + (groupSlot - 1) * kCompanionTiltDegrees
        heart.scale = heart.scale * mt.ease.out_back(pop) * sizeVariation
        heart.stretch_x = heart.stretch_x * (1.0 - bounce * kSquashAmount)
        heart.stretch_y = heart.stretch_y * (1.0 + bounce * kStretchAmount)
        heart.opacity = heart.opacity * fade * presence
        heart.fill.use = true
        heart.fill.color = color
        mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, heart,
            startX + ((groupSlot - 1) * emHeight * kCompanionSpacing + swing * sway) / aspect,
            startY + mt.ease.in_out_sine(mt.saturate(age)) * riseHeight)
    end
end

name: EFX003_anger_mark.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id EFX003
-- @duration 4.0
-- @title Anger Mark
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.12
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.3
-- @input number 3 "Mark Size (em)" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Vein Thickness" default=0.32
-- @input number 5 "Throb Rate (Hz)" default=1.25
-- @input number 6 "Shake (em)" default=0.035
-- @input number 7 "Corner (1=Top Right 2=Top Left)" default=1
-- @input color 1 "Mark Color" default={0.95,0.18,0.22,1}
--[[ @description
A four-vein anger mark snaps into two emphatic poses, with a brief title shake on each hit and a held recovery.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
本文の角に怒りマークが「ピキッ、ピキッ」と二段で大きく現れ、決めポーズを保つ演出です。

4本の筋は太さを保った曲がった線で、曲がり角と先端には丸みを持たせています。Vein Thicknessで筋の太さ、Throb Rate (Hz) で二段の拍動を繰り返す速さを調整します。本文は拍動の瞬間だけまとまって震え、Shake (em) を0にすると動きません。マークは本文の手前に描き、文字の枠を1つ使います。
]]

local kFallbackClipLength = 4.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEmUnits = 1000.0
local kSeed = 65065
-- The gap between the four veins, as a share of the mark's half size.
local kGapShare = 0.14
local kInnerCornerRadiusShare = 0.25
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kMaximumThicknessShare = 0.55
local kThrobSwell = 0.48
local kFirstHold = 0.16
local kSecondHit = 0.24
local kSecondHold = 0.48
local kRecoverEnd = 0.8
local kFirstThrob = 0.55
local kAnticipationThrob = 0.35
local kThrobTiltDegrees = 8.0
local kThrobStretch = 0.12
local kShakeSteps = 24.0
-- How far the mark's center sits outside and above the title's corner, as shares of its size.
local kCornerOutset = 0.12
local kCornerRise = 0.08
-- Character scale cannot reach zero, so below this the popping mark is hidden instead of shrunk.
local kHiddenPresence = 0.01

local marker = ""

local function inputDuration(enabled, seconds)
    return enabled and mt.clamp(seconds, 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
end

local function addVein(path, signX, signY, halfSize, thickness)
    local gap = halfSize * kGapShare
    local inner = gap + thickness
    local innerRadius = thickness * kInnerCornerRadiusShare
    local outerRadius = thickness + innerRadius
    local cornerEnd = gap + outerRadius
    local capRadius = thickness * 0.5
    local capCenter = halfSize - capRadius
    local capControl = capRadius * kCircleControl
    local function point(x, y) return x * signX, y * signY end
    local function curve(firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
        path:cubic_to(firstX * signX, firstY * signY, secondX * signX, secondY * signY, endX * signX, endY * signY)
    end
    path:move_to(point(capCenter, gap))
    path:line_to(point(cornerEnd, gap))
    path:quad_to(gap * signX, gap * signY, gap * signX, cornerEnd * signY)
    path:line_to(point(gap, capCenter))
    curve(gap, capCenter + capControl, gap + capRadius - capControl, halfSize, gap + capRadius, halfSize)
    curve(gap + capRadius + capControl, halfSize, inner, capCenter + capControl, inner, capCenter)
    path:line_to(point(inner, cornerEnd))
    path:quad_to(inner * signX, inner * signY, cornerEnd * signX, inner * signY)
    path:line_to(point(capCenter, inner))
    curve(capCenter + capControl, inner, halfSize, gap + capRadius + capControl, halfSize, gap + capRadius)
    curve(halfSize, gap + capRadius - capControl, capCenter + capControl, gap, capCenter, gap)
    path:close()
end

local function buildMark(sizeEm, thicknessShare)
    local path = mt.drawing_path()
    local halfSize = sizeEm * kEmUnits * 0.5
    local thickness = halfSize * (1.0 - kGapShare) * mt.clamp(thicknessShare, 0.05, kMaximumThicknessShare)
    for _, signs in ipairs({ { 1, 1 }, { -1, 1 }, { -1, -1 }, { 1, -1 } }) do
        addVein(path, signs[1], signs[2], halfSize, thickness)
    end
    return path
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local bodyCharacterCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local hasRoom = ctx.meta.limits.max_characters > bodyCharacterCount
    local sizeEm = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0)
    marker = ""
    if bodyCharacterCount > 0 and hasRoom and sizeEm > 0.0 then
        -- On a line of their own with zero-area bounds: the bounds keep them out of the alignment box,
        -- and the tracking added after each one only widens their own line, never the title's.
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = buildMark(sizeEm, ctx.inputs.numbers[4]), bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. "\n" .. marker
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local bodyIndices, markIndex = {}, nil
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        if marker ~= "" and ctx.chars[index].text == marker then
            markIndex = index
        else
            bodyIndices[#bodyIndices + 1] = index
        end
    end
    local bounds = #bodyIndices > 0 and mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, bodyIndices) or nil
    if markIndex == nil or bounds == nil then
        if markIndex ~= nil then ctx.chars[markIndex].opacity = 0.0 end
        return
    end

    local intro, outro = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx,
        inputDuration(ctx.inputs.booleans[1], ctx.inputs.numbers[1]),
        inputDuration(ctx.inputs.booleans[2], ctx.inputs.numbers[2]),
        kFallbackClipLength)
    local presence = mt.ease.out_back(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_back(outro))

    local rate = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0)
    local phase = (ctx.time * rate) % 1.0
    local throb, impact = 0.0, 0.0
    if rate > 0.0 then
        if phase < kFirstHold then
            throb = kFirstThrob
            impact = 1.0 - phase / kFirstHold
        elseif phase < kSecondHit then
            throb = kAnticipationThrob
        elseif phase < kSecondHold then
            throb = 1.0
            impact = 1.0 - (phase - kSecondHit) / (kSecondHold - kSecondHit)
        else
            throb = 1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((phase - kSecondHold) / (kRecoverEnd - kSecondHold)))
        end
    end

    local emHeight = ctx.font.em_size * math.max(ctx.global.scale, 0.0001)
    local aspect = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local sizeHeight = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0) * emHeight
    local leftCorner = math.floor(ctx.inputs.numbers[7] + 0.5) == 2
    local cornerX = leftCorner and bounds.left or bounds.right
    local inwardX = leftCorner and 1.0 or -1.0

    local mark = ctx.chars[markIndex]
    mark.scale = mark.scale * math.max(presence, 0.0) * (1.0 + kThrobSwell * throb)
    mark.rotation = mark.rotation + (leftCorner and -1.0 or 1.0) * throb * kThrobTiltDegrees
    mark.stretch_x = mark.stretch_x * (1.0 + throb * kThrobStretch)
    mark.opacity = mark.opacity * (presence > kHiddenPresence and 1.0 or 0.0)
    mark.fill.use = true
    mark.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, mark,
        cornerX - inwardX * sizeHeight * kCornerOutset / aspect,
        bounds.top + sizeHeight * kCornerRise)

    -- The title and the mark shake as one block, hardest on each beat. Offsets are pre-global
    -- displacements, so the same delta added to every character moves them together under any
    -- global rotation or scale.
    local step = math.floor(ctx.time * kShakeSteps)
    local seed = kSeed + ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local amount = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0) * impact * math.max(presence, 0.0)
    local shakeX = (mt.random(seed, step, "x") - 0.5) * 2.0 * amount * ctx.font.em_size / aspect
    local shakeY = (mt.random(seed, step, "y") - 0.5) * 2.0 * amount * ctx.font.em_size
    for _, index in ipairs(bodyIndices) do
        local character = ctx.chars[index]
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + shakeX
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + shakeY
    end
    mark.offset_x = mark.offset_x + shakeX
    mark.offset_y = mark.offset_y + shakeY
end

name: EFX004_nervous_sweat.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id EFX004
-- @duration 4.0
-- @title Nervous Sweat
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.12
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.3
-- @input number 3 "Drop Count" default=3
-- @input number 4 "Drop Size (em)" default=0.7
-- @input number 5 "Spread (deg)" default=70
-- @input number 6 "Launch Speed (em/s)" default=2.6
-- @input number 7 "Gravity (em/s^2)" default=3
-- @input number 8 "Flight Time (s)" default=0.65
-- @input number 9 "Curve" default=0.6
-- @input number 10 "Corner (1=Top Right 2=Top Left)" default=1
-- @input color 1 "Drop Color" default={0.6,0.86,1,1}
--[[ @description
Unequal sweat drops burst into a curved fan and flick away in one continuous motion, with a short pause between bursts.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
大小の汗が本文の角から「あせっ！」と扇状に跳ね、動きを止めずに飛び去って消える演出です。

しずくは丸い頭と反った細い尾が滑らかにつながる形です。Curveで反りの強さを調整し、0にすると左右対称になります。Drop Size (em) は最大のしずくの大きさ、Spread (deg) は扇の開き、Flight Time (s) は1回の演出の長さです。Launch Speed (em/s)・Gravity (em/s^2) で飛び出す距離と落ち方を調整します。本文の配置と見た目は変えず、汗は本文の手前に描きます。しずく1つにつき文字の枠を1つ使います。
]]

local kFallbackClipLength = 4.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMaximumDropCount = 12
local kEmUnits = 1000.0
local kBulbShare = 0.3
local kLengthShare = 1.0
local kAppearShare = 0.1
local kExitStart = 0.72
local kPauseShare = 1.0
local kStartOutset = 0.6
local kFanCenterDegrees = 38.0
local kSteepestLaunchDegrees = 78.0
local kFlattestLaunchDegrees = 3.0
local kSizePattern = { 0.72, 1.0, 0.52 }
local kMaximumCurve = 3.0
local kTailBend = 0.2
local kLaunchStretch = 0.3
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTailControl = 0.65

local markers = {}

local function inputDuration(enabled, seconds)
    return enabled and mt.clamp(seconds, 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
end

local function launchAngle(ctx, slot, count)
    local leftCorner = math.floor(ctx.inputs.numbers[10] + 0.5) == 2
    local share = count > 1 and (slot - 1) / (count - 1) - 0.5 or 0.0
    local degrees = mt.clamp(kFanCenterDegrees + share * math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0),
        kFlattestLaunchDegrees, kSteepestLaunchDegrees)
    -- Measured from the outward horizontal, so the left corner mirrors the fan.
    return math.rad(leftCorner and 180.0 - degrees or degrees), leftCorner
end

local function flight(ctx, slot, count)
    local flightTime = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.05)
    local age = (ctx.time / flightTime) % (1.0 + kPauseShare)
    local travel = mt.ease.out_quad(mt.saturate(age))
    local seconds = travel * flightTime
    local angle = launchAngle(ctx, slot, count)
    local speed = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0)
    local gravity = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0)
    return {
        age = age,
        x = math.cos(angle) * speed * seconds,
        y = math.sin(angle) * speed * seconds - 0.5 * gravity * seconds * seconds,
    }
end

-- The head faces +X; a fixed silhouette keeps the fan readable throughout the flight.
local function buildDrop(sizeEm, curve)
    local path = mt.drawing_path()
    local radius = sizeEm * kBulbShare * kEmUnits
    local length = sizeEm * kLengthShare * kEmUnits
    local bend = mt.clamp(curve, -kMaximumCurve, kMaximumCurve) * length * kTailBend
    local circleControl = radius * kCircleControl
    path:move_to(-length, -bend)
    path:cubic_to(-length * kTailControl, -bend, -radius - circleControl, radius, -radius, radius)
    path:cubic_to(-radius + circleControl, radius, 0.0, circleControl, 0.0, 0.0)
    path:cubic_to(0.0, -circleControl, -radius + circleControl, -radius, -radius, -radius)
    path:cubic_to(-radius - circleControl, -radius, -length * kTailControl, -bend, -length, -bend)
    path:close()
    return path
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local bodyCharacterCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCharacterCount, 0)
    local requested = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, kMaximumDropCount))
    local dropCount = bodyCharacterCount > 0 and math.min(requested, budget) or 0
    local sizeEm = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0)
    markers = {}
    if dropCount > 0 and sizeEm > 0.0 then
        for slot = 1, dropCount do
            local sizeVariation = kSizePattern[(slot - 1) % #kSizePattern + 1]
            local _, leftCorner = launchAngle(ctx, slot, dropCount)
            local curve = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0) * (leftCorner and -1.0 or 1.0)
            local shape = buildDrop(sizeEm * sizeVariation, curve)
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = shape, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- On a line of their own with zero-area bounds: the bounds keep them out of the alignment box,
        -- and the tracking added after each one only widens their own line, never the title's.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. "\n" .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local slotByMarker = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do slotByMarker[marker] = slot end
    local bodyIndices, dropIndices = {}, {}
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = slotByMarker[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot ~= nil then
            dropIndices[slot] = index
        else
            bodyIndices[#bodyIndices + 1] = index
        end
    end
    local bounds = #bodyIndices > 0 and mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, bodyIndices) or nil
    if #dropIndices == 0 or bounds == nil then
        for _, index in pairs(dropIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
        return
    end

    local intro, outro = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx,
        inputDuration(ctx.inputs.booleans[1], ctx.inputs.numbers[1]),
        inputDuration(ctx.inputs.booleans[2], ctx.inputs.numbers[2]),
        kFallbackClipLength)
    local presence = intro * (1.0 - outro)

    local emHeight = ctx.font.em_size * math.max(ctx.global.scale, 0.0001)
    local aspect = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local sizeEm = math.max(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0)
    local color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
    local _, leftCorner = launchAngle(ctx, 1, 1)
    local cornerX = leftCorner and bounds.left or bounds.right

    for slot, index in ipairs(dropIndices) do
        local drop = ctx.chars[index]
        local state = flight(ctx, slot, #dropIndices)
        local launch = launchAngle(ctx, slot, #dropIndices)
        local startX = cornerX + math.cos(launch) * sizeEm * kStartOutset * emHeight / aspect
        local startY = bounds.top + math.sin(launch) * sizeEm * kStartOutset * emHeight
        local appear = mt.saturate(state.age / kAppearShare)
        local exit = mt.saturate((state.age - kExitStart) / (1.0 - kExitStart))

        drop.rotation = drop.rotation - math.deg(launch)
        drop.scale = drop.scale * mt.ease.out_back(appear) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(exit))
        drop.stretch_x = drop.stretch_x * (1.0 + kLaunchStretch * math.sin(appear * math.pi))
        drop.opacity = drop.opacity * (state.age > 0.0 and state.age < 1.0 and 1.0 or 0.0) * presence
        drop.fill.use = true
        drop.fill.color = color
        mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, drop, startX + state.x * emHeight / aspect, startY + state.y * emHeight)
    end
end
description: Unequal sweat drops burst into a curved fan and flick away in one continuous motion, with a short pause between bursts.

descriptions.ja:

しずくは丸い頭と反った細い尾が滑らかにつながる形です。Curveで反りの強さを調整し、0にすると左右対称になります。Drop Size (em) は最大のしずくの大きさ、Spread (deg) は扇の開き、Flight Time (s) は1回の演出の長さです。Launch Speed (em/s)・Gravity (em/s^2) で飛び出す距離と落ち方を調整します。本文の配置と見た目は変えず、汗は本文の手前に描きます。しずく1つにつき文字の枠を1つ使います。

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id ELA001
-- @duration 5
-- @title Wave
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
-- @input boolean 3 "Idle Motion" default=true
-- @input number 7 "Wave Frequency (Hz)" default=0.6
--[[ @description
A gentle wave travels through the text while it remains readable.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
読みやすさを保ちながら、文字列に波が伝わります。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, info.progress)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        local idle = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and amount * entrance * (1.0 - exit) or 0.0
        local phase = ctx.time * mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0) * math.pi * 2.0 - info.progress * math.pi * 2.0
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + math.sin(phase) * 0.02 * idle
    end
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)

end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

function OnLayout(ctx)

    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, info.progress)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)

        local residual = 1.0 - mt.ease.out_elastic(intro) + exit

--[[ @description.ja
文字列が蛇腹のように折りたたまれ、開いて整列します。

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, info.progress)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        local residual = 1.0 - entrance + exit
        local stretch = math.max(0.15, 1.0 - 0.7 * math.min(amount, 1.0) * residual)
        if ctx.global.vertical then character.stretch_y = character.stretch_y * stretch
        else character.stretch_x = character.stretch_x * stretch end
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (index % 2 == 0 and 1.0 or -1.0) * residual * amount * 15.0
    end

        mt.layout.reflow(ctx, 0.0, { anchor = math.ceil(ctx.char_count / 2) })
    end

    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)

        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)

文字が一つずつ滑り込み、順番に滑り出して消えます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local horizontal, vertical = travelVector(ctx)
    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local position = info.progress
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        local distance = 0.12 * amount * (exit - (1.0 - entrance))
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * distance
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * distance
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FAD005
-- @duration 5
-- @title Line Slide
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "First line\nSecond line\nThird line"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 5 "Direction (1=Up 2=Down 3=Left 4=Right)" default=1
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
--[[ @description
Lines slide into place in sequence, then slide away.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
複数の行が順番に滑り込み、順番に滑り出して消えます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function orderedPosition(ctx, index, count)
    local position = mt.distribute(index, count)
    local order = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    if order == 2 then
        position = 1.0 - position
    elseif order == 3 then
        position = math.abs(position * 2.0 - 1.0)
    elseif order == 4 then
        position = mt.random_range(ctx.meta.instance_seed, index, 0.0, 1.0)
    end
    return position
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local horizontal, vertical = travelVector(ctx)
    local lines = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for lineIndex, line in ipairs(lines) do
        local position = orderedPosition(ctx, lineIndex, #lines)
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        local distance = 0.08 * amount * (exit - (1.0 - entrance))
        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * distance
            character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * distance
            character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        end
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FAD006
-- @duration 5
-- @title Line Reveal
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input color 1 "Accent Color" default={0.3, 0.7, 1.0, 1.0}
--[[ @description
A line grows beneath the title, followed by a short text reveal.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
タイトル下の線が伸び、その後に文字が現れます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local rectangle = mt.drawing_path()
rectangle:move_to(-500, -500)
rectangle:line_to(500, -500)
rectangle:line_to(500, 500)
rectangle:line_to(-500, 500)
rectangle:close()
local marker = ""

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    marker = ""
    local count = utf8.len(ctx.global.text) or 0
    if count > 0 and count < ctx.meta.limits.max_characters then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = rectangle,
            advance_x = -ctx.global.tracking * 1000,
            advance_y = ctx.global.tracking * 1000,
            bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. marker
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.stagger_progress(intro, 0.3, 0.5))
    local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local count = ctx.char_count
    local hasMarker = count > 0 and marker ~= "" and ctx.chars[count].text == marker
    local bodyCount = hasMarker and count - 1 or count
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx, { to = bodyCount }) do
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
    end
    if hasMarker then
        local targets = {}
        for index = 1, bodyCount do targets[index] = index end
        local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, targets)
        local line = ctx.chars[count]
        if bounds and ctx.font.em_size > 0.0 then
            line.stretch_y = line.stretch_y * 0.04
            local lineBounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, { count })
            if lineBounds and lineBounds.width > 0.0 then
                line.stretch_x = line.stretch_x * bounds.width / lineBounds.width
                    * math.max(0.001, mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate(intro / 0.4)))
            end
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, line, bounds.center_x, bounds.bottom - ctx.font.em_size * 0.2)
            line.fill.use = true
            line.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
            line.opacity = line.opacity * (1.0 - exit) * mt.saturate(intro / 0.4)
        else
            line.opacity = 0.0
        end
    end
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FIX001
-- @duration 5
-- @title Horizontal Ruby
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "<ruby>漢字<rt>かんじ</rt></ruby>にルビを\n<ruby>振<rt>ふ</rt></ruby>る"
-- @input number 1 "Ruby Size" default=0.45
-- @input number 2 "Ruby Gap (em)" default=0.12
-- @input number 3 "Line Gap (em)" default=1.8
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 10 "Animation Amount" default=1
--[[ @description
Horizontal ruby lines rise and fade, then exit in reverse. Enter <ruby>漢字<rt>かんじ</rt></ruby>; newlines separate rows. Readings move with parent text. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
横書きの本文の上に、小さな読み仮名を添えるルビ組版です。漢字の読みや語句の注釈を、対応する親文字に沿って配置できます。

入力例：<ruby>漢字<rt>かんじ</rt></ruby>。タグ外の文字は本文になります。改行で行を分けられます。<rp>内の括弧などは表示しません。
「Ruby Size」でルビの大きさ、「Ruby Gap」で親文字との間隔、「Line Gap」で行間を調整します。長い読みは親文字の幅に縮小して収めます。
InspectorのTrackingで字間を調整できます。Line Spacingと左右・上下の揃えも反映します。
行ごとに本文とルビが一緒に浮かび上がり、アウトロでは逆の行順に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]

local kMaximumSpacing = 20.0

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

-- Keep the composition in the shared plane before Global transforms.
local function placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical, factor, verticalWriting)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.scale = character.scale * factor
    local originX = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_x or geometry.canvas_origin_x
    local originY = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_y or geometry.canvas_origin_y
    local pivotX, pivotY = character.pivot_x - 0.5, character.pivot_y - 0.5
    local displacementX = (originX - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_x * ctx.canvas.width
    local displacementY = (originY - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_y * ctx.canvas.height
    local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = (math.cos(angle) * displacementX + math.sin(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width
    local rotatedY = (-math.sin(angle) * displacementX + math.cos(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX - rotatedX
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY - rotatedY
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

local function runWidth(ctx, items, factor, verticalWriting)
    local width = 0.0
    for index in ipairs(items) do width = width + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting) end
    return math.max(0.0, width)
end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 - fraction * width
end

local function alignedTop(ctx, height)
    local fraction = ctx.global.v_align == "top" and 0.0 or ctx.global.v_align == "bottom" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 + fraction * height
end

local kVertical = false
local runs = {}
local rowCount = 0

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = kVertical
    runs = {}
    local texts = {}
    local function append(text, row, parent)
        local index = nil
        if text ~= "" then
            index = #runs + 1
            runs[index] = { row = row, parent = parent }
            texts[index] = text
        end
        return index
    end
    local text = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gsub("<rp>.-</rp>", "")
    rowCount = 0
    for line in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
        rowCount = rowCount + 1
        local cursor = 1
        while cursor <= #line do
            local first, last, parent, reading = line:find("<ruby>(.-)<rt>(.-)</rt></ruby>", cursor)
            if first then
                append(line:sub(cursor, first - 1), rowCount)
                local parentIndex = append(parent, rowCount)
                if parentIndex then append(reading, rowCount, parentIndex) end
                cursor = last + 1
            else
                append(line:sub(cursor), rowCount)
                break
            end
        end
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(texts, "\n")
end

local function placeReadingRun(ctx, items, pen, cross, factor)
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, kVertical)
        if kVertical then
            placeOrigin(ctx, character, cross, pen, factor, true)
            pen = pen - advance
        else
            placeOrigin(ctx, character, pen, cross, factor, false)
            pen = pen + advance
        end
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local alongEm = kVertical and emHeight or emWidth
    local crossEm = kVertical and emWidth or emHeight
    local readingScale = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.05, 1.0)
    local gap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumSpacing) * crossEm
    local lineGap = math.max(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, kMaximumSpacing),
        1.0 + readingScale + gap / crossEm) * crossEm * math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    local totals = {}
    for index, run in ipairs(runs) do
        run.items = groups[index] and groups[index].items or {}
        if not run.parent then
            totals[run.row] = (totals[run.row] or 0.0) + runWidth(ctx, run.items, 1.0, kVertical)
        end
    end
    local pens = {}
    for row = 1, rowCount do
        pens[row] = kVertical and alignedTop(ctx, totals[row] or 0.0) or alignedLeft(ctx, totals[row] or 0.0)
    end
    for _, run in ipairs(runs) do
        local cross = kVertical
            and alignedLeft(ctx, (rowCount - 1) * lineGap) + (rowCount - run.row) * lineGap
            or alignedTop(ctx, (rowCount - 1) * lineGap) - (run.row - 1) * lineGap
        if not run.parent then
            run.pen, run.cross = pens[run.row], cross
            run.span = runWidth(ctx, run.items, 1.0, kVertical)
            placeReadingRun(ctx, run.items, run.pen, cross, 1.0)
            pens[run.row] = run.pen + (kVertical and -1.0 or 1.0) * run.span
        else
            local parent = runs[run.parent]
            local naturalSpan = runWidth(ctx, run.items, readingScale, kVertical)
            local scale = readingScale * math.min(1.0, parent.span / math.max(naturalSpan, alongEm * 0.001))
            local span = runWidth(ctx, run.items, scale, kVertical)
            local pen = parent.pen + (kVertical and -1.0 or 1.0) * (parent.span - span) * 0.5
            -- Reading origins share the parent's baseline metrics; reserve a full em above/right.
            local readingCross = parent.cross + crossEm * (kVertical and 0.8 or 1.0) + gap
            placeReadingRun(ctx, run.items, pen, readingCross, scale)
        end
    end
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    for _, run in ipairs(runs) do
        for row = 1, run.row do units[row] = units[row] or {} end
        appendLayoutItems(units[run.row], run.items)
    end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, 0, "rise", "none")
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FIX002
-- @duration 5
-- @title Vertical Ruby
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "<ruby>漢字<rt>かんじ</rt></ruby>にルビを\n<ruby>振<rt>ふ</rt></ruby>る"
-- @input number 1 "Ruby Size" default=0.45
-- @input number 2 "Ruby Gap (em)" default=0.12
-- @input number 3 "Line Gap (em)" default=1.8
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
