-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 10 "Animation Amount" default=1
--[[ @description
Vertical ruby columns slide in from the right and exit in reverse. Enter <ruby>漢字<rt>かんじ</rt></ruby>; newlines separate columns. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
縦書きの本文の右側に、小さな読み仮名を添えるルビ組版です。文章を右から左へ並ぶ列に配置し、読みを対応する親文字に沿って添えられます。

入力例：<ruby>漢字<rt>かんじ</rt></ruby>。タグ外の文字は本文になります。改行で縦書きの列を分け、列は右から左へ配置します。<rp>内の括弧などは表示しません。
ルビは親文字の右側に配置します。「Ruby Size」で大きさ、「Ruby Gap」で間隔、「Line Gap」で列間を調整します。長い読みは親文字の長さに縮小して収めます。
InspectorのTrackingで字間を調整できます。Line Spacingと左右・上下の揃えも反映します。
縦書きの列ごとに本文とルビが右から現れ、アウトロでは逆の列順に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]

local kMaximumSpacing = 20.0

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

-- Keep the composition in the shared plane before Global transforms.
local function placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical, factor, verticalWriting)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.scale = character.scale * factor
    local originX = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_x or geometry.canvas_origin_x
    local originY = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_y or geometry.canvas_origin_y
    local pivotX, pivotY = character.pivot_x - 0.5, character.pivot_y - 0.5
    local displacementX = (originX - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_x * ctx.canvas.width
    local displacementY = (originY - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_y * ctx.canvas.height
    local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = (math.cos(angle) * displacementX + math.sin(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width
    local rotatedY = (-math.sin(angle) * displacementX + math.cos(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX - rotatedX
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY - rotatedY
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

local function runWidth(ctx, items, factor, verticalWriting)
    local width = 0.0
    for index in ipairs(items) do width = width + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting) end
    return math.max(0.0, width)
end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 - fraction * width
end

local function alignedTop(ctx, height)
    local fraction = ctx.global.v_align == "top" and 0.0 or ctx.global.v_align == "bottom" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 + fraction * height
end

local kVertical = true
local runs = {}
local rowCount = 0

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = kVertical
    runs = {}
    local texts = {}
    local function append(text, row, parent)
        local index = nil
        if text ~= "" then
            index = #runs + 1
            runs[index] = { row = row, parent = parent }
            texts[index] = text
        end
        return index
    end
    local text = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gsub("<rp>.-</rp>", "")
    rowCount = 0
    for line in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
        rowCount = rowCount + 1
        local cursor = 1
        while cursor <= #line do
            local first, last, parent, reading = line:find("<ruby>(.-)<rt>(.-)</rt></ruby>", cursor)
            if first then
                append(line:sub(cursor, first - 1), rowCount)
                local parentIndex = append(parent, rowCount)
                if parentIndex then append(reading, rowCount, parentIndex) end
                cursor = last + 1
            else
                append(line:sub(cursor), rowCount)
                break
            end
        end
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(texts, "\n")
end

local function placeReadingRun(ctx, items, pen, cross, factor)
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, kVertical)
        if kVertical then
            placeOrigin(ctx, character, cross, pen, factor, true)
            pen = pen - advance
        else
            placeOrigin(ctx, character, pen, cross, factor, false)
            pen = pen + advance
        end
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local alongEm = kVertical and emHeight or emWidth
    local crossEm = kVertical and emWidth or emHeight
    local readingScale = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.05, 1.0)
    local gap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumSpacing) * crossEm
    local lineGap = math.max(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, kMaximumSpacing),
        1.0 + readingScale + gap / crossEm) * crossEm * math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    local totals = {}
    for index, run in ipairs(runs) do
        run.items = groups[index] and groups[index].items or {}
        if not run.parent then
            totals[run.row] = (totals[run.row] or 0.0) + runWidth(ctx, run.items, 1.0, kVertical)
        end
    end
    local pens = {}
    for row = 1, rowCount do
        pens[row] = kVertical and alignedTop(ctx, totals[row] or 0.0) or alignedLeft(ctx, totals[row] or 0.0)
    end
    for _, run in ipairs(runs) do
        local cross = kVertical
            and alignedLeft(ctx, (rowCount - 1) * lineGap) + (rowCount - run.row) * lineGap
            or alignedTop(ctx, (rowCount - 1) * lineGap) - (run.row - 1) * lineGap
        if not run.parent then
            run.pen, run.cross = pens[run.row], cross
            run.span = runWidth(ctx, run.items, 1.0, kVertical)
            placeReadingRun(ctx, run.items, run.pen, cross, 1.0)
            pens[run.row] = run.pen + (kVertical and -1.0 or 1.0) * run.span
        else
            local parent = runs[run.parent]
            local naturalSpan = runWidth(ctx, run.items, readingScale, kVertical)
            local scale = readingScale * math.min(1.0, parent.span / math.max(naturalSpan, alongEm * 0.001))
            local span = runWidth(ctx, run.items, scale, kVertical)
            local pen = parent.pen + (kVertical and -1.0 or 1.0) * (parent.span - span) * 0.5
            -- Reading origins share the parent's baseline metrics; reserve a full em above/right.
            local readingCross = parent.cross + crossEm * (kVertical and 0.8 or 1.0) + gap
            placeReadingRun(ctx, run.items, pen, readingCross, scale)
        end
    end
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    for _, run in ipairs(runs) do
        for row = 1, run.row do units[row] = units[row] or {} end
        appendLayoutItems(units[run.row], run.items)
    end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, 0, "right", "none")
end

local function placeRun(ctx, items, horizontal, baseline, factor)

        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, false)
        placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, baseline, factor, false)
        horizontal = horizontal + advance
    end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5

    return 0.5 + fraction * height

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local lines = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    local _, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local subtitleScale = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.05, 2.0)
    local gap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumSpacing) * emHeight * math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    local maximumWidth = 0.0
    for index, line in ipairs(lines) do
        line.scale = index == 1 and 1.0 or subtitleScale
        line.width = runWidth(ctx, line.items, line.scale)
        maximumWidth = math.max(maximumWidth, line.width)
    end
    for index, line in ipairs(lines) do
        local left = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and alignedLeft(ctx, maximumWidth) or alignedLeft(ctx, line.width)
        placeRun(ctx, line.items, left, alignedTop(ctx, (#lines - 1) * gap) - (index - 1) * gap, line.scale)
    end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0

        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0

    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)

        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    for _, line in ipairs(mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)) do units[#units + 1] = line.items end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, 0, "rise", "none")

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FIX004
-- @duration 5
-- @title Arc Text
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "MUG TYPOGRAPHY"
-- @input number 1 "Radius (em)" default=5
-- @input number 2 "Arc Angle (degrees)" default=120
-- @input boolean 1 "Rotate Characters" default=true
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 10 "Animation Amount" default=1
--[[ @description
Characters follow a circular arc with a flowing entrance and reverse exit. Enter ordinary text; newlines become spaces. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字を円弧に沿って並べるレイアウトです。ロゴや見出しを弧状に配置でき、文字の向きを水平に保つか、弧に沿って回転させるかを選べます。

通常の文字列を入力します。改行は空白に置き換えます。
「Radius」で円弧の半径、「Arc Angle」で開き角を調整します。角度を負にすると逆向きに曲がります。「Rotate Characters」がONなら各文字が円弧の接線に沿って回転します。
InspectorのTrackingで字間を調整できます。
文字が円弧に沿う向きへ流れながら順に現れ、アウトロでは末尾から逆順に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false
    ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gsub("[\r\n]", " ")
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local radius = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.1, 100.0)
    local angle = math.rad(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], -360.0, 360.0))
    local total, naturalTotal = 0.0, 0.0
    local items = {}
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        items[#items + 1] = character
        naturalTotal = naturalTotal + math.abs(character.geometry.advance_x)
    end
    for index in ipairs(items) do total = total + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, 1.0, false) end
    if #items > 0 then
        local last = items[#items]
        total = total - (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[last.index] or 0.0)) * emWidth
    end
    if naturalTotal > 0.0 then angle = angle * total / naturalTotal end
    local pen = 0.0
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, 1.0, false)
        local glyphWidth = math.abs(character.geometry.advance_x) * character.scale * character.stretch_x
        local fraction = total > 0.0 and (pen + glyphWidth * 0.5) / total or 0.5
        local phase = (fraction - 0.5) * math.abs(angle)
        local direction = angle < 0.0 and -1.0 or 1.0
        local horizontal = 0.5 + math.sin(phase) * radius * emWidth
        local vertical = 0.5 + direction * (math.cos(phase) - 1.0) * radius * emHeight
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - character.geometry.bounds_center_x
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - character.geometry.bounds_center_y
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and direction * math.deg(phase) or 0.0)
        pen = pen + advance
    end
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do units[#units + 1] = { character } end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, 0, "tangent", "none")
end
description: Characters follow a circular arc with a flowing entrance and reverse exit. Enter ordinary text; newlines become spaces. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.

通常の文字列を入力します。改行は空白に置き換えます。

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FIX005
-- @duration 5
-- @title Indented List
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "主な機能\n  テキスト配置\n    ルビ\n    円弧配置\n  アニメーション\n導入手順\n  インストール"
-- @input number 1 "Indent (em)" default=1.2
-- @input number 2 "Line Gap (em)" default=1.4
-- @input number 3 "Nested Size Ratio" default=1
-- @input number 4 "Marker (0=None 1=Bullet 2=Number 3=SVG)" default=1
-- @input number 5 "Wrap Width (em, 0=Off)" default=16
-- @input number 6 "Marker Size" default=1
-- @input number 7 "Marker Gap (em)" default=0.35
-- @input text 1 "Marker SVG" default="<svg viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path d='M4 11 LYR001 17 L20 5 L22 7 LYR001 21 L2 13 Z'/></svg>"
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 10 "Animation Amount" default=1
--[[ @description
Indented list items slide in and retreat in reverse order. Tabs or paired spaces indent; Marker=3 uses Marker SVG. Wrap Width controls wrapping. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
字下げで階層を表すリストです。箇条書き・番号付きリスト・項目の構成図に使え、長い項目は本文の開始位置に揃えて折り返せます。項目の先頭には独自のSVGアイコンも使えます。

1行に1項目を入力し、行頭のタブ1個、または半角スペース2個で1階層下げます。例：機能［改行］半角スペース2個＋ルビ。タブとスペースは混在できます。
「Indent」で階層ごとの字下げ幅、「Line Gap」で行間、「Nested Size Ratio」で下位階層のサイズ比を調整します。
「Marker」は0＝なし、1＝中黒、2＝階層ごとの番号、3＝SVGです。「Wrap Width」は全体の折り返し幅（em単位）。0なら折り返しません。文字単位で折り返し、継続行は本文開始位置に揃えます。空行は残します。
「Marker SVG」にSVG全体またはパスのd属性を貼り付け、「Marker」を3にすると項目の先頭に表示します。
例：<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"/></svg>。viewBoxから縦横比を保って大きさを揃え、省略時やパスのみの入力は0 0 24 24として扱います。
path・circle・ellipse・rect・polygon・polyline・lineに対応します。SVG内の色は使わず、Inspectorの色・質感で描画します。A/a命令・transform・use・画像・文字・クリッピングには対応せず、空入力や読めないSVGは中黒に戻ります。
「Marker Size」で全マーカーのサイズ比、「Marker Gap」で本文までの間隔を調整します。マーカーは各項目の先頭行だけに付けます。
InspectorのTrackingで字間を調整できます。Line Spacingと左右・上下の揃えも反映します。
マーカーと本文が項目ごとに左から現れ、アウトロでは下の項目から逆順に左へ退きます。折り返し行も同じ項目として動きます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]

local kMaximumSpacing = 20.0

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

-- Keep the composition in the shared plane before Global transforms.
local function placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical, factor, verticalWriting)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.scale = character.scale * factor
    local originX = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_x or geometry.canvas_origin_x
    local originY = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_y or geometry.canvas_origin_y
    local pivotX, pivotY = character.pivot_x - 0.5, character.pivot_y - 0.5
    local displacementX = (originX - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_x * ctx.canvas.width
    local displacementY = (originY - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_y * ctx.canvas.height
    local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = (math.cos(angle) * displacementX + math.sin(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width
    local rotatedY = (-math.sin(angle) * displacementX + math.cos(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX - rotatedX
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY - rotatedY
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

local function runWidth(ctx, items, factor, verticalWriting)
    local width = 0.0
    for index in ipairs(items) do width = width + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting) end
    return math.max(0.0, width)
end

local function placeRun(ctx, items, horizontal, baseline, factor)
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        if factor == 0.0 then character.opacity = 0.0 end
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, false)
        placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, baseline, factor, false)
        horizontal = horizontal + advance
    end
end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 - fraction * width
end

local function alignedTop(ctx, height)
    local fraction = ctx.global.v_align == "top" and 0.0 or ctx.global.v_align == "bottom" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 + fraction * height
end

local kEllipseControlRatio = 0.5523

local function ellipseToPathData(centerX, centerY, radiusX, radiusY)
    local controlX = radiusX * kEllipseControlRatio
    local controlY = radiusY * kEllipseControlRatio
    return string.format(
        "M%f %fC%f %f %f %f %f %fC%f %f %f %f %f %fC%f %f %f %f %f %fC%f %f %f %f %f %fz",
        centerX,
        centerY - radiusY,
        centerX + controlX,
        centerY - radiusY,
        centerX + radiusX,
        centerY - controlY,
        centerX + radiusX,
        centerY,
        centerX + radiusX,
        centerY + controlY,
        centerX + controlX,
        centerY + radiusY,
        centerX,
        centerY + radiusY,
        centerX - controlX,
        centerY + radiusY,
        centerX - radiusX,
        centerY + controlY,
        centerX - radiusX,
        centerY,
        centerX - radiusX,
        centerY - controlY,
        centerX - controlX,
        centerY - radiusY,
        centerX,
        centerY - radiusY
    )
end

local function rectangleToPathData(x, y, width, height, radiusX, radiusY)
    local right = x + width
    local bottom = y + height

    if radiusX <= 0.0 or radiusY <= 0.0 then
        return string.format("M%f %fL%f %fL%f %fL%f %fz", x, y, right, y, right, bottom, x, bottom)
    end

    local controlX = radiusX * kEllipseControlRatio
    local controlY = radiusY * kEllipseControlRatio
    return string.format(
        "M%f %fL%f %fC%f %f %f %f %f %fL%f %fC%f %f %f %f %f %fL%f %fC%f %f %f %f %f %fL%f %fC%f %f %f %f %f %fz",
        x + radiusX,
        y,
        right - radiusX,
        y,
        right - radiusX + controlX,
        y,
        right,
        y + radiusY - controlY,
        right,
        y + radiusY,
        right,
        bottom - radiusY,
        right,
        bottom - radiusY + controlY,
        right - radiusX + controlX,
        bottom,
        right - radiusX,
        bottom,
        x + radiusX,
        bottom,
        x + radiusX - controlX,
        bottom,
        x,
        bottom - radiusY + controlY,
        x,
        bottom - radiusY,
        x,
        y + radiusY,
        x,
        y + radiusY - controlY,
        x + radiusX - controlX,
        y,
        x + radiusX,
        y
    )
end

local function pointsToPathData(points, close)
    local coordinates = {}

    for value in points:gmatch("[-+%d%.eE]+") do
        coordinates[#coordinates + 1] = tonumber(value)
    end

    local result = nil

    if #coordinates >= 4 then
        local commands = {}

        for index = 1, #coordinates - 1, 2 do
            commands[#commands + 1] =
                string.format("%s%f %f", #commands == 0 and "M" or "L", coordinates[index], coordinates[index + 1])
        end

        result = table.concat(commands) .. (close and "z" or "")
    end

    return result
end

local function readNumberAttribute(attributes, name)
    local value = attributes:match("%f[%a]" .. name .. '%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"') or attributes:match("%f[%a]" .. name .. "%s*=%s*'([^']*)'")
    return value and tonumber(value) or nil
end

local function parseSvgSource(source)
    local result = nil

    if source ~= nil and source ~= "" then
        if source:match("^%s*[Mm]") then
            result = {
                d = source,
                viewBox = nil,
            }
        else
            local viewBox = nil
            local viewBoxText = source:match('viewBox%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"') or source:match("viewBox%s*=%s*'([^']*)'")

            if viewBoxText then
                local numbers = {}

                for value in viewBoxText:gmatch("[-%d%.eE+]+") do
                    numbers[#numbers + 1] = tonumber(value)
                end

                if #numbers == 4 and numbers[3] > 0.0 and numbers[4] > 0.0 then
                    viewBox = numbers
                end
                assert(viewBox, "invalid viewBox")
            end

            local pathData = {}

            for element, attributes in source:gmatch("<(%a+)([^>]*)>") do
                local converted = nil

                if element == "path" then
                    converted = attributes:match('%sd%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"') or attributes:match("%sd%s*=%s*'([^']*)'")
                elseif element == "circle" or element == "ellipse" then
                    local centerX = readNumberAttribute(attributes, "cx") or 0.0
                    local centerY = readNumberAttribute(attributes, "cy") or 0.0
                    local radiusX = readNumberAttribute(attributes, element == "circle" and "r" or "rx")
                    local radiusY = element == "circle" and radiusX or readNumberAttribute(attributes, "ry")

                    if radiusX ~= nil and radiusY ~= nil and radiusX > 0.0 and radiusY > 0.0 then
                        converted = ellipseToPathData(centerX, centerY, radiusX, radiusY)
                    end
                elseif element == "rect" then
                    local width = readNumberAttribute(attributes, "width")
                    local height = readNumberAttribute(attributes, "height")

                    if width ~= nil and height ~= nil and width > 0.0 and height > 0.0 then
                        local radiusX = readNumberAttribute(attributes, "rx")
                        local radiusY = readNumberAttribute(attributes, "ry")
                        radiusX = radiusX or radiusY or 0.0
                        radiusY = radiusY or radiusX

                        converted = rectangleToPathData(
                            readNumberAttribute(attributes, "x") or 0.0,
                            readNumberAttribute(attributes, "y") or 0.0,
                            width,
                            height,
                            math.min(radiusX, width * 0.5),
                            math.min(radiusY, height * 0.5)
                        )
                    end
                elseif element == "polygon" or element == "polyline" then
                    local points = attributes:match('points%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"')
                        or attributes:match("points%s*=%s*'([^']*)'")

                    if points then
                        converted = pointsToPathData(points, element == "polygon")
                    end
                elseif element == "line" then
                    converted = string.format(
                        "M%f %fL%f %f",
                        readNumberAttribute(attributes, "x1") or 0.0,
                        readNumberAttribute(attributes, "y1") or 0.0,
                        readNumberAttribute(attributes, "x2") or 0.0,
                        readNumberAttribute(attributes, "y2") or 0.0
                    )
                end

                if converted then
                    pathData[#pathData + 1] = converted
                end
            end

            if #pathData > 0 then
                result = {
                    d = table.concat(pathData, " "),
                    viewBox = viewBox,
                }
            end
        end
    end

    return result
end



local markerCache = { source = "\0", path = nil }
local kMarkerAdvance = 600.0

local function resolveMarkerSvg(source)
    if source ~= markerCache.source then
        markerCache.source = source
        markerCache.path = nil
        local trimmed = source:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if trimmed ~= "" then
            local succeeded, path = pcall(function()
                assert(not trimmed:match("%f[%a]transform%s*="), "transforms are unsupported")
                assert(not trimmed:match("<%s*[uU][sS][eE]%f[%A]") and not trimmed:match("<%s*[iI][mM][aA][gG][eE]%f[%A]")
                    and not trimmed:match("<%s*[tT][eE][xX][tT]%f[%A]") and not trimmed:match("%f[%a]clip%-path%s*=") and not trimmed:match("<[cC][lL][iI][pP][pP][aA][tT][hH]%f[%A]"),
                    "references, images, text and clipping are unsupported")
                local parsed = parseSvgSource(trimmed)
                assert(parsed and not parsed.d:match("[Aa]"), "invalid SVG or unsupported arc commands")
                local template = mt.svg_path(parsed.d, { view_box = parsed.viewBox or { 0, 0, 24, 24 }, em_scale = 0.6 })
                assert(template:bounds(), "SVG has no geometry")
                return template
            end)
            if succeeded then markerCache.path = path
            else print("Marker SVG could not be read; using a bullet. " .. tostring(path)) end
        end
    end
    return markerCache.path
end

local rows = {}
local segments = {}

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false
    rows, segments = {}, {}
    local texts = {}
    local mode = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 3.0) + 0.5)
    local counters = {}
    local customMarker = ""
    if mode == 3 and ctx.meta.limits.max_characters > 0 then
        local path = resolveMarkerSvg(ctx.inputs.texts[1] or "")
        if path then customMarker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = path, advance_x = kMarkerAdvance }) end
    end
    for line in (ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n") .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
        local prefix, body = line:match("^([ 	]*)(.*)$")
        local columns = 0
        for symbol in prefix:gmatch(".") do columns = columns + (symbol == "	" and 2 or 1) end
        local level = math.floor(columns / 2)
        local row = { level = level, body = {}, marker = {} }
        rows[#rows + 1] = row
        if body ~= "" then
            counters[level] = (counters[level] or 0) + 1
            for depth in pairs(counters) do if depth > level then counters[depth] = nil end end
            local marker = mode == 1 and "•" or mode == 2 and tostring(counters[level]) .. "."
                or mode == 3 and (customMarker ~= "" and customMarker or "•") or ""
            for _, entry in ipairs({ { text = marker, key = "marker" }, { text = body, key = "body" } }) do
                if entry.text ~= "" then
                    texts[#texts + 1] = entry.text
                    segments[#segments + 1] = { row = row, key = entry.key }
                end
            end
        end
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(texts, "\n")
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for index, segment in ipairs(segments) do
        segment.row[segment.key] = groups[index] and groups[index].items or {}
    end
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local indent = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumSpacing) * emWidth
    local gap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.1, kMaximumSpacing) * emHeight * math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    local ratio = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.1, 1.0)
    local wrap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 100.0) * emWidth
    local markerSize = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 10.0)
    local markerGap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, kMaximumSpacing) * emWidth
    local markerWidth = 0.0
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        row.scale = math.max(0.05, ratio ^ row.level)
        markerWidth = math.max(markerWidth, runWidth(ctx, row.marker, row.scale * markerSize))
    end
    if markerWidth > 0.0 then markerWidth = markerWidth + markerGap end
    local placements = {}
    local baseline = 0.0
    local maximumRight = 0.0
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        local left = row.level * indent
        local bodyLeft = left + markerWidth
        placements[#placements + 1] = { items = row.marker, x = left, y = baseline, scale = row.scale * markerSize }
        local pen = bodyLeft
        for index, character in ipairs(row.body) do
            local advance = runAdvance(ctx, row.body, index, row.scale, false)
            if wrap > 0.0 and pen > bodyLeft and pen + advance > math.max(wrap, bodyLeft + emWidth) then
                baseline = baseline - gap
                pen = bodyLeft
            end
            placements[#placements + 1] = { items = { character }, x = pen, y = baseline, scale = row.scale }
            pen = pen + advance
            maximumRight = math.max(maximumRight, pen)
        end
        baseline = baseline - gap
    end
    local centerY = alignedTop(ctx, -(baseline + gap))
    for _, placement in ipairs(placements) do
        placeRun(ctx, placement.items, alignedLeft(ctx, maximumRight) + placement.x,
            centerY + placement.y, placement.scale)
    end
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        local unit = {}
        appendLayoutItems(unit, row.marker)
        appendLayoutItems(unit, row.body)
        if #unit > 0 then units[#units + 1] = unit end
    end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, 0, "left", "none")
end
description: Indented list items slide in and retreat in reverse order. Tabs or paired spaces indent; Marker=3 uses Marker SVG. Wrap Width controls wrapping. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.

descriptions.ja:
字下げで階層を表すリストです。箇条書き・番号付きリスト・項目の構成図に使え、長い項目は本文の開始位置に揃えて折り返せます。項目の先頭には独自のSVGアイコンも使えます。

1行に1項目を入力し、行頭のタブ1個、または半角スペース2個で1階層下げます。例：機能［改行］半角スペース2個＋ルビ。タブとスペースは混在できます。
「Indent」で階層ごとの字下げ幅、「Line Gap」で行間、「Nested Size Ratio」で下位階層のサイズ比を調整します。
「Marker」は0＝なし、1＝中黒、2＝階層ごとの番号、3＝SVGです。「Wrap Width」は全体の折り返し幅（em単位）。0なら折り返しません。文字単位で折り返し、継続行は本文開始位置に揃えます。空行は残します。
「Marker SVG」にSVG全体またはパスのd属性を貼り付け、「Marker」を3にすると項目の先頭に表示します。
例：<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"/></svg>。viewBoxから縦横比を保って大きさを揃え、省略時やパスのみの入力は0 0 24 24として扱います。
path・circle・ellipse・rect・polygon・polyline・lineに対応します。SVG内の色は使わず、Inspectorの色・質感で描画します。A/a命令・transform・use・画像・文字・クリッピングには対応せず、空入力や読めないSVGは中黒に戻ります。
「Marker Size」で全マーカーのサイズ比、「Marker Gap」で本文までの間隔を調整します。マーカーは各項目の先頭行だけに付けます。
InspectorのTrackingで字間を調整できます。Line Spacingと左右・上下の揃えも反映します。
マーカーと本文が項目ごとに左から現れ、アウトロでは下の項目から逆順に左へ退きます。折り返し行も同じ項目として動きます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。

name: FIX006_table.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FIX006
-- @duration 5
-- @title Table
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "品名	数量	価格\nコーヒー	2	600円\n紅茶	1	450円\nケーキ	3	1,500円"
-- @input boolean 1 "Header Row" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Equal Columns" default=false
-- @input number 1 "Column Gap (em)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Row Height (em)" default=1.5
-- @input number 3 "Cell Padding (em)" default=0.2
-- @input number 4 "Header Size" default=1.1
-- @input number 5 "Rules (0=None 1=Horizontal 2=Grid)" default=1
-- @input number 6 "Rule Width (em)" default=0.025
-- @input text 1 "Column Alignment" default="left,right,right"
-- @input color 1 "Header Color" default={0.2, 0.65, 1, 1}
-- @input color 2 "Rule Color" default={0.6, 0.65, 0.7, 1}
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 10 "Animation Amount" default=1
--[[ @description
Table rows fade in from top to bottom while the grid rises with the content. Paste tab-separated cells and newline-separated rows. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
複数の項目を行と列に揃えて並べる表です。料金表や比較表、一覧表などを作れ、見出し行・列ごとの文字揃え・罫線を設定できます。

タブ区切りの表を貼り付けます（例：品名［タブ］数量［タブ］価格）。改行で次の行になります。
「Header Row」がONなら1行目を見出しにします。空セル・列不足は空欄として扱います。セル内改行には対応しません。
「Column Alignment」に left,right,right のように列順で指定します（left／center／right）。未指定の列は左揃えです。
「Rules」は0＝なし、1＝横線、2＝格子。「Equal Columns」がONなら列幅を均等にします。
InspectorのTrackingで字間を調整できます。Line Spacingと左右・上下の揃えも反映します。
罫線と本文が一緒に下から浮かび上がり、セルの内容は行順に現れます。アウトロでは下の行から消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]

local kMaximumSpacing = 20.0

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

-- Keep the composition in the shared plane before Global transforms.
local function placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical, factor, verticalWriting)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.scale = character.scale * factor
    local originX = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_x or geometry.canvas_origin_x
    local originY = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_y or geometry.canvas_origin_y
    local pivotX, pivotY = character.pivot_x - 0.5, character.pivot_y - 0.5
    local displacementX = (originX - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_x * ctx.canvas.width
    local displacementY = (originY - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_y * ctx.canvas.height
    local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = (math.cos(angle) * displacementX + math.sin(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width
    local rotatedY = (-math.sin(angle) * displacementX + math.cos(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX - rotatedX
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY - rotatedY
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

local function runWidth(ctx, items, factor, verticalWriting)
    local width = 0.0
    for index in ipairs(items) do width = width + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting) end
    return math.max(0.0, width)
end

local function placeRun(ctx, items, horizontal, baseline, factor)
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, false)
        placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, baseline, factor, false)
        horizontal = horizontal + advance
    end
end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 - fraction * width
end

local function alignedTop(ctx, height)
    local fraction = ctx.global.v_align == "top" and 0.0 or ctx.global.v_align == "bottom" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 + fraction * height
end

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local cells = {}
local rowCount, columnCount = 0, 0
local marker = ""
local ruleIndex = 0
local rulesPath = mt.drawing_path()
local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
placeholder:close()

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false
    cells, rowCount, columnCount = {}, 0, 0
    marker = ""
    local texts = {}
    local text = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    for line in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
        rowCount = rowCount + 1
        local column = 0
        for cell in (line .. "	"):gmatch("(.-)	") do
            column = column + 1
            if cell ~= "" then
                cells[#cells + 1] = { row = rowCount, column = column }
                texts[#texts + 1] = cell
            end
        end
        columnCount = math.max(columnCount, column)
    end
    if #cells > 0 and ctx.meta.limits.max_characters > 0 then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, advance_x = 0, advance_y = 0,
            bounds = { -500, -500, 500, 500 } })
        texts[#texts + 1] = marker
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(texts, "\n")
end

local function rectangle(left, bottom, right, top, emWidth, emHeight)
    local horizontal = (left - 0.5) / emWidth * kUnitsPerEm
    local vertical = (0.5 - top) / emHeight * kUnitsPerEm
    local width = (right - left) / emWidth * kUnitsPerEm
    local height = (top - bottom) / emHeight * kUnitsPerEm
    rulesPath:move_to(horizontal, vertical)
    rulesPath:line_to(horizontal + width, vertical)
    rulesPath:line_to(horizontal + width, vertical + height)
    rulesPath:line_to(horizontal, vertical + height)
    rulesPath:close()
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    ruleIndex = 0
    rulesPath = mt.drawing_path()
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local padding = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, kMaximumSpacing)
    local gap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumSpacing) * emWidth
    local headerScale = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.05, 3.0) or 1.0
    local rowHeight = math.max(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.1, kMaximumSpacing),
        math.max(1.0, headerScale) + padding * 2.0) * emHeight * math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    local widths, lefts = {}, {}
    for column = 1, columnCount do widths[column] = 0.0 end
    local maximumWidth = 0.0
    for index, cell in ipairs(cells) do
        cell.items = groups[index] and groups[index].items or {}
        cell.scale = cell.row == 1 and headerScale or 1.0
        cell.width = runWidth(ctx, cell.items, cell.scale)
        widths[cell.column] = math.max(widths[cell.column], cell.width)
        maximumWidth = math.max(maximumWidth, cell.width)
    end
    local total = 0.0
    for column = 1, columnCount do
        widths[column] = (ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and maximumWidth or widths[column]) + padding * 2.0 * emWidth
        lefts[column] = total
        total = total + widths[column] + (column < columnCount and gap or 0.0)
    end
    local alignments = {}
    for alignment in (ctx.inputs.texts[1] .. ","):gmatch("(.-),") do
        alignments[#alignments + 1] = alignment:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower()
    end
    local left = alignedLeft(ctx, total)
    local top = alignedTop(ctx, rowCount * rowHeight)
    for _, cell in ipairs(cells) do
        local available = widths[cell.column] - padding * 2.0 * emWidth - cell.width
        local alignment = alignments[cell.column]
        local offset = alignment == "right" and available or alignment == "center" and available * 0.5 or 0.0
        local baseline = top - (cell.row - 0.5) * rowHeight - cell.scale * emHeight * 0.3
        placeRun(ctx, cell.items, left + lefts[cell.column] + padding * emWidth + offset, baseline, cell.scale)
        if cell.row == 1 and ctx.inputs.booleans[1] then
            for _, character in ipairs(cell.items) do
                local color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
                local inherited = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
                character.fill.use = true
                character.fill.color = { r = color.r, g = color.g, b = color.b, a = inherited.a }
            end
        end
    end
    if marker ~= "" and ctx.char_count > 0 and ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].text == marker then
        ruleIndex = ctx.char_count
        local character = ctx.chars[ruleIndex]
        local geometry = character.geometry
        character.scale = 1.0
        character.pivot_x, character.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
        character.offset_x = 1.0 - geometry.bounds_center_x
        character.offset_y = 1.0 - geometry.bounds_center_y
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[2]
        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width, character.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
        character.texture.use, character.texture.type = true, "none"
        local mode = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) + 0.5)
        local thickness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 0.2)
        character.opacity = mode > 0 and thickness > 0 and 1.0 or 0.0
        if mode > 0 and thickness > 0 then
            for row = 0, rowCount do
                local vertical = top - row * rowHeight
                rectangle(left, vertical - thickness * emHeight * 0.5, left + total,
                    vertical + thickness * emHeight * 0.5, emWidth, emHeight)
            end
            if mode == 2 then
                for column = 0, columnCount do
                    local horizontal = column == 0 and left or left + lefts[column] + widths[column]
                        + (column < columnCount and gap * 0.5 or 0.0)
                    rectangle(horizontal - thickness * emWidth * 0.5, top - rowCount * rowHeight,
                        horizontal + thickness * emWidth * 0.5, top, emWidth, emHeight)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    if ruleIndex > 0 then
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(ruleIndex)) do part.path:assign(rulesPath) end
    end
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    for row = 1, rowCount do units[row] = {} end
    for _, cell in ipairs(cells) do appendLayoutItems(units[cell.row], cell.items) end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, ruleIndex, "none", "rise")
end

「Rules」は0＝なし、1＝横線、2＝格子。「Equal Columns」がONなら列幅を均等にします。
InspectorのTrackingで字間を調整できます。Line Spacingと左右・上下の揃えも反映します。
罫線と本文が一緒に下から浮かび上がり、セルの内容は行順に現れます。アウトロでは下の行から消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
