-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FIX007
-- @duration 5
-- @title Monthly Calendar
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "4,打ち合わせ\n12,撮影\n23,締め切り"
-- @input number 1 "Year" default=2026
-- @input number 2 "Month" default=10
-- @input number 3 "Cell Width (em)" default=2.1
-- @input number 4 "Cell Height (em)" default=1.15
-- @input number 5 "Highlight Day (0=Off)" default=4
-- @input number 6 "Event Size" default=0.22
-- @input number 7 "Line Width (em)" default=0.015
-- @input number 11 "Cell Fill Opacity (0=Off)" default=0
-- @input boolean 1 "Monday First" default=false
-- @input boolean 2 "Adjacent Dates" default=true
-- @input color 1 "Grid Color" default={0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 1}
-- @input color 2 "Weekend Color" default={1, 0.4, 0.4, 1}
-- @input color 3 "Highlight Color" default={0.2, 0.7, 1, 1}
-- @input color 4 "Adjacent Color" default={0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1}
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 10 "Animation Amount" default=1
--[[ @description
Monthly calendar weeks appear sequentially, then fade in reverse. Set Year and Month; enter day,label per line, e.g. 4,Meeting. Cell Fill Opacity tints each date cell with a darkened kind color. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
指定した年月の日付と予定を、曜日ごとの格子に配置する月間カレンダーです。予定の一覧や告知に使え、週末の色分けや特定の日付の強調もできます。

予定は「日付,ラベル」を1行ずつ入力します。例：4,打ち合わせ［改行］12,撮影。同じ日の予定は「 / 」でまとめます。
「Year」「Month」で年月を指定します（年1〜9999、月1〜12）。うるう年と月ごとの日数を自動計算します。
「Monday First」で月曜／日曜始まりを切り替え、「Adjacent Dates」で前後月の日付を表示します。「Highlight Day」は0で無効です。
「Cell Fill Opacity (0=Off)」で日付枠の塗りの濃さを指定します（0で塗りません）。平日はGrid Color、週末はWeekend Color、Highlight DayはHighlight Color、前後月の日付はAdjacent Colorを、それぞれ暗くした色で塗り、塗った枠の日付は塗りの濃さに応じて白寄りにします。塗りは日付枠ごとに文字を1つずつ使うため（最大42）、文字数の上限に空きが足りないときは塗りません。
空入力でもカレンダーを表示します。不正な日付・書式の予定は無視します。予定はセル幅に縮小して収めます。
InspectorのTracking・Line Spacing・全体の位置／回転／拡大を反映します。本文の色・質感はInspectorから調整できます。
年月・曜日が先に現れ、日付と予定が週ごとに続きます。アウトロでは最後の週から逆順に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]
local kMaximumSpacing = 20.0

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

-- Keep the composition in the shared plane before Global transforms.
local function placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical, factor, verticalWriting)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.scale = character.scale * factor
    local originX = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_x or geometry.canvas_origin_x
    local originY = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_y or geometry.canvas_origin_y
    local pivotX, pivotY = character.pivot_x - 0.5, character.pivot_y - 0.5
    local displacementX = (originX - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_x * ctx.canvas.width
    local displacementY = (originY - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_y * ctx.canvas.height
    local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = (math.cos(angle) * displacementX + math.sin(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width
    local rotatedY = (-math.sin(angle) * displacementX + math.cos(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX - rotatedX
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY - rotatedY
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

local function runWidth(ctx, items, factor, verticalWriting)
    local width = 0.0
    for index in ipairs(items) do width = width + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting) end
    return math.max(0.0, width)
end

local function placeRun(ctx, items, horizontal, baseline, factor)
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, false)
        placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, baseline, factor, false)
        horizontal = horizontal + advance
    end
end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 - fraction * width
end

local function alignedTop(ctx, height)
    local fraction = ctx.global.v_align == "top" and 0.0 or ctx.global.v_align == "bottom" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 + fraction * height
end

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kCircleSegments = 32
local records = {}
local texts = {}
local marker = ""
local fillMarkers = {}
local fillIndexByMarker = {}
local fills = {}
local fillOpacity = 0.0
local decorationIndex = 0
local drawing = mt.drawing_path()
local shapeCount = 0
local layoutLeft, layoutTop = 0.5, 0.5
local gridOriginX, gridOriginY = 0.0, 0.0
local farX, farY = 1, 1
local layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight, layoutLineSpacing = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
placeholder:close()

-- Each filled cell has its own marker character, so a tilt gives it a depth of its own. Depth is read at a
-- character's origin, so the origin of a fill sits at the far corner of its cell (nothing is moved, only the
-- rectangle's offset from the origin changes) and the origin of the grid sits at the near corner of the grid:
-- fills then paint before the text of their cell, and the grid paints after the fills and the text.
-- A fill is the kind's color darkened, and the text on a filled cell is lifted toward white in step with the
-- fill opacity, so text stays readable on a fill of its own hue and an opacity of 0 changes nothing.
local kFillShade = 0.4
local kTextLift = 0.6

local function shaded(color)
    return { r = color.r * kFillShade, g = color.g * kFillShade, b = color.b * kFillShade, a = color.a }
end

local function lifted(color, amount)
    return { r = color.r + (1.0 - color.r) * amount, g = color.g + (1.0 - color.g) * amount,
        b = color.b + (1.0 - color.b) * amount, a = color.a }
end

local function fillOpacityInput(ctx)
    return mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[11], 0.0, 1.0)
end

local function trim(text)
    return text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end

local function beginText(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false
    records, texts, marker = {}, {}, ""
    fillMarkers = {}
end

local function addText(text)
    local record = { items = {}, text = text }
    if text ~= "" then
        records[#records + 1] = record
        texts[#texts + 1] = text
    end
    return record
end

local function finishText(ctx, fillable)
    if #records > 0 and ctx.meta.limits.max_characters > 0 then
        local function declareMarker()
            return ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, advance_x = 0, advance_y = 0,
                bounds = { -500, -500, 500, 500 } })
        end
        marker = declareMarker()
        -- Fills are all or nothing: a cell needs its own character to keep its own depth under a tilt.
        local spare = ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - (utf8.len(table.concat(texts)) or 0) - 1
        if fillOpacityInput(ctx) > 0.0 and spare >= #fillable then
            for index, cell in ipairs(fillable) do
                cell.fillMarker = declareMarker()
                fillMarkers[index] = cell.fillMarker
            end
        end
        texts[#texts + 1] = table.concat(fillMarkers) .. marker
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(texts, "\n")
end

local function styleDecoration(ctx, index, color)
    local character = ctx.chars[index]
    character.scale, character.stretch_x, character.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    character.pivot_x, character.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    character.rotation, character.yaw, character.pitch, character.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    character.fill.use, character.fill.color = true, color
    character.stroke.use = true
    character.stroke.width, character.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    character.shadow.use = true
    character.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    character.texture.use, character.texture.type = true, "none"
    character.blur.use = true
    character.blur.amount_x, character.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    character.opacity = 0.0
end

-- +1 when view depth grows toward +X (right) / +Y (down) of the calendar plane. The plane is posed by Global as
-- Rz * Ry * Rx (positive yaw brings the right end nearer, positive pitch the top end) and then seen from the
-- camera orbit, whose view depth axis is (-sin(yaw) cos(pitch), sin(pitch), cos(yaw) cos(pitch)).
local function farDirections(ctx)
    local radians = math.pi / 180.0
    local yaw, pitch, roll = ctx.global.yaw * radians, ctx.global.pitch * radians, ctx.global.rotation * radians
    local cosYaw, sinYaw, cosPitch, sinPitch = math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw), math.cos(pitch), math.sin(pitch)
    local cosRoll, sinRoll = math.cos(roll), math.sin(roll)
    local eyeYaw, eyePitch = ctx.camera.yaw * radians, ctx.camera.pitch * radians
    local depthX = -math.sin(eyeYaw) * math.cos(eyePitch)
    local depthY = math.sin(eyePitch)
    local depthZ = math.cos(eyeYaw) * math.cos(eyePitch)
    local rightDepth = depthX * cosRoll * cosYaw + depthY * sinRoll * cosYaw - depthZ * sinYaw
    local downDepth = depthX * (cosRoll * sinYaw * sinPitch - sinRoll * cosPitch)
        + depthY * (sinRoll * sinYaw * sinPitch + cosRoll * cosPitch) + depthZ * cosYaw * sinPitch
    return rightDepth >= 0.0 and 1 or -1, downDepth >= 0.0 and 1 or -1
end

local function beginLayout(ctx)
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for index, record in ipairs(records) do record.items = groups[index] and groups[index].items or {} end
    layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight = emSize(ctx)
    layoutLineSpacing = math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    drawing, shapeCount, decorationIndex = mt.drawing_path(), 0, 0
    farX, farY = farDirections(ctx)
    fills, fillIndexByMarker, fillOpacity = {}, {}, fillOpacityInput(ctx)
    if marker ~= "" and ctx.char_count > 0 and ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].text == marker then
        decorationIndex = ctx.char_count
        styleDecoration(ctx, decorationIndex, ctx.inputs.colors[1])
        local isFillMarker = {}
        for _, fillMarker in ipairs(fillMarkers) do isFillMarker[fillMarker] = true end
        for index = 1, ctx.char_count - 1 do
            local text = ctx.chars[index].text
            if isFillMarker[text] then fillIndexByMarker[text] = index end
        end
    end
end

local function layoutBox(ctx, width, height)
    layoutLeft = alignedLeft(ctx, width * layoutEmWidth)
    layoutTop = alignedTop(ctx, height * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing)
end

local function widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    return runWidth(ctx, record.items, factor, false) / layoutEmWidth
end

local function textAt(ctx, record, horizontal, vertical, factor, alignment, maximumWidth)
    if maximumWidth then
        local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
        if width > maximumWidth and width > 0.0 then factor = factor * math.max(0.0, maximumWidth) / width end
    end
    local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    local fraction = alignment == "center" and 0.5 or alignment == "right" and 1.0 or 0.0
    placeRun(ctx, record.items, layoutLeft + (horizontal - width * fraction) * layoutEmWidth,
        layoutTop - vertical * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing, factor)
end

local function tint(ctx, record, color)
    for _, character in ipairs(record.items) do
        local inherited = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = { r = color.r, g = color.g, b = color.b, a = inherited.a * color.a }
    end
end

-- Grid coordinates are relative to the grid character's origin, in path units.
local function point(horizontal, vertical)
    return (horizontal - gridOriginX) * kUnitsPerEm, (vertical - gridOriginY) * layoutLineSpacing * kUnitsPerEm
end

local function polygon(vertices)
    if decorationIndex > 0 and #vertices >= 3 then
        for index, vertex in ipairs(vertices) do
            local horizontal, vertical = point(vertex[1], vertex[2])
            if index == 1 then drawing:move_to(horizontal, vertical)
            else drawing:line_to(horizontal, vertical) end
        end
        drawing:close()
        shapeCount = shapeCount + 1
    end
end

local function line(firstX, firstY, lastX, lastY, thickness)
    local horizontal, vertical = lastX - firstX, lastY - firstY
    local distance = math.sqrt(horizontal * horizontal + vertical * vertical)
    if distance > 0.0 and thickness > 0.0 then
        local offsetX, offsetY = -vertical / distance * thickness * 0.5, horizontal / distance * thickness * 0.5
        polygon({ { firstX + offsetX, firstY + offsetY }, { lastX + offsetX, lastY + offsetY },
            { lastX - offsetX, lastY - offsetY }, { firstX - offsetX, firstY - offsetY } })
    end
end

local function frame(left, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, top, right, top, thickness)
    line(right, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(right, bottom, left, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, bottom, left, top, thickness)
end

local function circle(horizontal, vertical, radius, thickness)
    for index = 1, kCircleSegments do
        local firstAngle, lastAngle = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments, index * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments
        line(horizontal + math.cos(firstAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(firstAngle) * radius,
            horizontal + math.cos(lastAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(lastAngle) * radius, thickness)
    end
end

local function placeAtOrigin(ctx, character, originX, originY)
    placeOrigin(ctx, character, layoutLeft + originX * layoutEmWidth,
        layoutTop - originY * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing, 1.0, false)
end

-- The origin is the cell's far corner; the rectangle spans the whole cell from there.
local function placeFill(ctx, index, color, left, top, width, height)
    local character = ctx.chars[index]
    styleDecoration(ctx, index, shaded(color))
    local originX, originY = left + (farX > 0 and width or 0.0), top + (farY > 0 and height or 0.0)
    placeAtOrigin(ctx, character, originX, originY)
    local path = mt.drawing_path()
    local first, last = (left - originX) * kUnitsPerEm, (left + width - originX) * kUnitsPerEm
    local upper, lower = (top - originY) * layoutLineSpacing * kUnitsPerEm,
        (top + height - originY) * layoutLineSpacing * kUnitsPerEm
    path:move_to(first, upper)
    path:line_to(last, upper)
    path:line_to(last, lower)
    path:line_to(first, lower)
    path:close()
    character.opacity = fillOpacity
    fills[#fills + 1] = { index = index, path = path }
end

local function finishLayout(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then ctx.chars[decorationIndex].opacity = shapeCount > 0 and 1.0 or 0.0 end
    -- Fills are listed first so they draw behind the text and the grid; everything else keeps its order.
    local order = {}
    for _, fill in ipairs(fills) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | fill.index end
    if #order > 0 then
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(decorationIndex)) do part.path:assign(drawing) end
        for _, fill in ipairs(fills) do
            for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(fill.index)) do part.path:assign(fill.path) end
        end
    end
end


local calendar = {}
local kWeekLength = 7
local kMonthDays = { 31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31 }

local function monthDays(year, month)
    local days = kMonthDays[month]
    if month == 2 and year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 ~= 0 or year % 400 == 0) then days = 29 end
    return days
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local source = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    beginText(ctx)
    local year = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 1, 9999))
    local month = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 1, 12))
    local days = monthDays(year, month)
    local precedingYear = year - 1
    local precedingDays = precedingYear * 365 + precedingYear // 4 - precedingYear // 100 + precedingYear // 400
    for previousMonth = 1, month - 1 do precedingDays = precedingDays + monthDays(year, previousMonth) end
    local firstWeekday = (precedingDays + 1) % kWeekLength
    local offset = (firstWeekday - (ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and 1 or 0)) % kWeekLength
    calendar = { title = addText(string.format("%04d / %02d", year, month)), weekdays = {}, cells = {},
        weekCount = math.ceil((offset + days) / kWeekLength) }
    local events = {}
    for row in source:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local dayText, label = row:match("^%s*(%d+)%s*,%s*(.-)%s*$")
        local day = tonumber(dayText)
        if day and day >= 1 and day <= days and label ~= "" then
            events[day] = events[day] and events[day] .. " / " .. label or label
        end
    end
    local fillable = {}
    local weekdayNames = { "Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat" }
    for column = 0, kWeekLength - 1 do
        local weekday = (column + (ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and 1 or 0)) % kWeekLength
        calendar.weekdays[column + 1] = { record = addText(weekdayNames[weekday + 1]), weekday = weekday }
    end
    local previousMonth = month == 1 and 12 or month - 1
    local previousDays = monthDays(month == 1 and year - 1 or year, previousMonth)
    for slot = 0, calendar.weekCount * kWeekLength - 1 do
        local day = slot - offset + 1
        local current = day >= 1 and day <= days
        local displayed = day < 1 and previousDays + day or day > days and day - days or day
        local cell = { row = slot // kWeekLength, column = slot % kWeekLength,
            current = current, day = day, weekday = (firstWeekday + day - 1) % kWeekLength }
        cell.date = addText((current or ctx.inputs.booleans[2]) and tostring(displayed) or "")
        cell.event = addText(current and events[day] or "")
        calendar.cells[#calendar.cells + 1] = cell
        if current or ctx.inputs.booleans[2] then fillable[#fillable + 1] = cell end
    end
    finishText(ctx, fillable)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    beginLayout(ctx)
    local width = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.8, 10.0)
    local height = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.8, 10.0)
    local thickness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 0.2)
    local headerHeight = 1.25
    layoutBox(ctx, width * kWeekLength, headerHeight + height * calendar.weekCount)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then
        gridOriginX = farX > 0 and 0.0 or width * kWeekLength
        gridOriginY = farY > 0 and headerHeight or headerHeight + height * calendar.weekCount
        placeAtOrigin(ctx, ctx.chars[decorationIndex], gridOriginX, gridOriginY)
    end
    textAt(ctx, calendar.title, width * kWeekLength * 0.5, 0.55, 0.65, "center")
    for column, weekday in ipairs(calendar.weekdays) do
        textAt(ctx, weekday.record, (column - 0.5) * width, 1.05, 0.3, "center", width - 0.2)
        if weekday.weekday == 0 or weekday.weekday == 6 then tint(ctx, weekday.record, ctx.inputs.colors[2]) end
    end
    local highlightDay = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 31.0))
    for _, cell in ipairs(calendar.cells) do
        local left, top = cell.column * width, headerHeight + cell.row * height
        textAt(ctx, cell.date, left + 0.15, top + 0.48, 0.4, "left", width - 0.3)
        textAt(ctx, cell.event, left + 0.15, top + height - 0.18,
            mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.05, 1.0), "left", width - 0.3)
        local kind = not cell.current and 4 or cell.day == highlightDay and 3
            or (cell.weekday == 0 or cell.weekday == 6) and 2 or 1
        cell.fillIndex = cell.fillMarker and fillIndexByMarker[cell.fillMarker] or nil
        if cell.fillIndex then placeFill(ctx, cell.fillIndex, ctx.inputs.colors[kind], left, top, width, height) end
        local lift = cell.fillIndex and kTextLift * fillOpacity or 0.0
        if not cell.current then tint(ctx, cell.date, lifted(ctx.inputs.colors[4], lift))
        elseif cell.day == highlightDay then
            tint(ctx, cell.date, lifted(ctx.inputs.colors[3], lift))
            frame(left + 0.05, top + 0.05, left + width - 0.05, top + height - 0.05, thickness * 2.0)
        elseif cell.weekday == 0 or cell.weekday == 6 then tint(ctx, cell.date, lifted(ctx.inputs.colors[2], lift)) end
    end
    for column = 0, kWeekLength do line(column * width, headerHeight, column * width,
        headerHeight + calendar.weekCount * height, thickness) end
    for row = 0, calendar.weekCount do line(0, headerHeight + row * height,
        kWeekLength * width, headerHeight + row * height, thickness) end
    finishLayout(ctx)
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    units[1] = {}
    appendLayoutItems(units[1], calendar.title.items)
    for _, weekday in ipairs(calendar.weekdays) do appendLayoutItems(units[1], weekday.record.items) end
    for row = 1, calendar.weekCount do units[row + 1] = {} end
    for _, cell in ipairs(calendar.cells) do
        appendLayoutItems(units[cell.row + 2], cell.date.items)
        appendLayoutItems(units[cell.row + 2], cell.event.items)
        if cell.fillIndex then units[cell.row + 2][#units[cell.row + 2] + 1] = ctx.chars[cell.fillIndex] end
    end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decorationIndex, "none", "none")
end
description: Monthly calendar weeks appear sequentially, then fade in reverse. Set Year and Month; enter day,label per line, e.g. 4,Meeting. Cell Fill Opacity tints each date cell with a darkened kind color. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.

descriptions.ja:
指定した年月の日付と予定を、曜日ごとの格子に配置する月間カレンダーです。予定の一覧や告知に使え、週末の色分けや特定の日付の強調もできます。

予定は「日付,ラベル」を1行ずつ入力します。例：4,打ち合わせ［改行］12,撮影。同じ日の予定は「 / 」でまとめます。
「Year」「Month」で年月を指定します（年1〜9999、月1〜12）。うるう年と月ごとの日数を自動計算します。
「Monday First」で月曜／日曜始まりを切り替え、「Adjacent Dates」で前後月の日付を表示します。「Highlight Day」は0で無効です。
「Cell Fill Opacity (0=Off)」で日付枠の塗りの濃さを指定します（0で塗りません）。平日はGrid Color、週末はWeekend Color、Highlight DayはHighlight Color、前後月の日付はAdjacent Colorを、それぞれ暗くした色で塗り、塗った枠の日付は塗りの濃さに応じて白寄りにします。塗りは日付枠ごとに文字を1つずつ使うため（最大42）、文字数の上限に空きが足りないときは塗りません。
空入力でもカレンダーを表示します。不正な日付・書式の予定は無視します。予定はセル幅に縮小して収めます。
InspectorのTracking・Line Spacing・全体の位置／回転／拡大を反映します。本文の色・質感はInspectorから調整できます。
年月・曜日が先に現れ、日付と予定が週ごとに続きます。アウトロでは最後の週から逆順に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。

title: Monthly Calendar
author: Mug

name: FIX008_weekly_schedule.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FIX008
-- @duration 5
-- @title Weekly Schedule
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "Mon	09:00	10:30	企画会議\nTue	13:00	15:00	撮影\nFri	16:00	17:00	レビュー"
-- @input number 1 "Day Width (em)" default=1.9
-- @input number 2 "Hour Height (em)" default=0.55
-- @input number 3 "Start Hour" default=8
-- @input number 4 "End Hour" default=20
-- @input number 5 "Event Size" default=0.24
-- @input number 6 "Line Width (em)" default=0.012
-- @input color 1 "Grid Color" default={0.3, 0.55, 0.75, 1}
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 10 "Animation Amount" default=1
--[[ @description
Weekly timetable events appear in time order, then fade in reverse. Enter weekday[TAB]start[TAB]end[TAB]label, e.g. Mon[TAB]09:00[TAB]10:30[TAB]Meeting. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
曜日と時刻に沿って予定を配置する週間スケジュールです。時間割や撮影予定などを一覧にでき、同じ時間帯に重なる予定は横に並べて表示します。

「曜日［タブ］開始時刻［タブ］終了時刻［タブ］予定」を1行ずつ入力します。
例：Mon［タブ］09:00［タブ］10:30［タブ］企画会議。曜日はMon〜Sun、月〜日、または1〜7（月曜＝1）で指定します。
時刻はHH:MM形式。「Start Hour」「End Hour」で表示範囲を指定します。範囲をまたぐ予定は表示範囲内に収めます。
同じ曜日の重なる予定は横に並べます。不正な曜日・時刻、終了が開始以前の行は無視します。空入力では時間割の枠を表示します。
InspectorのTracking・Line Spacing・全体の位置／回転／拡大を反映します。本文の色・質感はInspectorから調整できます。
時間割の枠と本文が一緒に浮かび上がり、予定は開始時刻順に現れます。アウトロでは逆順に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]
local kMaximumSpacing = 20.0

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

-- Keep the composition in the shared plane before Global transforms.
local function placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical, factor, verticalWriting)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.scale = character.scale * factor
    local originX = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_x or geometry.canvas_origin_x
    local originY = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_y or geometry.canvas_origin_y
    local pivotX, pivotY = character.pivot_x - 0.5, character.pivot_y - 0.5
    local displacementX = (originX - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_x * ctx.canvas.width
    local displacementY = (originY - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_y * ctx.canvas.height
    local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = (math.cos(angle) * displacementX + math.sin(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width
    local rotatedY = (-math.sin(angle) * displacementX + math.cos(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX - rotatedX
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY - rotatedY
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

local function runWidth(ctx, items, factor, verticalWriting)
    local width = 0.0
    for index in ipairs(items) do width = width + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting) end
    return math.max(0.0, width)
end

local function placeRun(ctx, items, horizontal, baseline, factor)
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, false)
        placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, baseline, factor, false)
        horizontal = horizontal + advance
    end
end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 - fraction * width
end

local function alignedTop(ctx, height)
    local fraction = ctx.global.v_align == "top" and 0.0 or ctx.global.v_align == "bottom" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 + fraction * height
end

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kCircleSegments = 32
local records = {}
local texts = {}
local marker = ""
local decorationIndex = 0
local drawing = mt.drawing_path()
local shapeCount = 0
local layoutLeft, layoutTop = 0.5, 0.5
local layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight, layoutLineSpacing = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
placeholder:close()

local function trim(text)
    return text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end

local function beginText(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false
    records, texts, marker = {}, {}, ""
end

local function addText(text)
    local record = { items = {}, text = text }
    if text ~= "" then
        records[#records + 1] = record
        texts[#texts + 1] = text
    end
    return record
end

local function finishText(ctx)
    if #records > 0 and ctx.meta.limits.max_characters > 0 then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, advance_x = 0, advance_y = 0,
            bounds = { -500, -500, 500, 500 } })
        texts[#texts + 1] = marker
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(texts, "\n")
end

local function beginLayout(ctx)
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for index, record in ipairs(records) do record.items = groups[index] and groups[index].items or {} end
    layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight = emSize(ctx)
    layoutLineSpacing = math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    drawing, shapeCount, decorationIndex = mt.drawing_path(), 0, 0
    if marker ~= "" and ctx.char_count > 0 and ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].text == marker then
        decorationIndex = ctx.char_count
        local character = ctx.chars[decorationIndex]
        character.scale, character.stretch_x, character.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
        character.pivot_x, character.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
        character.rotation, character.yaw, character.pitch, character.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
        character.offset_x = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_x
        character.offset_y = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_y
        character.fill.use, character.fill.color = true, ctx.inputs.colors[1]
        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width, character.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
        character.texture.use, character.texture.type = true, "none"
        character.blur.use = true
        character.blur.amount_x, character.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
        character.opacity = 0.0
    end
end

local function layoutBox(ctx, width, height)
    layoutLeft = alignedLeft(ctx, width * layoutEmWidth)
    layoutTop = alignedTop(ctx, height * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing)
end

local function widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    return runWidth(ctx, record.items, factor, false) / layoutEmWidth
end

local function textAt(ctx, record, horizontal, vertical, factor, alignment, maximumWidth)
    if maximumWidth then
        local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
        if width > maximumWidth and width > 0.0 then factor = factor * math.max(0.0, maximumWidth) / width end
    end
    local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    local fraction = alignment == "center" and 0.5 or alignment == "right" and 1.0 or 0.0
    placeRun(ctx, record.items, layoutLeft + (horizontal - width * fraction) * layoutEmWidth,
        layoutTop - vertical * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing, factor)
end

local function tint(ctx, record, color)
    for _, character in ipairs(record.items) do
        local inherited = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = { r = color.r, g = color.g, b = color.b, a = inherited.a * color.a }
    end
end

local function point(horizontal, vertical)
    return ((layoutLeft - 0.5) / layoutEmWidth + horizontal) * kUnitsPerEm,
        ((0.5 - layoutTop) / layoutEmHeight + vertical * layoutLineSpacing) * kUnitsPerEm
end

local function polygon(vertices)
    if decorationIndex > 0 and #vertices >= 3 then
        for index, vertex in ipairs(vertices) do
            local horizontal, vertical = point(vertex[1], vertex[2])
            if index == 1 then drawing:move_to(horizontal, vertical)
            else drawing:line_to(horizontal, vertical) end
        end
        drawing:close()
        shapeCount = shapeCount + 1
    end
end

local function line(firstX, firstY, lastX, lastY, thickness)
    local horizontal, vertical = lastX - firstX, lastY - firstY
    local distance = math.sqrt(horizontal * horizontal + vertical * vertical)
    if distance > 0.0 and thickness > 0.0 then
        local offsetX, offsetY = -vertical / distance * thickness * 0.5, horizontal / distance * thickness * 0.5
        polygon({ { firstX + offsetX, firstY + offsetY }, { lastX + offsetX, lastY + offsetY },
            { lastX - offsetX, lastY - offsetY }, { firstX - offsetX, firstY - offsetY } })
    end
end

local function frame(left, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, top, right, top, thickness)
    line(right, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(right, bottom, left, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, bottom, left, top, thickness)
end

local function circle(horizontal, vertical, radius, thickness)
    for index = 1, kCircleSegments do
        local firstAngle, lastAngle = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments, index * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments
        line(horizontal + math.cos(firstAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(firstAngle) * radius,
            horizontal + math.cos(lastAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(lastAngle) * radius, thickness)
    end
end

local function finishLayout(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then ctx.chars[decorationIndex].opacity = shapeCount > 0 and 1.0 or 0.0 end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(decorationIndex)) do part.path:assign(drawing) end
    end
end


local schedule = {}
local kWeekdays = { "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun" }
local kDayNames = { mon = 1, tue = 2, wed = 3, thu = 4, fri = 5, sat = 6, sun = 7,
    ["月"] = 1, ["火"] = 2, ["水"] = 3, ["木"] = 4, ["金"] = 5, ["土"] = 6, ["日"] = 7 }

local function minutes(text)
    local hour, minute = text:match("^(%d%d?):(%d%d)$")
    local result = nil
    if hour then
        hour, minute = tonumber(hour), tonumber(minute)
        if hour <= 24 and minute < 60 and (hour < 24 or minute == 0) then result = hour * 60 + minute end
    end
    return result
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local source = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    beginText(ctx)
    local startHour = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0, 23))
    local endHour = math.max(startHour + 1, math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 1, 24)))
    schedule = { startHour = startHour, endHour = endHour, days = {}, hours = {}, events = {}, lanes = {} }
    for _, weekday in ipairs(kWeekdays) do schedule.days[#schedule.days + 1] = addText(weekday) end
    for hour = startHour, endHour do schedule.hours[#schedule.hours + 1] = addText(string.format("%02d:00", hour)) end
    for row in source:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local dayText, startText, endText, label = row:match("^([^\t]+)\t([^\t]+)\t([^\t]+)\t(.+)$")
        if dayText then
            local day = kDayNames[trim(dayText):lower()] or tonumber(trim(dayText))
            local startTime, endTime = minutes(trim(startText)), minutes(trim(endText))
            if day and day % 1 == 0 and day >= 1 and day <= 7 and startTime and endTime
                and endTime > startTime and endTime > startHour * 60 and startTime < endHour * 60 then
                schedule.events[#schedule.events + 1] = { day = day,
                    startTime = math.max(startHour * 60, startTime), endTime = math.min(endHour * 60, endTime),
                    label = trim(label) }
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(schedule.events, function(first, second)
        if first.day ~= second.day then return first.day < second.day end
        if first.startTime ~= second.startTime then return first.startTime < second.startTime end
        if first.endTime ~= second.endTime then return first.endTime < second.endTime end
        return first.label < second.label
    end)
    local laneEnds = {}
    for _, event in ipairs(schedule.events) do
        laneEnds[event.day] = laneEnds[event.day] or {}
        local ends = laneEnds[event.day]
        local lane = 1
        while ends[lane] and ends[lane] > event.startTime do lane = lane + 1 end
        ends[lane] = event.endTime
        event.lane = lane
        schedule.lanes[event.day] = math.max(schedule.lanes[event.day] or 1, lane)
        event.record = addText(event.label)
    end
    finishText(ctx)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    beginLayout(ctx)
    local dayWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.8, 10.0)
    local hourHeight = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.25, 5.0)
    local thickness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 0.2)
    local timeWidth, headerHeight = 1.1, 0.7
    local height = (schedule.endHour - schedule.startHour) * hourHeight
    layoutBox(ctx, timeWidth + 7 * dayWidth, headerHeight + height + 0.2)
    for column, record in ipairs(schedule.days) do
        textAt(ctx, record, timeWidth + (column - 0.5) * dayWidth, 0.45, 0.35, "center", dayWidth - 0.2)
    end
    for index, record in ipairs(schedule.hours) do
        local top = headerHeight + (index - 1) * hourHeight
        textAt(ctx, record, timeWidth - 0.15, top + 0.08, 0.23, "right")
        line(timeWidth, top, timeWidth + 7 * dayWidth, top, thickness)
    end
    for column = 0, 7 do line(timeWidth + column * dayWidth, headerHeight,
        timeWidth + column * dayWidth, headerHeight + height, thickness) end
    for _, event in ipairs(schedule.events) do
        local laneWidth = dayWidth / schedule.lanes[event.day]
        local left = timeWidth + (event.day - 1) * dayWidth + (event.lane - 1) * laneWidth
        local top = headerHeight + (event.startTime / 60 - schedule.startHour) * hourHeight
        local bottom = headerHeight + (event.endTime / 60 - schedule.startHour) * hourHeight
        frame(left + 0.05, top + 0.025, left + laneWidth - 0.05, bottom - 0.025, thickness * 2)
        local factor = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.05, 1.0), math.max(0.01, (bottom - top) * 0.6))
        textAt(ctx, event.record, left + 0.12, top + factor * 0.9 + 0.04, factor, "left", laneWidth - 0.24)
    end
    finishLayout(ctx)
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    units[1] = {}
    for _, record in ipairs(schedule.days) do appendLayoutItems(units[1], record.items) end
    for _, record in ipairs(schedule.hours) do appendLayoutItems(units[1], record.items) end
    local ordered = {}
    for _, event in ipairs(schedule.events) do ordered[#ordered + 1] = event end
    table.sort(ordered, function(first, second)
        if first.startTime ~= second.startTime then return first.startTime < second.startTime end
        if first.day ~= second.day then return first.day < second.day end
        return first.label < second.label
    end)
    for _, event in ipairs(ordered) do units[#units + 1] = event.record.items end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decorationIndex, "none", "rise")
end

曜日と時刻に沿って予定を配置する週間スケジュールです。時間割や撮影予定などを一覧にでき、同じ時間帯に重なる予定は横に並べて表示します。

「曜日［タブ］開始時刻［タブ］終了時刻［タブ］予定」を1行ずつ入力します。
例：Mon［タブ］09:00［タブ］10:30［タブ］企画会議。曜日はMon〜Sun、月〜日、または1〜7（月曜＝1）で指定します。
時刻はHH:MM形式。「Start Hour」「End Hour」で表示範囲を指定します。範囲をまたぐ予定は表示範囲内に収めます。
同じ曜日の重なる予定は横に並べます。不正な曜日・時刻、終了が開始以前の行は無視します。空入力では時間割の枠を表示します。
InspectorのTracking・Line Spacing・全体の位置／回転／拡大を反映します。本文の色・質感はInspectorから調整できます。
時間割の枠と本文が一緒に浮かび上がり、予定は開始時刻順に現れます。アウトロでは逆順に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FIX009
-- @duration 5
-- @title Tournament Bracket
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "さくら\nかえで\nすみれ\nつばき\nあおい\nひまわり"
-- @input number 1 "Team Size" default=0.45
-- @input number 2 "Round Gap (em)" default=0.8
-- @input number 3 "Row Gap (em)" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Line Width (em)" default=0.025
-- @input text 1 "Winner Picks" default="1,2,1,1,1,2,1"
-- @input color 1 "Bracket Color" default={0.3, 0.65, 0.9, 1}
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 10 "Animation Amount" default=1
--[[ @description
Tournament rounds appear toward the final, then disappear in reverse. Enter one team per line; Winner Picks uses comma-separated 1/2 choices, round order. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
チーム名を対戦の接続線で結び、決勝までの勝ち上がりを表すトーナメント表です。指定した勝者を次の回戦へ進め、人数が揃わない枠は不戦勝として扱います。

1行に1チームを入力します（最大32チーム）。空行は無視し、人数に合わせて2の累乗の枠を用意します。余った枠は不戦勝です。
「Winner Picks」に各試合の勝者を1＝上側、2＝下側でカンマ区切りに指定します。順番は1回戦の上から下、次の回戦の上から下です。不戦勝の試合も1枠分消費します。
例：4チームなら 1,2,1 で1回戦は上側・下側、決勝は上側が勝ちます。未指定・不正な指定は「?」として表示します。
「Team Size」「Round Gap」「Row Gap」でサイズと間隔を調整します。
InspectorのTracking・Line Spacing・全体の位置／回転／拡大を反映します。本文の色・質感はInspectorから調整できます。
対戦の接続線とチーム名が一緒に左から現れ、チーム名は1回戦から決勝へ順に表示します。アウトロは決勝から逆順に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]
local kMaximumSpacing = 20.0

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

-- Keep the composition in the shared plane before Global transforms.
local function placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical, factor, verticalWriting)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.scale = character.scale * factor
    local originX = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_x or geometry.canvas_origin_x
    local originY = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_y or geometry.canvas_origin_y
    local pivotX, pivotY = character.pivot_x - 0.5, character.pivot_y - 0.5
    local displacementX = (originX - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_x * ctx.canvas.width
    local displacementY = (originY - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_y * ctx.canvas.height
    local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = (math.cos(angle) * displacementX + math.sin(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width
    local rotatedY = (-math.sin(angle) * displacementX + math.cos(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX - rotatedX
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY - rotatedY
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

local function runWidth(ctx, items, factor, verticalWriting)
    local width = 0.0
    for index in ipairs(items) do width = width + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting) end
    return math.max(0.0, width)
end

local function placeRun(ctx, items, horizontal, baseline, factor)
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, false)
        placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, baseline, factor, false)
        horizontal = horizontal + advance
    end
end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 - fraction * width
end

local function alignedTop(ctx, height)
    local fraction = ctx.global.v_align == "top" and 0.0 or ctx.global.v_align == "bottom" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 + fraction * height
end

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kCircleSegments = 32
local records = {}
local texts = {}
local marker = ""
local decorationIndex = 0
local drawing = mt.drawing_path()
local shapeCount = 0
local layoutLeft, layoutTop = 0.5, 0.5
local layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight, layoutLineSpacing = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
placeholder:close()

local function trim(text)
    return text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end

local function beginText(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false
    records, texts, marker = {}, {}, ""
end

local function addText(text)
    local record = { items = {}, text = text }
    if text ~= "" then
        records[#records + 1] = record
        texts[#texts + 1] = text
    end
    return record
end

local function finishText(ctx)
    if #records > 0 and ctx.meta.limits.max_characters > 0 then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, advance_x = 0, advance_y = 0,
            bounds = { -500, -500, 500, 500 } })
        texts[#texts + 1] = marker
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(texts, "\n")
end

local function beginLayout(ctx)
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for index, record in ipairs(records) do record.items = groups[index] and groups[index].items or {} end
    layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight = emSize(ctx)
    layoutLineSpacing = math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    drawing, shapeCount, decorationIndex = mt.drawing_path(), 0, 0
    if marker ~= "" and ctx.char_count > 0 and ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].text == marker then
        decorationIndex = ctx.char_count
        local character = ctx.chars[decorationIndex]
        character.scale, character.stretch_x, character.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
        character.pivot_x, character.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
        character.rotation, character.yaw, character.pitch, character.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
        character.offset_x = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_x
        character.offset_y = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_y
        character.fill.use, character.fill.color = true, ctx.inputs.colors[1]
        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width, character.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
        character.texture.use, character.texture.type = true, "none"
        character.blur.use = true
        character.blur.amount_x, character.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
        character.opacity = 0.0
    end
end

local function layoutBox(ctx, width, height)
    layoutLeft = alignedLeft(ctx, width * layoutEmWidth)
    layoutTop = alignedTop(ctx, height * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing)
end

local function widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    return runWidth(ctx, record.items, factor, false) / layoutEmWidth
end

local function textAt(ctx, record, horizontal, vertical, factor, alignment, maximumWidth)
    if maximumWidth then
        local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
        if width > maximumWidth and width > 0.0 then factor = factor * math.max(0.0, maximumWidth) / width end
    end
    local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    local fraction = alignment == "center" and 0.5 or alignment == "right" and 1.0 or 0.0
    placeRun(ctx, record.items, layoutLeft + (horizontal - width * fraction) * layoutEmWidth,
        layoutTop - vertical * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing, factor)
end

local function tint(ctx, record, color)
    for _, character in ipairs(record.items) do
        local inherited = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = { r = color.r, g = color.g, b = color.b, a = inherited.a * color.a }
    end
end

local function point(horizontal, vertical)
    return ((layoutLeft - 0.5) / layoutEmWidth + horizontal) * kUnitsPerEm,
        ((0.5 - layoutTop) / layoutEmHeight + vertical * layoutLineSpacing) * kUnitsPerEm
end

local function polygon(vertices)
    if decorationIndex > 0 and #vertices >= 3 then
        for index, vertex in ipairs(vertices) do
            local horizontal, vertical = point(vertex[1], vertex[2])
            if index == 1 then drawing:move_to(horizontal, vertical)
            else drawing:line_to(horizontal, vertical) end
        end
        drawing:close()
        shapeCount = shapeCount + 1
    end
end

local function line(firstX, firstY, lastX, lastY, thickness)
    local horizontal, vertical = lastX - firstX, lastY - firstY
    local distance = math.sqrt(horizontal * horizontal + vertical * vertical)
    if distance > 0.0 and thickness > 0.0 then
        local offsetX, offsetY = -vertical / distance * thickness * 0.5, horizontal / distance * thickness * 0.5
        polygon({ { firstX + offsetX, firstY + offsetY }, { lastX + offsetX, lastY + offsetY },
            { lastX - offsetX, lastY - offsetY }, { firstX - offsetX, firstY - offsetY } })
    end
end

local function frame(left, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, top, right, top, thickness)
    line(right, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(right, bottom, left, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, bottom, left, top, thickness)
end

local function circle(horizontal, vertical, radius, thickness)
    for index = 1, kCircleSegments do
        local firstAngle, lastAngle = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments, index * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments
        line(horizontal + math.cos(firstAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(firstAngle) * radius,
            horizontal + math.cos(lastAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(lastAngle) * radius, thickness)
    end
end

local function finishLayout(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then ctx.chars[decorationIndex].opacity = shapeCount > 0 and 1.0 or 0.0 end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(decorationIndex)) do part.path:assign(drawing) end
    end
end


local bracket = {}
local kMaximumTeams = 32

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local source = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    beginText(ctx)
    local teams = {}
    for row in source:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local team = trim(row)
        if team ~= "" and #teams < kMaximumTeams then teams[#teams + 1] = team end
    end
    local picks = {}
    for token in (ctx.inputs.texts[1] .. ","):gmatch("(.-),") do picks[#picks + 1] = tonumber(trim(token)) or 0 end
    bracket = { rounds = {}, slots = 0 }
    if #teams > 0 then
        local slots = 1
        while slots < #teams do slots = slots * 2 end
        bracket.slots = slots
        local round = {}
        for index = 1, slots do
            round[index] = { name = teams[index], row = index - 1, record = addText(teams[index] or "—") }
        end
        bracket.rounds[1] = round
        local matchIndex = 0
        while #round > 1 do
            local nextRound = {}
            for index = 1, #round, 2 do
                matchIndex = matchIndex + 1
                local upper, lower = round[index], round[index + 1]
                local name = nil
                if not upper.name then name = lower.name
                elseif not lower.name then name = upper.name
                elseif picks[matchIndex] == 1 then name = upper.name
                elseif picks[matchIndex] == 2 then name = lower.name
                else name = "?" end
                nextRound[#nextRound + 1] = { name = name, row = (upper.row + lower.row) * 0.5,
                    record = addText(name or "—"), upper = upper, lower = lower }
            end
            bracket.rounds[#bracket.rounds + 1] = nextRound
            round = nextRound
        end
    end
    finishText(ctx)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    beginLayout(ctx)
    local factor = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.05, 2.0)
    local gap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.3, kMaximumSpacing)
    local rowGap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.3, kMaximumSpacing)
    local thickness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.2)
    local widths, lefts = {}, {}
    local totalWidth = 0.0
    for roundIndex, round in ipairs(bracket.rounds) do
        local width = 0.0
        for _, node in ipairs(round) do width = math.max(width, widthEm(ctx, node.record, factor)) end
        widths[roundIndex], lefts[roundIndex] = width + 0.2, totalWidth
        totalWidth = totalWidth + width + 0.2 + (roundIndex < #bracket.rounds and gap or 0.0)
    end
    layoutBox(ctx, totalWidth, math.max(0, bracket.slots - 1) * rowGap + factor)
    for roundIndex, round in ipairs(bracket.rounds) do
        for _, node in ipairs(round) do
            local baseline = node.row * rowGap + factor * 0.8
            textAt(ctx, node.record, lefts[roundIndex], baseline, factor, "left")
            if node.upper then
                local firstX, lastX = lefts[roundIndex - 1] + widths[roundIndex - 1], lefts[roundIndex] - 0.1
                local elbow = (firstX + lastX) * 0.5
                local upperY = node.upper.row * rowGap + factor * 0.45
                local lowerY = node.lower.row * rowGap + factor * 0.45
                line(firstX, upperY, elbow, upperY, thickness)
                line(firstX, lowerY, elbow, lowerY, thickness)
                line(elbow, upperY, elbow, lowerY, thickness)
                line(elbow, (upperY + lowerY) * 0.5, lastX, (upperY + lowerY) * 0.5, thickness)
            end
        end
    end
    finishLayout(ctx)
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    for _, round in ipairs(bracket.rounds) do
        local unit = {}
        for _, team in ipairs(round) do appendLayoutItems(unit, team.record.items) end
        units[#units + 1] = unit
    end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decorationIndex, "none", "left")
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FIX010
-- @duration 5
-- @title Route Map
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "中央\n  港\n  海岸\n公園\n美術館\n  図書館\n  大学\n空港"
-- @input number 1 "Station Size" default=0.45
-- @input number 2 "Station Gap (em)" default=1.5
-- @input number 3 "Branch Gap (em)" default=2.5
-- @input number 4 "Line Width (em)" default=0.035
-- @input boolean 1 "Number Stations" default=false
-- @input color 1 "Route Color" default={0.25, 0.75, 0.6, 1}
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
