--[[ @description
Route stations appear along the main line and branches, then fade in reverse. Enter stations per line; tabs or paired spaces create branches. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
駅名を丸い駅マーカーと接続線で表す路線図風のレイアウトです。縦の本線から右へ支線を伸ばし、経路や工程の分岐を図としてまとめられます。

1行に1駅名を入力します。行頭のタブ1個、または半角スペース2個で支線を指定します（最大3階層）。
例：中央［改行］半角スペース2個＋港［改行］半角スペース2個＋海岸［改行］公園。
字下げなしの駅は縦の本線、字下げした駅は直前の浅い階層の駅から右へ延びる支線に配置します。同じ階層の連続駅はつなげます。
空行は無視します。親がない字下げは本線に戻します。「Number Stations」で連番を付けます。駅間隔・支線間隔・駅名サイズを調整できます。
InspectorのTracking・Line Spacing・全体の位置／回転／拡大を反映します。本文の色・質感はInspectorから調整できます。
路線の線と駅名が一緒に浮かび上がり、駅名は入力順に点灯します。アウトロは最後の駅から逆順に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]
local kMaximumSpacing = 20.0

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

-- Keep the composition in the shared plane before Global transforms.
local function placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical, factor, verticalWriting)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.scale = character.scale * factor
    local originX = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_x or geometry.canvas_origin_x
    local originY = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_y or geometry.canvas_origin_y
    local pivotX, pivotY = character.pivot_x - 0.5, character.pivot_y - 0.5
    local displacementX = (originX - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_x * ctx.canvas.width
    local displacementY = (originY - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_y * ctx.canvas.height
    local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = (math.cos(angle) * displacementX + math.sin(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width
    local rotatedY = (-math.sin(angle) * displacementX + math.cos(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX - rotatedX
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY - rotatedY
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

local function runWidth(ctx, items, factor, verticalWriting)
    local width = 0.0
    for index in ipairs(items) do width = width + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting) end
    return math.max(0.0, width)
end

local function placeRun(ctx, items, horizontal, baseline, factor)
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, false)
        placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, baseline, factor, false)
        horizontal = horizontal + advance
    end
end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 - fraction * width
end

local function alignedTop(ctx, height)
    local fraction = ctx.global.v_align == "top" and 0.0 or ctx.global.v_align == "bottom" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 + fraction * height
end

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kCircleSegments = 32
local records = {}
local texts = {}
local marker = ""
local decorationIndex = 0
local drawing = mt.drawing_path()
local shapeCount = 0
local layoutLeft, layoutTop = 0.5, 0.5
local layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight, layoutLineSpacing = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
placeholder:close()

local function trim(text)
    return text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end

local function beginText(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false
    records, texts, marker = {}, {}, ""
end

local function addText(text)
    local record = { items = {}, text = text }
    if text ~= "" then
        records[#records + 1] = record
        texts[#texts + 1] = text
    end
    return record
end

local function finishText(ctx)
    if #records > 0 and ctx.meta.limits.max_characters > 0 then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, advance_x = 0, advance_y = 0,
            bounds = { -500, -500, 500, 500 } })
        texts[#texts + 1] = marker
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(texts, "\n")
end

local function beginLayout(ctx)
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for index, record in ipairs(records) do record.items = groups[index] and groups[index].items or {} end
    layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight = emSize(ctx)
    layoutLineSpacing = math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    drawing, shapeCount, decorationIndex = mt.drawing_path(), 0, 0
    if marker ~= "" and ctx.char_count > 0 and ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].text == marker then
        decorationIndex = ctx.char_count
        local character = ctx.chars[decorationIndex]
        character.scale, character.stretch_x, character.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
        character.pivot_x, character.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
        character.rotation, character.yaw, character.pitch, character.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
        character.offset_x = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_x
        character.offset_y = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_y
        character.fill.use, character.fill.color = true, ctx.inputs.colors[1]
        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width, character.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
        character.texture.use, character.texture.type = true, "none"
        character.blur.use = true
        character.blur.amount_x, character.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
        character.opacity = 0.0
    end
end

local function layoutBox(ctx, width, height)
    layoutLeft = alignedLeft(ctx, width * layoutEmWidth)
    layoutTop = alignedTop(ctx, height * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing)
end

local function widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    return runWidth(ctx, record.items, factor, false) / layoutEmWidth
end

local function textAt(ctx, record, horizontal, vertical, factor, alignment, maximumWidth)
    if maximumWidth then
        local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
        if width > maximumWidth and width > 0.0 then factor = factor * math.max(0.0, maximumWidth) / width end
    end
    local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    local fraction = alignment == "center" and 0.5 or alignment == "right" and 1.0 or 0.0
    placeRun(ctx, record.items, layoutLeft + (horizontal - width * fraction) * layoutEmWidth,
        layoutTop - vertical * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing, factor)
end

local function tint(ctx, record, color)
    for _, character in ipairs(record.items) do
        local inherited = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = { r = color.r, g = color.g, b = color.b, a = inherited.a * color.a }
    end
end

local function point(horizontal, vertical)
    return ((layoutLeft - 0.5) / layoutEmWidth + horizontal) * kUnitsPerEm,
        ((0.5 - layoutTop) / layoutEmHeight + vertical * layoutLineSpacing) * kUnitsPerEm
end

local function polygon(vertices)
    if decorationIndex > 0 and #vertices >= 3 then
        for index, vertex in ipairs(vertices) do
            local horizontal, vertical = point(vertex[1], vertex[2])
            if index == 1 then drawing:move_to(horizontal, vertical)
            else drawing:line_to(horizontal, vertical) end
        end
        drawing:close()
        shapeCount = shapeCount + 1
    end
end

local function line(firstX, firstY, lastX, lastY, thickness)
    local horizontal, vertical = lastX - firstX, lastY - firstY
    local distance = math.sqrt(horizontal * horizontal + vertical * vertical)
    if distance > 0.0 and thickness > 0.0 then
        local offsetX, offsetY = -vertical / distance * thickness * 0.5, horizontal / distance * thickness * 0.5
        polygon({ { firstX + offsetX, firstY + offsetY }, { lastX + offsetX, lastY + offsetY },
            { lastX - offsetX, lastY - offsetY }, { firstX - offsetX, firstY - offsetY } })
    end
end

local function frame(left, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, top, right, top, thickness)
    line(right, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(right, bottom, left, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, bottom, left, top, thickness)
end

local function circle(horizontal, vertical, radius, thickness)
    for index = 1, kCircleSegments do
        local firstAngle, lastAngle = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments, index * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments
        line(horizontal + math.cos(firstAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(firstAngle) * radius,
            horizontal + math.cos(lastAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(lastAngle) * radius, thickness)
    end
end

local function finishLayout(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then ctx.chars[decorationIndex].opacity = shapeCount > 0 and 1.0 or 0.0 end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(decorationIndex)) do part.path:assign(drawing) end
    end
end


local stations = {}
local kMaximumStations = 64
local kMaximumDepth = 3

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local source = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    beginText(ctx)
    stations = {}
    local ancestors = {}
    for row in source:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local prefix, name = row:match("^([ \t]*)(.*)$")
        name = trim(name)
        if name ~= "" and #stations < kMaximumStations then
            local columns = 0
            for symbol in prefix:gmatch(".") do columns = columns + (symbol == "\t" and 2 or 1) end
            local depth = math.min(kMaximumDepth, columns // 2)
            if depth > 0 and not ancestors[depth - 1] then depth = 0 end
            local parent = ancestors[depth] or ancestors[depth - 1]
            if depth == 0 then parent = ancestors[0] end
            local station = { depth = depth, parent = parent,
                record = addText((ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and tostring(#stations + 1) .. ". " or "") .. name) }
            stations[#stations + 1] = station
            ancestors[depth] = station
            for level = depth + 1, kMaximumDepth do ancestors[level] = nil end
        end
    end
    finishText(ctx)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    beginLayout(ctx)
    local factor = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.05, 2.0)
    local stationGap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.5, kMaximumSpacing)
    local branchGap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.5, kMaximumSpacing)
    local thickness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.2)
    local maximumLabel = 0.0
    for _, station in ipairs(stations) do maximumLabel = math.max(maximumLabel, widthEm(ctx, station.record, factor)) end
    branchGap = math.max(branchGap, maximumLabel + 0.5)
    local mainCount, right, bottom = 0, 0.0, 0.0
    for _, station in ipairs(stations) do
        if station.depth == 0 then
            station.x, station.y = maximumLabel + 0.4, mainCount * stationGap + factor
            mainCount = mainCount + 1
        else
            station.x = station.parent.x + branchGap
            station.y = station.parent.y + (station.depth > station.parent.depth and station.depth > 1 and stationGap * 0.5 or 0.0)
        end
        right, bottom = math.max(right, station.x + maximumLabel * 0.5), math.max(bottom, station.y)
    end
    layoutBox(ctx, right + 0.3, bottom + factor)
    for _, station in ipairs(stations) do
        if station.depth == 0 then textAt(ctx, station.record, station.x - 0.3, station.y + factor * 0.3, factor, "right")
        else textAt(ctx, station.record, station.x, station.y - 0.25, factor, "center") end
        circle(station.x, station.y, 0.1, thickness)
        if station.parent then
            line(station.parent.x, station.parent.y, station.x, station.parent.y, thickness)
            line(station.x, station.parent.y, station.x, station.y, thickness)
        end
    end
    finishLayout(ctx)
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    for _, station in ipairs(stations) do units[#units + 1] = station.record.items end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decorationIndex, "none", "rise")
end
description: Route stations appear along the main line and branches, then fade in reverse. Enter stations per line; tabs or paired spaces create branches. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.

「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]
local kMaximumSpacing = 20.0

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

-- Keep the composition in the shared plane before Global transforms.
local function placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical, factor, verticalWriting)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.scale = character.scale * factor
    local originX = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_x or geometry.canvas_origin_x
    local originY = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_y or geometry.canvas_origin_y
    local pivotX, pivotY = character.pivot_x - 0.5, character.pivot_y - 0.5
    local displacementX = (originX - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_x * ctx.canvas.width
    local displacementY = (originY - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_y * ctx.canvas.height
    local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = (math.cos(angle) * displacementX + math.sin(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width
    local rotatedY = (-math.sin(angle) * displacementX + math.cos(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX - rotatedX
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY - rotatedY
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

local function runWidth(ctx, items, factor, verticalWriting)
    local width = 0.0
    for index in ipairs(items) do width = width + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting) end
    return math.max(0.0, width)
end

local function placeRun(ctx, items, horizontal, baseline, factor)
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, false)
        placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, baseline, factor, false)
        horizontal = horizontal + advance
    end
end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 - fraction * width
end

local function alignedTop(ctx, height)
    local fraction = ctx.global.v_align == "top" and 0.0 or ctx.global.v_align == "bottom" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 + fraction * height
end

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kCircleSegments = 32
local records = {}
local texts = {}
local marker = ""
local decorationIndex = 0
local drawing = mt.drawing_path()
local shapeCount = 0
local layoutLeft, layoutTop = 0.5, 0.5
local layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight, layoutLineSpacing = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
placeholder:close()

local function trim(text)
    return text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end

local function beginText(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false
    records, texts, marker = {}, {}, ""
end

local function addText(text)
    local record = { items = {}, text = text }
    if text ~= "" then
        records[#records + 1] = record
        texts[#texts + 1] = text
    end
    return record
end

local function finishText(ctx)
    if #records > 0 and ctx.meta.limits.max_characters > 0 then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, advance_x = 0, advance_y = 0,
            bounds = { -500, -500, 500, 500 } })
        texts[#texts + 1] = marker
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(texts, "\n")
end

local function beginLayout(ctx)
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for index, record in ipairs(records) do record.items = groups[index] and groups[index].items or {} end
    layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight = emSize(ctx)
    layoutLineSpacing = math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    drawing, shapeCount, decorationIndex = mt.drawing_path(), 0, 0
    if marker ~= "" and ctx.char_count > 0 and ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].text == marker then
        decorationIndex = ctx.char_count
        local character = ctx.chars[decorationIndex]
        character.scale, character.stretch_x, character.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
        character.pivot_x, character.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
        character.rotation, character.yaw, character.pitch, character.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
        character.offset_x = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_x
        character.offset_y = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_y
        character.fill.use, character.fill.color = true, ctx.inputs.colors[1]
        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width, character.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
        character.texture.use, character.texture.type = true, "none"
        character.blur.use = true
        character.blur.amount_x, character.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
        character.opacity = 0.0
    end
end

local function layoutBox(ctx, width, height)
    layoutLeft = alignedLeft(ctx, width * layoutEmWidth)
    layoutTop = alignedTop(ctx, height * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing)
end

local function widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    return runWidth(ctx, record.items, factor, false) / layoutEmWidth
end

local function textAt(ctx, record, horizontal, vertical, factor, alignment, maximumWidth)
    if maximumWidth then
        local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
        if width > maximumWidth and width > 0.0 then factor = factor * math.max(0.0, maximumWidth) / width end
    end
    local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    local fraction = alignment == "center" and 0.5 or alignment == "right" and 1.0 or 0.0
    placeRun(ctx, record.items, layoutLeft + (horizontal - width * fraction) * layoutEmWidth,
        layoutTop - vertical * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing, factor)
end

local function tint(ctx, record, color)
    for _, character in ipairs(record.items) do
        local inherited = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = { r = color.r, g = color.g, b = color.b, a = inherited.a * color.a }
    end
end

local function point(horizontal, vertical)
    return ((layoutLeft - 0.5) / layoutEmWidth + horizontal) * kUnitsPerEm,
        ((0.5 - layoutTop) / layoutEmHeight + vertical * layoutLineSpacing) * kUnitsPerEm
end

local function polygon(vertices)
    if decorationIndex > 0 and #vertices >= 3 then
        for index, vertex in ipairs(vertices) do
            local horizontal, vertical = point(vertex[1], vertex[2])
            if index == 1 then drawing:move_to(horizontal, vertical)
            else drawing:line_to(horizontal, vertical) end
        end
        drawing:close()
        shapeCount = shapeCount + 1
    end
end

local function line(firstX, firstY, lastX, lastY, thickness)
    local horizontal, vertical = lastX - firstX, lastY - firstY
    local distance = math.sqrt(horizontal * horizontal + vertical * vertical)
    if distance > 0.0 and thickness > 0.0 then
        local offsetX, offsetY = -vertical / distance * thickness * 0.5, horizontal / distance * thickness * 0.5
        polygon({ { firstX + offsetX, firstY + offsetY }, { lastX + offsetX, lastY + offsetY },
            { lastX - offsetX, lastY - offsetY }, { firstX - offsetX, firstY - offsetY } })
    end
end

local function frame(left, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, top, right, top, thickness)
    line(right, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(right, bottom, left, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, bottom, left, top, thickness)
end

local function circle(horizontal, vertical, radius, thickness)
    for index = 1, kCircleSegments do
        local firstAngle, lastAngle = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments, index * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments
        line(horizontal + math.cos(firstAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(firstAngle) * radius,
            horizontal + math.cos(lastAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(lastAngle) * radius, thickness)
    end
end

local function finishLayout(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then ctx.chars[decorationIndex].opacity = shapeCount > 0 and 1.0 or 0.0 end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(decorationIndex)) do part.path:assign(drawing) end
    end
end


local ticket = {}
local kSpecialKeys = { title = "title", from = "from", to = "to", note = "note",
    ["タイトル"] = "title", ["出発地"] = "from", ["到着地"] = "to", ["注記"] = "note" }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local source = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    beginText(ctx)
    ticket = { fields = {} }
    local special = {}
    for row in source:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local key, value = row:match("^%s*([^=]+)%s*=%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if key then
            key, value = trim(key), trim(value)
            local target = kSpecialKeys[key:lower()]
            if target then special[target] = value
            elseif key ~= "" and value ~= "" then ticket.fields[#ticket.fields + 1] = { key = key, value = value } end
        elseif trim(row) ~= "" then special.note = (special.note and special.note .. " / " or "") .. trim(row) end
    end
    ticket.title, ticket.from, ticket.to, ticket.note = addText(special.title or ""), addText(special.from or ""),
        addText(special.to or ""), addText(special.note or "")
    for _, field in ipairs(ticket.fields) do field.label, field.record = addText(field.key), addText(field.value) end
    ticket.stub = addText(ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and #records > 0 and "BOARDING PASS" or "")
    finishText(ctx)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    beginLayout(ctx)
    local width = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 5.0, 40.0)
    local padding = math.min(width * 0.15, mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.15, 3.0))
    local factor = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.05, 2.0)
    local thickness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.2)
    local stubWidth = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and width * 0.23 or 0.0
    local mainWidth = width - stubWidth
    local fieldHeight = math.max(1.1, factor * 1.8)
    local routeHeight = 0.0
    if ticket.from.text ~= "" or ticket.to.text ~= "" then routeHeight = 1.0 else routeHeight = 0.0 end
    local headerHeight = ticket.title.text ~= "" and 0.9 or 0.0
    local noteHeight = ticket.note.text ~= "" and 0.6 or 0.0
    local height = padding * 2 + headerHeight + routeHeight + math.ceil(#ticket.fields / 2) * fieldHeight + noteHeight
    layoutBox(ctx, width, height)
    frame(0, 0, width, height, thickness)
    textAt(ctx, ticket.title, padding, padding + 0.65, 0.7, "left", mainWidth - padding * 2)
    local routeTop = padding + headerHeight
    textAt(ctx, ticket.from, padding, routeTop + 0.6, 0.65, "left", (mainWidth - padding * 3) * 0.5)
    textAt(ctx, ticket.to, mainWidth - padding, routeTop + 0.6, 0.65, "right", (mainWidth - padding * 3) * 0.5)
    for index, field in ipairs(ticket.fields) do
        local column, row = (index - 1) % 2, (index - 1) // 2
        local columnWidth = (mainWidth - padding * 2) * 0.5
        local left, top = padding + column * columnWidth, routeTop + routeHeight + row * fieldHeight
        textAt(ctx, field.label, left, top + 0.25, 0.22, "left", columnWidth - 0.2)
        textAt(ctx, field.record, left, top + 0.8, factor, "left", columnWidth - 0.2)
    end
    textAt(ctx, ticket.note, padding, height - padding, 0.27, "left", mainWidth - padding * 2)
    if stubWidth > 0.0 then
        local dash = 0.12
        local vertical = 0.0
        while vertical < height do
            line(mainWidth, vertical, mainWidth, math.min(height, vertical + dash), thickness)
            vertical = vertical + dash * 2
        end
        textAt(ctx, ticket.stub, mainWidth + stubWidth * 0.5, height * 0.5, 0.24, "center", stubWidth - padding)
    end
    finishLayout(ctx)
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    units[1] = {}
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do units[1][#units[1] + 1] = character end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decorationIndex, "none", "ticket")
end
description: A boarding pass slides in as one framed composition and glides away. Enter key=value per line; Title, From, To, and Note define sections. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.

descriptions.ja:
出発地・到着地と各種情報を、搭乗券風の枠にまとめるレイアウトです。旅行やイベントの告知、チケット風のタイトルカードに使え、切り取り線付きの半券も表示できます。

「項目名=値」を1行ずつ入力します。例：Title=MUG AIR［改行］From=TOKYO［改行］To=KYOTO［改行］Seat=12A。
Titleは見出し、From／Toは出発地・到着地、Noteは下部の注記になります。キーは大文字・小文字を区別せず、日本語の「タイトル」「出発地」「到着地」「注記」も使えます。
それ以外の項目は、入力順に2列の情報欄へ配置します。同じ特別キーが複数ある場合は最後の値を使います。「=」のない行は注記として追加します。
「Show Stub」で半券を表示し、「Width」「Padding」「Field Size」で全体幅・余白・本文サイズを調整します。長い値は欄幅に縮小します。
InspectorのTracking・Line Spacing・全体の位置／回転／拡大を反映します。本文の色・質感はInspectorから調整できます。
枠・半券・本文が一体になって左から現れ、アウトロでは右へ滑りながら消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FIX012
-- @duration 5
-- @title Relationship Chart
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "[nodes]\n制作\n監督\nデザイン\n撮影\n[links]\n制作,監督,依頼\n監督,撮影,指示\n制作,デザイン,相談\nデザイン,撮影,素材"
-- @input number 1 "Radius (em)" default=3.2
-- @input number 2 "Name Size" default=0.5
-- @input number 3 "Relation Size" default=0.22
-- @input number 4 "Line Width (em)" default=0.025
-- @input boolean 1 "Arrows" default=true
-- @input color 1 "Link Color" default={0.55, 0.65, 0.85, 1}
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 10 "Animation Amount" default=1
--[[ @description
Relationship nodes appear before their labeled connections; connections fade first on exit. List names under [nodes] and source,target,label under [links]. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
円周上に並べた名前の枠を、関係ラベル付きの線で結ぶ相関図です。人物や組織の関係、役割分担などを表せ、矢印で関係の向きも示せます。

[nodes]の下に名前を1行ずつ、[links]の下に「名前A,名前B,関係」を1行ずつ入力します。
例：[nodes]［改行］制作［改行］監督［改行］[links]［改行］制作,監督,依頼。
関係ラベルは省略できます。リンクにだけ登場する名前も自動で追加します。同じ名前は1つのノードにまとめます（最大32ノード）。
「Arrows」で矢印のON／OFF、「Radius」「Name Size」「Relation Size」で配置半径・名前・関係ラベルのサイズを指定します。
自己リンクはノードの外側にループを描きます。空の名前や書式の壊れたリンクは無視します。セクションなしの通常の行は名前として扱います。
InspectorのTracking・Line Spacing・全体の位置／回転／拡大を反映します。本文の色・質感はInspectorから調整できます。
名前が順に現れてから関係ラベルと接続線が続きます。アウトロでは接続線と関係ラベルが先に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]
local kMaximumSpacing = 20.0

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

-- Keep the composition in the shared plane before Global transforms.
local function placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical, factor, verticalWriting)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.scale = character.scale * factor
    local originX = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_x or geometry.canvas_origin_x
    local originY = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_y or geometry.canvas_origin_y
    local pivotX, pivotY = character.pivot_x - 0.5, character.pivot_y - 0.5
    local displacementX = (originX - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_x * ctx.canvas.width
    local displacementY = (originY - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_y * ctx.canvas.height
    local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = (math.cos(angle) * displacementX + math.sin(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width
    local rotatedY = (-math.sin(angle) * displacementX + math.cos(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX - rotatedX
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY - rotatedY
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

local function runWidth(ctx, items, factor, verticalWriting)
    local width = 0.0
    for index in ipairs(items) do width = width + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting) end
    return math.max(0.0, width)
end

local function placeRun(ctx, items, horizontal, baseline, factor)
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, false)
        placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, baseline, factor, false)
        horizontal = horizontal + advance
    end
end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 - fraction * width
end

local function alignedTop(ctx, height)
    local fraction = ctx.global.v_align == "top" and 0.0 or ctx.global.v_align == "bottom" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 + fraction * height
end

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kCircleSegments = 32
local records = {}
local texts = {}
local marker = ""
local decorationIndex = 0
local drawing = mt.drawing_path()
local shapeCount = 0
local layoutLeft, layoutTop = 0.5, 0.5
local layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight, layoutLineSpacing = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
placeholder:close()

local function trim(text)
    return text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end

local function beginText(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false
    records, texts, marker = {}, {}, ""
end

local function addText(text)
    local record = { items = {}, text = text }
    if text ~= "" then
        records[#records + 1] = record
        texts[#texts + 1] = text
    end
    return record
end

local function finishText(ctx)
    if #records > 0 and ctx.meta.limits.max_characters > 0 then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, advance_x = 0, advance_y = 0,
            bounds = { -500, -500, 500, 500 } })
        texts[#texts + 1] = marker
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(texts, "\n")
end

local function beginLayout(ctx)
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for index, record in ipairs(records) do record.items = groups[index] and groups[index].items or {} end
    layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight = emSize(ctx)
    layoutLineSpacing = math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    drawing, shapeCount, decorationIndex = mt.drawing_path(), 0, 0
    if marker ~= "" and ctx.char_count > 0 and ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].text == marker then
        decorationIndex = ctx.char_count
        local character = ctx.chars[decorationIndex]
        character.scale, character.stretch_x, character.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
        character.pivot_x, character.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
        character.rotation, character.yaw, character.pitch, character.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
        character.offset_x = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_x
        character.offset_y = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_y
        character.fill.use, character.fill.color = true, ctx.inputs.colors[1]
        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width, character.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
        character.texture.use, character.texture.type = true, "none"
        character.blur.use = true
        character.blur.amount_x, character.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
        character.opacity = 0.0
    end
end

local function layoutBox(ctx, width, height)
    layoutLeft = alignedLeft(ctx, width * layoutEmWidth)
    layoutTop = alignedTop(ctx, height * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing)
end

local function widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    return runWidth(ctx, record.items, factor, false) / layoutEmWidth
end

local function textAt(ctx, record, horizontal, vertical, factor, alignment, maximumWidth)
    if maximumWidth then
        local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
        if width > maximumWidth and width > 0.0 then factor = factor * math.max(0.0, maximumWidth) / width end
    end
    local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    local fraction = alignment == "center" and 0.5 or alignment == "right" and 1.0 or 0.0
    placeRun(ctx, record.items, layoutLeft + (horizontal - width * fraction) * layoutEmWidth,
        layoutTop - vertical * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing, factor)
end

local function tint(ctx, record, color)
    for _, character in ipairs(record.items) do
        local inherited = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = { r = color.r, g = color.g, b = color.b, a = inherited.a * color.a }
    end
end

local function point(horizontal, vertical)
    return ((layoutLeft - 0.5) / layoutEmWidth + horizontal) * kUnitsPerEm,
        ((0.5 - layoutTop) / layoutEmHeight + vertical * layoutLineSpacing) * kUnitsPerEm
end

local function polygon(vertices)
    if decorationIndex > 0 and #vertices >= 3 then
        for index, vertex in ipairs(vertices) do
            local horizontal, vertical = point(vertex[1], vertex[2])
            if index == 1 then drawing:move_to(horizontal, vertical)
            else drawing:line_to(horizontal, vertical) end
        end
        drawing:close()
        shapeCount = shapeCount + 1
    end
end

local function line(firstX, firstY, lastX, lastY, thickness)
    local horizontal, vertical = lastX - firstX, lastY - firstY
    local distance = math.sqrt(horizontal * horizontal + vertical * vertical)
    if distance > 0.0 and thickness > 0.0 then
        local offsetX, offsetY = -vertical / distance * thickness * 0.5, horizontal / distance * thickness * 0.5
        polygon({ { firstX + offsetX, firstY + offsetY }, { lastX + offsetX, lastY + offsetY },
            { lastX - offsetX, lastY - offsetY }, { firstX - offsetX, firstY - offsetY } })
    end
end

local function frame(left, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, top, right, top, thickness)
    line(right, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(right, bottom, left, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, bottom, left, top, thickness)
end

local function circle(horizontal, vertical, radius, thickness)
    for index = 1, kCircleSegments do
        local firstAngle, lastAngle = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments, index * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments
        line(horizontal + math.cos(firstAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(firstAngle) * radius,
            horizontal + math.cos(lastAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(lastAngle) * radius, thickness)
    end
end

local function finishLayout(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then ctx.chars[decorationIndex].opacity = shapeCount > 0 and 1.0 or 0.0 end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(decorationIndex)) do part.path:assign(drawing) end
    end
end


local chart = {}
local kMaximumNodes = 32

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local source = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    beginText(ctx)
    chart = { nodes = {}, links = {} }
    local byName = {}
    local function node(name)
        local result = byName[name]
        if not result and name ~= "" and #chart.nodes < kMaximumNodes then
            result = { name = name }
            chart.nodes[#chart.nodes + 1] = result
            byName[name] = result
        end
        return result
    end
    local section = "nodes"
    for row in source:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local text = trim(row)
        if text:lower() == "[nodes]" then section = "nodes"
        elseif text:lower() == "[links]" then section = "links"
        elseif section == "nodes" then node(text)
        else
            local first, second, label = text:match("^([^,]*),([^,]*),?(.*)$")
            if first and trim(first) ~= "" and trim(second) ~= "" then
                local from, to = node(trim(first)), node(trim(second))
                if from and to then chart.links[#chart.links + 1] = { from = from, to = to, label = trim(label) } end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(chart.nodes) do entry.record = addText(entry.name) end
    for _, link in ipairs(chart.links) do link.record = addText(link.label) end
    finishText(ctx)
end

local function edgeOffset(horizontal, vertical, halfWidth, halfHeight)
    local maximum = math.huge
    if math.abs(horizontal) > 0.000001 then maximum = math.min(maximum, halfWidth / math.abs(horizontal)) end
    if math.abs(vertical) > 0.000001 then maximum = math.min(maximum, halfHeight / math.abs(vertical)) end
    return maximum
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    beginLayout(ctx)
    local radius = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.5, 30.0)
    local factor = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.05, 2.0)
    local relationFactor = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.05, 1.0)
    local thickness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.2)
    local maximumWidth = 0.0
    for _, node in ipairs(chart.nodes) do
        node.width = widthEm(ctx, node.record, factor)
        maximumWidth = math.max(maximumWidth, node.width)
    end
    local centerX, centerY = radius + maximumWidth * 0.5 + 0.4, radius + factor + 0.4
    layoutBox(ctx, centerX * 2, centerY * 2)
    for index, node in ipairs(chart.nodes) do
        local phase = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / math.max(1, #chart.nodes) - math.pi * 0.5
        node.x = centerX + (#chart.nodes > 1 and math.cos(phase) * radius or 0.0)
        node.y = centerY + (#chart.nodes > 1 and math.sin(phase) * radius or 0.0)
        textAt(ctx, node.record, node.x, node.y + factor * 0.3, factor, "center")
        frame(node.x - node.width * 0.5 - 0.15, node.y - factor * 0.6,
            node.x + node.width * 0.5 + 0.15, node.y + factor * 0.6, thickness)
    end
    for _, link in ipairs(chart.links) do
        local from, to = link.from, link.to
        if from == to then
            local right = from.x + from.width * 0.5 + 0.4
            local top = from.y - factor * 1.2
            line(from.x, from.y - factor * 0.6, from.x, top, thickness)
            line(from.x, top, right, top, thickness)
            line(right, top, right, from.y, thickness)
            line(right, from.y, from.x + from.width * 0.5 + 0.15, from.y, thickness)
            textAt(ctx, link.record, right, top - 0.1, relationFactor, "center")
        else
            local deltaX, deltaY = to.x - from.x, to.y - from.y
            local distance = math.sqrt(deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY)
            local directionX, directionY = deltaX / distance, deltaY / distance
            local fromOffset = edgeOffset(directionX, directionY, from.width * 0.5 + 0.2, factor * 0.7)
            local toOffset = edgeOffset(directionX, directionY, to.width * 0.5 + 0.2, factor * 0.7)
            local firstX, firstY = from.x + directionX * fromOffset, from.y + directionY * fromOffset
            local lastX, lastY = to.x - directionX * toOffset, to.y - directionY * toOffset
            if fromOffset + toOffset < distance then
                line(firstX, firstY, lastX, lastY, thickness)
                if ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and thickness > 0.0 then
                    local arrowLength, arrowWidth = 0.16, 0.08
                    -- Wound like line() so the nonzero fill keeps the shaft under the head instead of cutting it out.
                    polygon({ { lastX, lastY },
                        { lastX - directionX * arrowLength + directionY * arrowWidth, lastY - directionY * arrowLength - directionX * arrowWidth },
                        { lastX - directionX * arrowLength - directionY * arrowWidth, lastY - directionY * arrowLength + directionX * arrowWidth } })
                end
            end
            textAt(ctx, link.record, firstX * 0.65 + lastX * 0.35 - directionY * 0.2,
                firstY * 0.65 + lastY * 0.35 + directionX * 0.2, relationFactor, "center", math.max(0.1, distance - fromOffset - toOffset))
        end
    end
    finishLayout(ctx)
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    for _, node in ipairs(chart.nodes) do units[#units + 1] = node.record.items end
    local links = {}
    for _, link in ipairs(chart.links) do appendLayoutItems(links, link.record.items) end
    if decorationIndex > 0 then links[#links + 1] = ctx.chars[decorationIndex] end
    if #links > 0 then units[#units + 1] = links end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decorationIndex, "none", "none")
end
description: Relationship nodes appear before their labeled connections; connections fade first on exit. List names under [nodes] and source,target,label under [links]. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.

descriptions.ja:
円周上に並べた名前の枠を、関係ラベル付きの線で結ぶ相関図です。人物や組織の関係、役割分担などを表せ、矢印で関係の向きも示せます。

[nodes]の下に名前を1行ずつ、[links]の下に「名前A,名前B,関係」を1行ずつ入力します。
例：[nodes]［改行］制作［改行］監督［改行］[links]［改行］制作,監督,依頼。
関係ラベルは省略できます。リンクにだけ登場する名前も自動で追加します。同じ名前は1つのノードにまとめます（最大32ノード）。
「Arrows」で矢印のON／OFF、「Radius」「Name Size」「Relation Size」で配置半径・名前・関係ラベルのサイズを指定します。
自己リンクはノードの外側にループを描きます。空の名前や書式の壊れたリンクは無視します。セクションなしの通常の行は名前として扱います。
InspectorのTracking・Line Spacing・全体の位置／回転／拡大を反映します。本文の色・質感はInspectorから調整できます。
名前が順に現れてから関係ラベルと接続線が続きます。アウトロでは接続線と関係ラベルが先に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。

name: FIX013_radial_labels.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FIX013
-- @duration 5
-- @title Radial Labels
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.1
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "Mug Typography\nルビ\nカレンダー\nリスト\nテーブル\n相関図\n路線図"
-- @input number 1 "Radius (em)" default=3
-- @input number 2 "Heading Size" default=0.65
-- @input number 3 "Label Size" default=0.45
-- @input number 4 "Start Angle (degrees)" default=90
-- @input number 5 "Line Width (em)" default=0.025
-- @input boolean 1 "Connectors" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Center Frame" default=true
-- @input color 1 "Connector Color" default={0.4, 0.7, 0.9, 1}
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 10 "Animation Amount" default=1
--[[ @description
A central heading appears before surrounding labels unfold clockwise; labels disappear first. Enter the heading first, then one label per line. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
中央の見出しの周囲にラベルを放射状に配置するレイアウトです。テーマと関連項目、製品と特徴などを整理でき、中央から各ラベルへの接続線も表示できます。

最初の空でない行を中央の見出し、以降の行を周辺ラベルとして入力します（周辺は最大32個）。
例：Mug Typography［改行］ルビ［改行］カレンダー［改行］テーブル。空行は無視します。
「Radius」で放射状の配置半径、「Start Angle」で先頭ラベルの角度を指定します。0度＝右、90度＝上で、以降は時計回りに配置します。
「Heading Size」「Label Size」でサイズ、「Connectors」で接続線、「Center Frame」で中央の囲みを切り替えます。ラベルは水平を保ち、長い見出し・ラベルに必要な幅を半径の下限へ反映します。
InspectorのTracking・Line Spacing・全体の位置／回転／拡大を反映します。本文の色・質感はInspectorから調整できます。
中央の見出しが先に現れ、周辺ラベルが時計回りに続きます。アウトロは周辺ラベルから中央へ逆順に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
]]
local kMaximumSpacing = 20.0

local function emSize(ctx)
    local height = ctx.font.em_size
    return height / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio, height
end

-- Keep the composition in the shared plane before Global transforms.
local function placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, vertical, factor, verticalWriting)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.scale = character.scale * factor
    local originX = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_x or geometry.canvas_origin_x
    local originY = verticalWriting and geometry.vertical_origin_y or geometry.canvas_origin_y
    local pivotX, pivotY = character.pivot_x - 0.5, character.pivot_y - 0.5
    local displacementX = (originX - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_x * ctx.canvas.width
    local displacementY = (originY - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY)
        * character.scale * character.stretch_y * ctx.canvas.height
    local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
    local rotatedX = (math.cos(angle) * displacementX + math.sin(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.width
    local rotatedY = (-math.sin(angle) * displacementX + math.cos(angle) * displacementY) / ctx.canvas.height
    character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal - geometry.bounds_center_x - pivotX - rotatedX
    character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical - geometry.bounds_center_y - pivotY - rotatedY
end

local function runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting)
    local character = items[index]
    local geometry = character.geometry
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local em = verticalWriting and emHeight or emWidth
    local advance = math.abs(verticalWriting and geometry.advance_y or geometry.advance_x)
    local spacing = (ctx.global.tracking + (ctx.global.margins[character.index] or 0.0)) * em
    local nextCharacter = items[index + 1]
    if nextCharacter then
        local step = verticalWriting
            and geometry.vertical_origin_y - nextCharacter.geometry.vertical_origin_y
            or nextCharacter.geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.canvas_origin_x
        spacing = step - advance
    end
    local stretch = verticalWriting and character.stretch_y or character.stretch_x
    return (advance * character.scale * stretch + spacing) * factor
end

local function runWidth(ctx, items, factor, verticalWriting)
    local width = 0.0
    for index in ipairs(items) do width = width + runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, verticalWriting) end
    return math.max(0.0, width)
end

local function placeRun(ctx, items, horizontal, baseline, factor)
    for index, character in ipairs(items) do
        local advance = runAdvance(ctx, items, index, factor, false)
        placeOrigin(ctx, character, horizontal, baseline, factor, false)
        horizontal = horizontal + advance
    end
end

local function alignedLeft(ctx, width)
    local fraction = ctx.global.h_align == "left" and 0.0 or ctx.global.h_align == "right" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 - fraction * width
end

local function alignedTop(ctx, height)
    local fraction = ctx.global.v_align == "top" and 0.0 or ctx.global.v_align == "bottom" and 1.0 or 0.5
    return 0.5 + fraction * height
end

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kCircleSegments = 32
local records = {}
local texts = {}
local marker = ""
local decorationIndex = 0
local drawing = mt.drawing_path()
local shapeCount = 0
local layoutLeft, layoutTop = 0.5, 0.5
local layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight, layoutLineSpacing = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
placeholder:close()

local function trim(text)
    return text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end

local function beginText(ctx)
    ctx.global.vertical = false
    records, texts, marker = {}, {}, ""
end

local function addText(text)
    local record = { items = {}, text = text }
    if text ~= "" then
        records[#records + 1] = record
        texts[#texts + 1] = text
    end
    return record
end

local function finishText(ctx)
    if #records > 0 and ctx.meta.limits.max_characters > 0 then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, advance_x = 0, advance_y = 0,
            bounds = { -500, -500, 500, 500 } })
        texts[#texts + 1] = marker
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(texts, "\n")
end

local function beginLayout(ctx)
    local groups = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for index, record in ipairs(records) do record.items = groups[index] and groups[index].items or {} end
    layoutEmWidth, layoutEmHeight = emSize(ctx)
    layoutLineSpacing = math.max(0.0, ctx.global.line_spacing)
    drawing, shapeCount, decorationIndex = mt.drawing_path(), 0, 0
    if marker ~= "" and ctx.char_count > 0 and ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].text == marker then
        decorationIndex = ctx.char_count
        local character = ctx.chars[decorationIndex]
        character.scale, character.stretch_x, character.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
        character.pivot_x, character.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
        character.rotation, character.yaw, character.pitch, character.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
        character.offset_x = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_x
        character.offset_y = 1.0 - character.geometry.bounds_center_y
        character.fill.use, character.fill.color = true, ctx.inputs.colors[1]
        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width, character.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
        character.texture.use, character.texture.type = true, "none"
        character.blur.use = true
        character.blur.amount_x, character.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
        character.opacity = 0.0
    end
end

local function layoutBox(ctx, width, height)
    layoutLeft = alignedLeft(ctx, width * layoutEmWidth)
    layoutTop = alignedTop(ctx, height * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing)
end

local function widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    return runWidth(ctx, record.items, factor, false) / layoutEmWidth
end

local function textAt(ctx, record, horizontal, vertical, factor, alignment, maximumWidth)
    if maximumWidth then
        local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
        if width > maximumWidth and width > 0.0 then factor = factor * math.max(0.0, maximumWidth) / width end
    end
    local width = widthEm(ctx, record, factor)
    local fraction = alignment == "center" and 0.5 or alignment == "right" and 1.0 or 0.0
    placeRun(ctx, record.items, layoutLeft + (horizontal - width * fraction) * layoutEmWidth,
        layoutTop - vertical * layoutEmHeight * layoutLineSpacing, factor)
end

local function tint(ctx, record, color)
    for _, character in ipairs(record.items) do
        local inherited = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = { r = color.r, g = color.g, b = color.b, a = inherited.a * color.a }
    end
end

local function point(horizontal, vertical)
    return ((layoutLeft - 0.5) / layoutEmWidth + horizontal) * kUnitsPerEm,
        ((0.5 - layoutTop) / layoutEmHeight + vertical * layoutLineSpacing) * kUnitsPerEm
end

local function polygon(vertices)
    if decorationIndex > 0 and #vertices >= 3 then
        for index, vertex in ipairs(vertices) do
            local horizontal, vertical = point(vertex[1], vertex[2])
            if index == 1 then drawing:move_to(horizontal, vertical)
            else drawing:line_to(horizontal, vertical) end
        end
        drawing:close()
        shapeCount = shapeCount + 1
    end
end

local function line(firstX, firstY, lastX, lastY, thickness)
    local horizontal, vertical = lastX - firstX, lastY - firstY
    local distance = math.sqrt(horizontal * horizontal + vertical * vertical)
    if distance > 0.0 and thickness > 0.0 then
        local offsetX, offsetY = -vertical / distance * thickness * 0.5, horizontal / distance * thickness * 0.5
        polygon({ { firstX + offsetX, firstY + offsetY }, { lastX + offsetX, lastY + offsetY },
            { lastX - offsetX, lastY - offsetY }, { firstX - offsetX, firstY - offsetY } })
    end
end

local function frame(left, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, top, right, top, thickness)
    line(right, top, right, bottom, thickness)
    line(right, bottom, left, bottom, thickness)
    line(left, bottom, left, top, thickness)
end

local function circle(horizontal, vertical, radius, thickness)
    for index = 1, kCircleSegments do
        local firstAngle, lastAngle = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments, index * math.pi * 2 / kCircleSegments
        line(horizontal + math.cos(firstAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(firstAngle) * radius,
            horizontal + math.cos(lastAngle) * radius, vertical + math.sin(lastAngle) * radius, thickness)
    end
end

local function finishLayout(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then ctx.chars[decorationIndex].opacity = shapeCount > 0 and 1.0 or 0.0 end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    if decorationIndex > 0 then
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(decorationIndex)) do part.path:assign(drawing) end
    end
end


local radial = {}
local kMaximumLabels = 32

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local source = ctx.global.text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    beginText(ctx)
    radial = { heading = addText(""), labels = {} }
    local hasHeading = false
    for row in source:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local text = trim(row)
        if text ~= "" then
            if not hasHeading then radial.heading = addText(text); hasHeading = true
            elseif #radial.labels < kMaximumLabels then radial.labels[#radial.labels + 1] = addText(text) end
        end
    end
    finishText(ctx)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    beginLayout(ctx)
    local radius = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.5, 30.0)
    local headingFactor = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.05, 2.0)
    local labelFactor = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.05, 2.0)
    local angle = math.rad(ctx.inputs.numbers[4] % 360)
    local thickness = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 0.2)
    local headingWidth = widthEm(ctx, radial.heading, headingFactor)
    local maximumLabel = 0.0
    for _, record in ipairs(radial.labels) do maximumLabel = math.max(maximumLabel, widthEm(ctx, record, labelFactor)) end
    radius = math.max(radius, headingWidth * 0.5 + maximumLabel * 0.5 + 0.5)
    local centerX = radius + math.max(maximumLabel, headingWidth) * 0.5 + 0.2
    local centerY = radius + math.max(headingFactor, labelFactor) + 0.2
    layoutBox(ctx, centerX * 2, centerY * 2)
    textAt(ctx, radial.heading, centerX, centerY + headingFactor * 0.3, headingFactor, "center")
    if ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and radial.heading.text ~= "" then
        frame(centerX - headingWidth * 0.5 - 0.15, centerY - headingFactor * 0.6,
            centerX + headingWidth * 0.5 + 0.15, centerY + headingFactor * 0.6, thickness)
    end
    for index, record in ipairs(radial.labels) do
        local phase = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / #radial.labels - angle
        local horizontal, vertical = centerX + math.cos(phase) * radius, centerY + math.sin(phase) * radius
        local width = widthEm(ctx, record, labelFactor)
        textAt(ctx, record, horizontal, vertical + labelFactor * 0.3, labelFactor, "center")
        if ctx.inputs.booleans[1] then
            local directionX, directionY = math.cos(phase), math.sin(phase)
            local fromOffset = math.huge
            if math.abs(directionX) > 0.000001 then fromOffset = math.min(fromOffset, (headingWidth * 0.5 + 0.25) / math.abs(directionX)) end
            if math.abs(directionY) > 0.000001 then fromOffset = math.min(fromOffset, (headingFactor * 0.7 + 0.15) / math.abs(directionY)) end
            local toOffset = math.huge
            if math.abs(directionX) > 0.000001 then toOffset = math.min(toOffset, (width * 0.5 + 0.15) / math.abs(directionX)) end
            if math.abs(directionY) > 0.000001 then toOffset = math.min(toOffset, (labelFactor * 0.7 + 0.15) / math.abs(directionY)) end
            if fromOffset + toOffset < radius then
                line(centerX + directionX * fromOffset, centerY + directionY * fromOffset,
                    horizontal - directionX * toOffset, vertical - directionY * toOffset, thickness)
            end
        end
    end
    finishLayout(ctx)
end

local kFallbackClipDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumTransitionDuration = 60.0
local kStaggerFraction = 0.55

local function layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, kMaximumTransitionDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackClipDuration)
end

local function animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decoration, movement, wholeMovement)
    local intro, outro = layoutTransitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 3.0)
    local emWidth, emHeight = emSize(ctx)
    local overallMotion = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
    local assignments = {}
    for index, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local delay = #units > 1 and (index - 1) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local reverseDelay = #units > 1 and (#units - index) / (#units - 1) * kStaggerFraction or 0.0
        local activeSpan = #units > 1 and 1.0 - kStaggerFraction or 1.0
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / activeSpan))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - reverseDelay) / activeSpan))
        for _, character in ipairs(unit) do
            assignments[character.index] = { visibility = entrance * (1.0 - exit), motion = 1.0 - entrance + exit }
        end
    end
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        local state = assignments[character.index]
        local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local motion = overallMotion
        if state then visibility, motion = state.visibility, state.motion end
        if character.index == decoration and assignments[decoration] == nil then motion = 0.0 end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
        if movement == "rise" then vertical = -0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "right" then horizontal = 0.45 * motion
        elseif movement == "left" then horizontal = -0.5 * motion
        elseif movement == "tangent" then
            local angle = math.rad(character.rotation)
            horizontal, vertical = -0.35 * motion * math.cos(angle), 0.35 * motion * math.sin(angle)
        end
        if wholeMovement == "rise" then vertical = vertical - 0.35 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "left" then horizontal = horizontal - 0.45 * overallMotion
        elseif wholeMovement == "ticket" then
            horizontal = horizontal - 0.8 * (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)) + 0.8 * mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        end
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * emWidth * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * emHeight * amount
    end
end

local function appendLayoutItems(unit, items)
    for _, character in ipairs(items) do unit[#unit + 1] = character end
end

local composeLayout = OnLayout

function OnLayout(ctx)
    composeLayout(ctx)
    local units = {}
    units[1] = radial.heading.items
    for _, record in ipairs(radial.labels) do units[#units + 1] = record.items end
    animateLayoutUnits(ctx, units, decorationIndex, "none", "none")
end
description: A central heading appears before surrounding labels unfold clockwise; labels disappear first. Enter the heading first, then one label per line. Intro/Outro: toggle, seconds; Amount: motion.

descriptions.ja:
中央の見出しの周囲にラベルを放射状に配置するレイアウトです。テーマと関連項目、製品と特徴などを整理でき、中央から各ラベルへの接続線も表示できます。

最初の空でない行を中央の見出し、以降の行を周辺ラベルとして入力します（周辺は最大32個）。
例：Mug Typography［改行］ルビ［改行］カレンダー［改行］テーブル。空行は無視します。
「Radius」で放射状の配置半径、「Start Angle」で先頭ラベルの角度を指定します。0度＝右、90度＝上で、以降は時計回りに配置します。
「Heading Size」「Label Size」でサイズ、「Connectors」で接続線、「Center Frame」で中央の囲みを切り替えます。ラベルは水平を保ち、長い見出し・ラベルに必要な幅を半径の下限へ反映します。
InspectorのTracking・Line Spacing・全体の位置／回転／拡大を反映します。本文の色・質感はInspectorから調整できます。
中央の見出しが先に現れ、周辺ラベルが時計回りに続きます。アウトロは周辺ラベルから中央へ逆順に消えます。
「Intro」「Outro」で各アニメーションを切り替え、「Intro Duration (s)」「Outro Duration (s)」で秒数を指定します。クリップが短い場合は両区間を比例圧縮します。「Animation Amount」は移動量で、0なら位置を動かさずフェードします。両方OFFなら固定表示です。
