source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FRM003
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Flower Frame
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "Sample Text\nHave a Nice Day"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.65
-- @input number 3 "Padding (em)" default=0.7
-- @input number 4 "Line Width (em)" default=0.055
-- @input number 5 "Corner Radius (em)" default=0.45
-- @input number 6 "Decoration Size (em)" default=0.8
-- @input number 7 "Idle Speed (Hz)" default=0.35
-- @input number 8 "Idle Amount" default=0.6
-- @input color 1 "Frame Color" default={0.57,0.80,0.65,1}
-- @input color 2 "Decoration Color" default={1,0.66,0.74,1}
--[[ @description
A gentle garden frame grows around the message, pops flowers open at three corners, and lets a petal drift away.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
細い枠がつるのように伸び、線が角を通ると花が大きく開き、弾むように膨らんだり縮んだりして落ち着きます。待機中は花がゆっくり揺れ、ときどき花びらが1枚舞います。

本文全体を測って枠の大きさを決めます。Padding (em)・Line Width (em)・Decoration Size (em) で余白・線の太さ・飾りの大きさを調整できます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。枠と飾りは本文の後ろに描き、文字の枠を2つ使います。空きが1つなら枠だけを描き、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
]]

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kMaximumEdgeSamples = 96
local kCornerSamples = 8
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawFrame

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function segment(path, first, last, width)
    local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
    local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    if length > kEpsilon and width > kEpsilon then
        local normalX, normalY = -differenceY / length * width * 0.5, differenceX / length * width * 0.5
        path:move_to(first.x - normalX, first.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x - normalX, last.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x + normalX, last.y + normalY)
        path:line_to(first.x + normalX, first.y + normalY)
        path:close()
        circle(path, first.x, first.y, width * 0.5)
        circle(path, last.x, last.y, width * 0.5)
    end
end

local function pathLength(points)
    local result = 0.0
    for index = 2, #points do
        local differenceX, differenceY = points[index].x - points[index - 1].x, points[index].y - points[index - 1].y
        result = result + math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    end
    return result
end

local function pointAlong(points, distance)
    local remaining = math.max(distance, 0.0)
    local result = points[#points]
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining <= length and length > kEpsilon then
            local progress = remaining / length
            result = { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, progress), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, progress) }
            break
        end
        remaining = remaining - length
    end
    return result
end

local function stroke(path, points, width, progress)
    local remaining = pathLength(points) * mt.saturate(progress)
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining > kEpsilon and length > kEpsilon then
            local portion = mt.saturate(remaining / length)
            segment(path, first, { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, portion), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, portion) }, width)
        end
        remaining = math.max(remaining - length, 0.0)
    end
end

local function perimeter(width, height, radius, scallopSize, scallopHeight)
    local points = {}
    local halfWidth, halfHeight = width * 0.5, height * 0.5
    local corner = math.min(radius, halfWidth, halfHeight)
    local sides = {
        { startX = -halfWidth + corner, startY = -halfHeight, endX = halfWidth - corner, endY = -halfHeight,
          normalX = 0, normalY = -1, centerX = halfWidth - corner, centerY = -halfHeight + corner, angle = -math.pi * 0.5 },
        { startX = halfWidth, startY = -halfHeight + corner, endX = halfWidth, endY = halfHeight - corner,
          normalX = 1, normalY = 0, centerX = halfWidth - corner, centerY = halfHeight - corner, angle = 0 },
        { startX = halfWidth - corner, startY = halfHeight, endX = -halfWidth + corner, endY = halfHeight,
          normalX = 0, normalY = 1, centerX = -halfWidth + corner, centerY = halfHeight - corner, angle = math.pi * 0.5 },
        { startX = -halfWidth, startY = halfHeight - corner, endX = -halfWidth, endY = -halfHeight + corner,
          normalX = -1, normalY = 0, centerX = -halfWidth + corner, centerY = -halfHeight + corner, angle = math.pi },
    }
    for _, side in ipairs(sides) do
        local length = math.abs(side.endX - side.startX) + math.abs(side.endY - side.startY)
        local lobes = math.max(1, math.ceil(length / math.max(scallopSize, kUnitsPerEm * 0.1)))
        local samples = scallopHeight > kEpsilon and math.min(kMaximumEdgeSamples, lobes * kCornerSamples) or 1
        for sample = 0, samples do
            local progress = sample / samples
            local bump = math.sin(progress * lobes * math.pi) ^ 2 * scallopHeight
            points[#points + 1] = { x = mt.lerp(side.startX, side.endX, progress) + side.normalX * bump,
                y = mt.lerp(side.startY, side.endY, progress) + side.normalY * bump }
        end
        for sample = 1, kCornerSamples do
            local angle = side.angle + sample / kCornerSamples * math.pi * 0.5
            points[#points + 1] = { x = side.centerX + math.cos(angle) * corner,
                y = side.centerY + math.sin(angle) * corner }
        end
    end
    points[#points + 1] = points[1]
    return points
end

-- Geometry is measured before Global rotation; writing through this adapter cancels
-- Global scale/stretch while placement lets the frame follow the remaining rotation.
local function drawingAt(ctx, path, centerX, centerY, offsetX, offsetY, scale, angle)
    local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
    local unitsPerPixel = kUnitsPerEm / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.canvas.height)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle or 0.0), math.sin(angle or 0.0)
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local localX = (offsetX or 0.0) + (horizontal * cosine - vertical * sine) * (scale or 1.0)
        local localY = (offsetY or 0.0) + (horizontal * sine + vertical * cosine) * (scale or 1.0)
        local canvasX = centerX + localX / kUnitsPerEm * emSize / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
        local canvasY = centerY - localY / kUnitsPerEm * emSize
        return (canvasX - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width * unitsPerPixel / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (0.5 - canvasY) * ctx.canvas.height * unitsPerPixel / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local duration = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackDuration)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, duration / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, kEpsilon))
    local intro, outro = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
    return intro, outro, introSeconds * compression
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if bodyCount > 0 and budget > 0 and ctx.global.text:match("%S") then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
        placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
        placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
        placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
        placeholder:close()
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, 2) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- A dedicated zero-bounds line excludes decoration tracking from the text's alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. "\n" .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[index]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    local centerX = (ctx.global.position_x + ctx.global.pivot_x - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local centerY = (1.5 - ctx.global.position_y - ctx.global.pivot_y) * ctx.canvas.height
    local rotation = math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)
    local differenceX, differenceY = ctx.canvas.width * 0.5 - centerX, ctx.canvas.height * 0.5 - centerY
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration,
        (centerX + math.cos(rotation) * differenceX - math.sin(rotation) * differenceY) / ctx.canvas.width,
        1.0 - (centerY + math.sin(rotation) * differenceX + math.cos(rotation) * differenceY) / ctx.canvas.height)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, { mt.drawing_path(), mt.drawing_path() }
    local markerSlots, bodyIndices = {}, {}
    local hasBodyInk = false
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then
            decorationIndices[slot] = index
        else
            bodyIndices[#bodyIndices + 1] = index
            if ctx.chars[index].part_count > 0 and mt.text.classify(ctx.chars[index].text) ~= "space" then
                hasBodyInk = true
            end
        end
    end
    local intro, outro, introDuration = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(bodyIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = ctx.chars[index].opacity * visibility end
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and hasBodyInk and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, bodyIndices, "character", "before_global_rotation")
        if bounds and bounds.width > kEpsilon and bounds.height > kEpsilon then
            for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
            local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
            local padding = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.15, 3.0) * kUnitsPerEm
            local width = bounds.width * ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio / emSize * kUnitsPerEm + padding * 2.0
            local height = bounds.height / emSize * kUnitsPerEm + padding * 2.0
            local lineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.3) * kUnitsPerEm
            local radius = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) * kUnitsPerEm, width * 0.5, height * 0.5)
            local decorationSize = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 2.0) * kUnitsPerEm
            local idleSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 4.0)
            local idleAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 1.0)
            drawFrame(ctx, bounds, width, height, lineWidth, radius, decorationSize, intro, outro, introDuration, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
            local order = {}
            for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
            local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
            ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
            ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
        end
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

local kFlowerCount = 3
local kPetalCount = 5
local kBloomSpan = 0.12
local kBloomSeconds = 0.32
local kPetalTravel = 0.6

local function leaf(path, size)
    if size > kEpsilon then
        path:move_to(0, 0)
        path:cubic_to(-size * 0.5, -size * 0.35, -size * 0.65, -size * 0.7, -size * 0.6, -size)
        path:cubic_to(-size * 0.1, -size * 0.8, size * 0.12, -size * 0.35, 0, 0)
        path:close()
    end
end

drawFrame = function(ctx, bounds, width, height, lineWidth, radius, decorationSize, intro, outro, introDuration, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
    local outline = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[1], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y)
    local reveal = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local points = perimeter(width, height, radius, kUnitsPerEm, 0)
    local totalLength = pathLength(points)
    stroke(outline, points, lineWidth, reveal)
    local cornerInset = radius * (1.0 - math.sqrt(0.5))
    local corners = { { width * 0.5 - cornerInset, -height * 0.5 + cornerInset },
        { width * 0.5 - cornerInset, height * 0.5 - cornerInset },
        { -width * 0.5 + cornerInset, height * 0.5 - cornerInset } }
    local blooms = {}
    if #decorationIndices > 1 then
        for slot = 1, kFlowerCount do
            local cornerDistance, travelled, closestDistance = 0.0, 0.0, math.huge
            for index, point in ipairs(points) do
                if index > 1 then
                    local previous = points[index - 1]
                    travelled = travelled + math.sqrt((point.x - previous.x) ^ 2 + (point.y - previous.y) ^ 2)
                end
                local distance = (point.x - corners[slot][1]) ^ 2 + (point.y - corners[slot][2]) ^ 2
                if distance < closestDistance then cornerDistance, closestDistance = travelled, distance end
            end
            local cornerProgress = cornerDistance / math.max(totalLength, kEpsilon)
            local bloomSpan = math.max(kEpsilon, math.min(kBloomSpan, 1.0 - cornerProgress))
            local arrivalTime = (1.0 - (1.0 - cornerProgress) ^ (1.0 / 3.0)) * introDuration
            local elapsed = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackDuration) - mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, kFallbackDuration)
            local bloom = introDuration > kEpsilon
                and mt.ease.out_elastic(mt.saturate((elapsed - arrivalTime) / kBloomSeconds)) or 1.0
            if outro > 0.0 then
                bloom = bloom * mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((reveal - cornerProgress) / bloomSpan))
            end
            blooms[slot] = bloom
            local size = decorationSize * (slot == kFlowerCount and 0.7 or 1.0)
            local swing = math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau + slot) * idleAmount * 0.09
            local petals = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
                corners[slot][1], corners[slot][2], math.max(bloom, 0.0), swing)
            local outlineSamples = kPetalCount * 16
            for sample = 0, outlineSamples - 1 do
                local angle = sample / outlineSamples * kTau
                local petalRadius = size * (0.32 + 0.08 * math.cos(angle * kPetalCount))
                local x, y = math.cos(angle) * petalRadius, math.sin(angle) * petalRadius
                if sample == 0 then petals:move_to(x, y) else petals:line_to(x, y) end
            end
            petals:close()
            circle(petals, 0, 0, size * 0.11, true)
            local leaves = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[1], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
                corners[slot][1], corners[slot][2], math.max(bloom, 0.0), swing)
            circle(leaves, 0, 0, size * 0.11)
            leaf(leaves, size * 0.7)
        end
        if idleSpeed > 0.0 and idleAmount > 0.0 then
            local age = (ctx.time * idleSpeed * 0.5) % 1.0
            local presence = math.sin(age * math.pi) * math.max(blooms[1] or 0.0, 0.0) * idleAmount
            local petal = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
                corners[1][1] + age * kPetalTravel * kUnitsPerEm,
                corners[1][2] + age * kUnitsPerEm, presence, age * math.pi)
            leaf(petal, decorationSize * 0.35)
        end
    end
end
description: A gentle garden frame grows around the message, pops flowers open at three corners, and lets a petal drift away.

descriptions.ja:
細い枠がつるのように伸び、線が角を通ると花が大きく開き、弾むように膨らんだり縮んだりして落ち着きます。待機中は花がゆっくり揺れ、ときどき花びらが1枚舞います。

本文全体を測って枠の大きさを決めます。Padding (em)・Line Width (em)・Decoration Size (em) で余白・線の太さ・飾りの大きさを調整できます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。枠と飾りは本文の後ろに描き、文字の枠を2つ使います。空きが1つなら枠だけを描き、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FRM004
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Stitch Frame
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "Sample Text\nMade with Love"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.0
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.65
-- @input number 3 "Padding (em)" default=0.6
-- @input number 4 "Line Width (em)" default=0.045
-- @input number 5 "Corner Radius (em)" default=0.4
-- @input number 6 "Decoration Size (em)" default=0.75
-- @input number 7 "Idle Speed (Hz)" default=0.45
-- @input number 8 "Idle Amount" default=0.55
-- @input color 1 "Frame Color" default={0.77,0.71,0.95,1}
-- @input color 2 "Decoration Color" default={1,0.73,0.64,1}
-- @input number 9 "Stitch Length (em)" default=0.24
--[[ @description
A stitched border sews itself around the message, finishing with a heart and a softly tilting button.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
点線の枠が一針ずつ縫われるように現れ、ハートとボタンを添えます。待機中はボタンが小さく揺れ、退場時は糸をほどきます。

本文全体を測って枠の大きさを決めます。Padding (em)・Line Width (em)・Decoration Size (em) で余白・線の太さ・飾りの大きさを調整できます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。枠と飾りは本文の後ろに描き、文字の枠を2つ使います。空きが1つなら枠だけを描き、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
]]

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kMaximumEdgeSamples = 96
local kCornerSamples = 8
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawFrame

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function segment(path, first, last, width)
    local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
    local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    if length > kEpsilon and width > kEpsilon then
        local normalX, normalY = -differenceY / length * width * 0.5, differenceX / length * width * 0.5
        path:move_to(first.x - normalX, first.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x - normalX, last.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x + normalX, last.y + normalY)
        path:line_to(first.x + normalX, first.y + normalY)
        path:close()
        circle(path, first.x, first.y, width * 0.5)
        circle(path, last.x, last.y, width * 0.5)
    end
end

local function pathLength(points)
    local result = 0.0
    for index = 2, #points do
        local differenceX, differenceY = points[index].x - points[index - 1].x, points[index].y - points[index - 1].y
        result = result + math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    end
    return result
end

local function pointAlong(points, distance)
    local remaining = math.max(distance, 0.0)
    local result = points[#points]
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining <= length and length > kEpsilon then
            local progress = remaining / length
            result = { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, progress), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, progress) }
            break
        end
        remaining = remaining - length
    end
    return result
end

local function stroke(path, points, width, progress)
    local remaining = pathLength(points) * mt.saturate(progress)
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining > kEpsilon and length > kEpsilon then
            local portion = mt.saturate(remaining / length)
            segment(path, first, { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, portion), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, portion) }, width)
        end
        remaining = math.max(remaining - length, 0.0)
    end
end

local function perimeter(width, height, radius, scallopSize, scallopHeight)
    local points = {}
    local halfWidth, halfHeight = width * 0.5, height * 0.5
    local corner = math.min(radius, halfWidth, halfHeight)
    local sides = {
        { startX = -halfWidth + corner, startY = -halfHeight, endX = halfWidth - corner, endY = -halfHeight,
          normalX = 0, normalY = -1, centerX = halfWidth - corner, centerY = -halfHeight + corner, angle = -math.pi * 0.5 },
        { startX = halfWidth, startY = -halfHeight + corner, endX = halfWidth, endY = halfHeight - corner,
          normalX = 1, normalY = 0, centerX = halfWidth - corner, centerY = halfHeight - corner, angle = 0 },
        { startX = halfWidth - corner, startY = halfHeight, endX = -halfWidth + corner, endY = halfHeight,
          normalX = 0, normalY = 1, centerX = -halfWidth + corner, centerY = halfHeight - corner, angle = math.pi * 0.5 },
        { startX = -halfWidth, startY = halfHeight - corner, endX = -halfWidth, endY = -halfHeight + corner,
          normalX = -1, normalY = 0, centerX = -halfWidth + corner, centerY = -halfHeight + corner, angle = math.pi },
    }
    for _, side in ipairs(sides) do
        local length = math.abs(side.endX - side.startX) + math.abs(side.endY - side.startY)
        local lobes = math.max(1, math.ceil(length / math.max(scallopSize, kUnitsPerEm * 0.1)))
        local samples = scallopHeight > kEpsilon and math.min(kMaximumEdgeSamples, lobes * kCornerSamples) or 1
        for sample = 0, samples do
            local progress = sample / samples
            local bump = math.sin(progress * lobes * math.pi) ^ 2 * scallopHeight
            points[#points + 1] = { x = mt.lerp(side.startX, side.endX, progress) + side.normalX * bump,
                y = mt.lerp(side.startY, side.endY, progress) + side.normalY * bump }
        end
        for sample = 1, kCornerSamples do
            local angle = side.angle + sample / kCornerSamples * math.pi * 0.5
            points[#points + 1] = { x = side.centerX + math.cos(angle) * corner,
                y = side.centerY + math.sin(angle) * corner }
        end
    end
    points[#points + 1] = points[1]
    return points
end

-- Geometry is measured before Global rotation; writing through this adapter cancels
-- Global scale/stretch while placement lets the frame follow the remaining rotation.
local function drawingAt(ctx, path, centerX, centerY, offsetX, offsetY, scale, angle)
    local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
    local unitsPerPixel = kUnitsPerEm / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.canvas.height)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle or 0.0), math.sin(angle or 0.0)
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local localX = (offsetX or 0.0) + (horizontal * cosine - vertical * sine) * (scale or 1.0)
        local localY = (offsetY or 0.0) + (horizontal * sine + vertical * cosine) * (scale or 1.0)
        local canvasX = centerX + localX / kUnitsPerEm * emSize / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
        local canvasY = centerY - localY / kUnitsPerEm * emSize
        return (canvasX - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width * unitsPerPixel / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (0.5 - canvasY) * ctx.canvas.height * unitsPerPixel / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if bodyCount > 0 and budget > 0 and ctx.global.text:match("%S") then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
        placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
        placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
        placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
        placeholder:close()
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, 2) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- A dedicated zero-bounds line excludes decoration tracking from the text's alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. "\n" .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[index]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    local centerX = (ctx.global.position_x + ctx.global.pivot_x - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local centerY = (1.5 - ctx.global.position_y - ctx.global.pivot_y) * ctx.canvas.height
    local rotation = math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)
    local differenceX, differenceY = ctx.canvas.width * 0.5 - centerX, ctx.canvas.height * 0.5 - centerY
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration,
        (centerX + math.cos(rotation) * differenceX - math.sin(rotation) * differenceY) / ctx.canvas.width,
        1.0 - (centerY + math.sin(rotation) * differenceX + math.cos(rotation) * differenceY) / ctx.canvas.height)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, { mt.drawing_path(), mt.drawing_path() }
    local markerSlots, bodyIndices = {}, {}
    local hasBodyInk = false
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then
            decorationIndices[slot] = index
        else
            bodyIndices[#bodyIndices + 1] = index
            if ctx.chars[index].part_count > 0 and mt.text.classify(ctx.chars[index].text) ~= "space" then
                hasBodyInk = true
            end
        end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(bodyIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = ctx.chars[index].opacity * visibility end
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and hasBodyInk and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, bodyIndices, "character", "before_global_rotation")
        if bounds and bounds.width > kEpsilon and bounds.height > kEpsilon then
            for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
            local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
            local padding = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.15, 3.0) * kUnitsPerEm
            local width = bounds.width * ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio / emSize * kUnitsPerEm + padding * 2.0
            local height = bounds.height / emSize * kUnitsPerEm + padding * 2.0
            local lineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.3) * kUnitsPerEm
            local radius = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) * kUnitsPerEm, width * 0.5, height * 0.5)
            local decorationSize = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 2.0) * kUnitsPerEm
            local idleSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 4.0)
            local idleAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 1.0)
            drawFrame(ctx, bounds, width, height, lineWidth, radius, decorationSize, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
            local order = {}
            for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
            local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
            ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
            ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
        end
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

local kStitchGap = 0.65
local kButtonDelay = 0.6
local kMaximumStitches = 180

local function heart(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size * 0.15)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.2, size * 0.3, size * 0.1, size * 0.38, 0, size * 0.5)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.1, size * 0.38, -size * 0.2, size * 0.3, -size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, -size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, 0, -size * 0.15)
    path:close()
end

drawFrame = function(ctx, bounds, width, height, lineWidth, radius, decorationSize, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
    local outline = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[1], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y)
    local points = perimeter(width, height, radius, kUnitsPerEm, 0)
    local length = pathLength(points)
    local stitchLength = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.08, 0.8) * kUnitsPerEm
    local count = math.min(kMaximumStitches, math.max(1, math.ceil(length / (stitchLength * (1.0 + kStitchGap)))))
    local spacing = length / count
    local reveal = mt.ease.in_out_sine(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_out_sine(outro))
    for stitch = 0, count - 1 do
        local progress = mt.saturate(reveal * count - stitch)
        if progress > kEpsilon then
            local start = stitch * spacing
            local finish = start + spacing / (1.0 + kStitchGap) * progress
            local thread = { pointAlong(points, start), pointAlong(points, (start + finish) * 0.5), pointAlong(points, finish) }
            stroke(outline, thread, lineWidth, 1.0)
        end
    end
    local pop = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate((intro - kButtonDelay) / (1.0 - kButtonDelay))) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    if #decorationIndices > 1 and pop > kEpsilon then
        local swing = math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau) * idleAmount * 0.13
        local buttonX, buttonY = width * 0.5 - radius, height * 0.5
        local button = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y, buttonX, buttonY, pop, swing)
        circle(button, 0, 0, decorationSize * 0.35)
        local holes = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[1], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y, buttonX, buttonY, pop, swing)
        for _, horizontal in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
            for _, vertical in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                circle(holes, horizontal * decorationSize * 0.11, vertical * decorationSize * 0.11, decorationSize * 0.035)
                circle(button, horizontal * decorationSize * 0.11, vertical * decorationSize * 0.11, decorationSize * 0.035, true)
            end
        end
        local badge = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
            -width * 0.5 + radius, -height * 0.5, pop, -swing)
        heart(badge, decorationSize * 0.6)
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FRM005
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Jewel Frame
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "Sample Text\nShine Bright"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.2
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.65
-- @input number 3 "Padding (em)" default=0.75
-- @input number 4 "Line Width (em)" default=0.035
-- @input number 5 "Corner Radius (em)" default=0.42
-- @input number 6 "Decoration Size (em)" default=0.8
-- @input number 7 "Idle Speed (Hz)" default=0.25
-- @input number 8 "Idle Amount" default=0.65
-- @input color 1 "Frame Color" default={0.77,0.70,0.96,1}
-- @input color 2 "Decoration Color" default={1,0.86,0.60,1}
--[[ @description
A double-line frame grows from a corner star, adds tiny jewels, and sends glints along the border.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
角の星から細い二重線が両方向に広がり、小さな宝石を添えます。待機中は縁に沿って輝きが走り、角の星がきらめきます。

本文全体を測って枠の大きさを決めます。Padding (em)・Line Width (em)・Corner Radius (em)・Decoration Size (em) で調整できます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。枠と飾りは本文の後ろに描き、補助グリフを2つ使います。空きが1つなら枠だけ、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
]]

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kMaximumEdgeSamples = 96
local kCornerSamples = 8
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawFrame

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function segment(path, first, last, width)
    local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
    local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    if length > kEpsilon and width > kEpsilon then
        local normalX, normalY = -differenceY / length * width * 0.5, differenceX / length * width * 0.5
        path:move_to(first.x - normalX, first.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x - normalX, last.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x + normalX, last.y + normalY)
        path:line_to(first.x + normalX, first.y + normalY)
        path:close()
        circle(path, first.x, first.y, width * 0.5)
        circle(path, last.x, last.y, width * 0.5)
    end
end

local function pathLength(points)
    local result = 0.0
    for index = 2, #points do
        local differenceX, differenceY = points[index].x - points[index - 1].x, points[index].y - points[index - 1].y
        result = result + math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    end
    return result
end

local function pointAlong(points, distance)
    local remaining = math.max(distance, 0.0)
    local result = points[#points]
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining <= length and length > kEpsilon then
            local progress = remaining / length
            result = { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, progress), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, progress) }
            break
        end
        remaining = remaining - length
    end
    return result
end

local function stroke(path, points, width, progress)
    local remaining = pathLength(points) * mt.saturate(progress)
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining > kEpsilon and length > kEpsilon then
            local portion = mt.saturate(remaining / length)
            segment(path, first, { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, portion), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, portion) }, width)
        end
        remaining = math.max(remaining - length, 0.0)
    end
end

local function perimeter(width, height, radius, scallopSize, scallopHeight)
    local points = {}
    local halfWidth, halfHeight = width * 0.5, height * 0.5
    local corner = math.min(radius, halfWidth, halfHeight)
    local sides = {
        { startX = -halfWidth + corner, startY = -halfHeight, endX = halfWidth - corner, endY = -halfHeight,
          normalX = 0, normalY = -1, centerX = halfWidth - corner, centerY = -halfHeight + corner, angle = -math.pi * 0.5 },
        { startX = halfWidth, startY = -halfHeight + corner, endX = halfWidth, endY = halfHeight - corner,
          normalX = 1, normalY = 0, centerX = halfWidth - corner, centerY = halfHeight - corner, angle = 0 },
        { startX = halfWidth - corner, startY = halfHeight, endX = -halfWidth + corner, endY = halfHeight,
          normalX = 0, normalY = 1, centerX = -halfWidth + corner, centerY = halfHeight - corner, angle = math.pi * 0.5 },
        { startX = -halfWidth, startY = halfHeight - corner, endX = -halfWidth, endY = -halfHeight + corner,
          normalX = -1, normalY = 0, centerX = -halfWidth + corner, centerY = -halfHeight + corner, angle = math.pi },
    }
    for _, side in ipairs(sides) do
        local length = math.abs(side.endX - side.startX) + math.abs(side.endY - side.startY)
        local lobes = math.max(1, math.ceil(length / math.max(scallopSize, kUnitsPerEm * 0.1)))
        local samples = scallopHeight > kEpsilon and math.min(kMaximumEdgeSamples, lobes * kCornerSamples) or 1
        for sample = 0, samples do
            local progress = sample / samples
            local bump = math.sin(progress * lobes * math.pi) ^ 2 * scallopHeight
            points[#points + 1] = { x = mt.lerp(side.startX, side.endX, progress) + side.normalX * bump,
                y = mt.lerp(side.startY, side.endY, progress) + side.normalY * bump }
        end
        for sample = 1, kCornerSamples do
            local angle = side.angle + sample / kCornerSamples * math.pi * 0.5
            points[#points + 1] = { x = side.centerX + math.cos(angle) * corner,
                y = side.centerY + math.sin(angle) * corner }
        end
    end
    points[#points + 1] = points[1]
    return points
end

-- Geometry is measured before Global rotation; writing through this adapter cancels
-- Global scale/stretch while placement lets the frame follow the remaining rotation.
local function drawingAt(ctx, path, centerX, centerY, offsetX, offsetY, scale, angle)
    local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
    local unitsPerPixel = kUnitsPerEm / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.canvas.height)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle or 0.0), math.sin(angle or 0.0)
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local localX = (offsetX or 0.0) + (horizontal * cosine - vertical * sine) * (scale or 1.0)
        local localY = (offsetY or 0.0) + (horizontal * sine + vertical * cosine) * (scale or 1.0)
        local canvasX = centerX + localX / kUnitsPerEm * emSize / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
        local canvasY = centerY - localY / kUnitsPerEm * emSize
        return (canvasX - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width * unitsPerPixel / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (0.5 - canvasY) * ctx.canvas.height * unitsPerPixel / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if bodyCount > 0 and budget > 0 and ctx.global.text:match("%S") then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
        placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
        placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
        placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
        placeholder:close()
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, 2) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- A dedicated zero-bounds line excludes decoration tracking from the text's alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. "\n" .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[index]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    local centerX = (ctx.global.position_x + ctx.global.pivot_x - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local centerY = (1.5 - ctx.global.position_y - ctx.global.pivot_y) * ctx.canvas.height
    local rotation = math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)
    local differenceX, differenceY = ctx.canvas.width * 0.5 - centerX, ctx.canvas.height * 0.5 - centerY
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration,
        (centerX + math.cos(rotation) * differenceX - math.sin(rotation) * differenceY) / ctx.canvas.width,
        1.0 - (centerY + math.sin(rotation) * differenceX + math.cos(rotation) * differenceY) / ctx.canvas.height)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, { mt.drawing_path(), mt.drawing_path() }
    local markerSlots, bodyIndices = {}, {}
    local hasBodyInk = false
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then
            decorationIndices[slot] = index
        else
            bodyIndices[#bodyIndices + 1] = index
            if ctx.chars[index].part_count > 0 and mt.text.classify(ctx.chars[index].text) ~= "space" then
                hasBodyInk = true
            end
        end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(bodyIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = ctx.chars[index].opacity * visibility end
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and hasBodyInk and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, bodyIndices, "character", "before_global_rotation")
        if bounds and bounds.width > kEpsilon and bounds.height > kEpsilon then
            for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
            local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
            local padding = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.15, 3.0) * kUnitsPerEm
            local width = bounds.width * ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio / emSize * kUnitsPerEm + padding * 2.0
            local height = bounds.height / emSize * kUnitsPerEm + padding * 2.0
            local lineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.3) * kUnitsPerEm
            local radius = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) * kUnitsPerEm, width * 0.5, height * 0.5)
            local decorationSize = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 2.0) * kUnitsPerEm
            local idleSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 4.0)
            local idleAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 1.0)
            drawFrame(ctx, bounds, width, height, lineWidth, radius, decorationSize, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
            local order = {}
            for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
            local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
            ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
            ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
        end
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

local function star(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.18, size * 0.12, size * 0.12, size * 0.18, 0, size)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.12, size * 0.18, -size * 0.18, size * 0.12, -size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, 0, -size)
    path:close()
end

local kDoubleLineGap = 0.16
local kGlintCount = 3

local function diamond(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size * 0.48)
    path:line_to(size * 0.35, -size * 0.1)
    path:line_to(0, size * 0.48)
    path:line_to(-size * 0.35, -size * 0.1)
    path:close()
end

local function drawBothWays(path, points, lineWidth, reveal)
    local reverse = { points[1] }
    for index = #points - 1, 1, -1 do reverse[#reverse + 1] = points[index] end
    stroke(path, points, lineWidth, reveal * 0.5)
    stroke(path, reverse, lineWidth, reveal * 0.5)
end

drawFrame = function(ctx, bounds, width, height, lineWidth, radius, decorationSize, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
    local outline = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[1], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y)
    local reveal = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local gap = math.min(kDoubleLineGap * kUnitsPerEm, width * 0.15, height * 0.15)
    local points = perimeter(width, height, radius, kUnitsPerEm, 0)
    drawBothWays(outline, points, lineWidth, reveal)
    drawBothWays(outline, perimeter(width - gap * 2, height - gap * 2, math.max(0, radius - gap), kUnitsPerEm, 0), lineWidth, reveal)
    if #decorationIndices > 1 and decorationSize > kEpsilon then
        local phase = ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau
        local twinkle = 1.0 + math.sin(phase) * idleAmount * 0.16
        local cornerStar = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
            -width * 0.5 + radius, -height * 0.5, reveal * twinkle)
        star(cornerStar, decorationSize * 0.42)
        local jewelPop = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate((intro - 0.5) / 0.5)) * (1.0 - outro)
        for _, sign in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
            local horizontal, vertical = sign * (width * 0.5 - radius), sign * height * 0.5
            local jewel = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
                horizontal, vertical, jewelPop, math.sin(phase + sign) * idleAmount * 0.08)
            diamond(jewel, decorationSize * 0.5)
            local facets = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[1], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
                horizontal, vertical, jewelPop, math.sin(phase + sign) * idleAmount * 0.08)
            facets:move_to(0, -decorationSize * 0.20)
            facets:line_to(decorationSize * 0.11, 0)
            facets:line_to(0, decorationSize * 0.20)
            facets:line_to(-decorationSize * 0.11, 0)
            facets:close()
        end
        local travel = ctx.time * idleSpeed * idleAmount
        for index = 1, kGlintCount do
            local position = pointAlong(points, ((travel + index / kGlintCount) % 1.0) * pathLength(points))
            local pulse = 0.65 + math.sin(phase + index * 2.0) * idleAmount * 0.35
            local glint = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
                position.x, position.y, jewelPop * pulse)
            star(glint, decorationSize * 0.16)
        end
    end
end
description: A double-line frame grows from a corner star, adds tiny jewels, and sends glints along the border.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FRM006
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Sticker Frame
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "Sample Text\nSweet Little Note"
-- @recommend fill #66516B
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.85
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.95
-- @input number 3 "Padding (em)" default=0.8
-- @input number 4 "Line Width (em)" default=0.25
-- @input number 5 "Corner Radius (em)" default=0.55
-- @input number 6 "Decoration Size (em)" default=0.75
-- @input number 7 "Idle Speed (Hz)" default=0.35
-- @input number 8 "Idle Amount" default=0.5
-- @input color 1 "Frame Color" default={1,0.98,0.97,1}
-- @input color 2 "Decoration Color" default={1,0.72,0.80,1}
--[[ @description
A pastel sticker flies in at a tilt, lands with a soft squash, and peels away from its upper corner.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
厚めの白い縁と淡い色の帯を重ねたシールが、文字と一緒に少し傾いて飛び込み、ぺたっと貼り付きます。退場時は右上の角からめくれて離れます。

本文全体を測って枠の大きさを決めます。Padding (em)・Line Width (em)・Corner Radius (em)・Decoration Size (em) で調整できます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。枠と飾りは本文の後ろに描き、補助グリフを2つ使います。空きが1つなら枠だけ、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
]]

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kMaximumEdgeSamples = 96
local kCornerSamples = 8
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawFrame
local applyStickerPose

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function segment(path, first, last, width)
    local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
    local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    if length > kEpsilon and width > kEpsilon then
        local normalX, normalY = -differenceY / length * width * 0.5, differenceX / length * width * 0.5
        path:move_to(first.x - normalX, first.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x - normalX, last.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x + normalX, last.y + normalY)
        path:line_to(first.x + normalX, first.y + normalY)
        path:close()
        circle(path, first.x, first.y, width * 0.5)
        circle(path, last.x, last.y, width * 0.5)
    end
end

local function pathLength(points)
    local result = 0.0
    for index = 2, #points do
        local differenceX, differenceY = points[index].x - points[index - 1].x, points[index].y - points[index - 1].y
        result = result + math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    end
    return result
end

local function pointAlong(points, distance)
    local remaining = math.max(distance, 0.0)
    local result = points[#points]
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining <= length and length > kEpsilon then
            local progress = remaining / length
            result = { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, progress), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, progress) }
            break
        end
        remaining = remaining - length
    end
    return result
end

local function stroke(path, points, width, progress)
    local remaining = pathLength(points) * mt.saturate(progress)
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining > kEpsilon and length > kEpsilon then
            local portion = mt.saturate(remaining / length)
            segment(path, first, { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, portion), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, portion) }, width)
        end
        remaining = math.max(remaining - length, 0.0)
    end
end

local function perimeter(width, height, radius, scallopSize, scallopHeight)
    local points = {}
    local halfWidth, halfHeight = width * 0.5, height * 0.5
    local corner = math.min(radius, halfWidth, halfHeight)
    local sides = {
        { startX = -halfWidth + corner, startY = -halfHeight, endX = halfWidth - corner, endY = -halfHeight,
          normalX = 0, normalY = -1, centerX = halfWidth - corner, centerY = -halfHeight + corner, angle = -math.pi * 0.5 },
        { startX = halfWidth, startY = -halfHeight + corner, endX = halfWidth, endY = halfHeight - corner,
          normalX = 1, normalY = 0, centerX = halfWidth - corner, centerY = halfHeight - corner, angle = 0 },
        { startX = halfWidth - corner, startY = halfHeight, endX = -halfWidth + corner, endY = halfHeight,
          normalX = 0, normalY = 1, centerX = -halfWidth + corner, centerY = halfHeight - corner, angle = math.pi * 0.5 },
        { startX = -halfWidth, startY = halfHeight - corner, endX = -halfWidth, endY = -halfHeight + corner,
          normalX = -1, normalY = 0, centerX = -halfWidth + corner, centerY = -halfHeight + corner, angle = math.pi },
    }
    for _, side in ipairs(sides) do
        local length = math.abs(side.endX - side.startX) + math.abs(side.endY - side.startY)
        local lobes = math.max(1, math.ceil(length / math.max(scallopSize, kUnitsPerEm * 0.1)))
        local samples = scallopHeight > kEpsilon and math.min(kMaximumEdgeSamples, lobes * kCornerSamples) or 1
        for sample = 0, samples do
            local progress = sample / samples
            local bump = math.sin(progress * lobes * math.pi) ^ 2 * scallopHeight
            points[#points + 1] = { x = mt.lerp(side.startX, side.endX, progress) + side.normalX * bump,
                y = mt.lerp(side.startY, side.endY, progress) + side.normalY * bump }
        end
        for sample = 1, kCornerSamples do
            local angle = side.angle + sample / kCornerSamples * math.pi * 0.5
            points[#points + 1] = { x = side.centerX + math.cos(angle) * corner,
                y = side.centerY + math.sin(angle) * corner }
        end
    end
    points[#points + 1] = points[1]
    return points
end

-- Geometry is measured before Global rotation; writing through this adapter cancels
-- Global scale/stretch while placement lets the frame follow the remaining rotation.
local function drawingAt(ctx, path, centerX, centerY, offsetX, offsetY, scale, angle)
    local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
    local unitsPerPixel = kUnitsPerEm / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.canvas.height)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle or 0.0), math.sin(angle or 0.0)
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local localX = (offsetX or 0.0) + (horizontal * cosine - vertical * sine) * (scale or 1.0)
        local localY = (offsetY or 0.0) + (horizontal * sine + vertical * cosine) * (scale or 1.0)
        local canvasX = centerX + localX / kUnitsPerEm * emSize / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
        local canvasY = centerY - localY / kUnitsPerEm * emSize
        return (canvasX - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width * unitsPerPixel / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (0.5 - canvasY) * ctx.canvas.height * unitsPerPixel / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    applyStickerPose(ctx, intro, outro)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if bodyCount > 0 and budget > 0 and ctx.global.text:match("%S") then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
        placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
        placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
        placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
        placeholder:close()
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, 2) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- A dedicated zero-bounds line excludes decoration tracking from the text's alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. "\n" .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[index]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    local centerX = (ctx.global.position_x + ctx.global.pivot_x - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local centerY = (1.5 - ctx.global.position_y - ctx.global.pivot_y) * ctx.canvas.height
    local rotation = math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)
    local differenceX, differenceY = ctx.canvas.width * 0.5 - centerX, ctx.canvas.height * 0.5 - centerY
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration,
        (centerX + math.cos(rotation) * differenceX - math.sin(rotation) * differenceY) / ctx.canvas.width,
        1.0 - (centerY + math.sin(rotation) * differenceX + math.cos(rotation) * differenceY) / ctx.canvas.height)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, { mt.drawing_path(), mt.drawing_path() }
    local markerSlots, bodyIndices = {}, {}
    local hasBodyInk = false
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then
            decorationIndices[slot] = index
        else
            bodyIndices[#bodyIndices + 1] = index
            if ctx.chars[index].part_count > 0 and mt.text.classify(ctx.chars[index].text) ~= "space" then
                hasBodyInk = true
            end
        end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(bodyIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = ctx.chars[index].opacity * visibility end
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and hasBodyInk and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, bodyIndices, "character", "before_global_rotation")
        if bounds and bounds.width > kEpsilon and bounds.height > kEpsilon then
            for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
            local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
            local padding = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.15, 3.0) * kUnitsPerEm
            local width = bounds.width * ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio / emSize * kUnitsPerEm + padding * 2.0
            local height = bounds.height / emSize * kUnitsPerEm + padding * 2.0
            local lineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.3) * kUnitsPerEm
            local radius = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) * kUnitsPerEm, width * 0.5, height * 0.5)
            local decorationSize = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 2.0) * kUnitsPerEm
            local idleSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 4.0)
            local idleAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 1.0)
            drawFrame(ctx, bounds, width, height, lineWidth, radius, decorationSize, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
            local order = {}
            for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
            local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
            ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
            ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
        end
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

local function star(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.18, size * 0.12, size * 0.12, size * 0.18, 0, size)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.12, size * 0.18, -size * 0.18, size * 0.12, -size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, 0, -size)
    path:close()
end

local kBandWidth = 0.12
local kPeelStart = 0.12

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

local function clippedCorner(points, boundary)
    local clipped = {}
    for index = 1, #points - 1 do
        local first, second = points[index], points[index + 1]
        local firstDistance = first.x - first.y - boundary
        local secondDistance = second.x - second.y - boundary
        if firstDistance <= 0 then clipped[#clipped + 1] = first end
        if (firstDistance <= 0) ~= (secondDistance <= 0) then
            local progress = firstDistance / (firstDistance - secondDistance)
            clipped[#clipped + 1] = { x = mt.lerp(first.x, second.x, progress), y = mt.lerp(first.y, second.y, progress) }
        end
    end
    if #clipped > 0 then clipped[#clipped + 1] = clipped[1] end
    return clipped
end

applyStickerPose = function(ctx, intro, outro)
    local landing = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate(intro / 0.8))
    local approach = 1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate(intro / 0.8))
    local squash = math.sin(mt.saturate((intro - 0.55) / 0.45) * math.pi) * 0.06
    local lift = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((outro - 0.45) / 0.55))
    ctx.global.scale = ctx.global.scale * (0.88 + landing * 0.12) * (1.0 - lift * 0.2)
    ctx.global.stretch_x = ctx.global.stretch_x * (1.0 + squash)
    ctx.global.stretch_y = ctx.global.stretch_y * (1.0 - squash)
    ctx.global.rotation = ctx.global.rotation - approach * 14.0 + lift * 18.0
    ctx.global.position_x = ctx.global.position_x - approach * 0.12 + lift * 0.12
    ctx.global.position_y = ctx.global.position_y + approach * 0.18 + lift * 0.10
end

drawFrame = function(ctx, bounds, width, height, lineWidth, radius, decorationSize, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
    local outline = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[1], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y)
    local peel = mt.ease.in_out_sine(mt.saturate((outro - kPeelStart) / (1.0 - kPeelStart)))
    local peelSize = math.min(width, height) * peel * 0.85
    local boundary = (width + height) * 0.5 - peelSize
    local points = clippedCorner(perimeter(width, height, radius, kUnitsPerEm, 0), boundary)
    if lineWidth > kEpsilon then polygon(outline, points) end
    if #decorationIndices > 1 then
        local inset = math.min(lineWidth * 0.85, width * 0.15, height * 0.15)
        local band = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y)
        local bandPoints = clippedCorner(perimeter(width - inset * 2, height - inset * 2,
            math.max(0, radius - inset), kUnitsPerEm, 0), boundary)
        stroke(band, bandPoints, math.min(lineWidth * 0.6, kBandWidth * kUnitsPerEm), 1.0)
        local swing = math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau) * idleAmount * 0.08
        local badge = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
            -width * 0.5 + radius, -height * 0.5 + inset, 1.0, swing)
        star(badge, decorationSize * 0.30)
        local dot = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
            width * 0.5 - radius, height * 0.5 - inset)
        circle(dot, 0, 0, decorationSize * 0.12)
        if peelSize > kEpsilon then
            local fold = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y)
            local cornerX, cornerY = width * 0.5, -height * 0.5
            fold:move_to(cornerX - peelSize, cornerY)
            fold:cubic_to(cornerX - peelSize * 0.90, cornerY + peelSize * 0.45,
                cornerX - peelSize * 0.55, cornerY + peelSize * 0.90, cornerX, cornerY + peelSize)
            fold:line_to(cornerX - peelSize * 0.85, cornerY + peelSize * 0.85)
            fold:close()
        end
    end
end
description: A pastel sticker flies in at a tilt, lands with a soft squash, and peels away from its upper corner.

厚めの白い縁と淡い色の帯を重ねたシールが、文字と一緒に少し傾いて飛び込み、ぺたっと貼り付きます。退場時は右上の角からめくれて離れます。

本文全体を測って枠の大きさを決めます。Padding (em)・Line Width (em)・Corner Radius (em)・Decoration Size (em) で調整できます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。枠と飾りは本文の後ろに描き、補助グリフを2つ使います。空きが1つなら枠だけ、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
