source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id FRM007
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Candy Frame
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "Sample Text\nSweet Moments"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.1
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.7
-- @input number 3 "Padding (em)" default=0.8
-- @input number 4 "Line Width (em)" default=0.16
-- @input number 5 "Corner Radius (em)" default=0.7
-- @input number 6 "Decoration Size (em)" default=0.9
-- @input number 7 "Idle Speed (Hz)" default=0.4
-- @input number 8 "Idle Amount" default=0.65
-- @input color 1 "Frame Color" default={1,0.65,0.77,1}
-- @input color 2 "Decoration Color" default={0.61,0.87,0.83,1}
-- @input color 3 "Candy Color" default={0.95,0.38,0.49,1}
--[[ @description
A striped candy-cane border gathers bouncing sweets and dots, then gently flutters their wrappers.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
ピンクとミントの斜め模様が連なるキャンディケーン風の枠に、キャンディと小さなドットが弾んで集まります。待機中はキャンディの包みがふわっと揺れ、退場時は飾りが外へ散ります。

本文全体を測って枠の大きさを決めます。Padding (em)・Line Width (em)・Corner Radius (em)・Decoration Size (em) で調整できます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。枠と飾りは本文の後ろに描き、Candy Color でキャンディ本体の色を枠線と別に調整できます。補助グリフを3つ使います。空きが2つなら二色の枠とドット、1つなら単色の枠だけ、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
]]

local kUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kMaximumEdgeSamples = 96
local kCornerSamples = 8
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawFrame

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function segment(path, first, last, width)
    local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
    local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    if length > kEpsilon and width > kEpsilon then
        local normalX, normalY = -differenceY / length * width * 0.5, differenceX / length * width * 0.5
        path:move_to(first.x - normalX, first.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x - normalX, last.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x + normalX, last.y + normalY)
        path:line_to(first.x + normalX, first.y + normalY)
        path:close()
        circle(path, first.x, first.y, width * 0.5)
        circle(path, last.x, last.y, width * 0.5)
    end
end

local function pathLength(points)
    local result = 0.0
    for index = 2, #points do
        local differenceX, differenceY = points[index].x - points[index - 1].x, points[index].y - points[index - 1].y
        result = result + math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    end
    return result
end

local function pointAlong(points, distance)
    local remaining = math.max(distance, 0.0)
    local result = points[#points]
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining <= length and length > kEpsilon then
            local progress = remaining / length
            result = { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, progress), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, progress) }
            break
        end
        remaining = remaining - length
    end
    return result
end

local function stroke(path, points, width, progress)
    local remaining = pathLength(points) * mt.saturate(progress)
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining > kEpsilon and length > kEpsilon then
            local portion = mt.saturate(remaining / length)
            segment(path, first, { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, portion), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, portion) }, width)
        end
        remaining = math.max(remaining - length, 0.0)
    end
end

local function perimeter(width, height, radius, scallopSize, scallopHeight)
    local points = {}
    local halfWidth, halfHeight = width * 0.5, height * 0.5
    local corner = math.min(radius, halfWidth, halfHeight)
    local sides = {
        { startX = -halfWidth + corner, startY = -halfHeight, endX = halfWidth - corner, endY = -halfHeight,
          normalX = 0, normalY = -1, centerX = halfWidth - corner, centerY = -halfHeight + corner, angle = -math.pi * 0.5 },
        { startX = halfWidth, startY = -halfHeight + corner, endX = halfWidth, endY = halfHeight - corner,
          normalX = 1, normalY = 0, centerX = halfWidth - corner, centerY = halfHeight - corner, angle = 0 },
        { startX = halfWidth - corner, startY = halfHeight, endX = -halfWidth + corner, endY = halfHeight,
          normalX = 0, normalY = 1, centerX = -halfWidth + corner, centerY = halfHeight - corner, angle = math.pi * 0.5 },
        { startX = -halfWidth, startY = halfHeight - corner, endX = -halfWidth, endY = -halfHeight + corner,
          normalX = -1, normalY = 0, centerX = -halfWidth + corner, centerY = -halfHeight + corner, angle = math.pi },
    }
    for _, side in ipairs(sides) do
        local length = math.abs(side.endX - side.startX) + math.abs(side.endY - side.startY)
        local lobes = math.max(1, math.ceil(length / math.max(scallopSize, kUnitsPerEm * 0.1)))
        local samples = scallopHeight > kEpsilon and math.min(kMaximumEdgeSamples, lobes * kCornerSamples) or 1
        for sample = 0, samples do
            local progress = sample / samples
            local bump = math.sin(progress * lobes * math.pi) ^ 2 * scallopHeight
            points[#points + 1] = { x = mt.lerp(side.startX, side.endX, progress) + side.normalX * bump,
                y = mt.lerp(side.startY, side.endY, progress) + side.normalY * bump }
        end
        for sample = 1, kCornerSamples do
            local angle = side.angle + sample / kCornerSamples * math.pi * 0.5
            points[#points + 1] = { x = side.centerX + math.cos(angle) * corner,
                y = side.centerY + math.sin(angle) * corner }
        end
    end
    points[#points + 1] = points[1]
    return points
end

-- Geometry is measured before Global rotation; writing through this adapter cancels
-- Global scale/stretch while placement lets the frame follow the remaining rotation.
local function drawingAt(ctx, path, centerX, centerY, offsetX, offsetY, scale, angle)
    local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
    local unitsPerPixel = kUnitsPerEm / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.canvas.height)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle or 0.0), math.sin(angle or 0.0)
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local localX = (offsetX or 0.0) + (horizontal * cosine - vertical * sine) * (scale or 1.0)
        local localY = (offsetY or 0.0) + (horizontal * sine + vertical * cosine) * (scale or 1.0)
        local canvasX = centerX + localX / kUnitsPerEm * emSize / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
        local canvasY = centerY - localY / kUnitsPerEm * emSize
        return (canvasX - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width * unitsPerPixel / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (0.5 - canvasY) * ctx.canvas.height * unitsPerPixel / (ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if bodyCount > 0 and budget > 0 and ctx.global.text:match("%S") then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        placeholder:move_to(-500, -500)
        placeholder:line_to(500, -500)
        placeholder:line_to(500, 500)
        placeholder:line_to(-500, 500)
        placeholder:close()
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, 3) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- A dedicated zero-bounds line excludes decoration tracking from the text's alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. "\n" .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[index]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    local centerX = (ctx.global.position_x + ctx.global.pivot_x - 0.5) * ctx.canvas.width
    local centerY = (1.5 - ctx.global.position_y - ctx.global.pivot_y) * ctx.canvas.height
    local rotation = math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)
    local differenceX, differenceY = ctx.canvas.width * 0.5 - centerX, ctx.canvas.height * 0.5 - centerY
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration,
        (centerX + math.cos(rotation) * differenceX - math.sin(rotation) * differenceY) / ctx.canvas.width,
        1.0 - (centerY + math.sin(rotation) * differenceX + math.cos(rotation) * differenceY) / ctx.canvas.height)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, { mt.drawing_path(), mt.drawing_path(), mt.drawing_path() }
    local markerSlots, bodyIndices = {}, {}
    local hasBodyInk = false
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then
            decorationIndices[slot] = index
        else
            bodyIndices[#bodyIndices + 1] = index
            if ctx.chars[index].part_count > 0 and mt.text.classify(ctx.chars[index].text) ~= "space" then
                hasBodyInk = true
            end
        end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(bodyIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = ctx.chars[index].opacity * visibility end
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and hasBodyInk and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, bodyIndices, "character", "before_global_rotation")
        if bounds and bounds.width > kEpsilon and bounds.height > kEpsilon then
            for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
            local emSize = ctx.font.em_size * math.abs(ctx.global.scale)
            local padding = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.15, 3.0) * kUnitsPerEm
            local width = bounds.width * ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio / emSize * kUnitsPerEm + padding * 2.0
            local height = bounds.height / emSize * kUnitsPerEm + padding * 2.0
            local lineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.3) * kUnitsPerEm
            local radius = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) * kUnitsPerEm, width * 0.5, height * 0.5)
            local decorationSize = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 2.0) * kUnitsPerEm
            local idleSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 4.0)
            local idleAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 1.0)
            drawFrame(ctx, bounds, width, height, lineWidth, radius, decorationSize, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
            local order = {}
            for _, slot in ipairs({ 1, 3, 2 }) do
                local index = decorationIndices[slot]
                if index then order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
            end
            local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
            ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
            ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
        end
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

local kDotCount = 12
local kStripeSpacing = 0.38
local kMaximumStripes = 160

local function sweet(path, size)
    path:move_to(-size * 0.20, -size * 0.24)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.36, -size * 0.35, size * 0.36, size * 0.35, -size * 0.20, size * 0.24)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.42, size * 0.16, -size * 0.42, -size * 0.16, -size * 0.20, -size * 0.24)
    path:close()
end

local function wrapper(path, size, sign, flutter)
    local points = { { x = sign * size * 0.28, y = 0 },
        { x = sign * size * 0.61, y = -size * (0.27 + flutter) },
        { x = sign * size * 0.55, y = 0 },
        { x = sign * size * 0.61, y = size * (0.27 - flutter) } }
    local first, last, step = 1, #points, 1
    if sign < 0 then first, last, step = #points, 1, -1 end
    path:move_to(points[first].x, points[first].y)
    for index = first + step, last, step do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
    path:close()
end

drawFrame = function(ctx, bounds, width, height, lineWidth, radius, decorationSize, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
    local outline = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[1], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y)
    local points = perimeter(width, height, radius, kUnitsPerEm, 0)
    local reveal = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    stroke(outline, points, lineWidth, reveal)
    if #decorationIndices > 1 and lineWidth > kEpsilon then
        local length = pathLength(points)
        local count = math.min(kMaximumStripes, math.max(1, math.ceil(length / (kStripeSpacing * kUnitsPerEm))))
        local spacing = length / count
        local stripeWidth = spacing * 0.42
        local stripes = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y)
        for stripe = 0, count - 1 do
            local centerDistance = (stripe + 0.5) * spacing
            if centerDistance + stripeWidth * 0.5 + lineWidth * 0.25 <= length * reveal then
                local corners = {}
                for _, corner in ipairs({ { -1, -1 }, { 1, -1 }, { 1, 1 }, { -1, 1 } }) do
                    local distance = centerDistance + corner[1] * stripeWidth * 0.5 + corner[2] * lineWidth * 0.25
                    local point = pointAlong(points, distance)
                    local before = pointAlong(points, math.max(0, distance - lineWidth * 0.05))
                    local after = pointAlong(points, math.min(length, distance + lineWidth * 0.05))
                    local tangentX, tangentY = after.x - before.x, after.y - before.y
                    local tangentLength = math.max(kEpsilon, math.sqrt(tangentX ^ 2 + tangentY ^ 2))
                    corners[#corners + 1] = { x = point.x - tangentY / tangentLength * corner[2] * lineWidth * 0.5,
                        y = point.y + tangentX / tangentLength * corner[2] * lineWidth * 0.5 }
                end
                stripes:move_to(corners[1].x, corners[1].y)
                for index = 2, #corners do stripes:line_to(corners[index].x, corners[index].y) end
                stripes:close()
            end
        end
    end
    if #decorationIndices > 1 and decorationSize > kEpsilon then
        if #decorationIndices > 2 then
            for slot, sign in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                local delay = 0.12 + slot * 0.08
                local arrival = mt.saturate((intro - delay) / (1.0 - delay))
                local pop = mt.ease.out_elastic(arrival) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
                local drift = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(arrival) + mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)) * decorationSize
                local horizontal = sign * (width * 0.5 - radius + drift)
                local vertical = -sign * (height * 0.5 + drift * 0.6)
                local angle = sign * 0.22 + math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau + slot) * idleAmount * 0.06
                local candy = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[3], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
                    horizontal, vertical, pop, angle)
                sweet(candy, decorationSize)
                local wrapping = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
                    horizontal, vertical, pop, angle)
                local flutter = math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau + slot) * idleAmount * 0.10
                wrapper(wrapping, decorationSize, -1, flutter)
                wrapper(wrapping, decorationSize, 1, -flutter)
                -- Wound the same way as the border stripes it can overlap, so the nonzero fill keeps both.
                wrapping:move_to(-decorationSize * 0.12, -decorationSize * 0.23)
                wrapping:line_to(0, -decorationSize * 0.25)
                wrapping:cubic_to(decorationSize * 0.14, -decorationSize * 0.10,
                    decorationSize * 0.08, decorationSize * 0.05, decorationSize * 0.23, decorationSize * 0.18)
                wrapping:line_to(decorationSize * 0.12, decorationSize * 0.23)
                wrapping:cubic_to(-decorationSize * 0.03, decorationSize * 0.10,
                    decorationSize * 0.03, -decorationSize * 0.10, -decorationSize * 0.12, -decorationSize * 0.23)
                wrapping:close()
            end
        end
        for index = 1, kDotCount do
            local progress = index / kDotCount
            local point = pointAlong(points, progress * pathLength(points))
            local delay = 0.12 + progress * 0.32
            local pop = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / (1.0 - delay))) * (1.0 - outro)
            local pulse = 1.0 + math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau + index) * idleAmount * 0.08
            local dot = drawingAt(ctx, decorationPaths[2], bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y,
                point.x, point.y, pop * pulse)
            circle(dot, 0, 0, decorationSize * (index % 2 == 0 and 0.06 or 0.04))
        end
    end
end
description: A striped candy-cane border gathers bouncing sweets and dots, then gently flutters their wrappers.

descriptions.ja:
ピンクとミントの斜め模様が連なるキャンディケーン風の枠に、キャンディと小さなドットが弾んで集まります。待機中はキャンディの包みがふわっと揺れ、退場時は飾りが外へ散ります。

本文全体を測って枠の大きさを決めます。Padding (em)・Line Width (em)・Corner Radius (em)・Decoration Size (em) で調整できます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。枠と飾りは本文の後ろに描き、Candy Color でキャンディ本体の色を枠線と別に調整できます。補助グリフを3つ使います。空きが2つなら二色の枠とドット、1つなら単色の枠だけ、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。

name: IMP001_slam_reveal.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id IMP001
-- @duration 5
-- @title Slam Reveal
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "Feeling [GREAT] today\nNothing can [STOP] me"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input boolean 3 "Group Words" default=false
-- @input boolean 4 "In Reading Order" default=false
-- @input boolean 5 "Overshoot" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=2.4
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 4 "Overlap" default=0.0
-- @input number 5 "Start Size (%)" default=300
-- @input number 6 "Final Size (%)" default=115
-- @input number 7 "Impact" default=1.0
-- @input number 8 "Marker (1=[] 2=【】 3=「」 4=*)" default=1
-- @input number 10 "Enlarged Time (s)" default=0.35
--[[ @description
Unmarked characters fade in one by one, then each marked character appears large in its place and shrinks into a snap, or all appear in reading order.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
囲んでいない文字が先に順番にフェードインし（囲んだ文字の場所は空けておきます）、そのあと、囲んだ文字が1文字ずつ、自分の位置に大きく現れて、縮みながらバシッとはまります。

例えば「今日は[最高]の日」と書くと、「最高」の2文字が、順に大きく現れて配置されます。囲み記号そのものは表示しません。囲みが1つも無いときは、すべての文字が順に配置されます。囲んでいない文字のフェードインには、Intro Duration (s) から囲んだ文字の合計時間を引いた残りを使います。Overlap は、囲んだ文字どうしの時間の重なりで、0なら1文字ずつ、大きいほど次の文字が早く出ます。Start Size (%) は現れるときの大きさ、Final Size (%) は配置後の大きさ（100で他の文字と同じ）、Impact ではまる瞬間の大きさの跳ねと画面の揺れの強さを指定します。Marker (1=[] 2=【】 3=「」 4=*) で囲み記号を選びます（*は同じ記号で開閉します）。Enlarged Time (s) は、囲んだ文字1つが現れてからはまるまでの時間です。文字数を掛けた合計がIntro Duration (s) の8割を超えるときは、8割に収まるよう縮めます。Overshoot がオンなら、現れてすぐ縮み、元の大きさより小さくなってから戻ります。オフなら、大きいまま少し留まってから加速して、最高速でぶつかります。Group Words がオンなら、囲み1つ（囲みが無いときは単語）をひとまとまりにして、同時に現します。オフなら1文字ずつです。In Reading Order がオフなら、囲んでいない文字が先に出てから、囲んだ文字が配置されます。オンなら、囲んだ文字も、本文の並びどおりの表示のタイミングで、大きく現れて配置されます（Overlap は使いません）。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kMaximumOverlap = 0.8
local kMinimumBaseSpan = 0.1
local kMaximumImpact = 3.0
local kMinimumSize = 0.5
local kMaximumSize = 6.0
local kPercent = 0.01
local kBaseStagger = 0.8
-- In reading order an unmarked character takes one step of the timeline and fades over a few steps; a flying one takes
-- its whole turn, so consecutive flying characters never share the center.
local kFadeSteps = 3.0
local kMaximumTurnShare = 0.8
local kMaximumTurnSeconds = 10.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
-- Shares of one marked character's time slot: it fades in at the center, stays there, flies, then the hit rings out.
local kAppearShare = 0.12
local kHoldShare = 0.4
local kFlightShare = 0.7
local kOvershootEndShare = 0.6
local kPunchScale = 0.25
local kPunchDecayPower = 3
local kShakeDistance = 0.016
local kShakeCycles = 3.5
local kShakeDecayPower = 3
local kShakeCrowd = 0.35
local kAlignmentAnchors = { left = 0.0, top = 0.0, baseline = 0.0, center = 0.5, right = 1.0, bottom = 1.0 }
local kMarkers = { { "[", "]" }, { "【", "】" }, { "「", "」" }, { "*", "*" } }

-- The number of the wrapping each visible code point of the rewritten text sits in (nil outside any), in reading order.
local markedGroups = {}

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
    return introProgress, outroProgress, introDuration
end

local function isLineBreak(symbol)
    return symbol == "\n" or symbol == "\r"
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local marker = kMarkers[math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 1, #kMarkers) + 0.5)]
    local kept, position, inside, group = {}, 0, false, 0
    markedGroups = {}
    for _, codepoint in utf8.codes(ctx.global.text) do
        local symbol = utf8.char(codepoint)
        if marker[1] == marker[2] and symbol == marker[1] then
            inside = not inside
            if inside then group = group + 1 end
        elseif symbol == marker[1] then
            inside = true
            group = group + 1
        elseif symbol == marker[2] then
            inside = false
        else
            kept[#kept + 1] = symbol
            if not isLineBreak(symbol) then
                position = position + 1
                markedGroups[position] = inside and group or nil
            end
        end
    end
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(kept)
end

-- Splits the characters into the ones that fly in (the wrapped ones, or every visible one when nothing is wrapped) and
-- the ones that fade in place. The flying ones come as turns, in reading order: one character each, or one wrapping
-- (one word when nothing is wrapped) each when grouped.
local function sortCharacters(ctx, byGroup)
    local wrapped, visible = {}, {}
    local position, word, insideWord = 0, 0, false
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local length = isLineBreak(character.text:sub(1, 1)) and 0 or (utf8.len(character.text) or 1)
        if mt.text.classify(character.text) ~= "space" and length > 0 then
            if not insideWord then word = word + 1 end
            insideWord = true
            visible[#visible + 1] = { index = index, group = word }
            if markedGroups[position + 1] then wrapped[#wrapped + 1] = { index = index, group = markedGroups[position + 1] } end
        else
            insideWord = false
        end
        position = position + length
    end
    local turns, isFlying, previousGroup = {}, {}, nil
    for _, entry in ipairs(#wrapped > 0 and wrapped or visible) do
        isFlying[entry.index] = true
        if byGroup and entry.group == previousGroup then
            table.insert(turns[#turns], entry.index)
        else
            turns[#turns + 1] = { entry.index }
        end
        previousGroup = entry.group
    end
    local rest = {}
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        if not isFlying[index] then rest[#rest + 1] = index end
    end
    return turns, rest, isFlying, #wrapped > 0
end

-- Lays the text out with the enlarged characters at their final size, so the line opens up around them using the real
-- advances. Reflow keeps each line's first character fixed, so the line is then shifted back by the share its alignment
-- keeps fixed: the start for left/top, the middle for center, the end for right/bottom.
local function makeRoomForEnlarged(ctx, isFlying, finalScale)
    local anchor = kAlignmentAnchors[ctx.global.vertical and ctx.global.v_align or ctx.global.h_align] or kAlignmentAnchors.center
    local lines = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    local endsBefore, ownScales = {}, {}
    for order, line in ipairs(lines) do
        endsBefore[order] = { mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, line.items[#line.items]) }
    end
    for index in pairs(isFlying) do
        ownScales[index] = ctx.chars[index].scale
        ctx.chars[index].scale = ownScales[index] * finalScale
    end
    mt.layout.reflow(ctx)
    for index, scale in pairs(ownScales) do ctx.chars[index].scale = scale end
    for order, line in ipairs(lines) do
        local endX, endY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, line.items[#line.items])
        local moveX, moveY = (endsBefore[order][1] - endX) * anchor, (endsBefore[order][2] - endY) * anchor
        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            local currentX, currentY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, currentX + moveX, currentY + moveY)
        end
    end
end

-- One flying character: where it is in its own time slot decides everything it does.
local function flyIn(character, slot, look)
    local appear = mt.saturate(slot / kAppearShare)
    -- Overshoot shrinks right after appearing and swings past its final size; Hit stays big a while, then accelerates.
    local shrinkStart = look.overshoot and kAppearShare or kHoldShare
    local shrinkEnd = look.overshoot and kOvershootEndShare or kFlightShare
    local travel = mt.saturate((slot - shrinkStart) / (shrinkEnd - shrinkStart))
    local shrink = look.overshoot and mt.ease.out_back(travel) or mt.ease.in_quad(travel)
    local ring = mt.saturate((slot - shrinkEnd) / (1.0 - shrinkEnd))
    local scale = mt.lerp(look.startScale, look.finalScale, shrink)
    local jolt = 0.0
    if travel >= 1.0 then
        -- The shrink ends at full speed and the size starts above the final one, so it reads as a hit that locks in.
        scale = scale * (1.0 + kPunchScale * look.impact * (1.0 - ring) ^ kPunchDecayPower)
        jolt = look.impact * (1.0 - ring) ^ kShakeDecayPower * math.cos(2.0 * math.pi * kShakeCycles * ring)
    end
    character.scale = character.scale * scale
    character.opacity = character.opacity * appear
    return jolt, scale
end

-- Characters of one turn grow together, so their spacing follows their size around the middle of the turn; otherwise
-- big neighbours would pile up on each other. Positions at rest are the reflowed ones, where the size is the final one.
local function spreadTurn(ctx, turn, scale, finalScale)
    if #turn > 1 then
        local sumX, sumY, positions = 0.0, 0.0, {}
        for order, index in ipairs(turn) do
            local x, y = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, ctx.chars[index])
            positions[order] = { x, y }
            sumX, sumY = sumX + x, sumY + y
        end
        local middleX, middleY = sumX / #turn, sumY / #turn
        local ratio = scale / finalScale
        for order, index in ipairs(turn) do
            local x, y = positions[order][1], positions[order][2]
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, ctx.chars[index], middleX + (x - middleX) * ratio, middleY + (y - middleY) * ratio)
        end
    end
end

-- The unmarked characters fade in first, then the flying turns follow one after another. Returns the jolt of the hits.
local function enlargedLast(ctx, introProgress, introSeconds, turns, rest, anyWrapped, look)
    local overlap = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, kMaximumOverlap)
    -- The turns take Enlarged Time each, shortened so they leave the fade-in its share of the intro. The fade-in gets
    -- whatever the turns do not use; with nothing wrapped there is no fade-in, so the turns may use all of it.
    local turnCount = 1.0 + (#turns - 1) * (1.0 - overlap)
    local turnShare = anyWrapped and kMaximumTurnShare or 1.0
    local flightSeconds = math.min(look.turnSeconds * turnCount, introSeconds * turnShare)
    local flightShare = introSeconds > kEpsilon and flightSeconds / introSeconds or 1.0
    local delay = anyWrapped and 1.0 - flightShare or 0.0
    local fadeProgress = mt.saturate(introProgress / math.max(delay, kMinimumBaseSpan))
    local flightProgress = introProgress - delay
    local slotLength = flightShare / turnCount
    local jolt = 0.0
    for order, turn in ipairs(turns) do
        local start = (order - 1) * slotLength * (1.0 - overlap)
        local slot = mt.saturate((flightProgress - start) / slotLength)
        local turnScale = look.finalScale
        for _, index in ipairs(turn) do
            -- Every character of a turn hits at once, which is one hit.
            local hit, scale = flyIn(ctx.chars[index], slot, look)
            jolt, turnScale = jolt + hit / #turn, scale
            ctx.chars[index].opacity = ctx.chars[index].opacity * look.fadeOut
        end
        spreadTurn(ctx, turn, turnScale, look.finalScale)
    end
    for order, index in ipairs(rest) do
        local appear = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.stagger_progress(fadeProgress, mt.distribute(order, #rest), kBaseStagger))
        ctx.chars[index].opacity = ctx.chars[index].opacity * appear * look.fadeOut
    end
    return jolt
end

-- In reading order: every character takes its turn in reading order, the flying ones with their whole flight inside the turn.
local function inReadingOrder(ctx, introProgress, introSeconds, turns, isFlying, look)
    local turnOf, flyingCharacters = {}, 0
    for order, turn in ipairs(turns) do
        for _, index in ipairs(turn) do
            turnOf[index] = order
            flyingCharacters = flyingCharacters + 1
        end
    end
    -- The flying turns take their Enlarged Time (shortened to leave room for the rest) and the unmarked characters share
    -- what is left of the intro, each fading over a few steps.
    local turnSeconds = #turns > 0 and math.min(look.turnSeconds, introSeconds * kMaximumTurnShare / #turns) or 0.0
    local steps = (ctx.char_count - flyingCharacters) + kFadeSteps - 1.0
    local stepSeconds = math.max(introSeconds - #turns * turnSeconds, 0.0) / math.max(steps, 1.0)
    local starts, lengths, turnStarts, cursor = {}, {}, {}, 0.0
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        if isFlying[index] then
            if not turnStarts[turnOf[index]] then
                turnStarts[turnOf[index]] = cursor
                cursor = cursor + turnSeconds
            end
            starts[index], lengths[index] = turnStarts[turnOf[index]], turnSeconds
        else
            starts[index], lengths[index] = cursor, kFadeSteps * stepSeconds
            cursor = cursor + stepSeconds
        end
    end
    local time = introSeconds > kEpsilon and introProgress * introSeconds or math.huge
    local jolt, turnScales = 0.0, {}
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = lengths[index] > kEpsilon and mt.saturate((time - starts[index]) / lengths[index]) or 1.0
        local character = ctx.chars[index]
        if isFlying[index] then
            local hit, scale = flyIn(character, slot, look)
            jolt = jolt + hit / #turns[turnOf[index]]
            turnScales[turnOf[index]] = scale
            character.opacity = character.opacity * look.fadeOut
        else
            character.opacity = character.opacity * mt.ease.out_cubic(slot) * look.fadeOut
        end
    end
    for order, turn in ipairs(turns) do spreadTurn(ctx, turn, turnScales[order] or look.finalScale, look.finalScale) end
    return jolt
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress, introSeconds = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local look = {
        startScale = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5] * kPercent, kMinimumSize, kMaximumSize),
        finalScale = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6] * kPercent, kMinimumSize, kMaximumSize),
        impact = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, kMaximumImpact),
        fadeOut = 1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress),
        turnSeconds = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, kMaximumTurnSeconds),
        overshoot = ctx.inputs.booleans[5],
    }

    local turns, rest, isFlying, anyWrapped = sortCharacters(ctx, ctx.inputs.booleans[3])
    makeRoomForEnlarged(ctx, isFlying, look.finalScale)

    local jolt
    if ctx.inputs.booleans[4] then
        jolt = inReadingOrder(ctx, introProgress, introSeconds, turns, isFlying, look)
    else
        jolt = enlargedLast(ctx, introProgress, introSeconds, turns, rest, anyWrapped, look)
    end

    -- Every character takes the jolt, so the whole line feels the hit, and a crowd landing together is not louder.
    local shake = mt.clamp(jolt / math.max(1.0, #turns * kShakeCrowd), -1.0, 1.0)
    if shake ~= 0.0 then
        for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
            local currentX, currentY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, currentX, currentY - shake * kShakeDistance)
        end
    end
end
description: Unmarked characters fade in one by one, then each marked character appears large in its place and shrinks into a snap, or all appear in reading order.

descriptions.ja:
囲んでいない文字が先に順番にフェードインし（囲んだ文字の場所は空けておきます）、そのあと、囲んだ文字が1文字ずつ、自分の位置に大きく現れて、縮みながらバシッとはまります。

例えば「今日は[最高]の日」と書くと、「最高」の2文字が、順に大きく現れて配置されます。囲み記号そのものは表示しません。囲みが1つも無いときは、すべての文字が順に配置されます。囲んでいない文字のフェードインには、Intro Duration (s) から囲んだ文字の合計時間を引いた残りを使います。Overlap は、囲んだ文字どうしの時間の重なりで、0なら1文字ずつ、大きいほど次の文字が早く出ます。Start Size (%) は現れるときの大きさ、Final Size (%) は配置後の大きさ（100で他の文字と同じ）、Impact ではまる瞬間の大きさの跳ねと画面の揺れの強さを指定します。Marker (1=[] 2=【】 3=「」 4=*) で囲み記号を選びます（*は同じ記号で開閉します）。Enlarged Time (s) は、囲んだ文字1つが現れてからはまるまでの時間です。文字数を掛けた合計がIntro Duration (s) の8割を超えるときは、8割に収まるよう縮めます。Overshoot がオンなら、現れてすぐ縮み、元の大きさより小さくなってから戻ります。オフなら、大きいまま少し留まってから加速して、最高速でぶつかります。Group Words がオンなら、囲み1つ（囲みが無いときは単語）をひとまとまりにして、同時に現します。オフなら1文字ずつです。In Reading Order がオフなら、囲んでいない文字が先に出てから、囲んだ文字が配置されます。オンなら、囲んだ文字も、本文の並びどおりの表示のタイミングで、大きく現れて配置されます（Overlap は使いません）。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id IMP002
-- @duration 5

-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
-- @input number 7 "Shake Frequency (Hz)" default=14
--[[ @description
A short shake follows the entrance, then the text stays still.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
登場直後だけ短く揺れ、読みやすい位置で静止します。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, info.progress)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        local envelope = math.sin(math.pi * intro) * (1.0 - intro) + math.sin(math.pi * outro) * outro
        local phase = ctx.time * mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 1.0, 40.0) * math.pi * 2.0
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + math.sin(phase) * 0.012 * envelope * amount
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + math.cos(phase * 1.7) * 0.008 * envelope * amount
    end
end

--[[ @description
Repeated text forms a tile pattern with a gentle traveling wave.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字をタイル状に反復し、柔らかな波を伝えます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local rows = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 1.0, 10.0) + 0.5)
    local columns = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 1.0, 10.0) + 0.5)
    local count = utf8.len(ctx.global.text) or 0
    local maximum = ctx.meta.limits.max_characters
    local block = {}
    local total = 0
    for row = 1, rows do
        local line = {}
        for column = 1, columns do
            if total + count + 1 <= maximum then
                line[#line + 1] = ctx.global.text
                total = total + count + 1
            end
        end
        if #line > 0 then block[#block + 1] = table.concat(line, " ") end
    end
    if #block > 0 then ctx.global.text = table.concat(block, "\n") end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, info.progress)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        local idle = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and amount * entrance * (1.0 - exit) or 0.0
        local phase = ctx.time * mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0) * math.pi * 2.0 - info.progress * math.pi * 2.0
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + math.sin(phase) * 0.02 * idle
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id KRK001
-- @duration 6
-- @title Karaoke Color
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "Sing with me"
-- @recommend lang en
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 7 "Cue Fade (s)" default=0.15
-- @input text 1 "Lyric Cues (start,end,first,last)" default="0.5,1.8,1,4;2.2,3.5,6,9;3.8,5.2,11,12"
-- @input color 1 "Accent Color" default={1.0, 0.7, 0.25, 1.0}
-- @input color 2 "Inactive Color" default={0.55, 0.55, 0.55, 1.0}
-- @input color 3 "Completed Color" default={0.9, 0.9, 0.9, 1.0}
--[[ @description
Cue times distinguish upcoming, sung, and completed words by color.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
歌唱前・歌唱中・歌唱済みの単語を時刻に合わせて色分けします。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function parseCues(ctx)
    local cues = {}
    local sheet = ctx.inputs.texts[1]
    local valid = true
    for row in sheet:gmatch("[^;\r\n]+") do
        if row:match("%S") then
            local startText, endText, firstText, lastText =
                row:match("^%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+)%s*$")
            local startTime, endTime = tonumber(startText), tonumber(endText)
            local firstCharacter, lastCharacter = tonumber(firstText), tonumber(lastText)

                valid = false
            end
        end
    end

        if first.end_time ~= second.end_time then return first.end_time < second.end_time end
        if first.first_character ~= second.first_character then return first.first_character < second.first_character end
        return first.last_character < second.last_character

    return cues
end

local function cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)

    duration = math.min(duration, (cue.end_time - cue.start_time) * 0.5)

        envelope = 1.0

local rectangle = mt.drawing_path()
rectangle:move_to(-500, -500)
rectangle:line_to(500, -500)
rectangle:line_to(500, 500)
rectangle:line_to(-500, 500)
rectangle:close()
local marker = ""

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    marker = ""
    local count = utf8.len(ctx.global.text) or 0
    if count > 0 and count < ctx.meta.limits.max_characters then
        marker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = rectangle,
            advance_x = -ctx.global.tracking * 1000,
            advance_y = ctx.global.tracking * 1000,
            bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. marker
    end
end

    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    local count = ctx.char_count
    local hasMarker = count > 0 and marker ~= "" and ctx.chars[count].text == marker
    local bodyCount = hasMarker and count - 1 or count
    local cues = parseCues(ctx)
    local valid = true

    if not valid then cues = {} end

    if hasMarker then
        local band = ctx.chars[count]
        band.opacity = 0.0
        local selected = nil
        local active = 0.0
        for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            local envelope = cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
            if envelope > active then selected = cue active = envelope end
        end
        if selected then
            local targets = {}
            for index = selected.first_character, selected.last_character do targets[#targets + 1] = index end
            local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, targets)
            local bandBounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, { count })
            local width = bandBounds and bandBounds.width or 0.0
            local height = bandBounds and bandBounds.height or 0.0
            if bounds and width > 0.0 and height > 0.0 then
                local padding = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 2.0) * ctx.font.em_size
                band.stretch_x = band.stretch_x * (bounds.width + padding * 2.0 / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio) / width
                band.stretch_y = band.stretch_y * (bounds.height + padding * 2.0) / height
                mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, band, bounds.center_x, bounds.center_y)
                band.fill.use = true
                band.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
                band.opacity = ctx.chars[selected.first_character].opacity * active
                    * math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0), 1.0)
            end
        end
        local order = { count }
        for index = 1, bodyCount do order[#order + 1] = index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_text
        if ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and originalOrder:match("%S") then
            ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text({ count }) .. " " .. originalOrder
        else
            ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order)
        end
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id LBL001
-- @duration 5
-- @title Count Up
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
-- @input number 7 "Start Value" default=0
-- @input number 8 "End Value" default=100
-- @input number 9 "Decimal Places" default=0
-- @input number 10 "Count Duration (s)" default=2
-- @input text 1 "Prefix" default=""
-- @input text 2 "Suffix" default="%"
--[[ @description
Numbers count between chosen values with optional decimals, prefix, and suffix.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
数値が指定値へ増減します。小数・接頭辞・接尾辞も指定できます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local duration = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 60.0)
    local progress = duration > 0.0 and mt.saturate(ctx.time / duration) or 1.0
    local first = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], -1e9, 1e9)
    local last = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], -1e9, 1e9)
    local places = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 6.0) + 0.5)
    local value = mt.lerp(first, last, mt.ease.out_cubic(progress))
    ctx.global.text = ctx.inputs.texts[1] .. string.format("%." .. places .. "f", value) .. ctx.inputs.texts[2]
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, info.progress)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)

    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id LYR001
-- @duration 6
-- @title Word Stack
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "Sing\nwith\nme"
-- @recommend lang en
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 7 "Cue Fade (s)" default=0.15
-- @input text 1 "Lyric Cues (start,end,first,last)" default="0.5,1.8,1,4;2.2,3.5,5,8;3.8,5.2,9,10"
--[[ @description
Words accumulate in a stack and disappear together after the final cue.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
単語が積み重なり、最後の歌唱区間の後にまとめて消えます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function parseCues(ctx)
    local cues = {}
    local sheet = ctx.inputs.texts[1]
    local valid = true
    for row in sheet:gmatch("[^;\r\n]+") do
        if row:match("%S") then
            local startText, endText, firstText, lastText =
                row:match("^%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+)%s*$")
            local startTime, endTime = tonumber(startText), tonumber(endText)
            local firstCharacter, lastCharacter = tonumber(firstText), tonumber(lastText)
            if startTime and endTime and firstCharacter and lastCharacter
                and startTime >= 0.0 and endTime > startTime and endTime < math.huge
                and firstCharacter >= 1 and lastCharacter >= firstCharacter
                and lastCharacter <= ctx.char_count
                and firstCharacter % 1 == 0 and lastCharacter % 1 == 0 then
                cues[#cues + 1] = {
                    start_time = startTime, end_time = endTime,
                    first_character = firstCharacter, last_character = lastCharacter,
                }
            else
                valid = false
            end
        end
    end
    if not valid then cues = {} end
    table.sort(cues, function(first, second)
        if first.start_time ~= second.start_time then return first.start_time < second.start_time end
        if first.end_time ~= second.end_time then return first.end_time < second.end_time end
        if first.first_character ~= second.first_character then return first.first_character < second.first_character end
        return first.last_character < second.last_character
    end)
    return cues
end

local function cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
    local duration = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0)
    duration = math.min(duration, (cue.end_time - cue.start_time) * 0.5)
    local envelope = 0.0
    if ctx.time >= cue.start_time and ctx.time < cue.end_time then
        envelope = 1.0
        if duration > 0.0 then
            envelope = mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, ctx.time - cue.start_time)
                * mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, cue.end_time - ctx.time)
        end
    end
    return envelope
end

local function tint(character, ctx, accent, strength)
    local base = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
    character.fill.use = true
    character.fill.color = { r = mt.lerp(base.r, accent.r, strength),
        g = mt.lerp(base.g, accent.g, strength), b = mt.lerp(base.b, accent.b, strength), a = base.a }
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text:gsub("[ \t]+", "\n")
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress))
    local cues = parseCues(ctx)
    local finalTime = 0.0
    for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do finalTime = math.max(finalTime, cue.end_time) end
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local active = 0.0
        local selected = nil
        local completed = false
        for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            if index >= cue.first_character and index <= cue.last_character then
                local envelope = cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
                if envelope > active then active = envelope selected = cue end
                if ctx.time >= cue.end_time then completed = true end
            end
        end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        if #cues > 0 then
            local reveal = 0.0
            for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
                if index >= cue.first_character and index <= cue.last_character and ctx.time >= cue.start_time and ctx.time < finalTime then
                    local duration = math.max(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0), 0.001)
                    reveal = math.max(reveal, mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((ctx.time - cue.start_time) / duration)))
                end
            end
            character.opacity = character.opacity * reveal
        end
    end
end

                and startTime >= 0.0 and endTime > startTime and endTime < math.huge
                and firstCharacter >= 1 and lastCharacter >= firstCharacter
                and lastCharacter <= ctx.char_count
                and firstCharacter % 1 == 0 and lastCharacter % 1 == 0 then
                cues[#cues + 1] = {
                    start_time = startTime, end_time = endTime,
                    first_character = firstCharacter, last_character = lastCharacter,
                }
            else
                valid = false
            end
        end
    end
    if not valid then cues = {} end
    table.sort(cues, function(first, second)
        if first.start_time ~= second.start_time then return first.start_time < second.start_time end
        if first.end_time ~= second.end_time then return first.end_time < second.end_time end
        if first.first_character ~= second.first_character then return first.first_character < second.first_character end
        return first.last_character < second.last_character
    end)
    return cues
end

local function cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
    local duration = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0)
    duration = math.min(duration, (cue.end_time - cue.start_time) * 0.5)
    local envelope = 0.0
    if ctx.time >= cue.start_time and ctx.time < cue.end_time then
        envelope = 1.0
        if duration > 0.0 then
            envelope = mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, ctx.time - cue.start_time)
                * mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, cue.end_time - ctx.time)
        end
    end
    return envelope
end

local function tint(character, ctx, accent, strength)
    local base = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
    character.fill.use = true
    character.fill.color = { r = mt.lerp(base.r, accent.r, strength),
        g = mt.lerp(base.g, accent.g, strength), b = mt.lerp(base.b, accent.b, strength), a = base.a }
end

local function rangeBounds(ctx, first, last)
    local targets = {}
    for index = first, last do targets[#targets + 1] = index end

end

local function alignmentDelta(ctx, range, whole)
    local horizontal = ctx.global.h_align
    local vertical = ctx.global.v_align
    local horizontalDelta = whole.center_x - range.center_x
    local verticalDelta = whole.center_y - range.center_y
    if horizontal == "left" then horizontalDelta = whole.left - range.left
    elseif horizontal == "right" then horizontalDelta = whole.right - range.right end
    if vertical == "top" then verticalDelta = whole.top - range.top
    elseif vertical == "bottom" or vertical == "baseline" then verticalDelta = whole.bottom - range.bottom end
    return horizontalDelta, verticalDelta
end

    local cues = parseCues(ctx)

            local range = rangeBounds(ctx, cue.first_character, cue.last_character)
            if range then
                local horizontal, vertical = alignmentDelta(ctx, range, whole)
                shifts[cue] = { horizontal = horizontal, vertical = vertical, range = range, ordinal = ordinal }
            end
        end

    local currentCue = nil
    for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
        if ctx.time >= cue.start_time and (not currentCue or cue.start_time > currentCue.start_time) then currentCue = cue end

        local range = shifts[currentCue].range
        local fade = math.max(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0), 0.001)
        local progress = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate((ctx.time - currentCue.start_time) / fade))
        local previous = nil
        for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            if cue.start_time < currentCue.start_time and (not previous or cue.start_time > previous.start_time) then previous = cue end
        end
        local previousRange = previous and shifts[previous] and shifts[previous].range or whole
        if ctx.global.vertical then
            scrollX = mt.lerp(whole.center_x - previousRange.center_x, whole.center_x - range.center_x, progress)
        else
            scrollY = mt.lerp(whole.center_y - previousRange.center_y, whole.center_y - range.center_y, progress)
        end
    end
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local active = 0.0
        local selected = nil
        local completed = false
        for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            if index >= cue.first_character and index <= cue.last_character then
                local envelope = cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
                if envelope > active then active = envelope selected = cue end
                if ctx.time >= cue.end_time then completed = true end
            end

            character.opacity = character.opacity * math.max(active, mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 1.0))

            if active > 0.0 then tint(character, ctx, ctx.inputs.colors[1], active * math.min(amount, 1.0)) end
        end
    end
end

name: LYR004_keyword_zoom.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id LYR004
-- @duration 6
-- @title Keyword Zoom
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "Sing with me"
-- @recommend lang en
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 7 "Cue Fade (s)" default=0.15
-- @input text 1 "Lyric Cues (start,end,first,last)" default="0.5,1.8,1,4;2.2,3.5,6,9;3.8,5.2,11,12"
--[[ @description
The view briefly approaches the current keyword and returns to the full text.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
現在のキーワードへ短く寄り、全文の配置へ戻ります。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function parseCues(ctx)
    local cues = {}
    local sheet = ctx.inputs.texts[1]
    local valid = true
    for row in sheet:gmatch("[^;\r\n]+") do
        if row:match("%S") then
            local startText, endText, firstText, lastText =
                row:match("^%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+)%s*$")
            local startTime, endTime = tonumber(startText), tonumber(endText)
            local firstCharacter, lastCharacter = tonumber(firstText), tonumber(lastText)
            if startTime and endTime and firstCharacter and lastCharacter
                and startTime >= 0.0 and endTime > startTime and endTime < math.huge
                and firstCharacter >= 1 and lastCharacter >= firstCharacter
                and lastCharacter <= ctx.char_count
                and firstCharacter % 1 == 0 and lastCharacter % 1 == 0 then
                cues[#cues + 1] = {
                    start_time = startTime, end_time = endTime,
                    first_character = firstCharacter, last_character = lastCharacter,
                }
            else
                valid = false
            end
        end
    end
    if not valid then cues = {} end
    table.sort(cues, function(first, second)
        if first.start_time ~= second.start_time then return first.start_time < second.start_time end
        if first.end_time ~= second.end_time then return first.end_time < second.end_time end
        if first.first_character ~= second.first_character then return first.first_character < second.first_character end
        return first.last_character < second.last_character
    end)
    return cues
end

local function cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
    local duration = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0)
    duration = math.min(duration, (cue.end_time - cue.start_time) * 0.5)
    local envelope = 0.0
    if ctx.time >= cue.start_time and ctx.time < cue.end_time then
        envelope = 1.0
        if duration > 0.0 then
            envelope = mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, ctx.time - cue.start_time)
                * mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, cue.end_time - ctx.time)
        end
    end
    return envelope
end

local function tint(character, ctx, accent, strength)
    local base = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
    character.fill.use = true
    character.fill.color = { r = mt.lerp(base.r, accent.r, strength),
        g = mt.lerp(base.g, accent.g, strength), b = mt.lerp(base.b, accent.b, strength), a = base.a }
end

local function rangeBounds(ctx, first, last)
    local targets = {}
    for index = first, last do targets[#targets + 1] = index end
    return mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, targets)
end

local function alignmentDelta(ctx, range, whole)
    local horizontal = ctx.global.h_align
    local vertical = ctx.global.v_align
    local horizontalDelta = whole.center_x - range.center_x
    local verticalDelta = whole.center_y - range.center_y
    if horizontal == "left" then horizontalDelta = whole.left - range.left
    elseif horizontal == "right" then horizontalDelta = whole.right - range.right end
    if vertical == "top" then verticalDelta = whole.top - range.top
    elseif vertical == "bottom" or vertical == "baseline" then verticalDelta = whole.bottom - range.bottom end
    return horizontalDelta, verticalDelta
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress))
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local cues = parseCues(ctx)
    local whole = rangeBounds(ctx, 1, ctx.char_count)
    local shifts = {}
    if whole then
        for ordinal, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            local range = rangeBounds(ctx, cue.first_character, cue.last_character)
            if range then
                local horizontal, vertical = alignmentDelta(ctx, range, whole)
                shifts[cue] = { horizontal = horizontal, vertical = vertical, range = range, ordinal = ordinal }
            end
        end
    end
    local currentCue = nil
    for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
        if cueEnvelope(ctx, cue) > 0.0 and (not currentCue or cue.start_time > currentCue.start_time) then currentCue = cue end
    end
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local active = 0.0
        local selected = nil
        local completed = false
        for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            if index >= cue.first_character and index <= cue.last_character then
                local envelope = cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
                if envelope > active then active = envelope selected = cue end
                if ctx.time >= cue.end_time then completed = true end
            end
        end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
        if currentCue and whole and shifts[currentCue] then
            local range = shifts[currentCue].range
            local strength = cueEnvelope(ctx, currentCue) * amount
            local zoom = 0.4 * strength
            local currentX, currentY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
            character.scale = character.scale * (1.0 + zoom)
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character,
                currentX + (whole.center_x - range.center_x) * strength + (currentX - range.center_x) * zoom,
                currentY + (whole.center_y - range.center_y) * strength + (currentY - range.center_y) * zoom)
        end
    end
end
description: The view briefly approaches the current keyword and returns to the full text.

descriptions.ja: 現在のキーワードへ短く寄り、全文の配置へ戻ります。

title: Keyword Zoom
author: Mug

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id LYR005
-- @duration 5
-- @title Beat Pulse
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
-- @input boolean 3 "Idle Motion" default=true
-- @input number 7 "BPM" default=120
-- @input number 8 "Beat Offset (s)" default=0.0
--[[ @description
Text pulses at a chosen BPM with an optional beat offset.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
指定したBPMと拍の開始時刻に合わせて文字が脈動します。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

local function travelVector(ctx)
    local direction = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    local horizontal, vertical = 0.0, 0.0
    if direction == 1 then vertical = 1.0
    elseif direction == 2 then vertical = -1.0
    elseif direction == 3 then horizontal = -1.0
    else horizontal = 1.0 end
    return horizontal, vertical
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, info.progress)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        local idle = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and amount * entrance * (1.0 - exit) or 0.0
        local frequency = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 1.0, 600.0) / 60.0
        local phase = ((ctx.time - ctx.inputs.numbers[8]) * frequency) % 1.0
        local pulse = math.exp(-phase * 12.0)
        character.scale = character.scale * (1.0 + pulse * 0.2 * idle)
    end
end
description: Text pulses at a chosen BPM with an optional beat offset.

descriptions.ja: 指定したBPMと拍の開始時刻に合わせて文字が脈動します。

title: Beat Pulse
author: Mug

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id PRT001
-- @duration 5
-- @title Fade Up (Parts)
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "分解と集合"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.0
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Character Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
-- @input number 7 "Sequencing (1=All Parts 2=Within Characters)" default=2
-- @input number 8 "Part Stagger" default=0.3
--[[ @description
Parts rise into place and fade away at the exit.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
パーツが浮き上がりながら現れ、元の文字に揃います。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kProgressEpsilon = 0.000000001

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function orderedPosition(ctx, index, count, salt)
    local position = mt.distribute(index, count)
    local order = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    if order == 2 then position = 1.0 - position
    elseif order == 3 then position = math.abs(position * 2.0 - 1.0)
    elseif order == 4 then position = mt.random_range(ctx.meta.instance_seed, salt + index, 0.0, 1.0) end
    return position
end

local function characterPositions(ctx)
    local indices = {}
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if character.part_count > 0 then indices[#indices + 1] = index end
    end
    local positions = {}
    for ordinal, index in ipairs(indices) do
        positions[index] = orderedPosition(ctx, ordinal, #indices, 0)
    end
    return positions
end

local function partProgress(ctx, part, character, positions, introProgress, outroProgress)
    local mode = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 1.0, 2.0) + 0.5)
    local intro, outro = introProgress, outroProgress
    local position
    if mode == 2 then
        local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
        intro = mt.stagger_progress(intro, positions[part.character_index], stagger)
        outro = mt.stagger_progress(outro, positions[part.character_index], stagger)
        position = orderedPosition(ctx, part.index_in_character, character.part_count, character.index * 1000)
    else
        position = orderedPosition(ctx, part.index, ctx.part_count, 0)
    end
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 0.9)
    intro = mt.stagger_progress(intro, position, stagger)
    outro = mt.stagger_progress(outro, position, stagger)
    if introProgress <= kProgressEpsilon then intro = 0.0
    elseif introProgress >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then intro = 1.0 end
    if outroProgress <= kProgressEpsilon then outro = 0.0
    elseif outroProgress >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then outro = 1.0 end
    return intro, outro
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local positions = characterPositions(ctx)
    for index, part, info in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local intro, outro = partProgress(ctx, part, info.char, positions, introProgress, outroProgress)
        local entrance, exit = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro), mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        local residual = 1.0 - entrance + exit
        part.opacity = part.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        if amount > 0.0 then
            part.offset_y = part.offset_y - 0.08 * amount * residual
        end
    end
end
description: Parts rise into place and fade away at the exit.

descriptions.ja: パーツが浮き上がりながら現れ、元の文字に揃います。

    intro = mt.stagger_progress(intro, position, stagger)
    outro = mt.stagger_progress(outro, position, stagger)
    if introProgress <= kProgressEpsilon then intro = 0.0
    elseif introProgress >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then intro = 1.0 end
    if outroProgress <= kProgressEpsilon then outro = 0.0
    elseif outroProgress >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then outro = 1.0 end
    return intro, outro
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local positions = characterPositions(ctx)
    for index, part, info in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local intro, outro = partProgress(ctx, part, info.char, positions, introProgress, outroProgress)
        local entrance, exit = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro), mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        local residual = 1.0 - entrance + exit
        part.opacity = part.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        if amount > 0.0 then
            local swing = math.cos(intro * math.pi * 3.0) * (1.0 - intro) ^ 2.0
            if math.abs(swing + exit) > 0.000001 then
                mt.layout.pivot_at_2d(ctx, part, "top")
                part.pitch = part.pitch + (swing + exit) * amount * 65.0
            end
        end
    end
end
