name: PRT019_part_swirl.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id PRT019
-- @duration 5
-- @title Part Swirl
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend text "分解と集合"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.0
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Character Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
-- @input number 7 "Sequencing (1=All Parts 2=Within Characters)" default=2
-- @input number 8 "Part Stagger" default=0.3
-- @input number 9 "Radius (canvas heights)" default=0.18
-- @input number 10 "Turns" default=0.75
-- @input number 5 "Direction (1=Clockwise 2=Counterclockwise)" default=1
--[[ @description
Parts swirl around each character and assemble into text.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
パーツが文字の周りを渦巻きながら集まります。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kProgressEpsilon = 0.000000001

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function orderedPosition(ctx, index, count, salt)
    local position = mt.distribute(index, count)
    local order = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    if order == 2 then position = 1.0 - position
    elseif order == 3 then position = math.abs(position * 2.0 - 1.0)
    elseif order == 4 then position = mt.random_range(ctx.meta.instance_seed, salt + index, 0.0, 1.0) end
    return position
end

local function characterPositions(ctx)
    local indices = {}
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if character.part_count > 0 then indices[#indices + 1] = index end
    end
    local positions = {}
    for ordinal, index in ipairs(indices) do
        positions[index] = orderedPosition(ctx, ordinal, #indices, 0)
    end
    return positions
end

local function partProgress(ctx, part, character, positions, introProgress, outroProgress)
    local mode = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 1.0, 2.0) + 0.5)
    local intro, outro = introProgress, outroProgress
    local position
    if mode == 2 then
        local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
        intro = mt.stagger_progress(intro, positions[part.character_index], stagger)
        outro = mt.stagger_progress(outro, positions[part.character_index], stagger)
        position = orderedPosition(ctx, part.index_in_character, character.part_count, character.index * 1000)
    else
        position = orderedPosition(ctx, part.index, ctx.part_count, 0)
    end
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 0.9)
    intro = mt.stagger_progress(intro, position, stagger)
    outro = mt.stagger_progress(outro, position, stagger)
    if introProgress <= kProgressEpsilon then intro = 0.0
    elseif introProgress >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then intro = 1.0 end
    if outroProgress <= kProgressEpsilon then outro = 0.0
    elseif outroProgress >= 1.0 - kProgressEpsilon then outro = 1.0 end
    return intro, outro
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local radiusAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 2.0)
    local turns = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[10], 0.0, 8.0)
    local direction = ctx.inputs.numbers[5] < 1.5 and -1.0 or 1.0
    local positions = characterPositions(ctx)
    for index, part, info in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local intro, outro = partProgress(ctx, part, info.char, positions, introProgress, outroProgress)
        local entrance, exit = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro), mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        local residual = 1.0 - entrance + exit
        part.opacity = part.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        if amount > 0.0 and residual > 0.0 then
            local localX = part.geometry.local_center_x * ctx.canvas.width / ctx.canvas.height
            local localY = -part.geometry.local_center_y
            local length = math.sqrt(localX * localX + localY * localY)
            local angle = length > kProgressEpsilon and math.atan(localY, localX)
                or mt.random_range(ctx.meta.instance_seed, index, 0.0, math.pi * 2.0)
            local sweep = residual * turns * math.pi * 2.0 * direction * amount
            local radius = length + residual * radiusAmount * amount
            part.offset_x = part.offset_x + (math.cos(angle + sweep) * radius - localX) * ctx.canvas.height / ctx.canvas.width
            part.offset_y = part.offset_y + math.sin(angle + sweep) * radius - localY
            part.rotation = part.rotation + math.deg(sweep)
        end
    end
end

name: PTH001_comet_arc.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id PTH001
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Comet Arc
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.2
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.95
--[[ @description
Letters follow individual Bezier arrivals, patrol figure-eight paths, and fling away along tangents.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字ごとのベジェ曲線で入場し、表示中は小さな8の字を巡り、接線方向へ飛び去る演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.2
local kOutroDuration = 0.95
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerAmount = 0.55
local kSteadyRadius = 0.018 -- figure-eight half-size in offset space
local kSteadyPeriod = 2.8 -- seconds per full idle loop
local kTrailHue = 0.55

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local characterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress

        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local introEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(introRaw)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)

        -- Per-glyph wing and height so the cascade fans out.
        local wingSign = ((index % 2) == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local entryLift = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.12, 0.22)
        local entrySide = wingSign * mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount, 0.18, 0.32)
        local exitSide = -wingSign * mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 2, 0.22, 0.38)
        local exitDrop = mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 3, -0.08, 0.12)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro: Bezier comet arrival (path progress 0 → 1)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introP0 = { x = 0.5 + entrySide, y = 0.5 + entryLift }
        local introP1 = { x = 0.5 + entrySide * 0.35, y = 0.5 + entryLift * 0.15 }
        local introP2 = { x = 0.5 - wingSign * 0.04, y = 0.5 - 0.02 }
        local introP3 = { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 }
        local introX, introY, introTangentX, introTangentY =
            mt.path.bezier(introP0, introP1, introP2, introP3, introEased)
        local introRotation = math.deg(math.atan(introTangentY, introTangentX))

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady: Catmull-Rom figure-eight around the seat
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local loopProgress = mt.cycle(ctx.time + order * 0.35, kSteadyPeriod)
        local idleWaypoints = {
            { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 },
            { x = 0.5 + kSteadyRadius, y = 0.5 + kSteadyRadius * 0.55 },
            { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 },
            { x = 0.5 - kSteadyRadius, y = 0.5 - kSteadyRadius * 0.55 },
            { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 },
        }
        local idleX, idleY, idleTangentX, idleTangentY =
            mt.path.catmull_rom(idleWaypoints, loopProgress)
        local idleRotation = math.deg(math.atan(idleTangentY, idleTangentX)) * 0.35

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro: different Bezier exit (not intro reversed)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local outroP0 = { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 }
        local outroP1 = { x = 0.5 + exitSide * 0.25, y = 0.5 + 0.06 }
        local outroP2 = { x = 0.5 + exitSide * 0.7, y = 0.5 + exitDrop * 0.4 }
        local outroP3 = { x = 0.5 + exitSide, y = 0.5 + exitDrop }
        local outroX, outroY, outroTangentX, outroTangentY =
            mt.path.bezier(outroP0, outroP1, outroP2, outroP3, outroEased)
        local outroRotation = math.deg(math.atan(outroTangentY, outroTangentX))

        -- Pick the active block pose (do not cross-lerp path states —
        -- that would leave the curve). Outro wins, then intro, else idle.
        local pathX = idleX
        local pathY = idleY
        local rotation = idleRotation
        if outroEased > 0.0 then
            pathX = outroX
            pathY = outroY
            rotation = outroRotation
        elseif introEased < 1.0 then
            pathX = introX
            pathY = introY
            rotation = introRotation
        end

        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + (pathX) - 0.5
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + (pathY) - 0.5
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (rotation)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (mt.saturate(introRaw * 2.5) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroRaw)))
        character.scale = character.scale * (1.0 + (1.0 - introEased) * 0.2 + outroEased * 0.15)

        -- Cool comet trail palette; brighter while still airborne on the arc.
        local airAmount = (1.0 - introEased) + outroEased
        local baseColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kTrailHue + order * 0.08, 0.35, 0.88, 1.0)
        local hotColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kTrailHue - 0.08, 0.55, 1.0, 1.0)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(baseColor, hotColor, mt.saturate(airAmount))
    end
end

name: PTH002_storyboard_keys.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id PTH002
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Storyboard Keys
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.25
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.0
--[[ @description
Keyframe choreography combines a drop-bounce entrance, looping hold phrase, and crouch-launch exit.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
落下・跳ね返り・静止、表示中の短いループ、しゃがんで飛び出す退場をキーフレーム表で組んだ演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。各動作の時刻と値はキーフレーム表で編集します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.25
local kOutroDuration = 1.0
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerSeconds = 0.07 -- real-time cascade between characters
local kSteadyLoopSeconds = 1.6

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress
        -- Real-second stagger (not progress-scaled) so typing speed stays
        -- constant when the clip is stretched.
        local localTime = ctx.time - (index - 1) * kStaggerSeconds

        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, 0.45)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, 1.0 - order, 0.4)
        local introEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(introRaw)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)
        local steadyWeight = introEased * (1.0 - outroEased)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro keys: drop → bounce → settle (localTime seconds)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introOffsetY = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.18 },
            { t = 0.4, v = 0.0, ease = "out_bounce" },
            { t = 0.85, v = 0.0 },
        }, localTime)
        local introScale = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.55 },
            { t = 0.35, v = 1.08, ease = "out_back" },
            { t = 0.7, v = 1.0, ease = "out_cubic" },
        }, localTime)
        local introRotation = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = -18.0 },
            { t = 0.45, v = 4.0, ease = "out_cubic" },
            { t = 0.8, v = 0.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, localTime)
        local introColor = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = { r = 0.35, g = 0.4, b = 0.55, a = 1.0 } },
            { t = 0.5, v = { r = 1.0, g = 0.72, b = 0.35, a = 1.0 }, ease = "out_cubic" },
            { t = 0.95, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, localTime)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady keys: looping phrase on a cycled clock
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local steadyClock = mt.cycle(ctx.time + order * 0.25, kSteadyLoopSeconds) * kSteadyLoopSeconds
        local steadyOffsetY = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 0.4, v = 0.012, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = 0.9, v = -0.006, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = 0.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)
        local steadyRotation = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 0.5, v = 3.5, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = 0.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)
        local steadyScale = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 1.0 },
            { t = 0.55, v = 1.04, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = 1.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)
        local steadyColor = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 } },
            { t = 0.7, v = { r = 0.55, g = 0.78, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro keys: crouch → launch (outro-local seconds)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Map outroRaw 0–1 onto a fixed 0–1 second key window so the
        -- phrase always completes at clip end regardless of clip length.
        local outroClock = outroEased * 1.0
        local outroOffsetY = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 0.25, v = -0.02, ease = "in_cubic" },
            { t = 1.0, v = 0.28, ease = "in_back" },
        }, outroClock)
        local outroScale = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 1.0 },
            { t = 0.3, v = 0.88, ease = "in_cubic" },
            { t = 1.0, v = 1.25, ease = "in_cubic" },
        }, outroClock)
        local outroRotation = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 1.0, v = 22.0 * (((index % 2) == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0), ease = "in_cubic" },
        }, outroClock)
        local outroColor = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 } },
            { t = 0.45, v = { r = 0.75, g = 0.55, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }, ease = "out_cubic" },
            { t = 1.0, v = { r = 0.25, g = 0.3, b = 0.55, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_cubic" },
        }, outroClock)

        -- Block composite: intro pose → steady phrase → outro launch.
        local offsetY = introOffsetY
        local scale = introScale
        local rotation = introRotation
        local fillColor = introColor

        offsetY = mt.lerp(offsetY, steadyOffsetY, steadyWeight)
        scale = mt.lerp(scale, steadyScale, steadyWeight)
        rotation = mt.lerp(rotation, steadyRotation, steadyWeight)
        fillColor = mt.color.lerp(fillColor, steadyColor, steadyWeight)

        offsetY = mt.lerp(offsetY, outroOffsetY, outroEased)
        scale = mt.lerp(scale, outroScale, outroEased)
        rotation = mt.lerp(rotation, outroRotation, outroEased)
        fillColor = mt.color.lerp(fillColor, outroColor, outroEased)

        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + offsetY
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x
        character.scale = character.scale * (scale)
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (rotation)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (mt.saturate(introRaw * 3.0) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroRaw)))

        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = fillColor
    end
end
description: Keyframe choreography combines a drop-bounce entrance, looping hold phrase, and crouch-launch exit.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id PTH003
-- @duration 8.0
-- @recommend fill #b8d6ff
-- @recommend gradient #ff7a33
-- @title Path Parade
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.65
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.7
--[[ @description
Letters queue, parade clockwise around a closed path, and return to their starting positions.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
読める状態で待つ文字が順に出発し、閉じた経路を時計回りに巡って元の位置へ戻る演出です。角では減速・回転・伸縮します。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。閉じた経路の形はkPathPointsの座標で編集します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kPathPoints = {
    { x = 0.22, y = 0.82 },
    { x = 0.78, y = 0.82 },
    { x = 0.78, y = 0.18 },
    { x = 0.22, y = 0.18 },
}

local kIntroDuration = 0.65
local kOutroDuration = 0.7
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0
local kIntroScale = 0.24
local kReadingSegmentIndex = 3
local kBottomHoldDuration = 1.15
local kDepartureStaggerSeconds = 0.16
local kMaximumDepartureWaveDuration = 1.6
local kCircuitDuration = 4.4
local kCollectedHoldDuration = 0.9
local kCornerWindow = 0.2
local kCornerBrakeStrength = 0.42
local kCornerCutDistance = 0.022
local kCornerReleaseHop = 0.012
local kCornerCompression = 0.16
local kCornerReleaseScale = 0.09
local kCornerBankDegrees = 9.0
local kBottomEdgeReadingRotation = 180.0
local kTurnEpsilon = 1e-5

local kReleaseBrightness = 1.35

local kTwoPi = math.pi * 2.0

local function getShortestAngleDifference(startAngle, endAngle)
    return (endAngle - startAngle + math.pi) % kTwoPi - math.pi
end

local function interpolateAngle(startAngle, endAngle, amount)
    return startAngle + getShortestAngleDifference(startAngle, endAngle) * amount
end

local function getTurnDirection(startAngle, endAngle)
    local angleDifference = getShortestAngleDifference(startAngle, endAngle)
    local turnDirection = 0.0
    if angleDifference > kTurnEpsilon then
        turnDirection = 1.0
    elseif angleDifference < -kTurnEpsilon then
        turnDirection = -1.0
    end
    return turnDirection
end

local function buildPathSegments(pathPoints, aspectRatio)
    local segments = {}
    local totalLength = 0.0

    for index = 1, #pathPoints do
        local startPoint = pathPoints[index]
        local endPoint = pathPoints[index % #pathPoints + 1]
        local distanceX = (endPoint.x - startPoint.x) * aspectRatio
        local distanceY = endPoint.y - startPoint.y
        local segmentLength = math.sqrt(distanceX * distanceX + distanceY * distanceY)
        local segmentAngle = math.atan(distanceY, distanceX)

        segments[index] = {
            startPoint = startPoint,
            endPoint = endPoint,
            length = segmentLength,
            angle = segmentAngle,
            cumulativeStart = totalLength,
        }
        totalLength = totalLength + segmentLength
    end

    return segments, totalLength
end

local function applyCornerBrake(segmentProgress)
    return mt.lerp(
        segmentProgress,
        mt.smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, segmentProgress),
        kCornerBrakeStrength
    )
end

local function invertCornerBrake(targetProgress)
    local lowerBound = 0.0
    local upperBound = 1.0
    local kSearchIterations = 14

    for _ = 1, kSearchIterations do
        local midpoint = (lowerBound + upperBound) * 0.5
        if applyCornerBrake(midpoint) < targetProgress then
            lowerBound = midpoint
        else
            upperBound = midpoint
        end
    end

    return (lowerBound + upperBound) * 0.5
end

local function scaleColorBrightness(color, brightness)
    return {
        r = mt.saturate(color.r * brightness),
        g = mt.saturate(color.g * brightness),
        b = mt.saturate(color.b * brightness),
        a = color.a,
    }
end

local function captureNaturalText(ctx)
    local minimumX = 0.5
    local maximumX = 0.5
    local minimumY = 0.5
    local maximumY = 0.5
    local hasCharacter = false
    local positions = {}

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local positionX, positionY =
            mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
        positions[index] = { x = positionX, y = positionY }

        if hasCharacter then
            minimumX = math.min(minimumX, positionX)
            maximumX = math.max(maximumX, positionX)
            minimumY = math.min(minimumY, positionY)
            maximumY = math.max(maximumY, positionY)
        else
            minimumX = positionX
            maximumX = positionX
            minimumY = positionY
            maximumY = positionY
            hasCharacter = true
        end
    end

    return {
        centerX = (minimumX + maximumX) * 0.5,
        centerY = (minimumY + maximumY) * 0.5,
        positions = positions,
    }
end

local function evaluateClosedPath(segments, totalLength, progress)
    local wrappedDistance = mt.wrap(progress, 0.0, 1.0) * totalLength
    local selectedSegmentIndex = 1
    local selectedSegmentProgress = 0.0
    local segmentFound = false

    for index = 1, #segments do
        local segment = segments[index]
        local cumulativeEnd = segment.cumulativeStart + segment.length
        if not segmentFound and wrappedDistance <= cumulativeEnd then
            selectedSegmentIndex = index
            selectedSegmentProgress =
                (wrappedDistance - segment.cumulativeStart) / math.max(segment.length, kTurnEpsilon)
            segmentFound = true
        end
    end

    selectedSegmentProgress = mt.saturate(selectedSegmentProgress)
    local selectedSegment = segments[selectedSegmentIndex]
    local previousSegment = segments[(selectedSegmentIndex - 2) % #segments + 1]
    local nextSegment = segments[selectedSegmentIndex % #segments + 1]

    -- A partial smoothstep keeps most of each edge moving steadily while
    -- still bringing velocity down as the character reaches a corner.
    local brakedProgress = applyCornerBrake(selectedSegmentProgress)
    local positionX =
        mt.lerp(selectedSegment.startPoint.x, selectedSegment.endPoint.x, brakedProgress)
    local positionY =
        mt.lerp(selectedSegment.startPoint.y, selectedSegment.endPoint.y, brakedProgress)

    local travelAngle = selectedSegment.angle
    local cornerAmount = 0.0
    local releaseAmount = 0.0
    local turnDirection = 0.0

    if selectedSegmentProgress < kCornerWindow then
        local cornerExitProgress =
            mt.smoothstep(0.0, kCornerWindow, selectedSegmentProgress)
        travelAngle = interpolateAngle(
            previousSegment.angle,
            selectedSegment.angle,
            0.5 + cornerExitProgress * 0.5
        )
        cornerAmount = 1.0 - cornerExitProgress
        releaseAmount = math.sin(cornerExitProgress * math.pi)
        turnDirection = getTurnDirection(previousSegment.angle, selectedSegment.angle)
    elseif selectedSegmentProgress > 1.0 - kCornerWindow then
        local cornerEntryProgress = mt.smoothstep(
            1.0 - kCornerWindow,
            1.0,
            selectedSegmentProgress
        )
        travelAngle = interpolateAngle(
            selectedSegment.angle,
            nextSegment.angle,
            cornerEntryProgress * 0.5
        )
        cornerAmount = cornerEntryProgress
        turnDirection = getTurnDirection(selectedSegment.angle, nextSegment.angle)
    end

    return {
        positionX = positionX,
        positionY = positionY,
        travelAngle = travelAngle,
        cornerAmount = cornerAmount,
        releaseAmount = releaseAmount,
        turnDirection = turnDirection,
    }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local safeCharacterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local pathSegments, totalPathLength =
        buildPathSegments(kPathPoints, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio)
    local readingSegment = pathSegments[kReadingSegmentIndex]
    local naturalText = captureNaturalText(ctx)
    local accentColor = ctx.global.gradient.end_color
    local releaseColor = scaleColorBrightness(accentColor, kReleaseBrightness)

    local departureStagger = math.min(
        kDepartureStaggerSeconds,
        kMaximumDepartureWaveDuration / math.max(safeCharacterCount - 1, 1)
    )
    local departureWaveDuration =
        math.max(safeCharacterCount - 1, 0) * departureStagger
    local cycleDuration =
        kBottomHoldDuration
            + departureWaveDuration
            + kCircuitDuration
            + kCollectedHoldDuration
    local cycleTime = ctx.time % cycleDuration

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local characterOrder = mt.distribute(index, safeCharacterCount)
        local baseCharacterScale = character.scale
        local baseCharacterStretchX = character.stretch_x
        local baseCharacterStretchY = character.stretch_y
        local baseCharacterOpacity = character.opacity
        local naturalPosition = naturalText.positions[index]

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Bottom queue: preserve the natural text's horizontal spacing
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local readableSegmentProgress =
            0.5
                - (naturalPosition.x - naturalText.centerX)
                    * ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
                    / math.max(readingSegment.length, kTurnEpsilon)
        local rawReadableSegmentProgress = readableSegmentProgress
        if readableSegmentProgress >= 0.0 and readableSegmentProgress <= 1.0 then
            rawReadableSegmentProgress =
                invertCornerBrake(readableSegmentProgress)
        end
        local readingSlotProgress = (
            readingSegment.cumulativeStart
                + rawReadableSegmentProgress * readingSegment.length
        ) / totalPathLength

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- One-by-one circuit: hold, launch, orbit, collect, hold
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local departureTime =
            kBottomHoldDuration + (index - 1) * departureStagger
        local travelTime = cycleTime - departureTime
        local circuitProgress = 0.0
        if travelTime >= 0.0 and travelTime < kCircuitDuration then
            local rawCircuitProgress =
                mt.saturate(travelTime / kCircuitDuration)
            circuitProgress = mt.ease.in_out_sine(rawCircuitProgress)
        end

        local pathProgress = readingSlotProgress + circuitProgress
        local pathState =
            evaluateClosedPath(pathSegments, totalPathLength, pathProgress)

        -- For a left turn, the left-hand normal points inside the route;
        -- for a right turn, the right-hand normal does. This cuts the hard
        -- polygon corner without changing the user-authored path points.
        local inwardNormalX =
            -math.sin(pathState.travelAngle) * pathState.turnDirection
        local inwardNormalY =
            math.cos(pathState.travelAngle) * pathState.turnDirection
        local inwardDistance =
            pathState.cornerAmount * kCornerCutDistance
                + pathState.releaseAmount * kCornerReleaseHop
        local naturalVerticalOffset =
            naturalPosition.y - naturalText.centerY
        local rotatedNaturalOffsetX =
            math.sin(pathState.travelAngle)
                * naturalVerticalOffset
                / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
        local rotatedNaturalOffsetY =
            -math.cos(pathState.travelAngle) * naturalVerticalOffset
        local targetPositionX = pathState.positionX
            + inwardNormalX * inwardDistance / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
            + rotatedNaturalOffsetX
        local targetPositionY = pathState.positionY
            + inwardNormalY * inwardDistance
            + rotatedNaturalOffsetY

        local introDelay = characterOrder * 0.28
        local characterIntro = mt.ease.out_back(
            mt.saturate(introAmount * (1.0 + introDelay) - introDelay)
        )
        local outroDelay = (1.0 - characterOrder) * 0.25
        local characterOutro = mt.ease.in_cubic(
            mt.saturate(outroAmount * (1.0 + outroDelay) - outroDelay)
        )

        local cornerCompression =
            pathState.cornerAmount * kCornerCompression
        local releaseScale =
            pathState.releaseAmount * kCornerReleaseScale
        -- The bottom edge is the default reading edge: characters are
        -- upright there and arranged left to right while moving clockwise.
        character.rotation = -math.deg(pathState.travelAngle)
            + kBottomEdgeReadingRotation
            - pathState.turnDirection * kCornerBankDegrees * pathState.cornerAmount
        character.scale =
            baseCharacterScale
                * mt.lerp(kIntroScale, 1.0, characterIntro)
                * (1.0 + releaseScale)
        character.stretch_x =
            baseCharacterStretchX * (1.0 - cornerCompression)
        character.stretch_y =
            baseCharacterStretchY * (1.0 + cornerCompression * 0.7)

        -- place_2d is called after size and rotation are final, so the
        -- character's true transformed center lands exactly on the route.
        mt.layout.place_2d(
            ctx,
            character,
            targetPositionX,
            targetPositionY
        )

        character.opacity = baseCharacterOpacity
            * mt.saturate(characterIntro * 4.0)
            * (1.0 - characterOutro)

        local baseColor, fillMode = mt.color.resolve_fill(ctx, character)
        if fillMode ~= "transparent" then
            local turnColor = mt.color.lerp(
                baseColor,
                accentColor,
                pathState.cornerAmount)
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(
                turnColor,
                releaseColor,
                pathState.releaseAmount)
        end
    end
end
description: Letters queue, parade clockwise around a closed path, and return to their starting positions.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id PTH004
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Wavefall Settle
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.55
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.35
--[[ @description
Letters bounce into a wave and settle into alignment while accelerating offscreen.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
一直線の文字が跳ねて波形へ移り、整列しながら加速して画面外へ去る演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kDropHeight = 0.35
local kWaveAmplitude = 0.08
local kWaveFrequency = 0.9
local kBounceSettleSeconds = 3.0
local kIntroStagger = 0.08
local kOutroDuration = 1.35
local kExitDistance = 0.7
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local restPositions = {}
    local highestRestY = -math.huge
    local totalRestY = 0.0

    -- Measure every destination before moving any character so the entrance
    -- and exit can share level lines derived from the current inspector layout.
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local phase = mt.distribute(index, ctx.char_count)
        local waveOffset = math.sin(phase * math.pi * 2.0 * kWaveFrequency) * kWaveAmplitude
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + waveOffset

        local restX, restY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
        restPositions[index] = { x = restX, y = restY }
        highestRestY = math.max(highestRestY, restY)
        totalRestY = totalRestY + restY
    end

    local commonStartY = highestRestY + kDropHeight
    local commonExitBaseY = totalRestY / math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local introProgress, outroProgress =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, 0.0, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local levelAmount = mt.ease.in_out_sine(outroProgress)
    local fallAmount = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress)

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local restPosition = restPositions[index]
        if introProgress < 1.0 then
            mt.bounce_ground(ctx, character, restPosition.y, {
                t = introProgress * (math.max(ctx.char_count - 1, 0) * kIntroStagger + kBounceSettleSeconds),
                start_mode = "absolute",
                start_y = commonStartY,
                ground_mode = "absolute",
                delay = (index - 1) * kIntroStagger,
                align_to = "center",
                gravity = 5.0,
                restitution = 0.45,
                squash = 0.22,
                stretch = 0.035,
                flexibility = 18.0,
                damping = 6.5
            })
        end

        if outroProgress > 0.0 then
            local levelY = mt.lerp(restPosition.y, commonExitBaseY, levelAmount)
            local exitY = levelY - fallAmount * kExitDistance
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, restPosition.x, exitY)
        end
    end
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id PTH005
-- @duration 9.0
-- @recommend text "弾幕スタンバイ"
-- @recommend bg #080A12
-- @title Danmaku Overdrive
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.3
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.6
--[[ @description
Dense comments stream through twelve lanes with fixed messages, bursts, and sponsor credits. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
12レーンを流れる大量のコメントに固定・強調表示が混じり、最後に提供表示へ移る弾幕演出です。

本文はスクリプト内のkCommentsとkSponsorCommentsから生成します。コメントと提供表示を変更するには、それぞれの文字列テーブルを編集します。多くの文字を使うので、文字数上限の大きいプリセットで確認してください。

Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。IntroをOFFにすると開始演出を省略し、OutroをOFFにすると提供表示への切り替えとフェードを省略し、弾幕を継続します。
]]


local kComments = {
    "うぽつです",
    "きたああああああ",
    "初見ですよろしく",
    "ここすき",
    "その発想はなかった",
    "職人すごすぎる",
    "8888888888888888",
    "！？！？！？！？",
    "なぜ止めたし",
    "かわいいいいいい",
    "これは伸びる",
    "伝説の始まり",
    "待ってました",
    "音ハメ気持ちいい",
    "弾幕薄いよ何やってんの",
    "画面が見えない",
    "コメントで完成する動画",
    "すでにカオス",
    "右から来るぞ気をつけろ",
    "左からも来た",
    "色コメ助かる",
    "ここから本番",
    "まだ半分だと",
    "密度がおかしい",
    "88888888888888888888",
    "神回確定",
    "タイミング完璧",
    "何度でも見たい",
    "これぞ弾幕",
    "みんな落ち着け",
    "無理です",
    "加速してる",
    "目が足りない",
    "一時停止推奨",
    "止めても動くぞ",
    "最後まで見逃すな",
    "ここにいた証を残す",
    "未来の自分へ",
    "またこの場所で",
    "ご視聴ありがとうございました",
}

local kSponsorComments = {
    "この動画は",
    "ご覧のスポンサーの提供で",
    "お送りしました",
}

local kTuning = {
    baseline_density = 0.34, -- Fraction of comments used by the continuous stream.
    burst_density = 1.0, -- Fraction of comments used at the density peak.
    text_scale = 1.0, -- Shared multiplier for small, medium, and big comments.
    travel_speed = 1.0, -- 1.2 is 20% faster; 0.8 is 20% slower.
}

local kLaneCount = 12
local kFallbackClipLength = 9.0
local kIntroInitialDelay = 0.1
local kTravelPeriod = 3.8
local kBurstInitialDelay = 3.4
local kBurstInterval = 7.6
local kBurstSpreadDuration = 0.28
local kFinalBarrageClearance = 0.08
local kFixedInitialDelay = 0.45
local kFixedDisplayDuration = 2.5
local kFixedGapDuration = 0.3
local kSmallCommentScale = 0.25
local kMediumCommentScale = 0.33
local kBigCommentScale = 0.44
local kInnerStrokeWidth = 0.018

local function lineBounds(items)
    local left = math.huge
    local right = -math.huge
    local bottom = math.huge
    local top = -math.huge

    for _, character in ipairs(items) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        local centerX = geometry.bounds_center_x + character.offset_x - 0.5
        local centerY = geometry.bounds_center_y + character.offset_y - 0.5
        local halfWidth = geometry.bounds_width * math.abs(character.scale * character.stretch_x) * 0.5
        local halfHeight = geometry.bounds_height * math.abs(character.scale * character.stretch_y) * 0.5
        left = math.min(left, centerX - halfWidth)
        right = math.max(right, centerX + halfWidth)
        bottom = math.min(bottom, centerY - halfHeight)
        top = math.max(top, centerY + halfHeight)
    end

    return {
        center_x = (left + right) * 0.5,
        center_y = (bottom + top) * 0.5,
        width = right - left,
    }
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.text = table.concat(kComments, "\n") .. "\n" .. table.concat(kSponsorComments, "\n")
    ctx.global.stroke.order = "fill_over_stroke"
    ctx.global.stroke.join = "round"
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    -- The barrage is deliberately 2D-only. This keeps hundreds of animated
    -- characters off the projection path and makes that choice explicit.
    ctx.output.force_disable_3d_projection = true

    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackClipLength)
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    introSeconds = introSeconds * compression
    outroSeconds = outroSeconds * compression
    local lines = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    local remainingSeconds = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local clipDuration = ctx.time + remainingSeconds
    local baselineDensity = mt.saturate(kTuning.baseline_density)
    local burstDensity = math.max(baselineDensity, mt.saturate(kTuning.burst_density))
    local textScale = math.max(kTuning.text_scale, 0.001)
    local travelSpeed = math.max(kTuning.travel_speed, 0.001)
    for lineOrder, line in ipairs(lines) do
        local sponsorLineOrder = lineOrder - #kComments
        local isSponsor = sponsorLineOrder > 0
        local lineProgress = mt.distribute(math.min(lineOrder, #kComments), math.max(#kComments, 1))
        local laneIndex = ((lineOrder - 1) * 7) % kLaneCount
        local isFixed = not isSponsor and lineOrder % 10 == 0
        local isHighlighted = not isSponsor
            and (lineOrder % 6 == 0 or string.find(kComments[lineOrder] or "", "888", 1, true) ~= nil)
        local isSmall = lineOrder % 7 == 2 or lineOrder % 11 == 0
        local baseScale = kMediumCommentScale
        if isSponsor and sponsorLineOrder == 2 then
            baseScale = kBigCommentScale
        elseif isHighlighted then
            baseScale = kBigCommentScale
        elseif isSmall then
            baseScale = kSmallCommentScale
        end
        local lineIndices = {}

        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            table.insert(lineIndices, character.index)
            character.scale = character.scale * baseScale * textScale

            local hue = mt.cycle(lineProgress * 1.73, 1.0)
            local fillColor = isHighlighted
                and mt.color.from_oklch(0.88, 0.24, hue, 1.0)
                or { r = 0.96, g = 0.97, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }

            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = fillColor
            character.stroke.use = true
            character.stroke.width = kInnerStrokeWidth
            character.stroke.gap = 0.0
            character.stroke.color = { r = 0.015, g = 0.018, b = 0.035, a = 0.96 }
            character.stroke.outer_width = 0.0
            character.shadow.use = false
        end

        if #lineIndices > 0 then
            mt.layout.reflow(ctx, 0.0, {
                targets = lineIndices,
                anchor = lineIndices[1],
            })
        end

        local bounds = lineBounds(line.items)
        local targetCenterX = 0.5
        local targetCenterY = 0.12 + (laneIndex / math.max(kLaneCount - 1, 1)) * 0.76
        local spawnDelay = lineProgress * introSeconds
        local elapsedSinceSpawn = math.max(ctx.time - spawnDelay, 0.0)
        local visibility = ctx.time >= spawnDelay and 1.0 or 0.0
        local startX = 1.12 + bounds.width * 0.5

        if isSponsor then
            targetCenterX = 0.5
            targetCenterY = 0.58 - (sponsorLineOrder - 1) * 0.08
            visibility = outroSeconds > 0.0 and remainingSeconds < outroSeconds and 1.0 or 0.0
        elseif isFixed then
            local fixedOrder = math.floor(lineOrder / 10)
            local fixedSequenceIndex = math.floor((fixedOrder - 1) / 2)
            local fixedStartTime = kFixedInitialDelay
                + fixedSequenceIndex * (kFixedDisplayDuration + kFixedGapDuration)
            local fixedEndTime = fixedStartTime + kFixedDisplayDuration
            targetCenterX = 0.5
            targetCenterY = (lineOrder % 20 == 0) and 0.14 or 0.86
            visibility = ctx.time >= fixedStartTime
                and ctx.time < fixedEndTime
                and (outroSeconds == 0.0 or remainingSeconds >= outroSeconds)
                and 1.0
                or 0.0
        else
            local densityRank = mt.cycle(lineProgress * 2.618, 1.0)
            local nominalTravelPeriod = (3.5 + (lineOrder % 7) * 0.31) / travelSpeed
            local finalExitTime = outroSeconds > 0.0 and clipDuration - kFinalBarrageClearance
                or clipDuration + nominalTravelPeriod
            local availableTravelDuration = math.max(finalExitTime - spawnDelay, 0.001)
            local baselinePassCount = math.max(
                math.ceil(availableTravelDuration / nominalTravelPeriod),
                1
            )
            local baselineTravelPeriod = availableTravelDuration / baselinePassCount
            local travelProgress = mt.cycle(elapsedSinceSpawn, baselineTravelPeriod)

            if densityRank > baselineDensity then
                visibility = 0.0

                if densityRank <= burstDensity and burstDensity > baselineDensity then
                    local burstRank = (densityRank - baselineDensity)
                        / (burstDensity - baselineDensity)
                    local nominalBurstTravelPeriod = kTravelPeriod / travelSpeed
                    local latestBurstStartTime = finalExitTime
                        - nominalBurstTravelPeriod
                        - kBurstSpreadDuration
                    local burstBaseStartTime = math.max(
                        kIntroInitialDelay,
                        math.min(kBurstInitialDelay, latestBurstStartTime)
                    )
                    local burstTravelPeriod = math.min(
                        nominalBurstTravelPeriod,
                        math.max(finalExitTime - burstBaseStartTime - kBurstSpreadDuration, 0.001)
                    )
                    local burstStartTime = burstBaseStartTime + burstRank * kBurstSpreadDuration
                    local burstClock = ctx.time - burstStartTime
                    local isBurstActive = false

                    if burstClock >= 0.0 then
                        local burstElapsed = mt.cycle(burstClock, kBurstInterval) * kBurstInterval
                        local burstCycleIndex = math.floor(burstClock / kBurstInterval)
                        local burstCycleEndTime = burstStartTime
                            + burstCycleIndex * kBurstInterval
                            + burstTravelPeriod
                        isBurstActive = burstElapsed < burstTravelPeriod
                            and burstCycleEndTime <= finalExitTime
                        travelProgress = mt.saturate(burstElapsed / burstTravelPeriod)
                    end

                    visibility = isBurstActive and 1.0 or 0.0
                end
            end

            if ctx.time >= finalExitTime then
                travelProgress = 1.0
                visibility = 0.0
            end

            local endX = -0.12 - bounds.width * 0.5
            targetCenterX = mt.lerp(startX, endX, travelProgress)
        end

        local shiftX = targetCenterX - bounds.center_x
        local shiftY = targetCenterY - bounds.center_y

        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            character.offset_x = character.offset_x + shiftX
            character.offset_y = character.offset_y + shiftY
            character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility * mt.ease.out_quad(introProgress) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroProgress))
        end
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA001
-- @required 3d
-- @duration 5
-- @title Idle Wobble
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.9
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.9
--[[ @description
Letters bob and tilt continuously with a gentle camera drift.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字が小さく上下し、傾きとカメラの揺れで待機中も動くテロップです。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 0.9 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.9 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.camera.yaw = ctx.camera.yaw + mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.05) * 12.0
    ctx.camera.pitch = ctx.camera.pitch + mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.04, math.pi / 2.0) * 6.0
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local charIntro = mt.ease.out_back(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, 0.5))
        local charOutro = mt.ease.in_cubic(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, 0.5))
        local visibility = charIntro * (1.0 - charOutro)

        local phase = mt.random_range(
            ctx.meta.instance_seed,
            index,
            0.0,
            math.pi * 2.0,
            "bob-phase")
        local idleOffset = mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.5, phase) * 0.03
        local idleRotation = mt.noise1(ctx.time * 0.4 + index, 5) * 6.0

        character.offset_y = character.offset_y - (1.0 - charIntro) * 0.25 + charOutro * 0.25 + idleOffset
        character.scale = character.scale * ((0.6 + charIntro * 0.4))
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (idleRotation)

        character.opacity = character.opacity * (visibility)
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA002
-- @duration 5
-- @recommend lang ja
-- @recommend text "永字八法"
-- @title Stroke Order Draw
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.4
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.7
--[[ @description
Glyph parts appear in stroke order and erase in reverse. Parts follow font contours, not handwriting recognition. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字を構成するパーツが順に現れ、逆順に消える筆順風の表示です。パーツはフォント輪郭のsolid単位で、実際の筆画に自動分割する機能ではありません。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。パーツの数や分かれ方はフォントの輪郭に依存します。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kSecondsPerStroke = 0.14 -- drawing rate, anchored to the clip start
local kSecondsPerErase = 0.07 -- erasing rate, anchored to the clip end
local kPopDuration = 0.3 -- seconds each stroke takes to settle
local kPopScale = 0.25 -- overshoot amount at the moment a stroke lands
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local partCount = math.max(ctx.part_count, 1)
    local introTime, remainingSeconds =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, partCount * kSecondsPerStroke + kPopDuration, partCount * kSecondsPerErase, kFallbackClipLength)

    local drawnStrokes = introTime / kSecondsPerStroke
    local keepableStrokes = remainingSeconds / kSecondsPerErase
    local visibleStrokes = mt.clamp(math.min(drawnStrokes, keepableStrokes), 0.0, partCount)

    ctx.output.write_on_mode = "part"
    ctx.output.reorder_parts = true
    ctx.output.write_on_start = 0.0
    ctx.output.write_on_end = visibleStrokes / partCount

    -- The pop timing approximates each part's reveal time from its layout
    -- index. Inside a multi-part character the real reveal order is the
    -- stroke order, but both fall in the same window so the gap is invisible.
    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local secondsSinceDrawn = introTime - index * kSecondsPerStroke
        local settle = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate(secondsSinceDrawn / kPopDuration))
        part.scale = part.scale * (1.0 + (1.0 - settle) * kPopScale)
    end
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA003
-- @duration 5
-- @title Jelly Balloon
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.5
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.9
--[[ @description
Letters inflate, float softly, then overinflate and burst. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
風船のように文字が膨らんで浮かび、最後に大きく膨らんで消えます。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kInflateWindow = 0.8 -- seconds over which the inflations are staggered
local kInflateDuration = 0.7 -- seconds each balloon takes to inflate
local kWobbleAmount = 0.06 -- opposing stretch amplitude while floating
local kWobbleSpeed = 1.6 -- wobble cycles per second
local kFloatAmount = 0.012 -- canvas fraction of the idle drift
local kFloatSpeed = 0.5 -- drift cycles per second
local kFirstPopLead = 1.0 -- seconds of remaining time when the first balloon pops
local kPopSpread = 0.6 -- seconds between the first and last pop
local kSwellDuration = 0.3 -- seconds of over-inflation before the burst
local kSwellAmount = 0.22 -- extra scale at the moment of bursting
local kBurstDuration = 0.07 -- seconds from burst to fully gone
local kBurstScale = 0.5 -- extra scale spike while bursting
local kBurstKickDegrees = 40.0 -- max rotation kick on burst
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kHueSpread = 0.9 -- fraction of the hue wheel across the line
local kFullTurnDegrees = 360.0

local function getHueOffset(ctx)
    -- Individual character fills replace the rendered global gradient, so its
    -- angle remains available as an inspector knob for rotating the rainbow.
    return mt.wrap(
        ctx.global.gradient.angle / kFullTurnDegrees,
        0.0,
        1.0)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introTime, remainingSeconds =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, kInflateWindow + kInflateDuration, kFirstPopLead + kPopSpread + kSwellDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local hueOffset = getHueOffset(ctx)

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress
        local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed

        local inflateStart = order * kInflateWindow
        local inflate =
            mt.ease.out_elastic(mt.saturate((introTime - inflateStart) / kInflateDuration))

        -- Soft-body wobble: X and Y breathe against each other.
        local wobblePhase = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.0, math.pi * 2.0)
        local wobble = mt.wave(ctx.time, kWobbleSpeed, wobblePhase) * kWobbleAmount
        local sway = mt.wave(ctx.time, kFloatSpeed, wobblePhase) * kFloatAmount
        local bob = mt.wave(ctx.time, kFloatSpeed * 1.3, wobblePhase + math.pi / 2.0) * kFloatAmount

        -- Pop schedule, expressed in remaining time so it hugs the clip
        -- end: pre-swell approaches 1 right at the pop moment, then the
        -- burst window takes over.
        local popMoment = kFirstPopLead + kPopSpread - order * kPopSpread
        local sincePop = popMoment - remainingSeconds
        local preSwell = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate(1.0 + sincePop / kSwellDuration))
        local burst = mt.saturate(sincePop / kBurstDuration)
        local kick = mt.random_range(seed, index + ctx.char_count, -kBurstKickDegrees, kBurstKickDegrees)

        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + sway
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + bob
        character.scale = character.scale * (inflate * (1.0 + preSwell * kSwellAmount + burst * kBurstScale))
        character.stretch_x = character.stretch_x * (1.0 + wobble)
        character.stretch_y = character.stretch_y * (1.0 - wobble)
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (wobble * 60.0 + kick * burst)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (mt.saturate(inflate * 2.0) * (1.0 - burst))

        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.from_hsv(
            mt.wrap(order * kHueSpread + hueOffset, 0.0, 1.0),
            0.55,
            1.0,
            1.0)
    end
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA004
-- @duration 2.8
-- @title Brake Pileup
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=2.4
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
--[[ @description
A running line brakes suddenly; trailing letters collide, squash, and pile up. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
走ってきた先頭文字が急停止し、後続の文字がぶつかって圧縮される玉突き演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kEntryDistance = 1.1 -- canvas widths traveled before the brake point
local kBrakeTime = 0.7 -- seconds until the lead character halts in place
local kRunLean = -10.0 -- degrees; negative tips the glyph toward screen left (travel direction)
local kRunStretch = 0.15 -- extra horizontal stretch while sprinting
local kBrakeTip = -28.0 -- lead character's forward pitch at the brake moment
local kGapCompression = 0.45 -- compression factor of the piled spacing
local kPileTall = 0.18 -- baseline vertical squash stretch when piled up
local kImpactPunch = 0.08 -- impact stretch factor (subtle/restrained)
local kImpactFrequency = 3.5 -- lower frequency for the initial impact wiggle
local kImpactDamping = 10.0 -- high damping for the initial impact
local kHoldTime = 0.3 -- pause between the last crash and the realignment
local kRecoverDuration = 1.1 -- seconds to ease back into natural layout (longer for elastic settle)

-- Running animation parameters
local kRunFrequency = 16.0 -- step frequency (steps per second)
local kRunJumpHeight = 0.035 -- vertical bounce height
local kRunAngleOsc = 4.0 -- tilt oscillation amplitude while running
local kRunStretchOsc = 0.06 -- stretch oscillation amplitude while running

-- Cushion parameters (preventing single-frame harsh stops)
local kImpactRiseTime = 0.07 -- seconds taken to reach peak squish (soft cushion)
local kTipRiseTime = 0.05 -- seconds taken to reach peak forward lean (preventing 1-frame rotation snap)
local kOvertakeBuffer = 0.07 -- timeline buffer to blend the brake transition
local kLandDecay = 12.0 -- exponential decay rate for soft vertical landing (preventing drop snap)
local kDecelDuration = 0.18 -- seconds of late deceleration right before hitting the pile

local kRunSpeed = kEntryDistance / kBrakeTime -- canvas widths per second

local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local leadX = ctx.chars[1].geometry.bounds_center_x

    -- Calculate crash times based on kinematics. Trailing characters have a longer distance
    -- to travel to the pile-up point, so they crash sequentially from front to back.
    local crashTimes = {}
    local pileShifts = {}
    local maxShift = 0.0
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local pileShift = (character.geometry.bounds_center_x - leadX) * kGapCompression
        pileShifts[index] = pileShift
        crashTimes[index] = kBrakeTime + pileShift / kRunSpeed
        if pileShift > maxShift then
            maxShift = pileShift
        end
    end

    local lastCrashTime = kBrakeTime + maxShift / kRunSpeed
    local recoverStart = lastCrashTime + kHoldTime
    local introTime, _, _, outroProgress =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, recoverStart + kRecoverDuration, 0.5, kFallbackClipLength)

    -- Elastic recovery easing
    local recover = mt.ease.out_elastic(mt.saturate(
        mt.inverse_lerp(recoverStart, recoverStart + kRecoverDuration, introTime)
    ))

    -- Pass 1: Calculate temporary stretch, rotation, and offset_x / offset_y per character
    local stretchXs = {}
    local stretchYs = {}
    local rotations = {}
    local tempOffsetsX = {}
    local tempOffsetsY = {}

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local crashTime = crashTimes[index]
        local pileShift = pileShifts[index]

        local offsetX
        local offsetY
        local rotation
        local stretchX
        local stretchY

        -- Round total run cycle to the nearest integer multiple of pi so that
        -- the character always lands exactly on the ground (offsetY = 0.5) at the moment of impact.
        local rawSteps = crashTime * (kRunFrequency / math.pi)
        local roundedSteps = math.floor(rawSteps + 0.5)
        local targetRunCycle = roundedSteps * math.pi
        local brakeTimeStart = crashTime - kDecelDuration

        if introTime < crashTime then
            -- Sprint phase: sprint at constant speed initially, and apply a late deceleration
            -- (local brake) only when close to the crash point.
            local cycle
            local runStretch = kRunStretch

            if introTime < brakeTimeStart then
                -- Constant velocity sprint: unaware of the collision ahead
                offsetX = 0.5 + kEntryDistance - kRunSpeed * introTime
                cycle = introTime * kRunFrequency
                rotation = kRunLean + math.cos(cycle * 2.0) * kRunAngleOsc
                runStretch = kRunStretch + math.sin(cycle * 2.0) * kRunStretchOsc
            else
                -- Late deceleration phase: apply local ease-out quadratic brake to match speed profile
                local u = (introTime - brakeTimeStart) / kDecelDuration
                local ease = u * (2.0 - u) -- Out quadratic ease

                local xBrake = 0.5 + kEntryDistance - kRunSpeed * brakeTimeStart
                local xTarget = 0.5 - pileShift
                offsetX = mt.lerp(xBrake, xTarget, ease)

                -- Decelerate the foot stride cycle as well, aligning with ground phase-rounded end
                local cycleBrakeStart = brakeTimeStart * kRunFrequency
                cycle = mt.lerp(cycleBrakeStart, targetRunCycle, ease)

                -- Blend lean angle and stretch down to impact configuration
                rotation = mt.lerp(kRunLean + math.cos(cycle * 2.0) * kRunAngleOsc, kRunLean, ease)
                runStretch = mt.lerp(kRunStretch + math.sin(cycle * 2.0) * kRunStretchOsc, kRunStretch, ease)
            end

            offsetY = 0.5 + math.abs(math.sin(cycle)) * kRunJumpHeight
            stretchX = 1.0 + runStretch
            stretchY = 1.0 / (1.0 + runStretch)
        else
            -- Piled phase
            local sinceCrash = introTime - crashTime
            offsetX = 0.5 - pileShift

            -- Smoothly decay the last running jump bounce height to ground (0.5).
            local lastBounce = math.abs(math.sin(targetRunCycle)) * kRunJumpHeight
            offsetY = 0.5 + lastBounce * math.exp(-sinceCrash * kLandDecay)

            -- Hold the forward lean angle during the pile-up phase,
            -- and let it recover dynamically in sync with the physical layout recovery (recover).
            local rise = mt.saturate(sinceCrash / kTipRiseTime)
            local tipAngle = (index == 1) and kBrakeTip or kRunLean
            local baseRotation = tipAngle * rise

            -- Cushion the vertical stretch so the squash builds up over a few frames (kImpactRiseTime)
            local impactFactor = (sinceCrash / kImpactRiseTime) * math.exp(1.0 - sinceCrash / kImpactRiseTime)
            local punch = kImpactPunch * impactFactor
            local baseTall = kPileTall * mt.saturate(sinceCrash / kOvertakeBuffer) + punch

            -- Cascading impacts: trailing impacts propagate non-oscillating squeezing force forward
            local extraTall = 0.0
            local extraOffset = 0.0
            local extraRotation = 0.0

            for j = index + 1, ctx.char_count do
                local sinceOtherCrash = introTime - crashTimes[j]
                if sinceOtherCrash >= 0 then
                    local dist = j - index
                    local attenuation = 1.0 / (dist * 0.8 + 0.2) -- Attenuate the shock based on distance

                    -- Smooth rise-and-decay impulse envelope for the shock wave
                    local press = (sinceOtherCrash / kImpactRiseTime) * math.exp(1.0 - sinceOtherCrash / kImpactRiseTime)

                    -- Additional vertical squashing is applied to all characters, including the lead
                    extraTall = extraTall + 0.08 * press * attenuation

                    -- The lead character (index == 1) is the heaviest and remains anchored in position/angle
                    if index > 1 then
                        -- Shoved further left (forward)
                        extraOffset = extraOffset - 0.025 * press * attenuation
                        -- Tilted further forward from the shove
                        extraRotation = extraRotation - 6.0 * press * attenuation
                    end
                end
            end

            offsetX = offsetX + extraOffset
            rotation = baseRotation + extraRotation

            local tall = baseTall + extraTall
            stretchY = 1.0 + tall
            stretchX = 1.0 / (1.0 + tall)
        end

        stretchXs[index] = stretchX
        stretchYs[index] = stretchY
        rotations[index] = rotation
        tempOffsetsX[index] = offsetX
        tempOffsetsY[index] = offsetY
    end

    -- Pass 2: Boundary clamping with sub-frame cushion to prevent characters from slipping past each other
    local actualXs = {}
    local kOverlapFactor = 0.85 -- Allow slight overlapping for a squashed/packed visual feel

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geom = character.geometry
        -- Temporary X position by adding offset to natural position
        local tempX = geom.bounds_center_x + (tempOffsetsX[index] - 0.5)

        if index == 1 then
            actualXs[1] = tempX
        else
            local prevGeom = ctx.chars[index - 1].geometry
            -- Consider current physical width scaled by stretch_x
            local curWidth = geom.bounds_width * stretchXs[index]
            local prevWidth = prevGeom.bounds_width * stretchXs[index - 1]

            -- Soften physical boundary on impact: momentarily allow a deeper overlap (cushion),
            -- then spring back to the default packed distance (kOverlapFactor).
            local currentOverlap = kOverlapFactor
            local sinceCrash = introTime - crashTimes[index]
            if sinceCrash >= 0 then
                local dip = 0.12 * math.exp(-sinceCrash * 6.0) -- Rapidly returns to normal packed state
                currentOverlap = kOverlapFactor - dip
            end

            -- Minimum distance for adjacent characters to touch
            local minDist = (curWidth + prevWidth) * 0.5 * currentOverlap

            -- Cannot move left of the preceding character's right boundary (prevent overtaking)
            actualXs[index] = math.max(tempX, actualXs[index - 1] + minDist)
        end
    end

    -- Pass 3: Back-calculate offset_x and apply final state values
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do

        -- Back-calculate the clamped offset_x in the piled state
        local clampedOffsetX = actualXs[index] - character.geometry.bounds_center_x + 0.5

        -- Blend with recovery easing and apply final transform values
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + (mt.lerp(clampedOffsetX, 0.5, recover)) - 0.5
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + (mt.lerp(tempOffsetsY[index], 0.5, recover)) - 0.5
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (mt.lerp(rotations[index], 0.0, recover))
        character.stretch_x = character.stretch_x * (mt.lerp(stretchXs[index], 1.0, recover))
        character.stretch_y = character.stretch_y * (mt.lerp(stretchYs[index], 1.0, recover))
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroProgress))
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA005
-- @duration 4
-- @title Green Light
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=2.25
--[[ @description
Letters jog in place, crouch together, and sprint away one by one. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
その場で足踏みする文字列が一斉にしゃがみ、順に走り去る演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kReactionWindow = 0.9 -- seconds between the first and last launch
local kExitDuration = 1.1 -- seconds a character needs to clear the frame
local kCrouchLead = 0.25 -- seconds before the first launch the crouch hits
local kFallbackClipLength = 4.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kRevFrequency = 10.0 -- in-place jog steps per second while waiting
local kRevBounce = 0.008 -- canvas fraction of the waiting bounce
local kRevLean = -3.0 -- slight eager lean while waiting (negative = travel direction)
local kCrouchSquash = 0.18 -- vertical squash at the ready crouch
local kCrouchLean = 6.0 -- backward wind-up lean at the crouch
local kKickStretch = 0.3 -- horizontal stretch at the kick-off
local kRunLean = -12.0 -- forward lean while sprinting away
local kRunFrequency = 16.0 -- run-cycle steps per second
local kRunJumpHeight = 0.03 -- canvas fraction of the run bounce
local kAcceleration = 1.6 -- canvas widths per second^2 after launch

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local _, remainingSeconds, introProgress =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, 0.4, kExitDuration + kReactionWindow + kCrouchLead, kFallbackClipLength)
    local characterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local launchSpacing = kReactionWindow / characterCount

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do

        -- Remaining time at which this character launches: the lead
        -- (index 1) goes first, and the last launch still leaves
        -- kExitDuration to clear the frame.
        local launchRemaining = kExitDuration + kReactionWindow - (index - 1) * launchSpacing
        local sinceLaunch = launchRemaining - remainingSeconds
        local crouch = mt.saturate((sinceLaunch + kCrouchLead) / 0.1)

        local offsetX = 0.5
        local offsetY = 0.5
        local rotation
        local stretchX
        local stretchY

        if sinceLaunch >= 0.0 then
            -- Sprinting away: constant acceleration plus the run cycle.
            local kick = mt.saturate(sinceLaunch / 0.15)
            local cycle = sinceLaunch * kRunFrequency
            offsetX = 0.5 - 0.5 * kAcceleration * sinceLaunch * sinceLaunch
            offsetY = 0.5 + math.abs(math.sin(cycle)) * kRunJumpHeight * kick
            rotation = mt.lerp(kCrouchLean, kRunLean, kick)
            stretchX = 1.0 + kKickStretch * kick
            stretchY = 1.0 / (1.0 + kKickStretch * kick)
        elseif crouch > 0.0 then
            -- Ready crouch: everyone winds up together just before green.
            rotation = kCrouchLean * crouch
            stretchX = 1.0 + kCrouchSquash * crouch
            stretchY = 1.0 - kCrouchSquash * crouch
        else
            -- Impatient rev: jogging in place, phase-shifted per character.
            local revCycle = ctx.time * kRevFrequency + index * 1.7
            offsetY = 0.5 + math.abs(math.sin(revCycle)) * kRevBounce
            rotation = kRevLean + math.cos(revCycle * 2.0) * 1.5
            stretchX = 1.0 + math.sin(revCycle) * 0.02
            stretchY = 1.0 / stretchX
        end

        character.opacity = character.opacity * mt.ease.out_quad(introProgress)
        character.pivot_y = 0.5 - character.geometry.bounds_height * 0.5
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + (offsetX) - 0.5
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + (offsetY) - 0.5
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (rotation)
        character.stretch_x = character.stretch_x * (stretchX)
        character.stretch_y = character.stretch_y * (stretchY)
    end
end
