-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA006
-- @duration 4
-- @title Domino Shove
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=2.4
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
--[[ @description
A late runner hits the line, sending a domino topple wave through the letters. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
後から走ってきた文字が列へぶつかり、ドミノのように傾きが伝わる演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kImpactTime = 0.9 -- seconds until the runner hits the tail
local kEntryDistance = 1.0 -- canvas widths the runner travels
local kRunLean = -14.0 -- runner's forward lean while sprinting
local kRunFrequency = 16.0 -- run-cycle steps per second
local kRunJumpHeight = 0.03 -- canvas fraction of the run bounce
local kRunStretch = 0.18 -- speed stretch while sprinting
local kCrashSquash = 0.45 -- runner's horizontal squash at impact
local kCrashRecover = 0.8 -- seconds the runner takes to pop back
local kWaveDelay = 0.06 -- seconds the topple wave takes per character
local kTipMax = 26.0 -- degrees of forward pitch right next to the impact
local kTipRise = 0.07 -- seconds each tip takes to reach its peak
local kTipRecover = 0.9 -- seconds each character takes to spring upright
local kShoveDistance = 0.02 -- canvas fraction shoved forward at full strength
local kFadeLead = 0.6 -- seconds before clip end the fade starts
local kFadeStagger = 0.4 -- fade cascade across characters
local kFallbackClipLength = 4.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introTime, remainingSeconds =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, kImpactTime + math.max(ctx.char_count - 1, 0) * kWaveDelay + math.max(kCrashRecover, kTipRecover), kFadeLead, kFallbackClipLength)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

        local fadeAmount = mt.saturate(1.0 - remainingSeconds / kFadeLead)
    local runnerIndex = ctx.char_count
    local runSpeed = kEntryDistance / kImpactTime

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do

        local offsetX = 0.5
        local offsetY = 0.5
        local rotation = 0.0
        local stretchX = 1.0
        local stretchY = 1.0

        if index == runnerIndex then
            if introTime < kImpactTime then
                -- Full-speed entry, blissfully unaware of the line ahead.
                local cycle = introTime * kRunFrequency
                offsetX = 0.5 + kEntryDistance - runSpeed * introTime
                offsetY = 0.5 + math.abs(math.sin(cycle)) * kRunJumpHeight
                rotation = kRunLean + math.cos(cycle * 2.0) * 4.0
                stretchX = 1.0 + kRunStretch
                stretchY = 1.0 / (1.0 + kRunStretch)
            else
                -- Face-first squash, then an elastic pop back to shape.
                local sinceCrash = introTime - kImpactTime
                local recover = mt.ease.out_elastic(mt.saturate(sinceCrash / kCrashRecover))
                local squash = kCrashSquash * (1.0 - recover)
                rotation = kRunLean * (1.0 - recover)
                stretchX = 1.0 - squash
                stretchY = 1.0 + squash
            end
        else
            -- Topple wave: the shock reaches this character after a
            -- per-step delay and decays with the distance from the tail.
            local distanceFromImpact = runnerIndex - index
            local tipStart = kImpactTime + distanceFromImpact * kWaveDelay
            local sinceTip = introTime - tipStart
            if sinceTip >= 0.0 then
                local attenuation = 1.0 / (distanceFromImpact * 0.45 + 0.55)
                local rise = mt.saturate(sinceTip / kTipRise)
                local recover = mt.ease.out_elastic(mt.saturate(sinceTip / kTipRecover))
                local strength = rise * (1.0 - recover) * attenuation

                rotation = -kTipMax * strength
                offsetX = 0.5 - kShoveDistance * strength
            end
        end

        local fade = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(fadeAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))

        character.pivot_y = 0.5 - character.geometry.bounds_height * 0.5
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + (offsetX) - 0.5
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + (offsetY) - 0.5
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (rotation)
        character.stretch_x = character.stretch_x * (stretchX)
        character.stretch_y = character.stretch_y * (stretchY)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (1.0 - fade)
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA007
-- @duration 5
-- @title Focus Flow
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.0
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.0
--[[ @description
A magnifying focus swells each letter and pushes its neighbors aside as it passes. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
拡大する焦点が文字列を通過し、近くの文字を押し広げながら強調する演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kSecondsPerCharacter = 0.09 -- sweep rate; smaller = snappier
local kSweepPadding = 1.5 -- the sweep starts/ends this many characters off each end
local kFocusBoost = 0.45 -- extra scale at the focus center
local kFocusSigma = 1.4 -- gaussian width of the focus, in characters
local kRetypesetTracking = 0.012 -- spacing handed to mt.layout.reflow
local kRevealSoftness = 1.2 -- how tightly appearance hugs the passing focus
local kWiggleDegrees = 1.1 -- micro rotation drift keeping the hold organic
local kWiggleSpeed = 0.8 -- wiggle time scale
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kRestFill = { r = 1.0, g = 1.0, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 } -- resting color of the line
local kFocusFill = { r = 1.0, g = 0.78, b = 0.25, a = 1.0 } -- accent while the focus crosses

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local characterCount = ctx.char_count

    local sweepSpan = characterCount + 2.0 * kSweepPadding
    local secondsPerCharacter = kSecondsPerCharacter
    local sweepDuration = sweepSpan * secondsPerCharacter
    local introTime, remainingSeconds =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, sweepDuration, sweepDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    -- Focus positions in index space. The intro sweep starts at clip
    -- start; the outro sweep ends exactly at clip end.
    local introFocus = -kSweepPadding + introTime / secondsPerCharacter
    local outroFocus = -kSweepPadding + (sweepDuration - remainingSeconds) / secondsPerCharacter

    -- Pass 1: swell, reveal, and wipe. Scale must be final before the
    -- reflow so retypeset sees the true character widths.
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local introDistance = index - introFocus
        local outroDistance = index - outroFocus
        local focus = math.max(
            mt.falloff(introDistance, kFocusSigma),
            mt.falloff(outroDistance, kFocusSigma))

        -- A character exists from the moment the intro focus reaches it
        -- until the outro focus has passed over it.
        local revealed = mt.smoothstep(-kRevealSoftness, 0.0, introFocus - index)
        local wiped = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kRevealSoftness, outroFocus - index)

        character.scale = character.scale * (1.0 + kFocusBoost * mt.ease.out_quad(focus))
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (revealed * (1.0 - wiped))
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (mt.wiggle(ctx.time * kWiggleSpeed, 2.5, kWiggleDegrees, 2, index * 10))

        -- Color rides the same focus weight as the swell, so the accent
        -- travels with the magnifier and cools back to the resting color.
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(kRestFill, kFocusFill, focus)
    end

    -- Pass 2: reflow around the line's center character. Using a stable
    -- center anchor prevents discrete jumps when focus shifts across indices.
    local anchorIndex = math.ceil(ctx.char_count / 2)
    ctx.chars[anchorIndex].offset_x = ctx.chars[anchorIndex].offset_x
    mt.layout.reflow(ctx, kRetypesetTracking, {
        mode = "horizontal",
        anchor = anchorIndex,
    })
end

--[[ @description
One deterministic random letter puffs up and elastically settles, briefly squeezing its neighbors.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
ときどき一文字が膨らみ、周囲を押し広げてから弾性的に戻る演出です。対象はインスタンスseedから決まり、シークしても変わりません。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kFadeStagger = 0.3 -- entrance/exit cascade across characters
local kFirstHiccupDelay = 1.2 -- seconds before the first hiccup
local kHiccupInterval = 1.7 -- average seconds between hiccups
local kHiccupJitter = 0.8 -- random extra delay per hiccup
local kSwellAmount = 0.65 -- extra scale at the peak of a hiccup
local kSwellRise = 0.09 -- seconds the puff takes to reach its peak
local kSettleDuration = 0.7 -- seconds the elastic settle takes
local kMaxEvents = 64 -- scheduling scan limit
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed

    -- Find the most recent hiccup at or before now. Events are spaced by
    -- at least the base interval, so at most one is ever in flight.
    local latestOrdinal = 0
    local latestTime = 0.0
    local eventTime = kFirstHiccupDelay
    for ordinal = 1, kMaxEvents do
        eventTime = eventTime + mt.random_range(seed, ordinal, 0.0, kHiccupJitter)
        if eventTime > ctx.time then
            break
        end
        latestOrdinal = ordinal
        latestTime = eventTime
        eventTime = eventTime + kHiccupInterval
    end

    -- Hiccups only fire while the telop is fully on screen.
    local calm = mt.saturate(introAmount * 2.0 - 1.0) * (1.0 - outroAmount)
    local swell = 0.0
    local hiccupIndex = 1
    if latestOrdinal > 0 then
        local sinceHiccup = ctx.time - latestTime
        local rise = mt.saturate(sinceHiccup / kSwellRise)
        local settle = mt.ease.out_elastic(mt.saturate(sinceHiccup / kSettleDuration))
        swell = kSwellAmount * rise * (1.0 - settle) * calm
        hiccupIndex = math.floor(mt.random_range(
            seed, latestOrdinal + kMaxEvents, 1.0, ctx.char_count + 0.999))
        hiccupIndex = mt.clamp(hiccupIndex, 1, ctx.char_count)
    end

    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local appear = mt.ease.out_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        local vanish = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (appear * (1.0 - vanish))
    end

    -- Touch the layout only while a hiccup is visibly in flight, so the
    -- resting telop keeps the untouched host layout.
    if swell > 0.001 then
        ctx.chars[hiccupIndex].scale = 1.0 + swell
        ctx.chars[hiccupIndex].offset_x = ctx.chars[hiccupIndex].offset_x
        mt.layout.reflow(ctx, 0.0, {
            anchor = hiccupIndex,
        })
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA009
-- @duration 8
-- @title Pass Through
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
--[[ @description
An invisible runner opens a traveling gap through an otherwise resting line.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
見えない何かが下を通るように、止まった文字列の隙間が移動して閉じる演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kFadeStagger = 0.3 -- entrance/exit cascade across characters
local kFirstPassDelay = 1.3 -- seconds before the first run
local kPassInterval = 2.2 -- average seconds between runs
local kPassJitter = 0.9 -- random extra delay per run
local kPassDuration = 0.55 -- seconds one run takes end to end
local kGapWidth = 0.016 -- canvas fraction each side is pushed at the peak
local kGapSpread = 1.3 -- characters over which the push decays
local kTiltDegrees = 7.0 -- characters lean away from the runner
local kMaxEvents = 64 -- scheduling scan limit
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local characterCount = ctx.char_count

    -- Most recent run at or before now (never more than one in flight).
    local latestOrdinal = 0
    local latestTime = 0.0
    local eventTime = kFirstPassDelay
    for ordinal = 1, kMaxEvents do
        eventTime = eventTime + mt.random_range(seed, ordinal, 0.0, kPassJitter)
        if eventTime > ctx.time then
            break
        end
        latestOrdinal = ordinal
        latestTime = eventTime
        eventTime = eventTime + kPassInterval
    end

    local calm = mt.saturate(introAmount * 2.0 - 1.0) * (1.0 - outroAmount)
    local gapStrength = 0.0
    local runnerPosition = 0.0
    if latestOrdinal > 0 then
        local runProgress = (ctx.time - latestTime) / kPassDuration
        if runProgress <= 1.0 then
            -- The gap eases open on entry and shut on exit of the run.
            gapStrength = math.sin(mt.saturate(runProgress) * math.pi) * calm
            -- Runner travels past both ends; direction alternates.
            local span = characterCount + 2.0 * kGapSpread
            local along = -kGapSpread + runProgress * span
            if latestOrdinal % 2 == 0 then
                along = characterCount + kGapSpread - runProgress * span
            end
            runnerPosition = along
        end
    end

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local appear = mt.ease.out_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        local vanish = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (appear * (1.0 - vanish))

        if gapStrength > 0.001 then
            local distance = index - runnerPosition
            local falloff = mt.falloff(distance, kGapSpread)
            local side = 1.0
            if distance < 0.0 then
                side = -1.0
            end
            character.offset_x = character.offset_x + side * falloff * kGapWidth * gapStrength
            character.rotation = character.rotation + (side * falloff * kTiltDegrees * gapStrength)
        end
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA010
-- @duration 8
-- @title Bellows Wave
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.6
--[[ @description
Compression waves race from a seeded origin, squeezing and stretching real letter spacing.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字列の一か所から両端へ圧縮と伸長が伝わり、字間も蛇腹のように動く演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.6 -- seconds
local kFadeStagger = 0.3 -- entrance/exit cascade across characters
local kFirstWaveDelay = 1.2 -- seconds before the first wave
local kWaveInterval = 2.4 -- average seconds between waves
local kWaveJitter = 1.0 -- random extra delay per wave
local kWaveSpeed = 14.0 -- characters per second the front travels
local kPulseWidth = 1.1 -- characters wide the squeeze/stretch pulse is
local kPulseAmount = 0.3 -- stretch_x swing at the peak
local kTintStrength = 0.8 -- how strongly the tint rides the front
local kMaxEvents = 64 -- scheduling scan limit
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kBaseFill = { r = 1.0, g = 1.0, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kWaveFill = { r = 0.45, g = 0.75, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local characterCount = ctx.char_count

    -- Most recent wave at or before now.
    local latestOrdinal = 0
    local latestTime = 0.0
    local eventTime = kFirstWaveDelay
    for ordinal = 1, kMaxEvents do
        eventTime = eventTime + mt.random_range(seed, ordinal, 0.0, kWaveJitter)
        if eventTime > ctx.time then
            break
        end
        latestOrdinal = ordinal
        latestTime = eventTime
        eventTime = eventTime + kWaveInterval
    end

    local calm = mt.saturate(introAmount * 2.0 - 1.0) * (1.0 - outroAmount)
    local waveAlive = false
    local originIndex = 1
    local frontDistance = 0.0
    if latestOrdinal > 0 then
        originIndex = math.floor(mt.random_range(
            seed, latestOrdinal + kMaxEvents, 1.0, characterCount + 0.999))
        originIndex = mt.clamp(originIndex, 1, characterCount)
        frontDistance = (ctx.time - latestTime) * kWaveSpeed
        -- The wave dies once the front has cleared the farther end.
        local farthestReach = math.max(originIndex - 1, characterCount - originIndex)
            + kPulseWidth * 3.0
        waveAlive = frontDistance <= farthestReach and calm > 0.001
    end

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local appear = mt.ease.out_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        local vanish = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (appear * (1.0 - vanish))

        if waveAlive then
            -- Signed distance from the wavefront: negative before the
            -- front arrives, positive after it has passed. The pulse
            -- squeezes just ahead of the front and stretches just
            -- behind it (derivative-of-gaussian profile).
            local behindFront = frontDistance - math.abs(index - originIndex)
            local normalized = behindFront / kPulseWidth
            local pulse = -normalized * math.exp(-normalized * normalized)

            character.stretch_x = character.stretch_x * (1.0 + pulse * kPulseAmount * 2.0 * calm)
            local tint = math.exp(-normalized * normalized) * kTintStrength * calm
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(kBaseFill, kWaveFill, tint)
        end
    end

    -- Accordion spacing: reflow around the wave's origin so the width
    -- pulse folds real pleats instead of overlapping glyphs.
    if waveAlive then
        ctx.chars[originIndex].offset_x = ctx.chars[originIndex].offset_x
        mt.layout.reflow(ctx, 0.0, {
            anchor = originIndex,
        })
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA011
-- @duration 8
-- @title Calm Breath
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.7
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.7
--[[ @description
The text slowly inhales, holds, exhales, and rests through scale, width, spacing, and height.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字列全体が拡大率・横幅・字間・高さを変えながら、吸う・止める・吐く・休むの周期を繰り返す演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kBreathPeriod = 5.2 -- seconds per full breath
local kInhaleEnd = 0.32 -- normalized end of the inhale
local kHoldEnd = 0.42 -- normalized end of the full-lung hold
local kExhaleEnd = 0.88 -- normalized end of the exhale
local kBreathScale = 0.055 -- scale gain at full inhale
local kBreathStretch = 0.035 -- horizontal expansion at full inhale
local kBreathTracking = 0.018 -- em added at full inhale
local kBreathLift = 0.004 -- canvas-height lift at full inhale
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

local function getBreathAmount(time)
    -- Four deliberately unequal phases make the motion read as breathing
    -- instead of an endlessly oscillating scale control.
    local phase = (time % kBreathPeriod) / kBreathPeriod
    local amount = 0.0
    if phase < kInhaleEnd then
        amount = mt.ease.in_out_sine(phase / kInhaleEnd)
    elseif phase < kHoldEnd then
        amount = 1.0
    elseif phase < kExhaleEnd then
        amount = 1.0 - mt.ease.in_out_sine(
            (phase - kHoldEnd) / (kExhaleEnd - kHoldEnd))
    end
    return amount
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local fadeIn = mt.ease.out_quad(introAmount)
    local fadeOut = mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount)
    local breathAmount = getBreathAmount(ctx.time)

    ctx.global.scale = ctx.global.scale * (1.0 + breathAmount * kBreathScale)
    ctx.global.stretch_x = ctx.global.stretch_x * (1.0 + breathAmount * kBreathStretch)
    ctx.global.tracking = ctx.global.tracking + breathAmount * kBreathTracking
    ctx.global.position_y = ctx.global.position_y + breathAmount * kBreathLift
    ctx.global.opacity = ctx.global.opacity * fadeIn * (1.0 - fadeOut)
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA012
-- @duration 6
-- @recommend text "HERE|PULSE!|>"
-- @title Word Pulse
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.45
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.55
--[[ @description
One selected word beats as a phrase while neighboring text moves aside.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
選んだ単語だけがまとまって鼓動し、隣の文字を押し広げる演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。既定本文はHERE|PULSE!|>です。強調範囲はkWordStart／kWordEndの1始まりの文字番号で指定し、区切りの番号はkLeftDividerIndex／kRightDividerIndexで指定します。範囲は同じ1行に収めてください。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kWordStart = 6
local kWordEnd = 11
local kLeftDividerIndex = 5
local kRightDividerIndex = 12
local kIntroDuration = 0.45
local kOutroDuration = 0.55
local kFirstHeartbeatTime = 0.9
local kHeartbeatPeriod = 1.55
local kHeartbeatScale = 0.42
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kBaseFill = { r = 0.92, g = 0.95, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kDividerFill = { r = 0.25, g = 0.7, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kWordRestFill = { r = 1.0, g = 0.72, b = 0.18, a = 1.0 }
local kWordBeatFill = { r = 1.0, g = 0.18, b = 0.08, a = 1.0 }

local function pulseWindow(time, startTime, peakTime, endTime)
    local amount = 0.0
    if time >= startTime and time <= endTime then
        if time <= peakTime then
            amount = mt.smoothstep(startTime, peakTime, time)
        else
            amount = 1.0 - mt.smoothstep(peakTime, endTime, time)
        end
    end
    return amount
end

local function heartbeatAmount(time)
    local amount = 0.0
    if time >= kFirstHeartbeatTime then
        local beatTime = (time - kFirstHeartbeatTime) % kHeartbeatPeriod
        local primaryBeat = pulseWindow(beatTime, 0.0, 0.09, 0.3)
        local secondaryBeat = 0.52 * pulseWindow(beatTime, 0.31, 0.39, 0.62)
        amount = math.max(primaryBeat, secondaryBeat)
    end
    return amount
end

local function setPivotToHorizontalOrigin(character)
    local geometry = character.geometry
    character.pivot_x = 0.5 + geometry.canvas_origin_x - geometry.bounds_center_x
    character.pivot_y = 0.5 + geometry.canvas_origin_y - geometry.bounds_center_y
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count < kRightDividerIndex or ctx.chars[kWordStart].line_index ~= ctx.chars[ctx.char_count].line_index then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(
            ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_quad(introAmount) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount))
    local heartbeat = heartbeatAmount(ctx.time) * visibility
    local emphasizedScale = 1.0 + kHeartbeatScale * heartbeat

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (visibility)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = kBaseFill

        if index == kLeftDividerIndex or index >= kRightDividerIndex then
            character.fill.color = kDividerFill
        end

        if index >= kWordStart and index <= kWordEnd then
            character.scale = character.scale * (emphasizedScale)
            character.fill.color =
                mt.color.lerp(kWordRestFill, kWordBeatFill, heartbeat)

            -- Scaling around each glyph's horizontal typesetting origin
            -- keeps the word on a stable baseline.
            setPivotToHorizontalOrigin(character)
        end
    end

    -- Only the emphasized word and its suffix participate. The word's first
    -- character is the fixed anchor, so "HERE|" never moves. The right
    -- divider and arrow visibly absorb the word's changing advance.
    local reflowTargets = {}
    for index = kWordStart, ctx.char_count do
        table.insert(reflowTargets, index)
    end

    local anchor = ctx.chars[kWordStart]
    anchor.offset_x = anchor.offset_x
    anchor.offset_y = anchor.offset_y
    mt.layout.reflow(ctx, 0.0, {
        targets = reflowTargets,
        anchor = kWordStart,
        mode = "horizontal",
    })
end
description: One selected word beats as a phrase while neighboring text moves aside.

name: REA013_newtons_cradle.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id REA013
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Newton's Cradle
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.0
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.9
--[[ @description
End letters swing like Newton’s cradle while a brief impulse crosses the stationary middle.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
ニュートンのゆりかごのように両端の文字が振れ、中央を圧縮と色の衝撃が通り抜ける演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.0
local kIntroPullDuration = 0.7 -- seconds to pull the first end to its apex
local kOutroDuration = 0.9
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0

local kSwingLegDuration = 0.4 -- seconds between the contact point and apex
local kTransferDelayPerCharacter = 0.018 -- contact delay across one character
local kImpactDuration = 0.12 -- seconds of compression at each contact
local kMaximumSwingDegrees = 40.0
local kGlyphRotationRatio = 0.65 -- visible tilt relative to the pendulum angle
local kCableLength = 0.12 -- canvas-height radius of the pendulum arc
local kImpactSquash = 0.18
local kAssemblyLift = 0.07 -- canvas-height starting lift of the whole cradle

local function getFullSwingAngle(time, startTime, direction, swingLegDuration)
    -- One half-sine describes the complete physical leg: rest to apex and
    -- back to impact, without separate outbound and return keyframes.
    local duration = swingLegDuration * 2.0
    local active = time >= startTime and time <= startTime + duration
    local angle = 0.0
    if active then
        local progress = mt.saturate((time - startTime) / duration)
        angle = direction * kMaximumSwingDegrees * math.sin(progress * math.pi)
    end
    return angle
end

local function getRightSwingAngle(time, outboundStart, swingLegDuration)
    -- The cycle boundary is the right apex: first return to impact, then wait
    -- for the opposite transfer before swinging back out to the same apex.
    local angle = 0.0
    if time < swingLegDuration then
        local progress = time / swingLegDuration
        angle = kMaximumSwingDegrees * math.cos(progress * math.pi * 0.5)
    elseif time >= outboundStart then
        local progress = mt.saturate(
            (time - outboundStart) / swingLegDuration)
        angle = kMaximumSwingDegrees * math.sin(progress * math.pi * 0.5)
    end
    return angle
end

local function transitionDurations(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    return introSeconds * compression, outroSeconds * compression
end

local function getFittedSchedule(ctx, characterCount)
    -- Fit an integer number of impact-to-impact transfers into the available
    -- hold, so the outro always begins exactly when an end reaches contact.
    local clipDuration = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local introSeconds, outroSeconds = transitionDurations(ctx)
    local outroStart = math.max(introSeconds, clipDuration - outroSeconds)
    local motionDuration = math.max(outroStart - introSeconds, 0.0)
    local transferDuration =
        math.max(characterCount - 1, 0) * kTransferDelayPerCharacter
    local baseImpactInterval = 2.0 * kSwingLegDuration + transferDuration
    local impactTransferCount = math.max(0, math.floor(
        (motionDuration - kSwingLegDuration) / baseImpactInterval + 0.5))
    local fittedSwingLegDuration = kSwingLegDuration
    if motionDuration > 0.0 then
        fittedSwingLegDuration = math.max(
            motionDuration - impactTransferCount * transferDuration,
            0.001) / (1.0 + impactTransferCount * 2.0)
    end
    return outroStart,
        motionDuration,
        transferDuration,
        fittedSwingLegDuration,
        impactTransferCount
end

local function getImpactPulse(progress)
    -- stagger_pattern stays at zero before arrival and one after recovery,
    -- so a sine turns its normalized window into one compact contact pulse.
    return math.sin(progress * math.pi)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount = resolveTransitions(
        ctx,
        kIntroDuration,
        kOutroDuration,
        kFallbackClipLength)
    local characterCount = ctx.char_count
    local outroStart,
        motionDuration,
        transferDuration,
        swingLegDuration,
        impactTransferCount = getFittedSchedule(ctx, characterCount)
    local introSeconds = transitionDurations(ctx)
    local activeTime = math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds, 0.0)
    local mainTime = math.min(activeTime, motionDuration)
    local cycleDuration = 4.0 * swingLegDuration + 2.0 * transferDuration
    local cycleTime = mainTime % cycleDuration

    local rightImpactTime = swingLegDuration
    local leftSwingStart = rightImpactTime + transferDuration
    local leftImpactTime = leftSwingStart + swingLegDuration * 2.0
    local rightSwingOutStart = leftImpactTime + transferDuration
    local timeSinceLeftImpact = cycleTime - leftImpactTime
    if timeSinceLeftImpact < 0.0 then
        timeSinceLeftImpact = timeSinceLeftImpact + cycleDuration
    end
    local rightAngle = getRightSwingAngle(
        cycleTime,
        rightSwingOutStart,
        swingLegDuration)
    local leftAngle = getFullSwingAngle(
        cycleTime,
        leftSwingStart,
        -1.0,
        swingLegDuration)
    local pullProgress = mt.saturate(introAmount * kIntroDuration / kIntroPullDuration)
    local pullEased = mt.ease.in_out_sine(pullProgress)
    local introActive = introAmount < 1.0
    local outroActive = outroAmount > 0.0
    if introActive then
        rightAngle = kMaximumSwingDegrees * pullEased
        leftAngle = 0.0
    elseif outroActive then
        rightAngle = 0.0
        leftAngle = 0.0
    end

    local outroElapsed = outroAmount * kOutroDuration
    local fadeStart = math.min(
        transferDuration + kImpactDuration,
        kOutroDuration * 0.55)
    local fadeOut = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate(
        (outroElapsed - fadeStart)
            / math.max(kOutroDuration - fadeStart, 0.001)))
    local assemblyOffset = kAssemblyLift
        * mt.spring(ctx.time, 2.0, 5.0)
        * (1.0 - introAmount)

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local rightShockProgress = mt.stagger_pattern(
            cycleTime - rightImpactTime,
            index,
            characterCount,
            "desc",
            kTransferDelayPerCharacter,
            kImpactDuration)
        local leftShockProgress = mt.stagger_pattern(
            timeSinceLeftImpact,
            index,
            characterCount,
            "asc",
            kTransferDelayPerCharacter,
            kImpactDuration)
        local shockPulse = math.max(
            getImpactPulse(rightShockProgress),
            getImpactPulse(leftShockProgress))
        if introActive then
            shockPulse = 0.0
        elseif outroActive then
            local finalPattern = "desc"
            if impactTransferCount % 2 == 1 then
                finalPattern = "asc"
            end
            local finalShockProgress = mt.stagger_pattern(
                outroElapsed,
                index,
                characterCount,
                finalPattern,
                kTransferDelayPerCharacter,
                kImpactDuration)
            shockPulse = getImpactPulse(finalShockProgress)
        end

        local swingAngle = 0.0
        if characterCount == 1 then
            if introActive then
                swingAngle = rightAngle
            elseif outroActive then
                swingAngle = 0.0
            else
                swingAngle = mt.wave(
                    activeTime,
                    1.0 / (4.0 * swingLegDuration),
                    math.pi * 0.5) * kMaximumSwingDegrees
                shockPulse = mt.falloff(
                    swingAngle / kMaximumSwingDegrees,
                    0.12)
            end
        elseif index == 1 then
            swingAngle = leftAngle
        elseif index == characterCount then
            swingAngle = rightAngle
        end

        if index == 1 or index == characterCount then
            -- Place the glyph center on an explicit pendulum arc. Using the
            -- canvas helpers keeps the radius correct under global transforms.
            local restingX, restingY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
            local visibleSwingDegrees = swingAngle
            local visibleAngle = math.rad(visibleSwingDegrees)
            local targetX = restingX + kCableLength * math.sin(visibleAngle)
            local targetY = restingY
                + kCableLength * (1.0 - math.cos(visibleAngle))
            character.rotation = character.rotation
                - visibleSwingDegrees * kGlyphRotationRatio
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, targetX, targetY)
        end

        local squash = shockPulse * kImpactSquash
        character.stretch_x = character.stretch_x * (1.0 - squash)
        character.stretch_y = character.stretch_y * (1.0 + squash * 0.35)

        local baseColor, fillMode = mt.color.resolve_fill(ctx, character)
        if fillMode ~= "transparent" and shockPulse > 0.0 then
            -- Gradient End Color doubles as an inspector-defined impact color
            -- even when the rendered gradient itself is disabled.
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(
                baseColor,
                ctx.global.gradient.end_color,
                mt.saturate(shockPulse))
        end

        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + assemblyOffset
        character.opacity = character.opacity
            * mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount)
            * (1.0 - fadeOut)
    end
end
description: End letters swing like Newton’s cradle while a brief impulse crosses the stationary middle.

name: ROT001_rotate_in.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id ROT001
-- @duration 5
-- @title Rotate In
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
--[[ @description
Tilted characters rotate into place, hold, then rotate away.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
傾いた文字が回転して定位置に収まり、最後に回転して消えます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local position = info.progress
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        character.rotation = character.rotation + 30.0 * amount * (exit - (1.0 - entrance))
    end
end
description: Tilted characters rotate into place, hold, then rotate away.

descriptions.ja: 傾いた文字が回転して定位置に収まり、最後に回転して消えます。

title: Rotate In
author: Mug

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id ROT002
-- @duration 5
-- @title Hinge Swing
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
--[[ @description
Characters swing from their upper edges and gently settle into place.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字が上端を支点に揺れて現れ、定位置に収まります。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local position = info.progress
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        local swing = 1.0 - mt.ease.out_elastic(intro)
        local rotation = 35.0 * amount * (swing + exit)
        if math.abs(rotation) > 0.000001 then
            mt.layout.pivot_at_2d(ctx, character, "top")
            character.rotation = character.rotation + rotation
        end
    end
end
description: Characters swing from their upper edges and gently settle into place.

descriptions.ja: 文字が上端を支点に揺れて現れ、定位置に収まります。

author: Mug

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SCR001
-- @duration 8
-- @title End Credits
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "DIRECTOR\nAki Tanaka\nDESIGN\nMika Sato\nMUSIC\nRen Suzuki"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input number 7 "Scroll Speed (em/s)" default=1.5
--[[ @description
Multiple lines scroll upward at a steady speed with a short entrance and exit.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
複数行の文字が短く現れ、一定速度で上へ流れて消えます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress)
    local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress)
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], -10.0, 10.0)
    local fontHeight = ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent
    local duration = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackDuration)
    local scroll = (ctx.time - duration * 0.5) * speed * fontHeight * amount
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + scroll
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
    end
end
description: Multiple lines scroll upward at a steady speed with a short entrance and exit.

descriptions.ja: 複数行の文字が短く現れ、一定速度で上へ流れて消えます。

title: End Credits
author: Mug

name: SCR002_horizontal_ticker.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SCR002
-- @duration 8
-- @title Horizontal Ticker
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend text "LATEST NEWS — New release available now"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input boolean 4 "Repeat" default=true
-- @input number 7 "Scroll Speed (em/s)" default=3.0
--[[ @description
Text scrolls horizontally and repeats after it leaves the frame.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字が横に流れ、画面を出た後に繰り返します。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress)
    local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress)
    local speed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], -10.0, 10.0)
    local fontHeight = ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent
    local fontWidth = fontHeight / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local distance = ctx.time * speed * fontWidth * amount
    local targets = {}
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do targets[index] = index end
    local bounds = mt.layout.measure_bounds_2d(ctx, targets)
    local width = bounds and bounds.width or 0.0
    local travel = 1.0 + width
    local scroll = -distance
    if ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and math.abs(speed) * amount > 0.0 and bounds then
        local phase = math.abs(distance) % math.max(travel, 1.0)
        if speed >= 0.0 then scroll = 1.0 + width * 0.5 - bounds.center_x - phase
        else scroll = -width * 0.5 - bounds.center_x + phase end
    end
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local currentX, currentY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
        mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, character, currentX + scroll, currentY)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
    end
end
description: Text scrolls horizontally and repeats after it leaves the frame.

descriptions.ja: 文字が横に流れ、画面を出た後に繰り返します。

title: Horizontal Ticker
author: Mug

name: SFR001_leaf_corners.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SFR001
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Leaf Corners
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "Sample Text\nA Gentle Beginning"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input boolean 3 "Border" default=false
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.4
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 3 "Edge Inset (% height)" default=4
-- @input number 4 "Decoration Size (% height)" default=14
-- @input number 5 "Line Width (% height)" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Idle Speed (Hz)" default=0.3
-- @input number 7 "Idle Amount" default=0.5
-- @input color 1 "Primary Color" default={0.49,0.68,0.55,1}
-- @input color 2 "Accent Color" default={0.76,0.84,0.64,1}
--[[ @description
Leafy branches grow into all four screen corners and softly sway, even with no text.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
四隅にセージグリーンの枝葉をあしらいます。左上と右下を大きくし、枝が伸びたところから葉が開きます。待機中は葉がそっと揺れます。

画面サイズを基準に配置する装飾で、本文が空でも表示します。Edge Inset (% height)・Decoration Size (% height) で余白と大きさ、Border で枠線の有無を調整できます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。本文の位置・書体・色を保ち、装飾は本文の後ろに描きます。補助グリフを2つ使い、空きが1つなら装飾を単色で描き、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function segment(path, first, last, width)
    local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
    local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    if length > kEpsilon and width > kEpsilon then
        local normalX, normalY = -differenceY / length * width * 0.5, differenceX / length * width * 0.5
        path:move_to(first.x - normalX, first.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x - normalX, last.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x + normalX, last.y + normalY)
        path:line_to(first.x + normalX, first.y + normalY)
        path:close()
        circle(path, first.x, first.y, width * 0.5)
        circle(path, last.x, last.y, width * 0.5)
    end
end

local function pathLength(points)
    local result = 0.0
    for index = 2, #points do
        local differenceX, differenceY = points[index].x - points[index - 1].x, points[index].y - points[index - 1].y
        result = result + math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    end
    return result
end

local function pointAlong(points, distance)
    local remaining = math.max(distance, 0.0)
    local result = points[#points]
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining <= length and length > kEpsilon then
            local progress = remaining / length
            result = { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, progress), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, progress) }
            break
        end
        remaining = remaining - length
    end
    return result
end

local function stroke(path, points, width, progress)
    local remaining = pathLength(points) * mt.saturate(progress)
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining > kEpsilon and length > kEpsilon then
            local portion = mt.saturate(remaining / length)
            segment(path, first, { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, portion), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, portion) }, width)
        end
        remaining = math.max(remaining - length, 0.0)
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- A mirror reverses each outline's winding, and under the nonzero fill rule a reversed outline that
-- overlaps an unmirrored one in the same path cancels it into a hole. Mirrored subpaths are therefore
-- written back to front, which restores their winding without changing their shape.
local function at(path, horizontal, vertical, scale, angle, mirrorX, mirrorY)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle or 0.0), math.sin(angle or 0.0)
    local mirrored = (mirrorX or 1.0) * (mirrorY or 1.0) < 0.0
    local start, segments = nil, {}
    local function point(x, y)
        x, y = x * (mirrorX or 1.0), y * (mirrorY or 1.0)
        return horizontal + (x * cosine - y * sine) * (scale or 1.0),
            vertical + (x * sine + y * cosine) * (scale or 1.0)
    end
    local function flush(closed)
        if start ~= nil then
            local last = #segments > 0 and segments[#segments].to or start
            path:move_to(last[1], last[2])
            for index = #segments, 1, -1 do
                local entry = segments[index]
                local previous = index > 1 and segments[index - 1].to or start
                if entry.controls then
                    path:cubic_to(entry.controls[3], entry.controls[4], entry.controls[1], entry.controls[2],
                        previous[1], previous[2])
                else
                    path:line_to(previous[1], previous[2])
                end
            end
            if closed then path:close() end
        end
        start, segments = nil, {}
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                flush(false)
                start = { point(x, y) }
            else
                path:move_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { point(x, y) } }
            else
                path:line_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstHorizontal, firstVertical = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondHorizontal, secondVertical = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endHorizontal, endVertical = point(endX, endY)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { endHorizontal, endVertical },
                    controls = { firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical } }
            else
                path:cubic_to(firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical, endHorizontal, endVertical)
            end
        end,
        close = function()
            if mirrored then flush(true) else path:close() end
        end,
    }
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function star(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.18, size * 0.12, size * 0.12, size * 0.18, 0, size)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.12, size * 0.18, -size * 0.18, size * 0.12, -size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, 0, -size)
    path:close()
end

local function leaf(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.35, -size * 0.38, size * 0.70, -size * 0.25, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.60, size * 0.42, size * 0.18, size * 0.25, 0, 0)
    path:close()
end

local function heart(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size * 0.15)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.2, size * 0.3, size * 0.1, size * 0.38, 0, size * 0.5)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.1, size * 0.38, -size * 0.2, size * 0.3, -size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, -size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, 0, -size * 0.15)
    path:close()
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, 2) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[index]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, { mt.drawing_path(), mt.drawing_path() }
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local width, height = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits
        local inset = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 15.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        inset = math.min(inset, width * 0.15)
        local size = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 30.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01, width * 0.22)
        local lineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        local idleSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 4.0)
        local idleAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 1.0)
        local primary = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[1])
        local accent = #decorationIndices > 1 and screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[2]) or primary
        if ctx.inputs.booleans[3] then
            local corners = { { x = inset, y = inset }, { x = width - inset, y = inset },
                { x = width - inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = inset } }
            stroke(primary, corners, lineWidth, mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - outro))
        end
        if size > kEpsilon then drawScreen(ctx, primary, accent, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount) end
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, primary, accent, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
    for corner, signs in ipairs({ { 1, 1 }, { -1, 1 }, { -1, -1 }, { 1, -1 } }) do
        local horizontal = signs[1] > 0 and inset or width - inset
        local vertical = signs[2] > 0 and inset or height - inset
        local clusterSize = size * ((corner == 1 or corner == 3) and 1.0 or 0.75)
        local reveal = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        for branch = 0, 1 do
            local stem = at(primary, horizontal, vertical, 1.0, 0, signs[1], signs[2])
            local points = {}
            for sample = 0, 16 do
                local progress = sample / 16
                local x, y = clusterSize * progress * 1.2, clusterSize * (0.18 + progress * progress * 0.20)
                if branch == 1 then x, y = y, x end
                points[#points + 1] = { x = x, y = y }
            end
            stroke(stem, points, math.max(lineWidth, size * 0.014), reveal)
            for index = 1, 5 do
                local progress = index / 6
                local leafPop = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate((reveal - progress * 0.75) / 0.18))
                local x, y = clusterSize * progress * 1.2, clusterSize * (0.18 + progress * progress * 0.20)
                local angle = (index % 2 == 0 and -0.95 or 0.80) + branch * math.pi * 0.5
                if branch == 1 then x, y = y, x end
                local sway = math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau + index + corner) * idleAmount * 0.08
                local leaves = at(index % 2 == 0 and primary or accent,
                    horizontal + signs[1] * x, vertical + signs[2] * y, leafPop,
                    angle * signs[1] * signs[2] + sway, signs[1], signs[2])
                leaf(leaves, clusterSize * 0.32)
            end
        end
    end
end
description: Leafy branches grow into all four screen corners and softly sway, even with no text.
