-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SFR002
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Flower Bouquets
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "Sample Text\nBlooming Moments"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input boolean 3 "Border" default=false
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.4
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 3 "Edge Inset (% height)" default=4
-- @input number 4 "Decoration Size (% height)" default=16
-- @input number 5 "Line Width (% height)" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Idle Speed (Hz)" default=0.3
-- @input number 7 "Idle Amount" default=0.5
-- @input color 1 "Leaf Color" default={0.36,0.62,0.45,1}
-- @input color 2 "Flower Color 1" default={0.98,0.52,0.66,1}
-- @input color 3 "Flower Color 2" default={1,0.66,0.38,1}
-- @input color 4 "Flower Color 3" default={0.66,0.55,0.95,1}
--[[ @description
Little bouquets bloom at opposite screen corners while a cute honeybee loops around each one; text is optional.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
左下と右上に小さな花束を置き、葉と花が順番にふわっと現れ、花が咲くと可愛いミツバチが飛んできて花束のまわりを8の字に飛び回ります。中央を広く空け、待機中は花束がゆっくり揺れます。

画面サイズを基準に配置する装飾で、本文が空でも表示します。Edge Inset (% height)・Decoration Size (% height) で余白と大きさ、Border で枠線の有無を調整できます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。Leaf Color は茎と葉、Flower Color 1〜3 は3つの花の色です。花の中心とミツバチは黄色・こげ茶・白の固定色で描きます。本文の位置・書体・色を保ち、装飾は本文の後ろに描きます。補助グリフを最大7つ使い、空きが足りないときは色をまとめて描き（空きが1つなら単色）、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
-- One auxiliary glyph per color: leaves, three flowers, honey yellow (flower centres and the bee's body),
-- then the bee's markings and wings. With fewer free glyphs the later layers draw into the last one available.
local kLayerCount = 7
local kHoney, kBeeMarkings, kBeeWings = 5, 6, 7
local kFixedColors = {
    [kHoney] = { r = 1.0, g = 0.82, b = 0.25, a = 1.0 },
    [kBeeMarkings] = { r = 0.30, g = 0.22, b = 0.18, a = 1.0 },
    [kBeeWings] = { r = 1.0, g = 1.0, b = 1.0, a = 0.85 },
}
-- Painted first is behind: stems, flowers, then the flower centres and the bee with its wings under its body.
local kPaintOrder = { 1, 2, 3, 4, kBeeWings, kHoney, kBeeMarkings }
local kLeafDrop = 0.03
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function segment(path, first, last, width)
    local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
    local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    if length > kEpsilon and width > kEpsilon then
        local normalX, normalY = -differenceY / length * width * 0.5, differenceX / length * width * 0.5
        path:move_to(first.x - normalX, first.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x - normalX, last.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x + normalX, last.y + normalY)
        path:line_to(first.x + normalX, first.y + normalY)
        path:close()
        circle(path, first.x, first.y, width * 0.5)
        circle(path, last.x, last.y, width * 0.5)
    end
end

local function pathLength(points)
    local result = 0.0
    for index = 2, #points do
        local differenceX, differenceY = points[index].x - points[index - 1].x, points[index].y - points[index - 1].y
        result = result + math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    end
    return result
end

local function stroke(path, points, width, progress)
    local remaining = pathLength(points) * mt.saturate(progress)
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining > kEpsilon and length > kEpsilon then
            local portion = mt.saturate(remaining / length)
            segment(path, first, { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, portion), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, portion) }, width)
        end
        remaining = math.max(remaining - length, 0.0)
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- A mirror reverses each outline's winding, and under the nonzero fill rule a reversed outline that
-- overlaps an unmirrored one in the same path cancels it into a hole. Mirrored subpaths are therefore
-- written back to front, which restores their winding without changing their shape.
local function at(path, horizontal, vertical, scale, angle, mirrorX, mirrorY)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle or 0.0), math.sin(angle or 0.0)
    local mirrored = (mirrorX or 1.0) * (mirrorY or 1.0) < 0.0
    local start, segments = nil, {}
    local function point(x, y)
        x, y = x * (mirrorX or 1.0), y * (mirrorY or 1.0)
        return horizontal + (x * cosine - y * sine) * (scale or 1.0),
            vertical + (x * sine + y * cosine) * (scale or 1.0)
    end
    local function flush(closed)
        if start ~= nil then
            local last = #segments > 0 and segments[#segments].to or start
            path:move_to(last[1], last[2])
            for index = #segments, 1, -1 do
                local entry = segments[index]
                local previous = index > 1 and segments[index - 1].to or start
                if entry.controls then
                    path:cubic_to(entry.controls[3], entry.controls[4], entry.controls[1], entry.controls[2],
                        previous[1], previous[2])
                else
                    path:line_to(previous[1], previous[2])
                end
            end
            if closed then path:close() end
        end
        start, segments = nil, {}
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                flush(false)
                start = { point(x, y) }
            else
                path:move_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { point(x, y) } }
            else
                path:line_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstHorizontal, firstVertical = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondHorizontal, secondVertical = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endHorizontal, endVertical = point(endX, endY)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { endHorizontal, endVertical },
                    controls = { firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical } }
            else
                path:cubic_to(firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical, endHorizontal, endVertical)
            end
        end,
        close = function()
            if mirrored then flush(true) else path:close() end
        end,
    }
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function leaf(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.35, -size * 0.38, size * 0.70, -size * 0.25, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.60, size * 0.42, size * 0.18, size * 0.25, 0, 0)
    path:close()
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, kLayerCount) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[index]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = kFixedColors[slot] or ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}
    for slot = 1, kLayerCount do decorationPaths[slot] = mt.drawing_path() end
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local width, height = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits
        local inset = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 15.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        inset = math.min(inset, width * 0.15)
        local size = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 30.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01, width * 0.22)
        local lineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        local idleSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 4.0)
        local idleAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 1.0)
        local layers = {}
        for slot = 1, kLayerCount do
            layers[slot] = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[math.min(slot, #decorationIndices)])
        end
        local primary = layers[1]
        if ctx.inputs.booleans[3] then
            local corners = { { x = inset, y = inset }, { x = width - inset, y = inset },
                { x = width - inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = inset } }
            stroke(primary, corners, lineWidth, mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - outro))
        end
        if size > kEpsilon then drawScreen(ctx, layers, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount) end
        local order = {}
        for _, slot in ipairs(kPaintOrder) do
            if decorationIndices[slot] then order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | decorationIndices[slot] end
        end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

local function flower(path, size)
    local samples = 80
    for sample = 0, samples - 1 do
        local angle = sample / samples * kTau
        local radius = size * (0.40 + math.cos(angle * 5) * 0.10)
        local x, y = math.cos(angle) * radius, math.sin(angle) * radius
        if sample == 0 then path:move_to(x, y) else path:line_to(x, y) end
    end
    path:close()
end

local function ellipse(path, centerX, centerY, radiusX, radiusY)
    if radiusX > kEpsilon and radiusY > kEpsilon then
        local controlX, controlY = radiusX * kCircleControl, radiusY * kCircleControl
        path:move_to(centerX + radiusX, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radiusX, centerY + controlY, centerX + controlX, centerY + radiusY, centerX, centerY + radiusY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - controlX, centerY + radiusY, centerX - radiusX, centerY + controlY, centerX - radiusX, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radiusX, centerY - controlY, centerX - controlX, centerY - radiusY, centerX, centerY - radiusY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + controlX, centerY - radiusY, centerX + radiusX, centerY - controlY, centerX + radiusX, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

-- A band of the body ellipse between two x positions, so the stripes follow the body's curve.
local function bodyBand(path, radiusX, radiusY, fromX, toX)
    local samples = 10
    local function edge(x) return radiusY * math.sqrt(math.max(1.0 - (x / radiusX) ^ 2, 0.0)) end
    for sample = 0, samples do
        local x = mt.lerp(fromX, toX, sample / samples)
        if sample == 0 then path:move_to(x, -edge(x)) else path:line_to(x, -edge(x)) end
    end
    for sample = samples, 0, -1 do
        local x = mt.lerp(fromX, toX, sample / samples)
        path:line_to(x, edge(x))
    end
    path:close()
end

-- A round little honeybee facing +x, centred on its body. flap is the wings' current opening.
local function bee(layers, centerX, centerY, scale, facing, tilt, flap)
    local bodyX, bodyY = 1.0, 0.78
    local wings = at(layers[kBeeWings], centerX, centerY, scale, tilt, facing, 1)
    for _, wing in ipairs({ { x = -0.25, rotation = -0.45, size = 0.62 }, { x = 0.18, rotation = 0.25, size = 0.5 } }) do
        local blade = at(wings, wing.x, -bodyY * 0.95, 1, wing.rotation)
        ellipse(blade, 0, -wing.size * 0.55 * flap, wing.size * 0.55, wing.size * 0.75 * flap)
    end
    ellipse(at(layers[kHoney], centerX, centerY, scale, tilt, facing, 1), 0, 0, bodyX, bodyY)
    local markings = at(layers[kBeeMarkings], centerX, centerY, scale, tilt, facing, 1)
    bodyBand(markings, bodyX, bodyY, -0.42, -0.18)
    bodyBand(markings, bodyX, bodyY, 0.02, 0.24)
    -- The stinger, a big eye with a highlight, and a single curled antenna make it read as cute.
    markings:move_to(-bodyX * 0.92, -0.12)
    markings:line_to(-bodyX * 1.32, 0)
    markings:line_to(-bodyX * 0.92, 0.12)
    markings:close()
    circle(markings, bodyX * 0.55, -bodyY * 0.18, 0.17)
    circle(markings, bodyX * 0.6, -bodyY * 0.26, 0.06, true)
    stroke(markings, { { x = bodyX * 0.62, y = -bodyY * 0.8 }, { x = bodyX * 0.85, y = -bodyY * 1.35 },
        { x = bodyX * 1.1, y = -bodyY * 1.45 } }, 0.09, 1)
    circle(markings, bodyX * 1.12, -bodyY * 1.45, 0.11)
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, layers, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
    local stemLayer = layers[1]
    local idle = idleSpeed > kEpsilon and idleAmount > kEpsilon
    local stemWidth = math.max(lineWidth, size * 0.025)
    -- The root sits just inside the inset by what reaches past it: the stem's round cap sideways, and
    -- the last branch's lower leaf, which dips below the root. The outer edge then stays on the inset at any size.
    local rootInsetX = inset + stemWidth * 0.5
    local rootInsetY = inset + math.max(stemWidth * 0.5, size * kLeafDrop)
    for corner, sign in ipairs({ 1, -1 }) do
        local horizontal = sign > 0 and rootInsetX or width - rootInsetX
        local vertical = sign > 0 and height - rootInsetY or rootInsetY
        local reveal = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local sway = math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau + corner) * idleAmount * 0.04
        local stems = at(stemLayer, horizontal, vertical, reveal, sway, sign, -sign)
        for branch = 1, 3 do
            local x, y = size * (0.12 + branch * 0.33), size * (1.40 - branch * 0.30)
            stroke(stems, { { x = 0, y = 0 }, { x = x * 0.55, y = y * 0.35 }, { x = x, y = y } },
                stemWidth, 1.0)
            leaf(at(stems, x * 0.35, y * 0.4, 1, -0.65), size * 0.38)
            leaf(at(stems, x * 0.6, y * 0.6, 1, 2.25), size * 0.30)
            local pop = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate((intro - branch * 0.13) / (1.0 - branch * 0.13))) * (1.0 - outro)
            -- The flower sits on the stem tip as transformed by stems, so it sways and grows with its stem.
            local mirroredX, mirroredY = sign * x, -sign * y
            local tipX = horizontal + (mirroredX * math.cos(sway) - mirroredY * math.sin(sway)) * reveal
            local tipY = vertical + (mirroredX * math.sin(sway) + mirroredY * math.cos(sway)) * reveal
            flower(at(layers[1 + branch], tipX, tipY, pop, sway), size * (branch == 2 and 0.70 or 0.52))
            circle(at(layers[kHoney], tipX, tipY, pop), 0, 0, size * (branch == 2 and 0.70 or 0.52) * 0.14)
        end

        -- The bee arrives once the flowers are open, loops a figure of eight beside the bouquet,
        -- and leaves first on the way out. Without idle motion it hovers in place.
        local arrive = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate((intro - 0.55) / 0.45))
        local leave = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        local phase = idle and ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau * 0.8 + corner * 1.7 or corner * 1.7
        local loopX, loopY = size * 0.32 * idleAmount, size * 0.14 * idleAmount
        local beeX = horizontal + sign * size * 1.8 + math.sin(phase) * loopX
        local beeY = vertical - sign * size * 0.75 + math.sin(phase * 2.0) * loopY
            + (1.0 - mt.saturate(arrive)) * sign * size * 0.6 - leave * sign * size * 0.6
        -- beeX moves by sin(phase) on both corners, so its horizontal velocity follows cos(phase) alone.
        local facing = (idle and math.cos(phase) or sign) >= 0 and 1 or -1
        local flap = idle and 0.45 + 0.55 * math.abs(math.cos(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau * 20.0)) or 1.0
        local beeScale = size * 0.17 * math.max(arrive, 0.0) * (1.0 - leave)
        if beeScale > kEpsilon then
            bee(layers, beeX, beeY, beeScale, facing, math.sin(phase * 2.0) * 0.12 * idleAmount, flap)
        end
    end
end
description: Little bouquets bloom at opposite screen corners while a cute honeybee loops around each one; text is optional.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SFR003
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Starlight Screen
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "Sample Text\nWish upon a Star"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input boolean 3 "Border" default=false
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.4
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 3 "Edge Inset (% height)" default=4
-- @input number 4 "Decoration Size (% height)" default=12
-- @input number 5 "Line Width (% height)" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Idle Speed (Hz)" default=0.3
-- @input number 7 "Idle Amount" default=0.5
-- @input color 1 "Primary Color" default={0.72,0.67,0.92,1}
-- @input color 2 "Accent Color" default={1,0.86,0.59,1}
--[[ @description
Stars light up around the screen edges, with tiny corner accents and occasional shooting stars; text is optional.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
画面の端に星を散らし、中央には余白を残します。星が順番に灯り、待機中はきらめき、短い流れ星が上辺を横切ります。

画面サイズを基準に配置する装飾で、本文が空でも表示します。Edge Inset (% height)・Decoration Size (% height) で余白と大きさ、Border で枠線の有無を調整できます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。本文の位置・書体・色を保ち、装飾は本文の後ろに描きます。補助グリフを2つ使い、空きが1つなら装飾を単色で描き、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function segment(path, first, last, width)
    local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
    local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    if length > kEpsilon and width > kEpsilon then
        local normalX, normalY = -differenceY / length * width * 0.5, differenceX / length * width * 0.5
        path:move_to(first.x - normalX, first.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x - normalX, last.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x + normalX, last.y + normalY)
        path:line_to(first.x + normalX, first.y + normalY)
        path:close()
        circle(path, first.x, first.y, width * 0.5)
        circle(path, last.x, last.y, width * 0.5)
    end
end

local function pathLength(points)
    local result = 0.0
    for index = 2, #points do
        local differenceX, differenceY = points[index].x - points[index - 1].x, points[index].y - points[index - 1].y
        result = result + math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    end
    return result
end

local function pointAlong(points, distance)
    local remaining = math.max(distance, 0.0)
    local result = points[#points]
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining <= length and length > kEpsilon then
            local progress = remaining / length
            result = { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, progress), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, progress) }
            break
        end
        remaining = remaining - length
    end
    return result
end

local function stroke(path, points, width, progress)
    local remaining = pathLength(points) * mt.saturate(progress)
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining > kEpsilon and length > kEpsilon then
            local portion = mt.saturate(remaining / length)
            segment(path, first, { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, portion), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, portion) }, width)
        end
        remaining = math.max(remaining - length, 0.0)
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- A mirror reverses each outline's winding, and under the nonzero fill rule a reversed outline that
-- overlaps an unmirrored one in the same path cancels it into a hole. Mirrored subpaths are therefore
-- written back to front, which restores their winding without changing their shape.
local function at(path, horizontal, vertical, scale, angle, mirrorX, mirrorY)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle or 0.0), math.sin(angle or 0.0)
    local mirrored = (mirrorX or 1.0) * (mirrorY or 1.0) < 0.0
    local start, segments = nil, {}
    local function point(x, y)
        x, y = x * (mirrorX or 1.0), y * (mirrorY or 1.0)
        return horizontal + (x * cosine - y * sine) * (scale or 1.0),
            vertical + (x * sine + y * cosine) * (scale or 1.0)
    end
    local function flush(closed)
        if start ~= nil then
            local last = #segments > 0 and segments[#segments].to or start
            path:move_to(last[1], last[2])
            for index = #segments, 1, -1 do
                local entry = segments[index]
                local previous = index > 1 and segments[index - 1].to or start
                if entry.controls then
                    path:cubic_to(entry.controls[3], entry.controls[4], entry.controls[1], entry.controls[2],
                        previous[1], previous[2])
                else
                    path:line_to(previous[1], previous[2])
                end
            end
            if closed then path:close() end
        end
        start, segments = nil, {}
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                flush(false)
                start = { point(x, y) }
            else
                path:move_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { point(x, y) } }
            else
                path:line_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstHorizontal, firstVertical = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondHorizontal, secondVertical = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endHorizontal, endVertical = point(endX, endY)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { endHorizontal, endVertical },
                    controls = { firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical } }
            else
                path:cubic_to(firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical, endHorizontal, endVertical)
            end
        end,
        close = function()
            if mirrored then flush(true) else path:close() end
        end,
    }
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function star(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.18, size * 0.12, size * 0.12, size * 0.18, 0, size)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.12, size * 0.18, -size * 0.18, size * 0.12, -size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, 0, -size)
    path:close()
end

local function leaf(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.35, -size * 0.38, size * 0.70, -size * 0.25, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.60, size * 0.42, size * 0.18, size * 0.25, 0, 0)
    path:close()
end

local function heart(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size * 0.15)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.2, size * 0.3, size * 0.1, size * 0.38, 0, size * 0.5)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.1, size * 0.38, -size * 0.2, size * 0.3, -size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, -size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, 0, -size * 0.15)
    path:close()
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, 2) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[index]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, { mt.drawing_path(), mt.drawing_path() }
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local width, height = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits
        local inset = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 15.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        inset = math.min(inset, width * 0.15)
        local size = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 30.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01, width * 0.22)
        local lineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        local idleSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 4.0)
        local idleAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 1.0)
        local primary = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[1])
        local accent = #decorationIndices > 1 and screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[2]) or primary
        if ctx.inputs.booleans[3] then
            local corners = { { x = inset, y = inset }, { x = width - inset, y = inset },
                { x = width - inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = inset } }
            stroke(primary, corners, lineWidth, mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - outro))
        end
        if size > kEpsilon then drawScreen(ctx, primary, accent, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount) end
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

local kStarCount = 24

drawScreen = function(ctx, primary, accent, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
    local reveal = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - outro)
    for _, signs in ipairs({ { 1, 1 }, { -1, 1 }, { -1, -1 }, { 1, -1 } }) do
        local horizontal = signs[1] > 0 and inset or width - inset
        local vertical = signs[2] > 0 and inset or height - inset
        local corner = at(primary, horizontal, vertical, reveal, 0, signs[1], signs[2])
        stroke(corner, { { x = 0, y = size * 0.45 }, { x = 0, y = 0 }, { x = size * 0.45, y = 0 } }, lineWidth, 1)
    end
    for index = 0, kStarCount - 1 do
        local side = math.floor(index / 6)
        local progress = ((index % 6) + 0.65) / 6.5
        local distance = inset + size * (0.15 + (index % 3) * 0.18)
        local horizontal, vertical
        if side == 0 then horizontal, vertical = mt.lerp(inset, width - inset, progress), distance
        elseif side == 1 then horizontal, vertical = width - distance, mt.lerp(inset, height - inset, progress)
        elseif side == 2 then horizontal, vertical = mt.lerp(inset, width - inset, progress), height - distance
        else horizontal, vertical = distance, mt.lerp(inset, height - inset, progress) end
        local delay = (index % 7) * 0.06
        local pop = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / (1.0 - delay))) * (1.0 - outro)
        local twinkle = 1.0 + math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau + index * 1.7) * idleAmount * 0.40
        local stars = at(index % 3 == 0 and primary or accent, horizontal, vertical, pop * twinkle)
        star(stars, size * (index % 3 == 0 and 0.12 or 0.07))
        if index % 2 == 0 then circle(at(primary, horizontal + size * 0.11, vertical + size * 0.08, pop), 0, 0, size * 0.012) end
    end
    if idleSpeed > 0 and idleAmount > 0 then
        local age = (ctx.time * idleSpeed * 0.5) % 1.0
        local presence = math.sin(age * math.pi) * idleAmount * reveal
        local horizontal = mt.lerp(inset + size, width - inset - size, age)
        local vertical = inset + size * 0.48
        local trail = at(primary, horizontal, vertical, presence, 0.12)
        stroke(trail, { { x = -size * 0.7, y = 0 }, { x = 0, y = 0 } }, lineWidth, 1)
        star(at(accent, horizontal, vertical, presence), size * 0.10)
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SFR004
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Hanging Garland
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "Sample Text\nLet us Celebrate"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input boolean 3 "Border" default=false
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.4
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 3 "Edge Inset (% height)" default=4
-- @input number 4 "Decoration Size (% height)" default=18
-- @input number 5 "Line Width (% height)" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Idle Speed (Hz)" default=0.3
-- @input number 7 "Idle Amount" default=0.5
-- @input color 1 "Primary Color" default={0.72,0.70,0.93,1}
-- @input color 2 "Accent Color" default={1,0.72,0.80,1}
--[[ @description
A garland stretches across the screen top, hanging little flags, stars and hearts that pop in and sway; text is optional.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
上辺に紐を張り、小さな旗・星・ハートを吊るします。飾りがぽんぽん現れて揺れ、下隅には小さな紙吹雪を添えます。

画面サイズを基準に配置する装飾で、本文が空でも表示します。Edge Inset (% height)・Decoration Size (% height) で余白と大きさ、Border で枠線の有無を調整できます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。本文の位置・書体・色を保ち、装飾は本文の後ろに描きます。補助グリフを2つ使い、空きが1つなら装飾を単色で描き、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function segment(path, first, last, width)
    local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
    local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    if length > kEpsilon and width > kEpsilon then
        local normalX, normalY = -differenceY / length * width * 0.5, differenceX / length * width * 0.5
        path:move_to(first.x - normalX, first.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x - normalX, last.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x + normalX, last.y + normalY)
        path:line_to(first.x + normalX, first.y + normalY)
        path:close()
        circle(path, first.x, first.y, width * 0.5)
        circle(path, last.x, last.y, width * 0.5)
    end
end

local function pathLength(points)
    local result = 0.0
    for index = 2, #points do
        local differenceX, differenceY = points[index].x - points[index - 1].x, points[index].y - points[index - 1].y
        result = result + math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    end
    return result
end

local function pointAlong(points, distance)
    local remaining = math.max(distance, 0.0)
    local result = points[#points]
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining <= length and length > kEpsilon then
            local progress = remaining / length
            result = { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, progress), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, progress) }
            break
        end
        remaining = remaining - length
    end
    return result
end

local function stroke(path, points, width, progress)
    local remaining = pathLength(points) * mt.saturate(progress)
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining > kEpsilon and length > kEpsilon then
            local portion = mt.saturate(remaining / length)
            segment(path, first, { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, portion), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, portion) }, width)
        end
        remaining = math.max(remaining - length, 0.0)
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- A mirror reverses each outline's winding, and under the nonzero fill rule a reversed outline that
-- overlaps an unmirrored one in the same path cancels it into a hole. Mirrored subpaths are therefore
-- written back to front, which restores their winding without changing their shape.
local function at(path, horizontal, vertical, scale, angle, mirrorX, mirrorY)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle or 0.0), math.sin(angle or 0.0)
    local mirrored = (mirrorX or 1.0) * (mirrorY or 1.0) < 0.0
    local start, segments = nil, {}
    local function point(x, y)
        x, y = x * (mirrorX or 1.0), y * (mirrorY or 1.0)
        return horizontal + (x * cosine - y * sine) * (scale or 1.0),
            vertical + (x * sine + y * cosine) * (scale or 1.0)
    end
    local function flush(closed)
        if start ~= nil then
            local last = #segments > 0 and segments[#segments].to or start
            path:move_to(last[1], last[2])
            for index = #segments, 1, -1 do
                local entry = segments[index]
                local previous = index > 1 and segments[index - 1].to or start
                if entry.controls then
                    path:cubic_to(entry.controls[3], entry.controls[4], entry.controls[1], entry.controls[2],
                        previous[1], previous[2])
                else
                    path:line_to(previous[1], previous[2])
                end
            end
            if closed then path:close() end
        end
        start, segments = nil, {}
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                flush(false)
                start = { point(x, y) }
            else
                path:move_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { point(x, y) } }
            else
                path:line_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstHorizontal, firstVertical = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondHorizontal, secondVertical = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endHorizontal, endVertical = point(endX, endY)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { endHorizontal, endVertical },
                    controls = { firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical } }
            else
                path:cubic_to(firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical, endHorizontal, endVertical)
            end
        end,
        close = function()
            if mirrored then flush(true) else path:close() end
        end,
    }
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function star(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.18, size * 0.12, size * 0.12, size * 0.18, 0, size)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.12, size * 0.18, -size * 0.18, size * 0.12, -size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, 0, -size)
    path:close()
end

local function leaf(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.35, -size * 0.38, size * 0.70, -size * 0.25, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.60, size * 0.42, size * 0.18, size * 0.25, 0, 0)
    path:close()
end

local function heart(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size * 0.15)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.2, size * 0.3, size * 0.1, size * 0.38, 0, size * 0.5)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.1, size * 0.38, -size * 0.2, size * 0.3, -size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, -size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, 0, -size * 0.15)
    path:close()
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, 2) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[index]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, { mt.drawing_path(), mt.drawing_path() }
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local width, height = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits
        local inset = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 15.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        inset = math.min(inset, width * 0.15)
        local size = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 30.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01, width * 0.22)
        local lineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        local idleSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 4.0)
        local idleAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 1.0)
        local primary = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[1])
        local accent = #decorationIndices > 1 and screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[2]) or primary
        if ctx.inputs.booleans[3] then
            local corners = { { x = inset, y = inset }, { x = width - inset, y = inset },
                { x = width - inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = inset } }
            stroke(primary, corners, lineWidth, mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - outro))
        end
        if size > kEpsilon then drawScreen(ctx, primary, accent, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount) end
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

local kFlagCount = 9

drawScreen = function(ctx, primary, accent, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
    local reveal = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - outro)
    local rope = {}
    for sample = 0, 48 do
        local progress = sample / 48
        rope[#rope + 1] = { x = mt.lerp(inset, width - inset, progress), y = inset + math.sin(progress * math.pi) * size * 0.45 }
    end
    stroke(primary, rope, math.max(lineWidth, size * 0.015), reveal)
    for index = 1, kFlagCount do
        local progress = index / (kFlagCount + 1)
        local horizontal = mt.lerp(inset, width - inset, progress)
        local vertical = inset + math.sin(progress * math.pi) * size * 0.45
        local delay = progress * 0.45
        local pop = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate((intro - delay) / (1.0 - delay))) * (1.0 - outro)
        local swing = math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau + index * 0.8) * idleAmount * 0.10
        local ornament = at(index % 2 == 0 and primary or accent, horizontal, vertical, pop, swing)
        stroke(ornament, { { x = 0, y = 0 }, { x = 0, y = size * 0.18 } }, lineWidth, 1)
        if index % 3 == 0 then
            star(at(ornament, 0, size * 0.40), size * 0.20)
        elseif index % 3 == 1 then
            polygon(ornament, { { x = -size * 0.17, y = size * 0.16 }, { x = size * 0.17, y = size * 0.16 },
                { x = size * 0.17, y = size * 0.52 }, { x = 0, y = size * 0.43 }, { x = -size * 0.17, y = size * 0.52 } })
        else heart(at(ornament, 0, size * 0.40), size * 0.40) end
    end
    for _, sign in ipairs({ 1, -1 }) do
        for index = 1, 5 do
            local horizontal = sign > 0 and inset + size * index * 0.22 or width - inset - size * index * 0.22
            local vertical = height - inset - size * (0.2 + (index % 3) * 0.18)
            local angle = index * 0.7 + math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau + index) * idleAmount * 0.08
            local confetti = at(index % 2 == 0 and primary or accent, horizontal, vertical, reveal, angle)
            polygon(confetti, { { x = -size * 0.045, y = -size * 0.025 }, { x = size * 0.045, y = -size * 0.025 },
                { x = size * 0.045, y = size * 0.025 }, { x = -size * 0.045, y = size * 0.025 } })
        end
    end
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SFR005
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Soft Curtain
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "Sample Text\nThe Story Begins"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input boolean 3 "Border" default=false
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 3 "Edge Inset (% height)" default=2
-- @input number 4 "Decoration Size (% height)" default=20
-- @input number 5 "Line Width (% height)" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Idle Speed (Hz)" default=0.3
-- @input number 7 "Idle Amount" default=0.5
-- @input color 1 "Primary Color" default={0.84,0.57,0.67,1}
-- @input color 2 "Accent Color" default={1,0.84,0.75,1}
--[[ @description
Soft side curtains and a scalloped drape open to welcome a title, gently breathe, and close on exit; text is optional.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
左右のやわらかいカーテンと上部のドレープが中央へ開き、タイトルを迎えます。待機中は布がわずかに揺れ、退場時は静かに閉じます。

画面サイズを基準に配置する装飾で、本文が空でも表示します。Edge Inset (% height)・Decoration Size (% height) で余白と大きさ、Border で枠線の有無を調整できます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。本文の位置・書体・色を保ち、装飾は本文の後ろに描きます。補助グリフを2つ使い、空きが1つなら装飾を単色で描き、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function segment(path, first, last, width)
    local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
    local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    if length > kEpsilon and width > kEpsilon then
        local normalX, normalY = -differenceY / length * width * 0.5, differenceX / length * width * 0.5
        path:move_to(first.x - normalX, first.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x - normalX, last.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x + normalX, last.y + normalY)
        path:line_to(first.x + normalX, first.y + normalY)
        path:close()
        circle(path, first.x, first.y, width * 0.5)
        circle(path, last.x, last.y, width * 0.5)
    end
end

local function pathLength(points)
    local result = 0.0
    for index = 2, #points do
        local differenceX, differenceY = points[index].x - points[index - 1].x, points[index].y - points[index - 1].y
        result = result + math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    end
    return result
end

local function pointAlong(points, distance)
    local remaining = math.max(distance, 0.0)
    local result = points[#points]
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining <= length and length > kEpsilon then
            local progress = remaining / length
            result = { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, progress), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, progress) }
            break
        end
        remaining = remaining - length
    end
    return result
end

local function stroke(path, points, width, progress)
    local remaining = pathLength(points) * mt.saturate(progress)
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining > kEpsilon and length > kEpsilon then
            local portion = mt.saturate(remaining / length)
            segment(path, first, { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, portion), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, portion) }, width)
        end
        remaining = math.max(remaining - length, 0.0)
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- A mirror reverses each outline's winding, and under the nonzero fill rule a reversed outline that
-- overlaps an unmirrored one in the same path cancels it into a hole. Mirrored subpaths are therefore
-- written back to front, which restores their winding without changing their shape.
local function at(path, horizontal, vertical, scale, angle, mirrorX, mirrorY)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle or 0.0), math.sin(angle or 0.0)
    local mirrored = (mirrorX or 1.0) * (mirrorY or 1.0) < 0.0
    local start, segments = nil, {}
    local function point(x, y)
        x, y = x * (mirrorX or 1.0), y * (mirrorY or 1.0)
        return horizontal + (x * cosine - y * sine) * (scale or 1.0),
            vertical + (x * sine + y * cosine) * (scale or 1.0)
    end
    local function flush(closed)
        if start ~= nil then
            local last = #segments > 0 and segments[#segments].to or start
            path:move_to(last[1], last[2])
            for index = #segments, 1, -1 do
                local entry = segments[index]
                local previous = index > 1 and segments[index - 1].to or start
                if entry.controls then
                    path:cubic_to(entry.controls[3], entry.controls[4], entry.controls[1], entry.controls[2],
                        previous[1], previous[2])
                else
                    path:line_to(previous[1], previous[2])
                end
            end
            if closed then path:close() end
        end
        start, segments = nil, {}
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                flush(false)
                start = { point(x, y) }
            else
                path:move_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { point(x, y) } }
            else
                path:line_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstHorizontal, firstVertical = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondHorizontal, secondVertical = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endHorizontal, endVertical = point(endX, endY)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { endHorizontal, endVertical },
                    controls = { firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical } }
            else
                path:cubic_to(firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical, endHorizontal, endVertical)
            end
        end,
        close = function()
            if mirrored then flush(true) else path:close() end
        end,
    }
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function star(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.18, size * 0.12, size * 0.12, size * 0.18, 0, size)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.12, size * 0.18, -size * 0.18, size * 0.12, -size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, 0, -size)
    path:close()
end

local function leaf(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.35, -size * 0.38, size * 0.70, -size * 0.25, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.60, size * 0.42, size * 0.18, size * 0.25, 0, 0)
    path:close()
end

local function heart(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size * 0.15)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.2, size * 0.3, size * 0.1, size * 0.38, 0, size * 0.5)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.1, size * 0.38, -size * 0.2, size * 0.3, -size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, -size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, 0, -size * 0.15)
    path:close()
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, 2) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[index]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, { mt.drawing_path(), mt.drawing_path() }
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local width, height = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits
        local inset = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 15.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        inset = math.min(inset, width * 0.15)
        local size = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 30.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01, width * 0.22)
        local lineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        local idleSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 4.0)
        local idleAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 1.0)
        local primary = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[1])
        local accent = #decorationIndices > 1 and screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[2]) or primary
        if ctx.inputs.booleans[3] then
            local corners = { { x = inset, y = inset }, { x = width - inset, y = inset },
                { x = width - inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = inset } }
            stroke(primary, corners, lineWidth, mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - outro))
        end
        if size > kEpsilon then drawScreen(ctx, primary, accent, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount) end
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, primary, accent, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
    local opening = mt.ease.in_out_sine(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_out_sine(outro))
    local availableWidth, availableHeight = width - inset * 2, height - inset * 2
    local panelWidth = mt.lerp(availableWidth * 0.5, size * 0.8, opening)
    local breath = math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau) * idleAmount * size * 0.02
    for _, sign in ipairs({ 1, -1 }) do
        local panel = at(primary, sign > 0 and inset or width - inset, inset, 1, 0, sign, 1)
        panel:move_to(0, 0)
        panel:line_to(panelWidth, 0)
        panel:cubic_to(panelWidth * 0.90 + breath, availableHeight * 0.20,
            panelWidth * 0.40 + breath, availableHeight * 0.42, panelWidth * 0.36, availableHeight * 0.56)
        panel:cubic_to(panelWidth * 0.55, availableHeight * 0.70, panelWidth * 0.50, availableHeight * 0.87, panelWidth * 0.64, availableHeight)
        panel:line_to(0, availableHeight)
        panel:close()
        local folds = at(accent, sign > 0 and inset or width - inset, inset, 1, 0, sign, 1)
        for fold = 1, 3 do
            local points = {}
            for sample = 0, 20 do
                local progress = sample / 20
                local taper = 1.0 - math.sin(progress * math.pi) * 0.5
                points[#points + 1] = { x = panelWidth * fold * 0.17 * taper + breath * math.sin(progress * math.pi), y = availableHeight * progress }
            end
            stroke(folds, points, math.max(lineWidth, size * 0.01), 1)
        end
        local tie = at(accent, sign > 0 and inset + panelWidth * 0.22 or width - inset - panelWidth * 0.22,
            inset + availableHeight * 0.55, 1, 0, 1, 0.25)
        circle(tie, 0, 0, panelWidth * 0.23)
    end
    local drape = {}
    for sample = 0, 72 do
        local progress = sample / 72
        drape[#drape + 1] = { x = mt.lerp(inset, width - inset, progress),
            y = inset + size * (0.35 + math.abs(math.sin(progress * math.pi * 3)) * 0.22) }
    end
    local cloth = { { x = inset, y = inset }, { x = width - inset, y = inset } }
    for index = #drape, 1, -1 do cloth[#cloth + 1] = drape[index] end
    polygon(primary, cloth)
    stroke(accent, drape, math.max(lineWidth, size * 0.013), 1)
end
