source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SFR006
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Scrapbook Corners
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @font_lang en
-- @recommend text "Sample Text\nMemories to Keep"
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input boolean 3 "Border" default=false
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.4
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 3 "Edge Inset (% height)" default=4
-- @input number 4 "Decoration Size (% height)" default=15
-- @input number 5 "Line Width (% height)" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Idle Speed (Hz)" default=0.3
-- @input number 7 "Idle Amount" default=0.5
-- @input color 1 "Primary Color" default={0.96,0.88,0.75,1}
-- @input color 2 "Accent Color" default={0.93,0.66,0.76,1}
--[[ @description
Paper scraps, pastel tape and small stickers land asymmetrically in the screen corners, leaving room for a title; text is optional.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
四隅に紙の切れ端、マスキングテープ、小さなシールを配置します。左右非対称の飾りが少し傾いて貼り付き、手作りの可愛さを添えます。

画面サイズを基準に配置する装飾で、本文が空でも表示します。Edge Inset (% height)・Decoration Size (% height) で余白と大きさ、Border で枠線の有無を調整できます。Intro・Outro は個別に切り替えられます。Idle Speed (Hz) または Idle Amount を0にすると待機中の動きを止めます。本文の位置・書体・色を保ち、装飾は本文の後ろに描きます。補助グリフを2つ使い、空きが1つなら装飾を単色で描き、空きが無ければ本文だけを表示します。
]]

local kScreenUnits = 1000.0
local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0
local kEpsilon = 0.000001
local kCircleControl = 0.5522847498
local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local markers, decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, {}, {}
local drawScreen

local function circle(path, centerX, centerY, radius, hole)
    if radius > kEpsilon then
        local control = radius * kCircleControl
        local direction = hole and -1.0 or 1.0
        path:move_to(centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX + control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX, centerY + radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - control, centerY + radius * direction, centerX - radius, centerY + control * direction, centerX - radius, centerY)
        path:cubic_to(centerX - radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX - control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX, centerY - radius * direction)
        path:cubic_to(centerX + control, centerY - radius * direction, centerX + radius, centerY - control * direction, centerX + radius, centerY)
        path:close()
    end
end

local function segment(path, first, last, width)
    local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
    local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    if length > kEpsilon and width > kEpsilon then
        local normalX, normalY = -differenceY / length * width * 0.5, differenceX / length * width * 0.5
        path:move_to(first.x - normalX, first.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x - normalX, last.y - normalY)
        path:line_to(last.x + normalX, last.y + normalY)
        path:line_to(first.x + normalX, first.y + normalY)
        path:close()
        circle(path, first.x, first.y, width * 0.5)
        circle(path, last.x, last.y, width * 0.5)
    end
end

local function pathLength(points)
    local result = 0.0
    for index = 2, #points do
        local differenceX, differenceY = points[index].x - points[index - 1].x, points[index].y - points[index - 1].y
        result = result + math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
    end
    return result
end

local function pointAlong(points, distance)
    local remaining = math.max(distance, 0.0)
    local result = points[#points]
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining <= length and length > kEpsilon then
            local progress = remaining / length
            result = { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, progress), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, progress) }
            break
        end
        remaining = remaining - length
    end
    return result
end

local function stroke(path, points, width, progress)
    local remaining = pathLength(points) * mt.saturate(progress)
    for index = 2, #points do
        local first, last = points[index - 1], points[index]
        local differenceX, differenceY = last.x - first.x, last.y - first.y
        local length = math.sqrt(differenceX * differenceX + differenceY * differenceY)
        if remaining > kEpsilon and length > kEpsilon then
            local portion = mt.saturate(remaining / length)
            segment(path, first, { x = mt.lerp(first.x, last.x, portion), y = mt.lerp(first.y, last.y, portion) }, width)
        end
        remaining = math.max(remaining - length, 0.0)
    end
end

local function polygon(path, points)
    if #points > 2 then
        path:move_to(points[1].x, points[1].y)
        for index = 2, #points do path:line_to(points[index].x, points[index].y) end
        path:close()
    end
end

-- A mirror reverses each outline's winding, and under the nonzero fill rule a reversed outline that
-- overlaps an unmirrored one in the same path cancels it into a hole. Mirrored subpaths are therefore
-- written back to front, which restores their winding without changing their shape.
local function at(path, horizontal, vertical, scale, angle, mirrorX, mirrorY)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(angle or 0.0), math.sin(angle or 0.0)
    local mirrored = (mirrorX or 1.0) * (mirrorY or 1.0) < 0.0
    local start, segments = nil, {}
    local function point(x, y)
        x, y = x * (mirrorX or 1.0), y * (mirrorY or 1.0)
        return horizontal + (x * cosine - y * sine) * (scale or 1.0),
            vertical + (x * sine + y * cosine) * (scale or 1.0)
    end
    local function flush(closed)
        if start ~= nil then
            local last = #segments > 0 and segments[#segments].to or start
            path:move_to(last[1], last[2])
            for index = #segments, 1, -1 do
                local entry = segments[index]
                local previous = index > 1 and segments[index - 1].to or start
                if entry.controls then
                    path:cubic_to(entry.controls[3], entry.controls[4], entry.controls[1], entry.controls[2],
                        previous[1], previous[2])
                else
                    path:line_to(previous[1], previous[2])
                end
            end
            if closed then path:close() end
        end
        start, segments = nil, {}
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                flush(false)
                start = { point(x, y) }
            else
                path:move_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { point(x, y) } }
            else
                path:line_to(point(x, y))
            end
        end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstHorizontal, firstVertical = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondHorizontal, secondVertical = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endHorizontal, endVertical = point(endX, endY)
            if mirrored then
                segments[#segments + 1] = { to = { endHorizontal, endVertical },
                    controls = { firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical } }
            else
                path:cubic_to(firstHorizontal, firstVertical, secondHorizontal, secondVertical, endHorizontal, endVertical)
            end
        end,
        close = function()
            if mirrored then flush(true) else path:close() end
        end,
    }
end

-- Paths are in screen-height units; inverse Global rotation and scale keep them screen-fixed.
local function screenPath(ctx, path)
    local cosine, sine = math.cos(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation)), math.sin(math.rad(ctx.global.rotation))
    local function point(horizontal, vertical)
        local differenceX = horizontal - ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits * 0.5
        local differenceY = vertical - kScreenUnits * 0.5
        return (cosine * differenceX + sine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x),
            (-sine * differenceX + cosine * differenceY) / (ctx.font.em_size * ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y)
    end
    return {
        move_to = function(_, x, y) path:move_to(point(x, y)) end,
        line_to = function(_, x, y) path:line_to(point(x, y)) end,
        cubic_to = function(_, firstX, firstY, secondX, secondY, endX, endY)
            local firstDesignX, firstDesignY = point(firstX, firstY)
            local secondDesignX, secondDesignY = point(secondX, secondY)
            local endDesignX, endDesignY = point(endX, endY)
            path:cubic_to(firstDesignX, firstDesignY, secondDesignX, secondDesignY, endDesignX, endDesignY)
        end,
        close = function() path:close() end,
    }
end

local function star(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.18, size * 0.12, size * 0.12, size * 0.18, 0, size)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.12, size * 0.18, -size * 0.18, size * 0.12, -size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.18, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.12, -size * 0.18, 0, -size)
    path:close()
end

local function leaf(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.35, -size * 0.38, size * 0.70, -size * 0.25, size, 0)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.60, size * 0.42, size * 0.18, size * 0.25, 0, 0)
    path:close()
end

local function heart(path, size)
    path:move_to(0, -size * 0.15)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(size * 0.2, size * 0.3, size * 0.1, size * 0.38, 0, size * 0.5)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.1, size * 0.38, -size * 0.2, size * 0.3, -size * 0.35, size * 0.16)
    path:cubic_to(-size * 0.65, -size * 0.15, -size * 0.4, -size * 0.5, 0, -size * 0.15)
    path:close()
end

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[1] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[2] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackDuration)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    markers = {}
    local bodyCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    local budget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - bodyCount, 0)
    if budget > 0 then
        local placeholder = mt.drawing_path()
        polygon(placeholder, { { x = -500, y = -500 }, { x = 500, y = -500 },
            { x = 500, y = 500 }, { x = -500, y = 500 } })
        for slot = 1, math.min(budget, 2) do
            markers[slot] = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = placeholder, bounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 } })
        end
        -- The dedicated zero-bounds line preserves the title's tracking and alignment box.
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. (bodyCount > 0 and "\n" or "") .. table.concat(markers)
    end
end

local function prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility)
    local decoration = ctx.chars[index]
    decoration.offset_x, decoration.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.pivot_x, decoration.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
    decoration.rotation, decoration.yaw, decoration.pitch, decoration.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.scale, decoration.stretch_x, decoration.stretch_y = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
    decoration.opacity = visibility
    decoration.fill.use = true
    decoration.fill.color = ctx.inputs.colors[slot]
    decoration.stroke.use = true
    decoration.stroke.width, decoration.stroke.outer_width = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.shadow.use = true
    decoration.shadow.color = { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 }
    decoration.blur.use = true
    decoration.blur.amount_x, decoration.blur.amount_y = 0.0, 0.0
    decoration.texture.use = true
    decoration.texture.type = "none"
    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        if part.character_index == index then
            part.offset_x, part.offset_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.pivot_x, part.pivot_y = 0.5, 0.5
            part.scale, part.stretch_x, part.stretch_y, part.opacity = 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0
            part.rotation, part.yaw, part.pitch, part.z = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
            part.fill.use, part.stroke.use, part.shadow.use = false, false, false
            part.blur.use, part.texture.use = false, false
        end
    end
    mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, decoration, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    decorationIndices, decorationPaths = {}, { mt.drawing_path(), mt.drawing_path() }
    local markerSlots = {}
    for slot, marker in ipairs(markers) do markerSlots[marker] = slot end
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local slot = markerSlots[ctx.chars[index].text]
        if slot then decorationIndices[slot] = index end
    end
    local intro, outro = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
    for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do ctx.chars[index].opacity = 0.0 end
    if #decorationIndices > 0 and ctx.font.em_size > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_x) > kEpsilon
        and math.abs(ctx.global.scale * ctx.global.stretch_y) > kEpsilon then
        for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do prepareDecoration(ctx, index, slot, visibility) end
        local width, height = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio * kScreenUnits, kScreenUnits
        local inset = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 15.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        inset = math.min(inset, width * 0.15)
        local size = math.min(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 30.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01, width * 0.22)
        local lineWidth = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[5], 0.0, 2.0) * kScreenUnits * 0.01
        local idleSpeed = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 0.0, 4.0)
        local idleAmount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 1.0)
        local primary = screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[1])
        local accent = #decorationIndices > 1 and screenPath(ctx, decorationPaths[2]) or primary
        if ctx.inputs.booleans[3] then
            local corners = { { x = inset, y = inset }, { x = width - inset, y = inset },
                { x = width - inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = height - inset }, { x = inset, y = inset } }
            stroke(primary, corners, lineWidth, mt.ease.out_cubic(intro) * (1.0 - outro))
        end
        if size > kEpsilon then drawScreen(ctx, primary, accent, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount) end
        local order = {}
        for _, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | index end
        local originalOrder = ctx.output.manual_order_enabled and ctx.output.manual_order_text or ""
        ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
        ctx.output.manual_order_text = mt.order_text(order) .. (originalOrder:match("%S") and " " .. originalOrder or "")
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for slot, index in ipairs(decorationIndices) do
        for _, part in ipairs(ctx.paths:character(index)) do part.path:assign(decorationPaths[slot]) end
    end
end

drawScreen = function(ctx, primary, accent, width, height, inset, size, lineWidth, intro, outro, idleSpeed, idleAmount)
    for corner, signs in ipairs({ { 1, 1 }, { -1, 1 }, { -1, -1 }, { 1, -1 } }) do
        local clusterSize = size * ((corner == 1 or corner == 3) and 1 or 0.70)
        local delay = (corner - 1) * 0.09
        local progress = mt.saturate((intro - delay) / (1.0 - delay))
        local pop = mt.ease.out_back(progress) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        local drift = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(progress)) * clusterSize * 0.2
        local horizontal = signs[1] > 0 and inset + clusterSize * 0.15 + drift or width - inset - clusterSize * 0.15 - drift
        local vertical = signs[2] > 0 and inset + clusterSize * 0.15 + drift or height - inset - clusterSize * 0.15 - drift
        local swing = math.sin(ctx.time * idleSpeed * kTau + corner) * idleAmount * 0.02
        local angle = (corner % 2 == 0 and 0.12 or -0.10) + swing
        local paper = at(primary, horizontal, vertical, pop, angle, signs[1], signs[2])
        local points = { { x = 0, y = 0 }, { x = clusterSize * 1.15, y = 0 }, { x = clusterSize * 1.15, y = clusterSize * 0.7 } }
        for sample = 10, 0, -1 do
            points[#points + 1] = { x = clusterSize * 1.15 * sample / 10, y = clusterSize * (sample % 2 == 0 and 0.78 or 0.72) }
        end
        polygon(paper, points)
        local tape = at(accent, horizontal, vertical, pop, angle, signs[1], signs[2])
        polygon(at(tape, clusterSize * 0.20, clusterSize * 0.04, 1, -0.10),
            { { x = 0, y = 0 }, { x = clusterSize * 0.92, y = 0 }, { x = clusterSize * 0.88, y = clusterSize * 0.21 }, { x = clusterSize * 0.02, y = clusterSize * 0.21 } })
        local badge = at(tape, clusterSize * 0.79, clusterSize * 0.56, 1, 0.2)
        if corner % 2 == 0 then star(badge, clusterSize * 0.20) else heart(badge, clusterSize * 0.40) end
        for dot = 1, 3 do circle(at(tape, clusterSize * dot * 0.15, clusterSize * 0.49), 0, 0, clusterSize * 0.025) end
    end
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SPC001
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Chronos Time Dilation
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.0
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.8
--[[ @description
Pendulum arrivals settle into distance-dependent local time, pulsing strokes and rocking each glyph.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
振り子状の入場後、文字ごとに異なる時間の速さで揺れと縁取りが脈動する演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.0
local kOutroDuration = 0.8
local kStaggerInterval = 0.035
local kMaxOpacity = 1.0
local kTimeDilationStrength = 1.8
local kPendulumFrequency = 0.35
local kArcRadius = 0.14
local kBaseStrokeWidth = 0.015

local kColorTitanium = { r = 0.92, g = 0.94, b = 0.97, a = 1.0 }
local kColorCobaltStroke = { r = 0.28, g = 0.62, b = 0.95, a = 0.85 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local introProgress, outroProgress = resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)

    -- Dynamic subtle spatial tilt
    ctx.global.yaw = ctx.global.yaw + (mt.wave(time, 0.12, 0.0) * 3.0)
    ctx.global.pitch = ctx.global.pitch + (mt.wave(time, 0.15, 0.5) * 2.0)

    -- Global opacity blending
    ctx.global.opacity = ctx.global.opacity * (mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress) * (1.0 - outroProgress))
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local remainingTime = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)
    local totalChars = ctx.char_count

    -- Ensure bounding box is disabled to remain completely distinct from 50
    ctx.bounding_box.enabled = false

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry

        -- Relativistic Local Time Dilation based on distance from center
        local dx = geometry.bounds_center_x - 0.5
        local dy = geometry.bounds_center_y - 0.5
        local distFromCenter = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        local localTime = time * (1.0 + (distFromCenter - 0.2) * kTimeDilationStrength)

        -- 1. Intro: Pendulum Arc Release
        local introSpan = math.max(totalChars - 1, 0) * kStaggerInterval + 0.45
        local charIntroRaw = mt.clamp((introProgress * introSpan - (index - 1) * kStaggerInterval) / 0.45, 0.0, 1.0)
        local charIntroEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(charIntroRaw)
        local introRotation = (1.0 - charIntroEased) * -50.0
        local introArcX = (1.0 - charIntroEased) * -0.15
        local introArcY = (1.0 - charIntroEased) * -0.08

        -- 2. Outro: Pendulum Arc Rewind (Seamless normalized window)
        local staggerRatio = 0.03
        local charOutroWindowStart = (index - 1) * staggerRatio
        local charOutroWindowSpan = math.max(0.3, 1.0 - (totalChars - 1) * staggerRatio)
        local charOutroRaw = mt.clamp((outroProgress - charOutroWindowStart) / charOutroWindowSpan, 0.0, 1.0)
        local charOutroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(charOutroRaw)
        local outroRotation = charOutroEased * 50.0
        local outroArcX = charOutroEased * 0.15
        local outroArcY = charOutroEased * -0.08

        -- 3. Idle: Pendulum Oscillation & Breathing Time Dilation Stroke
        local pendulumPhase = index * 0.35
        local pendulumAngle = math.sin(localTime * kPendulumFrequency * math.pi * 2.0 + pendulumPhase) * 0.18
        local idleArcX = math.sin(pendulumAngle) * kArcRadius
        local idleArcY = (1.0 - math.cos(pendulumAngle)) * kArcRadius * 0.5

        -- Dynamic localized stroke pulsation symbolizing time distortion
        local strokePulse = (mt.wave(localTime * 1.2, 0.6, distFromCenter * 4.0) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.015
        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width = kBaseStrokeWidth + strokePulse
        character.stroke.color = kColorCobaltStroke

        -- Composite transformations (Circular Arc + Rotation)
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + introArcX + outroArcX + idleArcX
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + introArcY + outroArcY + idleArcY
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (introRotation + outroRotation + math.deg(pendulumAngle))
        character.pivot_y = 0.8 -- Pivot anchored near bottom for natural pendulum swing
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (mt.clamp(charIntroEased * (1.0 - charOutroEased), 0.0, kMaxOpacity))

        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = kColorTitanium
    end
end
description: Pendulum arrivals settle into distance-dependent local time, pulsing strokes and rocking each glyph.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SPC002
-- @duration 5
-- @title Cosmic Dust
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.6
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.3
--[[ @description
Stardust parts drift through depth, dock into glyphs, and scatter with violet-blue-cyan glints.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
星屑のようなパーツが奥行きから漂い集まり、紫・青・シアンの光をまとって再び散ります。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。パーツの数や分かれ方はフォントの輪郭に依存します。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.6 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 1.3 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kStaggerAmount = 0.5 -- how much of each window is spread across parts
local kMinDrift = 0.15 -- canvas fraction, shortest drift-in distance
local kMaxDrift = 0.32 -- canvas fraction, longest drift-in distance
local kWanderAmount = 0.02 -- canvas fraction of the residual noise wander
local kWanderSpeed = 0.8 -- wander cycles per second
local kBaseHue = 265.0 / 360.0 -- normalized oklch hue, violet
local kHueSwing = 70.0 / 360.0 -- swings down toward cyan
local kHueDriftSpeed = 0.12 -- hue cycles per second
local kSparkleSpeed = 5.0 -- sparkle noise updates per second
local kSparkleSharpness = 3.0 -- higher = rarer, sharper glints

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = 0.1
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = 0.0
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed

        local stagger = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.0, kStaggerAmount)
        local dock = mt.ease.out_quad(mt.saturate(introAmount * (1.0 + stagger) - stagger))
        local scatter = mt.ease.in_quad(mt.saturate(outroAmount * (1.0 + stagger) - stagger))

        local inAngle = mt.random_range(seed, index + ctx.part_count, 0.0, math.pi * 2.0)
        local outAngle = mt.random_range(seed, index + ctx.part_count * 2, 0.0, math.pi * 2.0)
        local drift = mt.random_range(seed, index + ctx.part_count * 3, kMinDrift, kMaxDrift)

        -- The wander never fully dies during the hold -- stardust floats.
        local loose = math.max(1.0 - dock, scatter)
        local wanderStrength = kWanderAmount * (0.15 + 0.85 * loose)
        local wanderX = mt.noise1(ctx.time * kWanderSpeed + index * 2.13, 31) * wanderStrength
        local wanderY = mt.noise1(ctx.time * kWanderSpeed + index * 2.13, 32) * wanderStrength

        part.offset_x = part.offset_x + math.cos(inAngle) * drift * (1.0 - dock)
            + math.cos(outAngle) * drift * scatter + wanderX
        part.offset_y = part.offset_y + math.sin(inAngle) * drift * (1.0 - dock)
            + math.sin(outAngle) * drift * scatter + wanderY

        -- Sparkle: sharpened positive noise, boosted while dissolving.
        local glint = math.max(mt.noise1(ctx.time * kSparkleSpeed + index * 4.7, 33), 0.0)
            ^ kSparkleSharpness
        local sparkle = glint * (1.0 + scatter * 1.5)

        local hue = kBaseHue - kHueSwing
            * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(index * 0.7 + ctx.time * kHueDriftSpeed * math.pi * 2.0))
        local dustColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.68 + 0.27 * mt.saturate(sparkle), 0.11, hue)

        part.fill.use = true
        part.fill.color = dustColor
        part.shadow.use = true
        part.shadow.color = mt.color.with_alpha(dustColor, 0.35 + 0.45 * mt.saturate(sparkle))
        part.scale = part.scale * (0.9 + 0.1 * dock + 0.15 * mt.saturate(sparkle))
        part.opacity = part.opacity * (mt.saturate(dock * 2.5) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(scatter)))
    end
end
description: Stardust parts drift through depth, dock into glyphs, and scatter with violet-blue-cyan glints.

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SPC003
-- @duration 5
-- @title Light Sweep Prism
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.5
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.5
--[[ @description
A tilted light band lifts and flashes parts, leaving spectral colors behind. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
斜めの光が通過したパーツを手前へ持ち上げ、白い閃光から虹色へ変える演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kSweepPeriod = 5.0 -- seconds for one full out-and-back sweep
local kSweepAngle = math.rad(20.0) -- tilt of the sweep direction from horizontal
local kBandWidth = 0.09 -- gaussian half-width of the light band, world units
local kSweepReach = 0.9 -- world-space distance the band travels past center
local kLiftHeight = 0.25 -- part.z at full flash
local kBaseHue = 0.55 -- resting hue the prism colors are spread around

local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local _, _, introProgress, outroProgress =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, 0.5, 0.5, kFallbackClipLength)
    local aspect = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local sweepX = math.cos(kSweepAngle)
    local sweepY = math.sin(kSweepAngle)
    local bandPosition = mt.lerp(-kSweepReach, kSweepReach, mt.pingpong(ctx.time, kSweepPeriod))

    for _, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local geometry = part.geometry
        local worldX = (geometry.canvas_center_x - 0.5) * aspect
        local worldY = geometry.canvas_center_y - 0.5

        -- Signed distance along the sweep direction: negative once the
        -- band has passed this part.
        local signedDistance = (worldX * sweepX + worldY * sweepY) - bandPosition

        local flash = mt.falloff(signedDistance, kBandWidth)
        local lit = mt.smoothstep(0.0, 0.1, -signedDistance)

        -- Spectral color: hue fans out with position so neighboring
        -- parts refract into neighboring wavelengths.
        local prismHue = mt.wrap(kBaseHue + worldY * 0.35 + worldX * 0.12, 0.0, 1.0)
        local prismColor = mt.color.from_hsv(prismHue, 0.65, 1.0, 1.0)
        local dimColor = { r = 0.32, g = 0.33, b = 0.38, a = 1.0 }
        local white = { r = 1.0, g = 1.0, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }

        local settled = mt.color.lerp(dimColor, prismColor, lit)

        part.opacity = part.opacity * mt.ease.out_quad(introProgress) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroProgress))
        part.fill.use = true
        part.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(settled, white, flash)
        part.z = flash * kLiftHeight
        part.scale = part.scale * (1.0 + flash * 0.15)
    end
end
description: A tilted light band lifts and flashes parts, leaving spectral colors behind. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SPC004
-- @duration 5.0
-- @required 3d
-- @recommend bg #040509
-- @title Antigravity Singularity
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.2
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.9
--[[ @description
Parts spring from a singularity, hover weightlessly as assembled glyphs, and deconstruct into depth.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
中心から飛び出したパーツが文字に集まり、無重力で漂ってから奥行きへ分解される演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。パーツの数や分かれ方はフォントの輪郭に依存します。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.2
local kOutroDuration = 0.9
local kStaggerInterval = 0.03
local kSpringFrequency = 2.2
local kSpringDamping = 3.5
local kZeroGHorizontalAmount = 0.005
local kZeroGVerticalAmount = 0.009
local kMaxOpacity = 1.0

local kColorDeepSpace = { r = 0.88, g = 0.90, b = 0.94, a = 1.0 }
local kColorCyanTint = { r = 0.25, g = 0.85, b = 0.95, a = 1.0 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local introProgress, outroProgress = resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)

    -- Gentle anti-gravitational spatial posture rotation
    ctx.global.rotation = ctx.global.rotation + mt.wave(time, 0.12, 0.0) * 1.5
    ctx.global.yaw = ctx.global.yaw + mt.wave(time, 0.15, 0.5) * 4.0
    ctx.global.pitch = ctx.global.pitch + mt.wave(time, 0.18, 1.0) * 2.5

    -- Global opacity blending
    ctx.global.opacity = ctx.global.opacity * (mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress) * (1.0 - outroProgress))
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local remainingTime = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)
    local instanceSeed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local totalParts = ctx.part_count

    -- Keep every glyph assembled during the idle drift. Independent part
    -- motion made neighboring characters collide and broke their silhouettes.
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local wiggleX = mt.wiggle(
            time,
            0.35,
            kZeroGHorizontalAmount,
            2,
            instanceSeed + index)
        local wiggleY = mt.wiggle(
            time,
            0.28,
            kZeroGVerticalAmount,
            2,
            instanceSeed + index * 2)
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + wiggleX
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + wiggleY
    end

    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local geometry = part.geometry

        -- 1. Intro: Physical spring fluid transition from singularity
        local staggerTime = (index - 1) * kStaggerInterval
        local introSpan = math.max(totalParts - 1, 0) * kStaggerInterval + 0.5
        local introTime = introProgress * introSpan - staggerTime
        local introProgressPart = mt.clamp(introTime / 0.5, 0.0, 1.0)
        local springSettle = mt.spring(introTime, kSpringFrequency, kSpringDamping) * (1.0 - introProgress)

        local dx = 0.5 - geometry.canvas_center_x
        local dy = 0.5 - geometry.canvas_center_y
        local introOffsetX = 0.5 + dx * springSettle
        local introOffsetY = 0.5 + dy * springSettle
        local introZ = springSettle * 1.5
        local introScale = mt.lerp(0.1, 1.0, mt.ease.out_expo(introProgressPart))

        -- 2. Outro: Grid Deconstruction (seamless normalized window)
        local staggerRatio = 0.025
        local partOutroWindowStart = (index - 1) * staggerRatio
        local partOutroWindowSpan = math.max(0.3, 1.0 - (totalParts - 1) * staggerRatio)
        local partOutroRaw = mt.clamp((outroProgress - partOutroWindowStart) / partOutroWindowSpan, 0.0, 1.0)
        local partOutroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(partOutroRaw)

        local gridDirection = (index % 2 == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local outroOffsetX = partOutroEased * 0.1 * gridDirection
        local outroZ = partOutroEased * -0.8
        local outroYaw = partOutroEased * 90.0 * gridDirection

        -- 3. Idle: part-level depth drift and quantum spectrum
        local driftZ = mt.wave(time, 0.3, index * 0.2) * 0.02

        local distFromCenter = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        local rippleHue = mt.wrap(time * 0.2 + distFromCenter * 1.5, 0.0, 1.0)
        local oklchColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.78, 0.18, rippleHue, 1.0)
        local quantumPulse = (mt.wave(time * 1.5, 0.6, distFromCenter * 3.0) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.3
        local finalColor = mt.color.lerp(kColorDeepSpace, oklchColor, quantumPulse)

        -- Composite transform
        part.offset_x = part.offset_x + introOffsetX + outroOffsetX - 0.5
        part.offset_y = part.offset_y + introOffsetY - 0.5
        part.z = introZ + outroZ + driftZ
        part.yaw = outroYaw
        part.scale = part.scale * (introScale * (1.0 - partOutroEased * 0.4))
        part.opacity = part.opacity * (mt.clamp(introProgressPart * (1.0 - partOutroEased), 0.0, kMaxOpacity))

        part.fill.use = true
        part.fill.color = finalColor
    end
end
description: Parts spring from a singularity, hover weightlessly as assembled glyphs, and deconstruct into depth.

    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.1 -- seconds for the first wake front to finish
local kOutroDuration = 0.85 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.5 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kWakeRadius = 0.55 -- canvas units the intro front travels past center
local kWaveSpeed = 0.42 -- canvas units per second of the idle harmonic
local kWaveWidth = 0.07 -- half-width of the ring's gaussian envelope
local kLiftHeight = 0.045 -- canvas-height fraction at peak crest
local kScalePop = 0.22 -- extra scale at the crest
local kIdleAmplitude = 0.55 -- relative strength of the continuous harmonic
local kBaseHue = 0.55 -- cyan resting hue
local kFlashHue = 0.08 -- warm flash hue at the crest

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    -- Intro front starts collapsed at the center and expands outward.
    local introFront = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * kWakeRadius
    -- Idle harmonic keeps a slow ring pinging forever after the wake.
    local idleFront = mt.cycle(ctx.time, kWakeRadius / kWaveSpeed) * kWakeRadius
    -- Outro front collapses from the outside back to the center.
    local outroFront = (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount)) * kWakeRadius

    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        local radius = mt.layout.radial_distance(
            ctx,
            geometry.bounds_center_x,
            geometry.bounds_center_y
        )

        local introCrest = mt.falloff(radius - introFront, kWaveWidth)
        local idleCrest =
            mt.falloff(radius - idleFront, kWaveWidth) * kIdleAmplitude * introAmount
        local outroCrest = mt.falloff(radius - outroFront, kWaveWidth) * outroAmount

        -- Characters "wake" once the intro front has passed them, and
        -- fall back asleep as the outro front reclaims them from outside.
        local woken = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kWaveWidth * 1.5, introFront - radius)
        local asleep = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kWaveWidth * 1.5, radius - outroFront)
        local presence = woken * (1.0 - asleep * outroAmount)

        local crest = introCrest + idleCrest + outroCrest
        local lift = crest * kLiftHeight
        -- Outro also gently sinks the whole line so the exit is not only a
        -- ring fade but a physical collapse.
        local sink = outroAmount * 0.03

        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + lift - sink
        character.scale = character.scale * (1.0 + crest * kScalePop)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (mt.saturate(presence * 1.15) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount) * 0.35))

        local flash = mt.saturate(introCrest + idleCrest * 0.6)
        local restingColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kBaseHue, 0.35, 0.92, 1.0)
        local flashColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kFlashHue, 0.75, 1.0, 1.0)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(restingColor, flashColor, flash)
    end
end

name: SPC006_curious_lean.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SPC006
-- @duration 6.0
-- @required 3d
-- @title Curious Lean
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.15
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.95
--[[ @description
Glyphs lean into view, keep thinking through small head tilts, then spin away.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字が首を傾げるように手前へ現れ、細かな傾きを続けてから回転して去る演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.15
local kOutroDuration = 0.95
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerAmount = 0.5
local kWingDistance = 0.28 -- canvas fraction slid in from the side
local kPeekDrop = 0.04 -- slight drop while peeking in
local kIntroTiltDegrees = 18.0
local kSteadyTiltDegrees = 5.5
local kSteadyTiltFrequency = 0.55 -- Hz, thinking nod cadence
local kSteadyYawDegrees = 7.0
local kSteadyPulse = 0.06 -- scale breath while thinking
local kOutroSpinDegrees = 55.0
local kOutroKick = 0.34 -- canvas fraction of the exit shove
local kAmberHue = 0.08
local kSteelHue = 0.58

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local steadyAmount = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount))

    -- Room re-read: slow global yaw only while thinking.
    ctx.global.yaw = ctx.global.yaw + (mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.11, 0.0) * kSteadyYawDegrees * steadyAmount)
    ctx.global.pitch = ctx.global.pitch + (mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.09, 1.2) * 2.0 * steadyAmount)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress

        -- Per-character block weights (each finishes before clip end).
        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local introEased = mt.ease.out_back(introRaw)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_back(outroRaw)
        local introClamped = mt.saturate(introEased)
        local steadyWeight = introClamped * (1.0 - outroEased)

        -- Wing side alternates so the lean-in reads as a crowd, not a march.
        local wingSign = ((index % 2) == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local personality = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.75, 1.25)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro: side-eye peek from the wings
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introRemain = 1.0 - introClamped
        local introOffsetX = wingSign * kWingDistance * introRemain * personality
        local introOffsetY = -kPeekDrop * introRemain
        local introRotation = -wingSign * kIntroTiltDegrees * introRemain
        local introOpacity = mt.saturate(introRaw * 2.2)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady: thinking tilts + sly amber pulse (never still)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local thinkPhase = ctx.time * kSteadyTiltFrequency * math.pi * 2.0
            + index * 0.85
            + personality
        local thinkTilt = math.sin(thinkPhase) * kSteadyTiltDegrees * steadyWeight * personality
        local thinkNod = math.sin(thinkPhase * 0.5 + 0.4) * 0.008 * steadyWeight
        local thinkPulse = 1.0
            + math.sin(thinkPhase * 1.3) * kSteadyPulse * steadyWeight
        local amberMix = (math.sin(thinkPhase * 0.7) * 0.5 + 0.5) * steadyWeight * 0.55

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro: heel-spin shrug and opposite-wing exit
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local outroOffsetX = -wingSign * kOutroKick * outroEased * personality
        local outroOffsetY = kPeekDrop * 0.6 * outroEased
        local outroRotation = wingSign * kOutroSpinDegrees * outroEased
        local wink = 1.0 + math.sin(outroEased * math.pi) * 0.18
        local outroFade = 1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)

        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + introOffsetX + outroOffsetX
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + introOffsetY + thinkNod + outroOffsetY
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (introRotation + thinkTilt + outroRotation)
        character.scale = character.scale * (thinkPulse * wink)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (introOpacity * outroFade)

        local steel = mt.color.from_hsv(kSteelHue, 0.18, 0.92, 1.0)
        local amber = mt.color.from_hsv(kAmberHue, 0.72, 1.0, 1.0)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(steel, amber, amberMix)
    end
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SPC007
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Neural Spark
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.25
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.0
--[[ @description
Scattered thoughts snap into an answer, hold with a neural glow, then become a punchline.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
ばらばらの思考のような文字が一瞬で整列し、電気的な光の流れをまとってから再び動き出す演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.25
local kOutroDuration = 1.0
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerAmount = 0.48
local kChaosMin = 0.14
local kChaosMax = 0.38
local kChaosSpin = 140.0
local kSpringFrequency = 3.6
local kSpringDamping = 3.4
local kTokenHop = 0.012 -- canvas fraction of steady token ticks
local kTokenFrequency = 1.4 -- Hz base for token hops
local kStrokeBase = 0.01
local kStrokePulse = 0.012
local kPunchDistance = 0.42
local kPunchSpin = 200.0
local kPunchScale = 0.45

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local steadyAmount = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount))

    -- Thought-current tracking: slightly tight while answering, looser
    -- in chaos / punchline so fragments can breathe.
    ctx.global.tracking = ctx.global.tracking + (mt.lerp(0.06, 0.0, steadyAmount))
    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = 0.1 + (1.0 - steadyAmount) * 0.08
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = 110.0
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.05, g = 0.15, b = 0.35, a = 0.55 }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local characterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local time = ctx.time

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress

        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)

        -- Spring commit: scatterWeight 1 = pure chaos, 0 = locked answer.
        local springTime = introRaw * 1.2
        local springSettle = mt.spring(springTime, kSpringFrequency, kSpringDamping)
        local scatterWeight = mt.lerp(1.0, springSettle, mt.saturate(introRaw * 10.0))
        local answerWeight = mt.saturate(1.0 - scatterWeight) * (1.0 - outroEased)
        local steadyWeight = answerWeight

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro: noisy half-thoughts → decisive spring commit
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local chaosAngle = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.0, math.pi * 2.0)
        local chaosDistance =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount, kChaosMin, kChaosMax)
        local chaosSpin =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 2, -kChaosSpin, kChaosSpin)
        local introOffsetX = math.cos(chaosAngle) * chaosDistance * scatterWeight
        local introOffsetY = math.sin(chaosAngle) * chaosDistance * scatterWeight
        local introRotation = chaosSpin * scatterWeight
        -- Flicker while uncommitted, solid once the spring locks.
        local chaosFlicker = 0.35
            + 0.65 * mt.random_range(seed + math.floor(time * 18.0), index, 0.0, 1.0)
        local introOpacity = mt.lerp(chaosFlicker, 1.0, mt.saturate(1.0 - scatterWeight))

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady: voltage current + per-glyph token hops
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local tokenPhase = time * kTokenFrequency * math.pi * 2.0
            + order * math.pi * 1.7
            + mt.random_range(seed, index + 7, 0.0, math.pi)
        -- Soft square-ish hop: mostly down, brief uptick = "token emit".
        local tokenWave = math.max(0.0, math.sin(tokenPhase))
        local tokenHop = tokenWave * tokenWave * kTokenHop * steadyWeight
        local voltage = (mt.wave(time, 0.85, order * 2.4) * 0.5 + 0.5) * steadyWeight
        local currentHue = mt.wrap(0.52 + order * 0.22 + time * 0.08, 0.0, 1.0)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro: punchline detonation (new rays, not intro reverse)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local punchAngle =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 3, 0.0, math.pi * 2.0)
        local punchSpin =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 4, -kPunchSpin, kPunchSpin)
        local punchOffsetX = math.cos(punchAngle) * kPunchDistance * outroEased
        local punchOffsetY = math.sin(punchAngle) * kPunchDistance * outroEased
        local punchRotation = punchSpin * outroEased
        local punchScale = 1.0 + kPunchScale * outroEased
        local punchFade = 1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroRaw)

        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + introOffsetX + punchOffsetX
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + introOffsetY + tokenHop + punchOffsetY
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (introRotation + punchRotation)
        character.scale = character.scale * (punchScale)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (introOpacity * punchFade)

        -- Voltage palette: ice → electric cyan/violet while answering,
        -- blows toward hot white on the punchline.
        local answerColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.78 + voltage * 0.1, 0.16 + voltage * 0.08, currentHue, 1.0)
        local chaosColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.55, 0.04, 0.6, 1.0)
        local punchColor = { r = 1.0, g = 0.95, b = 0.88, a = 1.0 }
        local filled = mt.color.lerp(chaosColor, answerColor, answerWeight)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(filled, punchColor, outroEased)

        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width = kStrokeBase + kStrokePulse * voltage
        character.stroke.color = mt.color.from_oklch(0.7, 0.14, currentHue, 0.35 + voltage * 0.5)
        character.stroke.gap = 0.0

        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = {
            r = 0.1,
            g = 0.35,
            b = 0.9,
            a = 0.1 + 0.35 * answerWeight,
        }
    end
end

name: SPC008_debris_burst.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SPC008
-- @duration 6.0
-- @required 3d
-- @recommend bg #0a0a0c
-- @title Debris Burst
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.1
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=4.3
--[[ @description
Heat and pressure build until text fractures into tumbling, burning debris.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字が発光・振動して負荷を蓄え、最後に奥行きへ回転する燃える破片として散る演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。パーツの数や分かれ方はフォントの輪郭に依存します。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0

local kIntroDuration = 1.1
local kIntroStagger = 0.45 -- fraction of the intro spread across parts
local kSettleDistance = 0.26 -- canvas fraction the parts converge from
local kSettleSpin = 220.0 -- degrees of tumble shed while converging

-- The load phase runs in two beats: the glow climbs the text until it is fully
-- saturated, then everything holds at the limit for a breath before failing.
local kOutroLead = 4.3
local kGlowDuration = 1.9
local kHoldDuration = 0.6
local kTremorFrequency = 22.0 -- shudder cycles per second at full load
local kTremorAmount = 0.0035 -- canvas fraction of the shudder at full load
local kHoldTremorBoost = 2.2 -- the shudder tightens further during the hold
local kGlowLoadShare = 0.75 -- fraction of the total strain applied by full glow
local kLoadCompression = 0.05 -- how far the text compresses under load
local kLoadTracking = 0.05 -- letters crowd together as the strain peaks

-- The heat color is the inspector's gradient end color, left untouched so the
-- effect is retintable. Only the edge between it and the untouched fill moves,
-- rising through the text from the bottom up.
local kGlowAngle = 90.0 -- top-to-bottom axis: fill above, end_color below
local kGlowMidpoint = 0.0 -- biases the ramp toward end_color for a crisp edge
local kGlowEdgeStart = 1.0 -- edge begins at the cap height, text fully cold
local kGlowEdgeEnd = -0.1 -- and is walked past the baseline, leaving it saturated
local kGlowEdgeLead = 0.3 -- how far end trails start: the softness of the edge

-- Failure is near enough simultaneous, with only a slight radial delay from the
-- epicentre so the break reads as one event spreading outward. The variety
-- lives in the flight, not the timing.
local kFailureRadialDelay = 0.09 -- seconds from the centre to the furthest part
local kBurstSpeedMin = 0.7
local kBurstSpeedMax = 1.4
local kBurstSpread = 30.0 -- degrees each fragment may deviate from its throw
-- A purely radial throw is nearly horizontal on one line of text, leaving no arc
-- to fall from. Blending toward straight up gives every fragment real lift.
local kBurstUpwardBias = 0.62 -- 0 = purely radial, 1 = straight up
local kBurstGravity = 2.6
local kBurstDrag = 0.25 -- 1/second, light air resistance that keeps the arcs
local kBurstSpin = 200.0 -- degrees per second; more turns competes with the arc
local kBurstShrink = 0.15 -- perspective already shrinks whatever recedes

-- Depth, so some fragments tumble toward the camera and others recede. Total
-- tumble angles rather than rates: each settles into an attitude and holds it,
-- keeping its silhouette readable along the arc.
local kBurstDepthNear = -0.55
local kBurstDepthFar = 0.75
local kBurstTumbleYaw = 70.0
local kBurstTumblePitch = 60.0
local kBurstTumbleRamp = 0.6 -- seconds to reach the settled attitude

local kLifetimeMin = 0.7
local kLifetimeMax = 1.5
local kFlashMin = 0.08 -- shortest white-hot flash as a fragment lets go
local kFlashMax = 0.26 -- longest flash, so the breaks read individually
local kCoolDuration = 0.55 -- seconds to fall from glowing back to the text colour
local kColorEmber = { r = 1.0, g = 0.97, b = 0.92, a = 1.0 }

---Seconds since the outro began, 0 beforehand.
local function getOutroElapsed(ctx)
    local _, outroProgress = resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroLead, kFallbackClipLength)
    return outroProgress * kOutroLead
end

---Progress of the heat climbing the text, reaching 1 well before failure.
local function getGlowAmount(outroElapsed)
    return mt.saturate(outroElapsed / kGlowDuration)
end

---Progress through the held breath that follows full glow.
local function getHoldAmount(outroElapsed)
    return mt.saturate((outroElapsed - kGlowDuration) / kHoldDuration)
end

---Seconds since the text gave way, still negative while it holds.
local function getFailureElapsed(outroElapsed)
    return outroElapsed - kGlowDuration - kHoldDuration
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local outroElapsed = getOutroElapsed(ctx)
    local glow = getGlowAmount(outroElapsed)
    local hold = getHoldAmount(outroElapsed)
    local heat = mt.ease.in_quad(glow)

    -- The glow takes the strain most of the way; the hold supplies the rest, so
    -- the held beat reads as mounting pressure rather than a pause.
    local load = glow * kGlowLoadShare + hold * (1.0 - kGlowLoadShare)

    ctx.global.gradient.color_space = "oklab"
    ctx.global.gradient.angle = kGlowAngle
    ctx.global.gradient.midpoint = kGlowMidpoint

    -- The position pair is the edge between cold text above and heat below.
    -- Walking it down past the baseline leaves every glyph saturated.
    local heatEdge = mt.lerp(kGlowEdgeStart, kGlowEdgeEnd, heat)
    ctx.global.gradient.start_position = heatEdge
    ctx.global.gradient.end_position = heatEdge + kGlowEdgeLead

    -- The strain only applies while the text is still intact; glow and hold both
    -- stay at 1 afterwards, so the gate is what releases the debris.
    if getFailureElapsed(outroElapsed) <= 0.0 then
        local tremor = mt.wave(ctx.time, kTremorFrequency * (1.0 + hold * kHoldTremorBoost), 0.0)
        ctx.global.position_x = ctx.global.position_x + tremor * kTremorAmount * math.max(heat, hold)
        ctx.global.tracking = ctx.global.tracking - load * kLoadTracking
        ctx.global.stretch_y = ctx.global.stretch_y * (1.0 - load * kLoadCompression)
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local introProgress = resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, 0.0, kFallbackClipLength)
    local outroElapsed = getOutroElapsed(ctx)
    local failureElapsed = getFailureElapsed(outroElapsed)
    local hold = getHoldAmount(outroElapsed)
    local load = math.max(getGlowAmount(outroElapsed), hold)

    -- Aspect corrected, so the burst stays circular on a wide comp.
    local characterRadius = {}
    local furthestRadius = 0.0
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        local radius = mt.layout.radial_distance(ctx, geometry.bounds_center_x, geometry.bounds_center_y)
        characterRadius[index] = radius
        furthestRadius = math.max(furthestRadius, radius)
    end

    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local geometry = part.geometry

        -- Normalised so the delay stays the same regardless of text length.
        local radius = characterRadius[part.character_index]
        local radialProgress = furthestRadius > 0.0 and radius / furthestRadius or 0.0
        local sinceBurst = failureElapsed - radialProgress * kFailureRadialDelay

        if sinceBurst > 0.0 then
            -- Angles are screen based (-90 is straight up) while canvas Y is up,
            -- hence the negated vertical delta. Rotating the outward direction
            -- toward vertical keeps the left/right split while giving every
            -- fragment enough lift to arc over and fall back.
            local outwardAngle = math.deg(math.atan(0.5 - geometry.canvas_center_y, geometry.canvas_center_x - 0.5))
            local throwAngle = mt.lerp_angle(outwardAngle, -90.0, kBurstUpwardBias)

            local flight = mt.projectile_2d({
                t = sinceBurst,
                speed = mt.random_range(seed, index, kBurstSpeedMin, kBurstSpeedMax, "speed"),
                angle = throwAngle + mt.random_range(seed, index, -kBurstSpread, kBurstSpread, "spread"),
                gravity = kBurstGravity,
                drag = kBurstDrag,
                spin = mt.random_range(seed, index, -kBurstSpin, kBurstSpin, "spin"),
            })

            part.offset_x = part.offset_x + flight.x
            part.offset_y = part.offset_y + flight.y
            part.rotation = part.rotation + flight.rotation

            -- Constant rate, deliberately ungoverned by gravity: pulling Z back
            -- would flatten the spread toward the layout plane.
            part.z = part.z + mt.random_range(seed, index, kBurstDepthNear, kBurstDepthFar, "depth") * sinceBurst

            local tumble = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate(sinceBurst / kBurstTumbleRamp))
            part.yaw = part.yaw + mt.random_range(seed, index, -kBurstTumbleYaw, kBurstTumbleYaw, "yaw") * tumble
            part.pitch = part.pitch
                + mt.random_range(seed, index, -kBurstTumblePitch, kBurstTumblePitch, "pitch") * tumble

            local age = mt.saturate(sinceBurst / mt.random_range(seed, index, kLifetimeMin, kLifetimeMax, "life"))
            part.scale = part.scale * (1.0 - kBurstShrink * age)
            part.opacity = part.opacity * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(age))

            -- fill.use holds for the whole flight, since it is what keeps the
            -- fragment off the saturated gradient. Breaking away costs it the
            -- pressure that was heating it, so it flares white on release and
            -- then cools to the text's own colour.
            local flashDuration = mt.random_range(seed, index, kFlashMin, kFlashMax, "flash")
            local flash = 1.0 - mt.saturate(sinceBurst / flashDuration)
            local baseColor = mt.color.resolve_fill(ctx, part)
            local glowColor = ctx.global.gradient.end_color
            local cooled = mt.color.lerp(glowColor, baseColor, mt.ease.out_quad(sinceBurst / kCoolDuration))
            part.fill.use = true
            part.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(cooled, kColorEmber, flash)
        elseif load > 0.0 then
            -- Still holding, but straining: fragments creak against each other
            -- with a jitter that grows right up to the breaking point.
            local jitterFrequency = kTremorFrequency * (1.0 + hold * kHoldTremorBoost)
            local jitterPhase = mt.wave(ctx.time, jitterFrequency, index * 0.13)
            local jitterAngle = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.0, 360.0, "jitter")
            local jitterX, jitterY = mt.polar_offset_2d(jitterAngle, mt.ease.in_quad(load) * kTremorAmount)
            part.offset_x = part.offset_x + jitterX * jitterPhase
            part.offset_y = part.offset_y + jitterY * jitterPhase
        elseif introProgress < 1.0 then
            -- Intro: fragments converge on their glyph from a scattered ring,
            -- shedding the tumble they arrived with.
            local settle = mt.ease.out_cubic(
                mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, mt.distribute(index, ctx.part_count), kIntroStagger))
            local remaining = 1.0 - settle

            local approachAngle = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.0, 360.0, "approach")
            local distance = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.5, 1.0, "distance") * kSettleDistance
            local offsetX, offsetY = mt.polar_offset_2d(approachAngle, remaining * distance)

            part.offset_x = part.offset_x + offsetX
            part.offset_y = part.offset_y + offsetY
            part.rotation = part.rotation + remaining * mt.random_range(seed, index, -kSettleSpin, kSettleSpin, "settle")
            part.opacity = part.opacity * settle
        end
    end
end
description: Heat and pressure build until text fractures into tumbling, burning debris.
