-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SPC009
-- @duration 11.0
-- @required 3d
-- @recommend text "ENDLESS-SIGNAL"
-- @recommend bg #03030A
-- @title Mobius Transmission
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=7.2
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=2.15
--[[ @description
Fragments assemble into a one-sided receiver, circle a signal, decode into text, and escape into depth. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
パーツが一面の受信ループへ集まり、信号が巡回した後に読みやすい文字へ切り替わり、最後は奥行きへ散る演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。演出の定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。パーツの数や分かれ方はフォントの輪郭に依存します。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。

Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。IntroをOFFにすると開始演出を省略し、OutroをOFFにすると終了演出を省略します。
]]


local kFallbackClipLength = 11.0
local kArrivalDuration = 1.35
local kArrivalStaggerSpan = 0.55
local kArrivalDepth = 0.85
local kArrivalArcDegrees = 220.0
local kArrivalRadialDistance = 0.48
local kPulseStart =
    kArrivalDuration + kArrivalStaggerSpan + 0.05
local kPulsePeriod = 1.8
local kPulseAfterglowDuration = 0.35
local kPulsePauseDuration = 0.55
local kIntroStart =
    kPulseStart +
    kPulsePeriod +
    kPulseAfterglowDuration +
    kPulsePauseDuration
local kIntroDuration = 1.3
local kIntroStaggerSpan = 0.45
local kIntroScaleSettleDuration = 0.8
local kIntroFadeDuration = 0.32
local kMinimumTextHoldDuration = 1.7
local kOutroLeadTime = 2.15
local kOutroDuration = 1.15
local kOutroStaggerSpan = 0.42
local kOutroFadeDuration = 0.48

local kLoopCenterX = 0.5
local kLoopCenterY = 0.5
local kLoopRadius = 0.275
local kLeafLengthUnits = 1320.0
local kLeafHalfWidthUnits = 172.0
local kLeafOverlap = 1.08
local kLeafVeinGapRatio = 0.065
local kLeafCenterSkewRatio = 0.1
local kLeafUpperFullness = 0.96
local kLeafLowerFullness = 0.82
local kLeafFullnessVariation = 0.08
local kLeafUpperTrailingControlRatio = 0.58
local kLeafUpperLeadingControlRatio = 0.2
local kLeafUpperTrailingHeightRatio = 0.82
local kLeafLowerTrailingControlRatio = 0.52
local kLeafLowerLeadingControlRatio = 0.28
local kLeafLowerTrailingHeightRatio = 0.68
local kLeafVeinTrailingControlRatio = 0.42
local kLeafVeinLeadingControlRatio = 0.36
local kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio = 0.26
local kPathUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kMinimumLeafScale = 0.28
local kMaximumLeafScale = 1.35
local kMinimumScale = 0.0001
local kEdgeOnYaw = 90.0
local kHalfTurnDegrees = 180.0
local kFullTurnDegrees = 360.0

local kPulseRadius = 0.105
local kPulseTrailOffset = 0.13
local kPulseTrailRadius = 0.18
local kPulseTrailStrength = 0.38
local kPulseWidthBoost = 0.42
local kPulseDepthLift = 0.035
local kIdleBreathAmount = 0.018
local kIdleBreathFrequency = 0.21
local kShardLengthUnits = 1180.0
local kShardHalfWidthUnits = 72.0
local kShardLaunchDistance = 0.52
local kShardDepth = 0.72
local kShardPositionFanDegrees = 22.0
local kShardDirectionJitterDegrees = 35.0
local kShardMinimumSpeedScale = 0.76
local kShardMaximumSpeedScale = 1.28
local kShardDirectionSeedOffset = 113
local kShardSpeedSeedOffset = 197
local kShardTailEndRatio = 0.62
local kShardShoulderRatio = 0.18
local kShardTailNotchUnits = 115.0
local kShardAfterimageLengthUnits = 220.0
local kShardAfterimageCount = 2
local kShardAfterimageLengthDecay = 0.72
local kShardAfterimageBaseGapUnits = 90.0
local kShardAfterimageTravelGapUnits = 150.0
local kShardAfterimageHeightRatio = 0.28
local kShardAfterimageVerticalOffsetRatio = 0.42
local kShardAfterimageSlantUnits = 32.0
local kGlitchPulseCount = 3
local kGlitchPulseSpacing = 0.105
local kGlitchPulseDuration = 0.09
local kGlitchFalloffRadiusRatio = 0.42
local kGlitchBurstPeriod = 0.94
local kGlitchTimingJitter = 0.028
local kGlitchActivationChance = 0.42
local kGlitchMinimumStrength = 0.68
local kGlitchCharacterSeedStride = 4099
local kGlitchEventSeedStride = 131
local kGlitchTimingSeedOffset = 17
local kGlitchActivationSeedOffset = 43
local kGlitchStrengthSeedOffset = 79
local kGlitchBlockCount = 5
local kGlitchBlockHeightUnits = 96.0
local kGlitchBlockVerticalStepUnits = 155.0
local kGlitchBlockBaseWidthUnits = 300.0
local kGlitchBlockWidthStepUnits = 90.0
local kGlitchOffset = 0.008

local kCameraPerspective = 0.28
local kCameraYawAmplitude = 13.0
local kCameraPitch = 8.0
local kCameraZoom = 1.04

local kPearlColor = { r = 0.82, g = 0.87, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 }
local kLeafColor = { r = 0.12, g = 0.32, b = 0.72, a = 1.0 }
local kPulseColor = { r = 0.68, g = 1.0, b = 0.94, a = 1.0 }
local kGlitchColorA = { r = 0.2, g = 0.95, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kGlitchColorB = { r = 1.0, g = 0.22, b = 0.74, a = 1.0 }
local kEdgeColor = { r = 0.04, g = 0.08, b = 0.22, a = 0.96 }
local kStrokeWidth = 0.008

local kPathModeLeaf = "leaf"
local kPathModeShard = "shard"
local kPathModeGlitch = "glitch"

local cachedPathMode = {}
local cachedPathWidth = {}
local cachedPathBend = {}
local cachedPathProgress = {}

local function resolveAnimationClock(ctx)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    introSeconds = introSeconds * compression
    outroSeconds = outroSeconds * compression
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, kFallbackClipLength)
    local originalIntro = kIntroStart + kIntroDuration + kIntroStaggerSpan + kIntroScaleSettleDuration
    local originalDuration = originalIntro + kMinimumTextHoldDuration + kOutroLeadTime
    local holdSeconds = math.max(clipSeconds - introSeconds - outroSeconds, 0.0)
    local animationTime = originalIntro * introProgress
    if introProgress >= 1.0 then
        local holdProgress = mt.saturate((ctx.time - introSeconds) / math.max(holdSeconds, 0.000001))
        animationTime = originalIntro + kMinimumTextHoldDuration * holdProgress + kOutroLeadTime * outroProgress
    end
    return animationTime, originalDuration
end

local function getOutroStart(ctx)
    return math.max(
        kIntroStart + kIntroDuration + kIntroStaggerSpan +
            kMinimumTextHoldDuration,
        select(2, resolveAnimationClock(ctx)) - kOutroLeadTime)
end

local function getCircularDistance(firstPosition, secondPosition)
    local directDistance = math.abs(firstPosition - secondPosition)
    return math.min(directDistance, 1.0 - directDistance)
end

local function getStaggerProgress(
        time,
        ordinal,
        characterCount,
        pattern,
        totalSpan,
        duration)
    local perCharacterDelay =
        totalSpan / math.max(characterCount - 1, 1)
    local progress = mt.stagger_pattern(
        time,
        ordinal,
        characterCount,
        pattern,
        perCharacterDelay,
        duration)
    return mt.smoothstep(
        0.0,
        1.0,
        progress)
end

local function getGlitchEvent(ctx, ordinal, outroStart)
    local animationTime = resolveAnimationClock(ctx)
    local textHoldStart =
        kIntroStart + kIntroDuration + kIntroStaggerSpan + 0.18
    local textHoldEnd = outroStart - 0.22
    local glitchAmount = 0.0
    local glitchEventIndex = 0

    if animationTime >= textHoldStart and animationTime < textHoldEnd then
        local rhythmTime = animationTime - textHoldStart
        local currentBurstIndex =
            math.floor(rhythmTime / kGlitchBurstPeriod)

        for burstOffset = -1, 1 do
            local burstIndex = currentBurstIndex + burstOffset
            if burstIndex >= 0 then
                for pulseIndex = 0, kGlitchPulseCount - 1 do
                    local eventIndex =
                        burstIndex * kGlitchPulseCount + pulseIndex
                    local randomIndex =
                        ordinal * kGlitchCharacterSeedStride +
                        eventIndex * kGlitchEventSeedStride
                    local selectedCharacter =
                        mt.random(
                            ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                                kGlitchActivationSeedOffset,
                            randomIndex) < kGlitchActivationChance

                    if selectedCharacter then
                        local timingOffset =
                            mt.random_range(
                                ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                                    kGlitchTimingSeedOffset,
                                randomIndex,
                                -kGlitchTimingJitter,
                                kGlitchTimingJitter)
                        local eventTime =
                            textHoldStart +
                            burstIndex * kGlitchBurstPeriod +
                            pulseIndex * kGlitchPulseSpacing +
                            timingOffset
                        local eventDistance =
                            math.abs(animationTime - eventTime)

                        if eventDistance <=
                            kGlitchPulseDuration * 0.5 then
                            local eventStrength =
                                mt.random_range(
                                    ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                                        kGlitchStrengthSeedOffset,
                                    randomIndex,
                                    kGlitchMinimumStrength,
                                    1.0)
                            local candidateAmount =
                                mt.falloff(
                                    eventDistance,
                                    kGlitchPulseDuration *
                                        kGlitchFalloffRadiusRatio) *
                                eventStrength
                            if candidateAmount > glitchAmount then
                                glitchAmount = candidateAmount
                                glitchEventIndex = eventIndex + 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return glitchAmount, glitchEventIndex
end

local function getFoldTransforms(segmentState, targetRotation, targetPitch)
    local yaw = 0.0
    local rotation = 0.0
    local pitch = 0.0

    if segmentState < 0.5 then
        local foldProgress = mt.smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, segmentState * 2.0)
        yaw = mt.lerp(0.0, kEdgeOnYaw, foldProgress)
    else
        local unfoldProgress =
            mt.smoothstep(
                0.0,
                1.0,
                (segmentState - 0.5) * 2.0)
        yaw = mt.lerp(kEdgeOnYaw, 0.0, unfoldProgress)
        rotation = targetRotation * unfoldProgress
        pitch = targetPitch * unfoldProgress
    end

    return yaw, rotation, pitch
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local animationTime, clipLength = resolveAnimationClock(ctx)
    local inspectorGlobalScale = ctx.global.scale
    local introScaleReleaseStart =
        kIntroStart + kIntroStaggerSpan + kIntroDuration * 0.5
    local introScaleReleaseEnd =
        kIntroStart +
        kIntroDuration +
        kIntroStaggerSpan +
        kIntroScaleSettleDuration
    local introScaleReleaseProgress = mt.saturate(
        mt.inverse_lerp(
            introScaleReleaseStart,
            introScaleReleaseEnd,
            animationTime))
    local introScaleLock =
        1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(introScaleReleaseProgress)
    local introCompletion =
        mt.smoothstep(
            kIntroStart,
            kIntroStart +
                kIntroDuration +
                kIntroStaggerSpan,
            animationTime)
    local introLoopPresence = 1.0 - introCompletion
    local outroStart = getOutroStart(ctx)
    local outroScaleLockStart =
        outroStart + kOutroStaggerSpan + kOutroDuration * 0.5
    local outroScaleLockEnd =
        outroStart + kOutroStaggerSpan + kOutroDuration
    local outroScaleLock = mt.smoothstep(
        outroScaleLockStart,
        outroScaleLockEnd,
        animationTime)
    local generatedScaleLock =
        math.max(introScaleLock, outroScaleLock)
    local outroPresence =
        mt.smoothstep(
            outroStart,
            outroStart +
                kOutroDuration +
                kOutroStaggerSpan,
            animationTime)
    local introVisibility =
        mt.smoothstep(0.0, kIntroFadeDuration, animationTime)
    local outroVisibility = 1.0 - mt.smoothstep(
        clipLength - kOutroFadeDuration,
        clipLength,
        animationTime)

    ctx.camera.yaw =
        mt.wave(animationTime, 0.115, 0.0) *
            kCameraYawAmplitude * introLoopPresence -
        outroPresence * 7.0
    ctx.camera.pitch =
        kCameraPitch * introLoopPresence - outroPresence * 4.0
    ctx.camera.perspective =
        kCameraPerspective * math.max(introLoopPresence, outroPresence)
    ctx.camera.zoom =
        mt.lerp(1.0, kCameraZoom, introLoopPresence) -
        outroPresence * 0.06
    ctx.global.scale =
        mt.lerp(inspectorGlobalScale, 1.0, generatedScaleLock)
    ctx.global.opacity =
        ctx.global.opacity * introVisibility * outroVisibility
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local animationTime = resolveAnimationClock(ctx)
    cachedPathMode = {}
    cachedPathWidth = {}
    cachedPathBend = {}
    cachedPathProgress = {}

    local leafCharacterCount = 0
    local ordinalByCharacter = {}
    for characterIndex, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if character.part_count > 0 then
            leafCharacterCount = leafCharacterCount + 1
            ordinalByCharacter[characterIndex] = leafCharacterCount
        end
    end

    local emCanvasHeight = math.max(
        ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent,
        0.001)
    local angleStep = kFullTurnDegrees / math.max(leafCharacterCount, 1)
    local chordLength =
        2.0 * kLoopRadius *
        math.sin(math.rad(angleStep) * 0.5) *
        kLeafOverlap
    local targetLeafScale = mt.clamp(
        chordLength / (emCanvasHeight * kLeafLengthUnits / kPathUnitsPerEm),
        kMinimumLeafScale,
        kMaximumLeafScale)
    local pulseProgress = mt.saturate(
        mt.inverse_lerp(
            kPulseStart,
            kPulseStart + kPulsePeriod,
            animationTime))
    local pulseVisibility =
        mt.smoothstep(kPulseStart, kPulseStart + 0.12, animationTime) *
        (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(
            kPulseStart + kPulsePeriod,
            kPulseStart + kPulsePeriod +
                kPulseAfterglowDuration,
            animationTime))
    local pulsePosition = pulseProgress
    local pulseTrailPosition =
        mt.cycle(pulsePosition - kPulseTrailOffset, 1.0)
    local breathingRadius =
        kLoopRadius *
        (1.0 + mt.wave(animationTime, kIdleBreathFrequency, 0.0) * kIdleBreathAmount)
    local outroStart = getOutroStart(ctx)

    for characterIndex, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
            local ordinal = ordinalByCharacter[characterIndex]

        if ordinal ~= nil then
            local distributedPosition =
                (ordinal - 1.0) / math.max(leafCharacterCount, 1)
            local angleDegrees = distributedPosition * kFullTurnDegrees
            local introLeafState =
                1.0 - getStaggerProgress(
                    animationTime - kIntroStart,
                    ordinal,
                    leafCharacterCount,
                    "asc",
                    kIntroStaggerSpan,
                    kIntroDuration)
            local outroState =
                getStaggerProgress(
                    animationTime - outroStart,
                    ordinal,
                    leafCharacterCount,
                    "desc",
                    kOutroStaggerSpan,
                    kOutroDuration)
            local arrivalProgress =
                getStaggerProgress(
                    animationTime,
                    ordinal,
                    leafCharacterCount,
                    "asc",
                    kArrivalStaggerSpan,
                    kArrivalDuration)
            local naturalCanvasX, naturalCanvasY =
                mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
            local pulseDistance =
                getCircularDistance(distributedPosition, pulsePosition)
            local pulseTrailDistance =
                getCircularDistance(
                    distributedPosition,
                    pulseTrailPosition)
            local pulseAmount = mt.saturate(
                mt.falloff(pulseDistance, kPulseRadius) +
                mt.falloff(pulseTrailDistance, kPulseTrailRadius) *
                    kPulseTrailStrength)
            local placedCanvasX = naturalCanvasX
            local placedCanvasY = naturalCanvasY
            local pathMode = nil
            local pathWidth = kLeafHalfWidthUnits
            local pathBend = 0.0
            local pathProgress = 0.0
            local color = kPearlColor
            local strokeColor = kEdgeColor

            if outroState > 0.0 then
                local launchProgress = mt.smoothstep(
                    0.5,
                    1.0,
                    outroState)
                local directionJitter =
                    mt.random_range(
                        ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                            kShardDirectionSeedOffset,
                        ordinal,
                        -kShardDirectionJitterDegrees,
                        kShardDirectionJitterDegrees)
                local speedScale =
                    mt.random_range(
                        ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                            kShardSpeedSeedOffset,
                        ordinal,
                        kShardMinimumSpeedScale,
                        kShardMaximumSpeedScale)
                local launchAngle =
                    -90.0 +
                    (distributedPosition - 0.5) *
                        kShardPositionFanDegrees +
                    directionJitter
                local launchDistance =
                    launchProgress *
                    kShardLaunchDistance *
                    speedScale
                local launchOffsetX, launchOffsetY =
                    mt.polar_offset_2d(
                        launchAngle,
                        launchDistance)
                placedCanvasX = naturalCanvasX + launchOffsetX
                placedCanvasY = naturalCanvasY + launchOffsetY

                local yaw, rotation, pitch =
                    getFoldTransforms(
                        outroState,
                        launchAngle,
                        -28.0 + distributedPosition * 56.0)
                character.yaw = character.yaw + yaw
                character.rotation =
                    character.rotation +
                    rotation
                character.pitch = character.pitch + pitch
                character.z =
                    character.z +
                    launchProgress *
                        kShardDepth *
                        speedScale
                character.scale =
                    character.scale * mt.lerp(1.0, 0.58, launchProgress)
                if outroState >= 0.5 then
                    character.scale =
                        character.scale /
                        math.max(ctx.global.scale, kMinimumScale)
                end
                character.opacity =
                    character.opacity *
                    (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.72, 1.0, outroState))

                local shardPulse =
                    mt.falloff(outroState - 0.58, 0.16)
                color =
                    mt.color.lerp(kPearlColor, kPulseColor, shardPulse)
                strokeColor =
                    mt.color.lerp(kEdgeColor, kPulseColor, shardPulse)
                pathMode =
                    outroState >= 0.5 and kPathModeShard or nil
                pathWidth =
                    kShardHalfWidthUnits * (1.0 + shardPulse * 0.7)
                pathBend =
                    (distributedPosition - 0.5) * 0.3
                pathProgress =
                    mt.saturate(launchProgress * speedScale)
            else
                local arrivalAngleDegrees =
                    angleDegrees -
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) * kArrivalArcDegrees
                local arrivalAngleRadians =
                    math.rad(arrivalAngleDegrees)
                local arrivalRadius =
                    breathingRadius +
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) *
                        kArrivalRadialDistance
                local arrivalCanvasX =
                    kLoopCenterX +
                    math.cos(arrivalAngleRadians) * arrivalRadius /
                        (ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio *
                            ctx.canvas.pixel_aspect_ratio)
                local arrivalCanvasY =
                    kLoopCenterY +
                    math.sin(arrivalAngleRadians) * arrivalRadius
                placedCanvasX =
                    mt.lerp(
                        naturalCanvasX,
                        arrivalCanvasX,
                        introLeafState)
                placedCanvasY =
                    mt.lerp(
                        naturalCanvasY,
                        arrivalCanvasY,
                        introLeafState)

                local targetRotation =
                    -(arrivalAngleDegrees + 90.0)
                local targetPitch =
                    distributedPosition * kHalfTurnDegrees -
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) *
                        kArrivalArcDegrees * 0.5
                local yaw, rotation, pitch =
                    getFoldTransforms(
                        introLeafState,
                        targetRotation,
                        targetPitch)
                character.yaw = character.yaw + yaw
                character.rotation =
                    character.rotation + rotation
                character.pitch = character.pitch + pitch
                character.z =
                    character.z +
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) *
                        kArrivalDepth *
                        introLeafState
                character.scale =
                    character.scale *
                    mt.lerp(
                        1.0,
                        targetLeafScale,
                        introLeafState) *
                    mt.lerp(0.32, 1.0, arrivalProgress)
                character.opacity =
                    character.opacity *
                    mt.smoothstep(0.0, 0.45, arrivalProgress)

                local visiblePulse =
                    pulseAmount *
                    pulseVisibility *
                    introLeafState *
                    arrivalProgress
                character.z =
                    character.z - visiblePulse * kPulseDepthLift
                color = mt.color.lerp(
                    mt.color.lerp(
                        kPearlColor,
                        kLeafColor,
                        introLeafState),
                    kPulseColor,
                    visiblePulse)
                strokeColor =
                    mt.color.lerp(
                        kEdgeColor,
                        kPulseColor,
                        visiblePulse * 0.7)
                pathMode =
                    introLeafState >= 0.5 and kPathModeLeaf or nil
                pathWidth =
                    kLeafHalfWidthUnits *
                    (1.0 + visiblePulse * kPulseWidthBoost)
                pathBend =
                    mt.wave(animationTime, 0.38, distributedPosition) *
                    (0.08 + visiblePulse * 0.14)

                local glitchAmount, glitchEventIndex =
                    getGlitchEvent(ctx, ordinal, outroStart)
                if introLeafState < 0.5 and
                    glitchEventIndex > 0 then
                    local glitchDirection =
                        (ordinal + glitchEventIndex) % 2 == 0 and
                        1.0 or -1.0
                    placedCanvasX =
                        placedCanvasX +
                        glitchDirection *
                            kGlitchOffset * glitchAmount
                    placedCanvasY =
                        placedCanvasY +
                        ((glitchEventIndex - 1) %
                            kGlitchPulseCount - 1.0) *
                            kGlitchOffset * 0.35 *
                            glitchAmount
                    character.stretch_x =
                        character.stretch_x *
                        (1.0 + glitchAmount * 0.18)
                    character.stretch_y =
                        character.stretch_y *
                        (1.0 - glitchAmount * 0.12)
                    color = mt.color.lerp(
                        kPearlColor,
                        glitchEventIndex % 2 == 0 and
                            kGlitchColorA or kGlitchColorB,
                        glitchAmount)
                    strokeColor =
                        mt.color.lerp(
                            kEdgeColor,
                            kPulseColor,
                            glitchAmount)
                    pathMode = kPathModeGlitch
                    pathWidth = glitchAmount
                    pathBend = glitchEventIndex
                end
            end

            mt.layout.place_2d(
                ctx,
                character,
                placedCanvasX,
                placedCanvasY)

            if pathMode ~= nil then
                local firstPart = ctx.parts[character.part_start]
                if firstPart ~= nil then
                    mt.layout.place_2d(
                        ctx,
                        firstPart,
                        placedCanvasX,
                        placedCanvasY)
                end
            end

            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = color
            character.stroke.use = true
            character.stroke.width = kStrokeWidth
            character.stroke.gap = 0.0
            character.stroke.color = strokeColor

            cachedPathMode[characterIndex] = pathMode
            cachedPathWidth[characterIndex] = pathWidth
            cachedPathBend[characterIndex] = pathBend
            cachedPathProgress[characterIndex] = pathProgress
        end
    end
end

local function appendLeafPath(path, characterIndex, halfWidth, bend)
    local halfLength = kLeafLengthUnits * 0.5
    local leafDirection =
        characterIndex % 2 == 0 and -1.0 or 1.0
    local centerY =
        halfWidth * kLeafCenterSkewRatio * leafDirection
    local veinGap = halfWidth * kLeafVeinGapRatio
    local upperWidth =
        halfWidth *
        (kLeafUpperFullness -
            leafDirection * kLeafFullnessVariation) *
        (1.0 + bend)
    local lowerWidth =
        halfWidth *
        (kLeafLowerFullness +
            leafDirection * kLeafFullnessVariation) *
        (1.0 - bend)

    path:move_to(-halfLength, centerY - veinGap)
    path:cubic_to(
        -halfLength * kLeafUpperTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY - upperWidth * kLeafUpperTrailingHeightRatio,
        halfLength * kLeafUpperLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY - upperWidth,
        halfLength,
        centerY)
    path:cubic_to(
        halfLength * kLeafVeinLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY - veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength * kLeafVeinTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY - veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength,
        centerY - veinGap)
    path:close()

    path:move_to(-halfLength, centerY + veinGap)
    path:cubic_to(
        -halfLength * kLeafLowerTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY + lowerWidth * kLeafLowerTrailingHeightRatio,
        halfLength * kLeafLowerLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY + lowerWidth,
        halfLength,
        centerY)
    path:cubic_to(
        halfLength * kLeafVeinLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY + veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength * kLeafVeinTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY + veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength,
        centerY + veinGap)
    path:close()
end

local function appendShardPath(path, halfWidth, bend, progress)
    local halfLength = kShardLengthUnits * 0.5
    local noseX = halfLength
    local shoulderX = halfLength * kShardShoulderRatio
    local tailEndX = -halfLength * kShardTailEndRatio
    local tailCenterY = bend * halfWidth
    local tailHalfWidth = halfWidth * 0.36

    path:move_to(noseX, 0.0)
    path:cubic_to(
        shoulderX,
        -halfWidth,
        -shoulderX,
        -halfWidth * 0.72,
        tailEndX,
        tailCenterY - tailHalfWidth)
    path:line_to(
        tailEndX + kShardTailNotchUnits,
        tailCenterY)
    path:line_to(tailEndX, tailCenterY + tailHalfWidth)
    path:cubic_to(
        -shoulderX,
        halfWidth * 0.72,
        shoulderX,
        halfWidth,
        noseX,
        0.0)
    path:close()

    local afterimageGap =
        kShardAfterimageBaseGapUnits +
        progress * kShardAfterimageTravelGapUnits
    local previousLeftX = tailEndX
    for afterimageIndex = 1, kShardAfterimageCount do
        local afterimageLength =
            kShardAfterimageLengthUnits *
            kShardAfterimageLengthDecay ^ (afterimageIndex - 1)
        local afterimageRightX = previousLeftX - afterimageGap
        local afterimageLeftX =
            afterimageRightX - afterimageLength
        local verticalDirection =
            afterimageIndex % 2 == 0 and -1.0 or 1.0
        local afterimageCenterY =
            tailCenterY +
            verticalDirection *
                halfWidth *
                kShardAfterimageVerticalOffsetRatio
        local afterimageHalfHeight =
            halfWidth * kShardAfterimageHeightRatio
        local afterimageSlant =
            kShardAfterimageSlantUnits * verticalDirection

        path:move_to(
            afterimageLeftX - afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY - afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            afterimageRightX - afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY - afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            afterimageRightX + afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY + afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            afterimageLeftX + afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY + afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:close()
        previousLeftX = afterimageLeftX
    end
end

local function appendGlitchPath(
        path,
        characterIndex,
        glitchAmount,
        glitchEventIndex)
    for blockIndex = 1, kGlitchBlockCount do
        local widthStep =
            (characterIndex * 3 +
                blockIndex * 2 +
                glitchEventIndex) % 4
        local blockWidth =
            kGlitchBlockBaseWidthUnits +
            widthStep * kGlitchBlockWidthStepUnits
        local blockHalfWidth = blockWidth * 0.5
        local blockHalfHeight =
            kGlitchBlockHeightUnits *
            (0.7 + glitchAmount * 0.3) * 0.5
        local blockCenterX =
            math.sin(
                characterIndex * 1.7 +
                blockIndex * 2.1 +
                glitchEventIndex) *
            170.0 * glitchAmount
        local blockCenterY =
            (blockIndex -
                (kGlitchBlockCount + 1.0) * 0.5) *
            kGlitchBlockVerticalStepUnits

        path:move_to(
            blockCenterX - blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY - blockHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            blockCenterX + blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY - blockHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            blockCenterX + blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY + blockHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            blockCenterX - blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY + blockHalfHeight)
        path:close()
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for characterIndex = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local pathMode = cachedPathMode[characterIndex]
        if pathMode ~= nil then
            local pathParts = ctx.paths:character(characterIndex)

            if #pathParts > 0 then
                local halfWidth =
                    cachedPathWidth[characterIndex] or kLeafHalfWidthUnits
                local bend = cachedPathBend[characterIndex] or 0.0
                local pathProgress =
                    cachedPathProgress[characterIndex] or 0.0
                local generatedPath = pathParts[1].path

                generatedPath:clear()
                if pathMode == kPathModeLeaf then
                    appendLeafPath(
                        generatedPath,
                        characterIndex,
                        halfWidth,
                        bend)
                elseif pathMode == kPathModeShard then
                    appendShardPath(
                        generatedPath,
                        halfWidth,
                        bend,
                        pathProgress)
                elseif pathMode == kPathModeGlitch then
                    appendGlitchPath(
                        generatedPath,
                        characterIndex,
                        halfWidth,
                        math.floor(bend))
                end

                for partIndex = 2, #pathParts do
                    pathParts[partIndex].path:clear()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

descriptions.ja:
パーツが一面の受信ループへ集まり、信号が巡回した後に読みやすい文字へ切り替わり、最後は奥行きへ散る演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。演出の定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。パーツの数や分かれ方はフォントの輪郭に依存します。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。

Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。IntroをOFFにすると開始演出を省略し、OutroをOFFにすると終了演出を省略します。

author: Mug

name: SPC010_chromatic_rift.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id SPC010
-- @duration 7.2
-- @recommend text "CHROMA//RIFT"
-- @recommend bg #03020B
-- @title Chromatic Rift
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.05
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.35
--[[ @description
Misregistered color shells fuse into a double-stroke emblem; a chromatic gap tears open and stitches closed.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
色ずれした輪郭が二重ストロークの文字へ集まり、色の裂け目が開いて両端から縫い合わされる演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.05
local kOutroDuration = 1.35
local kFallbackClipLength = 7.2
local kIntroStagger = 0.5
local kOutroStagger = 0.62
local kRiftSpeed = 3.0
local kRiftSpread = 8.5
local kMaximumGap = 0.046
local kInnerWidth = 0.026
local kInnerImpactWidth = 0.016
local kOuterWidth = 0.043
local kOuterAfterglowWidth = 0.022
local kAssemblyGap = 0.058
local kSutureGap = 0.062

local function bell(value, center, width)
    local distance = (value - center) / width
    return math.exp(-distance * distance)
end

local function withAlpha(color, alpha)
    return { r = color.r, g = color.g, b = color.b, a = alpha }
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local globalBreath = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(ctx.time * 1.35)

    ctx.global.rotation = ctx.global.rotation + math.sin(ctx.time * 0.72) * 1.2
    ctx.global.scale = ctx.global.scale * (1.0 + globalBreath * 0.018)

    ctx.global.stroke.order = "fill_over_stroke"
    ctx.global.stroke.join = "round"
    ctx.global.stroke.miter_limit = 4.0

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = 0.2 + globalBreath * 0.16
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = 304.0 + math.sin(ctx.time * 0.9) * 14.0
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.01, g = 0.0, b = 0.05, a = 0.82 }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    -- This effect is deliberately 2D-only. Do not copy this override merely as
    -- an optimization: it makes every Inspector and keyframed 3D setting inert.
    ctx.output.force_disable_3d_projection = true

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress
        local inspectorOffsetX = character.offset_x
        local inspectorOffsetY = character.offset_y
        local inspectorRotation = character.rotation
        local inspectorScale = character.scale
        local inspectorStretchX = character.stretch_x
        local inspectorStretchY = character.stretch_y
        local inspectorOpacity = character.opacity
        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, kIntroStagger)
        local centerProximity = 1.0 - math.abs(order * 2.0 - 1.0)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, centerProximity, kOutroStagger)
        local shellArrival = mt.smoothstep(0.0, 0.25, introRaw)
        local innerArrival = mt.smoothstep(0.12, 0.5, introRaw)
        local fillArrival = mt.smoothstep(0.32, 0.72, introRaw)
        local arrivalProgress = mt.ease.out_back(mt.smoothstep(0.0, 0.72, introRaw))
        local registrationLock = mt.smoothstep(0.52, 0.82, introRaw)
        local registrationImpact = bell(introRaw, 0.78, 0.095)

        local sutureWake = mt.smoothstep(0.0, 0.16, outroAmount)
        local stitched = mt.smoothstep(0.12, 0.62, outroRaw)
        local colorDrain = mt.smoothstep(0.34, 0.78, outroRaw)
        local sutureFlash = bell(outroRaw, 0.5, 0.11)
        local convergence = centerProximity ^ 6.0 * bell(outroRaw, 0.72, 0.15)
        local terminalFade = 1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.8, 1.0, outroRaw)

        -- The negative half of the carrier deliberately stays at exactly
        -- zero, giving the emblem a fully sealed state between fractures.
        local phase = ctx.time * kRiftSpeed - order * kRiftSpread
        local carrier = math.sin(phase)
        local opening = math.max(0.0, carrier)
        local gapEnergy = opening * opening * (3.0 - 2.0 * opening)

        -- A delayed, wider lobe makes the outer shell keep glowing after
        -- the gap itself starts closing.
        local afterglowCarrier = math.sin(phase - 0.72)
        local afterglow = math.max(0.0, afterglowCarrier)
        afterglow = afterglow * afterglow
        local impact = mt.smoothstep(0.58, 0.94, gapEnergy)
        local riftImpact = impact * (1.0 - stitched)
        local riftAfterglow = afterglow * (1.0 - stitched)
        local settledWeight = registrationLock * (1.0 - stitched)
        local riftGap = kMaximumGap * gapEnergy * settledWeight
        local assemblyGap = kAssemblyGap * shellArrival * (1.0 - registrationLock)
        local sutureGap = kSutureGap * sutureWake * (1.0 - stitched)
        local activeGap = math.max(riftGap, assemblyGap, sutureGap)

        local side = order * 2.0 - 1.0
        local verticalSign = ((index % 2) == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local idleTilt = math.sin(ctx.time * 1.7 + order * math.pi * 2.0)
        local entryDistance = 1.0 - arrivalProgress
        local entryOffsetX = side * entryDistance * 0.24
        local entryOffsetY = verticalSign * entryDistance * 0.13
        local riftOffsetX = side * riftGap * 0.32
        local riftOffsetY = verticalSign * riftGap * 0.4 + riftAfterglow * 0.006
        local registrationPull = -side * stitched * 0.009

        character.offset_x = inspectorOffsetX + entryOffsetX + riftOffsetX + registrationPull
        character.offset_y = inspectorOffsetY + entryOffsetY + riftOffsetY
        character.rotation = inspectorRotation
            + verticalSign * entryDistance * 62.0
            + idleTilt * 1.5 * registrationLock * (1.0 - stitched)
            + verticalSign * riftImpact * 5.5
        character.scale = inspectorScale
            * (0.2 + arrivalProgress * 0.8)
            * (1.0 + registrationImpact * 0.17 + riftImpact * 0.1
                + sutureFlash * 0.035 + convergence * 0.16)
        character.stretch_x = inspectorStretchX
            * (1.0 + riftGap * 1.05 - sutureFlash * 0.025)
        character.stretch_y = inspectorStretchY
            * (1.0 - riftGap * 0.58 + sutureFlash * 0.035)
        character.opacity = inspectorOpacity * shellArrival * terminalFade

        local hue = mt.cycle(ctx.time * 0.13 + order * 0.68, 1.0)
        local calmFill = mt.color.from_oklch(0.94, 0.035, hue + 0.12, 1.0)
        local impactFill = mt.color.from_oklch(0.98, 0.11, hue + 0.2, 1.0)
        local innerCalm = mt.color.from_oklch(0.72, 0.2, hue, 1.0)
        local innerImpact = mt.color.from_oklch(0.86, 0.27, hue + 0.16, 1.0)
        local outerCalm = mt.color.from_oklch(0.34, 0.18, hue + 0.54, 1.0)
        local outerHot = mt.color.from_oklch(0.68, 0.3, hue + 0.43, 1.0)
        local sealedFill = { r = 0.055, g = 0.05, b = 0.08, a = 1.0 }
        local sealedInner = { r = 0.11, g = 0.1, b = 0.15, a = 1.0 }
        local sealedOuter = { r = 0.025, g = 0.02, b = 0.045, a = 1.0 }
        local convergenceWhite = { r = 1.0, g = 0.98, b = 0.9, a = 1.0 }

        local fillAlpha = fillArrival * (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.62, 0.88, outroRaw))
        local innerAlpha = innerArrival * (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.7, 0.94, outroRaw))
        local outerAlpha = shellArrival * terminalFade
        local introWhiteFlash = registrationImpact * (1.0 - outroRaw)
        local outroGlow = math.max(sutureFlash, convergence)

        local fillColor = mt.color.lerp(calmFill, impactFill, math.max(riftImpact, introWhiteFlash))
        fillColor = mt.color.lerp(fillColor, sealedFill, colorDrain)
        fillColor = mt.color.lerp(fillColor, convergenceWhite, convergence)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = withAlpha(fillColor, fillAlpha)

        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width =
            kInnerWidth + kInnerImpactWidth * math.max(riftImpact, registrationImpact)
        character.stroke.gap = activeGap
        character.stroke.color = withAlpha(
            mt.color.lerp(
                mt.color.lerp(innerCalm, innerImpact, math.max(riftImpact, introWhiteFlash)),
                sealedInner,
                colorDrain * (1.0 - convergence)),
            innerAlpha)
        character.stroke.outer_width =
            kOuterWidth
            + kOuterAfterglowWidth * math.max(riftAfterglow, registrationImpact)
            + outroGlow * 0.03
        character.stroke.outer_color = withAlpha(
            mt.color.lerp(
                mt.color.lerp(
                    outerCalm,
                    outerHot,
                    mt.saturate(riftImpact + riftAfterglow * 0.75 + registrationImpact + outroGlow)),
                sealedOuter,
                colorDrain * (1.0 - convergence)),
            outerAlpha)

        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = mt.color.from_oklch(
            0.46,
            0.25,
            hue + 0.48,
            (0.22 + riftImpact * 0.52 + registrationImpact * 0.26 + outroGlow * 0.4)
                * outerAlpha)
    end
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id STY001
-- @duration 5
-- @recommend bg #dddddd
-- @title Jelly Snap
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.8
--[[ @description
Candy-colored letters snap through quantized poses and disappear in a random picking cascade. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字の姿勢とキャンディカラーが段階的に切り替わり、ランダムな順序で取り去られる演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kCutsPerSecond = 3.0
local kPopInSeconds = 0.6 -- duration of the pop-in phase
local kJitterAmount = 0.004 -- canvas fraction of the per-cut pose jitter
local kScaleSnapAmount = 0.06 -- per-cut scale snap range
local kRotationSnapDegrees = 4.0 -- per-cut rotation snap range
local kVanishLead = 0.8 -- seconds before clip end the picking starts
local kPrePickScale = 1.18 -- scale pop on the cut before a character is picked
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kCandyColors = {
    { r = 1.0, g = 0.85, b = 0.2, a = 1.0 }, -- lemon
    { r = 0.95, g = 0.25, b = 0.35, a = 1.0 }, -- strawberry
    { r = 0.55, g = 0.85, b = 0.3, a = 1.0 }, -- lime
    { r = 1.0, g = 0.6, b = 0.15, a = 1.0 }, -- orange
    { r = 0.6, g = 0.4, b = 0.85, a = 1.0 }, -- grape
    { r = 0.3, g = 0.5, b = 0.9, a = 1.0 }, -- blueberry
}
local kFullTurnDegrees = 360.0

local function getPaletteOffset(ctx)
    -- Individual character fills replace the rendered global gradient, so its
    -- angle remains available as an inspector knob for rotating the palette.
    local paletteProgress = mt.wrap(
        ctx.global.gradient.angle / kFullTurnDegrees,
        0.0,
        1.0)
    return math.floor(paletteProgress * #kCandyColors)
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.stroke.width = 0.012
    ctx.global.stroke.color = { r = 1.0, g = 1.0, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
    ctx.global.stroke.join = "round"
    ctx.global.stroke.order = "fill_over_stroke"
    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introTime, remainingSeconds =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, kPopInSeconds, kVanishLead, kFallbackClipLength)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local cutIndex = math.floor(ctx.time * kCutsPerSecond)
    local paletteOffset = getPaletteOffset(ctx)

    local popInProgress = mt.saturate(introTime / kPopInSeconds)
    local vanishProgress = mt.saturate(1.0 - remainingSeconds / kVanishLead)
    local visibleCount = math.ceil((1.0 - vanishProgress) * ctx.char_count)
    local nextVanishCount = math.ceil(
        (1.0 - mt.saturate(1.0 - (remainingSeconds - 1.0 / kCutsPerSecond) / kVanishLead))
            * ctx.char_count)

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local poseSalt = index * 8191 + cutIndex

        -- Pop-in: each character has a fixed random threshold; it exists
        -- once the intro progress passes it (so the fill-in order is a
        -- deterministic shuffle, one deterministic subset per cut).
        local popThreshold = mt.random_range(seed, index + ctx.char_count * 5, 0.0, 0.95)
        local appeared = popInProgress >= popThreshold

        local vanishRank = math.floor(mt.random_range(seed, index + ctx.char_count * 7, 0.0, 0.999)
            * ctx.char_count) + 1
        local picked = vanishProgress > 0.0 and vanishRank > visibleCount
        local aboutToBePicked = not picked and vanishProgress > 0.0 and vanishRank > nextVanishCount

        local colorIndex =
            ((index + cutIndex + paletteOffset) % #kCandyColors) + 1
        local candyColor = kCandyColors[colorIndex]

        local scaleSnap = mt.random_range(seed, poseSalt + 2, -kScaleSnapAmount, kScaleSnapAmount)
        local pickPop = aboutToBePicked and kPrePickScale or 1.0

        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + mt.random_range(seed, poseSalt, -kJitterAmount, kJitterAmount)
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + mt.random_range(seed, poseSalt + 1, -kJitterAmount, kJitterAmount)
        character.scale = character.scale * ((1.0 + scaleSnap) * pickPop)
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (mt.random_range(seed, poseSalt + 4, -kRotationSnapDegrees, kRotationSnapDegrees))
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = candyColor
        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = mt.color.with_alpha(candyColor, 0.35)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * ((appeared and not picked) and 1.0 or 0.0)
    end
end
description: Candy-colored letters snap through quantized poses and disappear in a random picking cascade. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id STY002
-- @duration 5
-- @title Gold Shine
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.4
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.2
--[[ @description
Gold lettering carries a traveling specular shine with a dark outline and soft shadow.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
金色の文字を明るい反射が横切るタイトルです。金色・暗い縁取り・影をスクリプトで設定します。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.4 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 1.2 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kShinePeriod = 2.4 -- seconds between shine passes
local kShineHalfWidth = 0.16 -- gradient-position half width of the shine band
local kShineAngleDegrees = 24.0 -- shine sweeps slightly off-vertical
local kTrackingSpread = 0.05 -- extra tracking while loose
local kRiseDistance = 0.02 -- canvas fraction of the entrance rise
local kFadeStagger = 0.5 -- entrance/exit cascade across characters
local kGoldFill = { r = 0.82, g = 0.66, b = 0.30, a = 1.0 }
local kShineColor = { r = 1.0, g = 0.96, b = 0.82, a = 1.0 }
local kStrokeColor = { r = 0.32, g = 0.23, b = 0.08, a = 1.0 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local settleIn = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount)
    local loosenOut = mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount)

    ctx.global.fill.color = kGoldFill
    ctx.global.tracking = ctx.global.tracking + ((1.0 - settleIn) * kTrackingSpread + loosenOut * kTrackingSpread)

    -- Shine pass: a narrow bright band rides the gradient positions from
    -- before the text to past it, once per period, forever.
    local shineCenter = mt.cycle(ctx.time, kShinePeriod) * (1.0 + 2.0 * kShineHalfWidth * 2.0)
        - kShineHalfWidth * 2.0
    ctx.global.gradient.color_space = "oklab"
    ctx.global.gradient.end_color = kShineColor
    ctx.global.gradient.angle = kShineAngleDegrees
    ctx.global.gradient.midpoint = 0.5
    ctx.global.gradient.start_position = shineCenter - kShineHalfWidth
    ctx.global.gradient.end_position = shineCenter + kShineHalfWidth

    ctx.global.stroke.width = 0.004
    ctx.global.stroke.color = kStrokeColor
    ctx.global.stroke.order = "fill_over_stroke"
    ctx.global.stroke.join = "round"

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = 0.12
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = 45.0
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.05, g = 0.03, b = 0.0, a = 0.35 }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local fadeIn = mt.ease.out_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        local fadeOut = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))

        character.offset_y = character.offset_y - (1.0 - fadeIn) * kRiseDistance
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (fadeIn * (1.0 - fadeOut))
    end
end
description: Gold lettering carries a traveling specular shine with a dark outline and soft shadow.

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id STY003
-- @duration 5
-- @recommend bg #ccbbaa
-- @title Heavy Metal
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.09
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.0
--[[ @description
Steel letters slam down without bouncing; narrow reflections sweep the metal finish. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
鋼板のような文字が跳ねずに着地し、金属の細い反射光が流れる演出です。配色・縁取り・影をスクリプトで設定します。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kDropWindow = 0.8 -- seconds over which the slams are staggered
local kDropDuration = 0.2 -- seconds each plate falls (accelerating, no ease-out)
local kDropHeight = 0.3 -- canvas fraction fallen
local kImpactDip = 0.008 -- canvas fraction the whole line sinks per impact
local kImpactDuration = 0.09 -- seconds the sink lasts
local kSnapLead = 1.0 -- seconds before clip end the fold-down starts
local kSnapDuration = 0.12 -- seconds each plate takes to snap flat
local kSnapStagger = 0.7 -- fold cascade across characters
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kShinePeriod = 1.8 -- seconds between specular sweeps
local kShineHalfWidth = 0.07 -- narrow, hard highlight band
local kSteelFill = { r = 0.58, g = 0.62, b = 0.68, a = 1.0 }
local kShineColor = { r = 0.95, g = 0.97, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kEdgeColor = { r = 0.1, g = 0.11, b = 0.14, a = 1.0 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.fill.color = kSteelFill

    local shineCenter = mt.cycle(ctx.time, kShinePeriod) * (1.0 + 4.0 * kShineHalfWidth)
        - kShineHalfWidth * 2.0
    ctx.global.gradient.color_space = "oklab"
    ctx.global.gradient.end_color = kShineColor
    ctx.global.gradient.angle = 18.0
    ctx.global.gradient.midpoint = 0.5
    ctx.global.gradient.start_position = shineCenter - kShineHalfWidth
    ctx.global.gradient.end_position = shineCenter + kShineHalfWidth

    ctx.global.stroke.width = 0.005
    ctx.global.stroke.color = kEdgeColor
    ctx.global.stroke.join = "miter_clip" -- hard corners for the machined edge

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.0, g = 0.0, b = 0.0, a = 0.6 }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introTime, remainingSeconds =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, kDropWindow + kDropDuration + kImpactDuration, kSnapLead, kFallbackClipLength)
    local snapAmount =
        mt.saturate(1.0 - (remainingSeconds - (kSnapLead - kSnapDuration)) / kSnapDuration)
    local characterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)

    -- Every landing shakes the whole line: collect the strongest active
    -- impact dip before styling the characters.
    local lineDip = 0.0
    for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local landTime = mt.distribute(index, characterCount) * kDropWindow + kDropDuration
        local sinceImpact = introTime - landTime
        if sinceImpact >= 0.0 and sinceImpact < kImpactDuration then
            lineDip = math.max(lineDip, kImpactDip * (1.0 - sinceImpact / kImpactDuration))
        end
    end

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress

        local dropStart = order * kDropWindow
        -- Pure acceleration, cut off at the floor: rigid, zero restitution.
        local fall = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate((introTime - dropStart) / kDropDuration))

        local snapProgress = mt.stagger_progress(snapAmount, order, kSnapStagger)
        -- Fold-flat is faked in 2D by collapsing the height against the
        -- bottom edge (an edge-on plate), since pitch only renders in 3D.
        local snap = mt.ease.in_quad(snapProgress)

        character.pivot_y = 0.5 - character.geometry.bounds_height * 0.5
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + (1.0 - fall) * kDropHeight - lineDip
        character.stretch_y = character.stretch_y * (1.0 - snap * 0.98)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (fall * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(mt.saturate(snapProgress * 1.2 - 0.2))))
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id STY004
-- @duration 5
-- @recommend bg #aaccaa
-- @title Wood Blocks
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.7
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.1
--[[ @description
Wooden letters settle with a slight clatter and tip forward on exit. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
木のブロックを並べたように文字が小さく揺れて着地し、退場時は前へ倒れます。木目風の色・縁取り・影を設定します。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kPlaceWindow = 1.0 -- seconds over which the blocks are placed
local kPlaceDuration = 0.3 -- seconds each block takes to be set down
local kPlaceHeight = 0.07 -- canvas fraction, the gentle set-down height
local kSettleTiltDegrees = 5.0 -- initial lean that settles after placement
local kSettleDuration = 0.4 -- seconds the lean takes to settle
local kTipLead = 1.1 -- seconds before clip end the tipping starts
local kTipDuration = 0.5 -- seconds each block takes to tip flat
local kTipStagger = 0.7 -- tipping cascade across characters
local kTipDegrees = 84.0 -- final tipped-over angle
local kFadeAfterTip = 0.3 -- fade applied once a block lies flat
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kWoodTones = {
    { r = 0.55, g = 0.36, b = 0.20, a = 1.0 },
    { r = 0.42, g = 0.27, b = 0.15, a = 1.0 },
    { r = 0.63, g = 0.44, b = 0.26, a = 1.0 },
    { r = 0.49, g = 0.33, b = 0.19, a = 1.0 },
}
local kGrainColor = { r = 0.87, g = 0.78, b = 0.62, a = 1.0 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.stroke.width = 0.008
    ctx.global.stroke.color = kGrainColor
    ctx.global.stroke.join = "round"
    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.15, g = 0.09, b = 0.04, a = 0.3 }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introTime, remainingSeconds =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, kPlaceWindow + kPlaceDuration + kSettleDuration, kTipLead, kFallbackClipLength)
    local tipAmount =
        mt.saturate(1.0 - (remainingSeconds - (kTipLead - kTipDuration)) / kTipDuration)

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress
        local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed

        local placeStart = order * kPlaceWindow
        -- Decelerating descent: the block is set down, not dropped.
        local setDown = mt.ease.out_quad(mt.saturate((introTime - placeStart) / kPlaceDuration))
        local sincePlaced = introTime - (placeStart + kPlaceDuration)
        -- The only springiness in the whole material: a subdued back ease
        -- on the settling lean, never on the position.
        local settle = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate(sincePlaced / kSettleDuration))
        local lean = mt.random_range(seed, index, -kSettleTiltDegrees, kSettleTiltDegrees)

        local tipProgress = mt.stagger_progress(tipAmount, order, kTipStagger)
        local tip = mt.ease.out_bounce(tipProgress) -- wooden clatter at the end of the tip

        character.pivot_y = 0.5 - character.geometry.bounds_height * 0.5
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + (1.0 - setDown) * kPlaceHeight
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (lean * (1.0 - settle) + tip * kTipDegrees)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (setDown)
            * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(mt.saturate((tipProgress - (1.0 - kFadeAfterTip)) / kFadeAfterTip)))

        local toneIndex = math.floor(mt.random_range(seed, index + ctx.char_count, 1.0, #kWoodTones + 0.999))
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = kWoodTones[math.min(toneIndex, #kWoodTones)]
    end
end
description: Wooden letters settle with a slight clatter and tip forward on exit. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.

木のブロックを並べたように文字が小さく揺れて着地し、退場時は前へ倒れます。木目風の色・縁取り・影を設定します。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。

name: STY005_mono_cut.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id STY005
-- @duration 5
-- @recommend bg #dddddd
-- @title Mono Cut
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.7
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.9
--[[ @description
Black-and-white typography snaps between hard-cut poses with inverted flashes. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
白黒の文字が滑らかに補間せず、コマを飛ばすような姿勢と明暗の反転で切り替わる演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kCutsPerSecond = 12.0
local kIntroFlashSeconds = 0.7 -- duration of the opening flash burst
local kIntroDropoutChance = 0.35 -- chance a character is missing during a flash cut
local kHoldBlinkChance = 0.06 -- chance a hold-phase cut inverts for one cut
local kJitterAmount = 0.004 -- canvas fraction of the per-cut pose jitter
local kScaleSnapAmount = 0.05 -- per-cut scale snap range
local kOutroFlashLead = 0.9 -- seconds before clip end the closing burst starts
local kVanishLead = 0.45 -- seconds before clip end the characters start vanishing
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kBandMargin = 16.0 -- fontSize percent
local kBlack = { r = 0.0, g = 0.0, b = 0.0, a = 1.0 }
local kWhite = { r = 1.0, g = 1.0, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local _, remainingSeconds, introProgress =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, kIntroFlashSeconds, kOutroFlashLead, kFallbackClipLength)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local cutIndex = math.floor(ctx.time * kCutsPerSecond)

    -- Phase flags for THIS cut.
    local inIntroBurst = introProgress < 1.0
    local inOutroBurst = remainingSeconds < kOutroFlashLead
    local cutRandom = mt.random_range(seed, cutIndex, 0.0, 1.0)

    local inverted = false
    if inIntroBurst or inOutroBurst then
        inverted = cutRandom > 0.5
    elseif cutRandom < kHoldBlinkChance then
        inverted = true
    end

    ctx.bounding_box.enabled = true
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_top = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_bottom = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_left = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_right = false
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_x = kBandMargin
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_y = kBandMargin * 0.7
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_enabled = true
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_opacity = 1.0
    local bandColor = kBlack
    local textColor = kWhite
    if inverted then
        bandColor = kWhite
        textColor = kBlack
    end
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_color = bandColor

    -- Vanish phase: fewer characters survive each cut, in a fixed
    -- deterministic shuffle.
    local vanishProgress = mt.saturate(1.0 - remainingSeconds / kVanishLead)
    local visibleCount = math.ceil((1.0 - vanishProgress) * ctx.char_count)

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local poseSalt = index * 8191 + cutIndex

        local dropped = false
        if inIntroBurst and mt.random_range(seed, poseSalt + 3, 0.0, 1.0) < kIntroDropoutChance then
            dropped = true
        end
        local vanishRank = math.floor(mt.random_range(seed, index + ctx.char_count * 7, 0.0, 0.999)
            * ctx.char_count) + 1
        if vanishProgress > 0.0 and vanishRank > visibleCount then
            dropped = true
        end

        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + mt.random_range(seed, poseSalt, -kJitterAmount, kJitterAmount)
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + mt.random_range(seed, poseSalt + 1, -kJitterAmount, kJitterAmount)
        character.scale = character.scale * (1.0 + mt.random_range(seed, poseSalt + 2, -kScaleSnapAmount, kScaleSnapAmount))
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = textColor
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (dropped and 0.0 or 1.0)
    end
end
description: Black-and-white typography snaps between hard-cut poses with inverted flashes. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id STY006
-- @duration 12
-- @title Slow Sun
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.7
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.7
--[[ @description
A sundial-like shadow contracts toward noon and stretches toward evening under stationary text.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字を静止させたまま、日時計のように影の向きと長さがゆっくり変わる演出です。影の設定をスクリプトで変化させます。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.7 -- seconds
local kArcDegrees = 150.0 -- total shadow sweep around the inspector angle
local kHorizonDistance = 0.32 -- added distance near sunrise and sunset
local kNoonDistance = 0.055 -- added distance at the top of the arc
local kNoonOpacity = 0.45 -- shadow alpha multiplier at noon
local kFallbackClipLength = 12.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local fadeIn = mt.ease.out_quad(introAmount)
    local fadeOut = mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount)
    local sunProgress = mt.ease.in_out_sine(
        mt.timeline.progress(ctx, kFallbackClipLength))
    local sunHeight = math.sin(sunProgress * math.pi)
    local horizonAmount = 1.0 - sunHeight

    local inspectorAngle = ctx.global.shadow.angle
    local inspectorDistance = ctx.global.shadow.distance
    local inspectorColor = ctx.global.shadow.color

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = inspectorAngle
        + mt.lerp(-kArcDegrees * 0.5, kArcDegrees * 0.5, sunProgress)
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = inspectorDistance
        + mt.lerp(kNoonDistance, kHorizonDistance, horizonAmount)
    ctx.global.shadow.color = mt.color.with_alpha(
        inspectorColor,
        inspectorColor.a * mt.lerp(kNoonOpacity, 1.0, horizonAmount))
    ctx.global.opacity = ctx.global.opacity * fadeIn * (1.0 - fadeOut)
end
description: A sundial-like shadow contracts toward noon and stretches toward evening under stationary text.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id STY007
-- @duration 4.0
-- @title Architectural Kinetic Typography
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.0
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.8
--[[ @description
Monochrome tracking collapses into a precise framed title with a subtle camera dolly.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
広い字間が整った配置へ収まり、枠と控えめなカメラ移動で見せる白黒のタイトルです。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.0
local kOutroDuration = 0.8
local kWideTrackingStart = 0.45
local kNormalTracking = 0.0
local kMaxOpacity = 1.0
local kBoxMargin = 120.0
local kBoxWidth = 12.0
local kBoxCornerRadius = 4.0
local kCameraZoomMin = 1.0
local kCameraZoomMax = 1.05
local kBreathFrequency = 0.3

local kColorTextNormal = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.95, a = 1.0 }
local kColorBoxStroke = { r = 0.85, g = 0.86, b = 0.88, a = 0.85 }
local kColorBoxFill = { r = 0.12, g = 0.13, b = 0.16, a = 0.4 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local introProgress, outroProgress = resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)

    -- Dynamic wide tracking collapse to normal grid pitch
    local introTrackingProgress = mt.ease.out_expo(introProgress)
    local introTracking = mt.lerp(kWideTrackingStart, kNormalTracking, introTrackingProgress)
    local outroTracking = outroProgress * 0.15
    local breathTracking = mt.wave(time, kBreathFrequency, 0.0) * 0.015
    ctx.global.tracking = ctx.global.tracking + (introTracking + outroTracking + breathTracking)

    -- Subtle camera dolly for cinematic depth
    local cameraZoom = mt.lerp(kCameraZoomMin, kCameraZoomMax, mt.ease.in_out_sine(introProgress))
    ctx.camera.zoom = cameraZoom + mt.wave(time, 0.25, 0.0) * 0.01

    -- Smooth global opacity control
    local introOpacity = mt.clamp(introProgress * 2.0, 0.0, kMaxOpacity)
    local outroOpacity = 1.0 - outroProgress
    ctx.global.opacity = ctx.global.opacity * (introOpacity * outroOpacity)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local remainingTime = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)

    -- Architectural Bounding Box configuration
    ctx.bounding_box.enabled = true
    ctx.bounding_box.width = kBoxWidth
    ctx.bounding_box.color = kColorBoxStroke
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_enabled = true
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_color = kColorBoxFill
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_opacity = 0.4 * (1.0 - outroProgress)
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_x = kBoxMargin * (0.8 + 0.2 * mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress))
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_y = kBoxMargin * 0.6
    ctx.bounding_box.corner_radius = kBoxCornerRadius
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_top = true
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_bottom = true
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_left = true
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_right = true

    -- Character-level linear slide and smooth staggered outro
    local totalChars = ctx.char_count
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local staggerRatio = 0.04

        -- Intro character vertical slide (smooth drop-in)
        local introSpan = math.max(totalChars - 1, 0) * 0.03 + 0.35
        local charIntroRaw = mt.clamp((introProgress * introSpan - (index - 1) * 0.03) / 0.35, 0.0, 1.0)
        local charIntroEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(charIntroRaw)
        local introOffsetY = (1.0 - charIntroEased) * -0.06

        -- Outro character horizontal slide (seamless staggered motion anchored to outroProgress)
        -- Normalizing window so all characters finish smoothly before clip end without sudden stop
        local charOutroWindowStart = (index - 1) * staggerRatio
        local charOutroWindowSpan = math.max(0.3, 1.0 - (totalChars - 1) * staggerRatio)
        local charOutroRaw = mt.clamp((outroProgress - charOutroWindowStart) / charOutroWindowSpan, 0.0, 1.0)
        local charOutroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(charOutroRaw)
        local outroOffsetX = charOutroEased * 0.12

        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + introOffsetY
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + outroOffsetX
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (charIntroEased * (1.0 - charOutroEased))

        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = kColorTextNormal
    end
end
description: Monochrome tracking collapses into a precise framed title with a subtle camera dolly.
