name: STY008_dialogue_cue.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id STY008
-- @duration 5.0
-- @recommend lang ja pos 0.5 0.18 bg checkerboard #55616d
-- @recommend text "Meet me at the last station."
-- @title Dialogue Cue
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.75
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.64
--[[ @description
An accent opens a caption card; character groups lock in before text and card retract together. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
アクセント色の合図から字幕カードが開き、短い文字群が収まってからカードと本文が一緒に退場する演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で演出全体の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0
local kOutroDuration = 0.64

local kSignalDuration = 0.26
local kCardDelay = 0.1
local kCardDuration = 0.38
local kTextDelay = 0.28
local kTextSettleDuration = 0.24
local kGroupSize = 3
local kGroupDelay = 0.055

local kTextSlideDistance = 0.028
local kIntroStretchX = 0.68
local kLandingColorAmount = 0.68

local kTextOutDuration = 0.2
local kTextOutDelay = 0.018
local kTextOutDistance = 0.032
local kCardOutDelay = 0.18
local kCardOutDuration = 0.34

local kCardMarginX = 26.0
local kCardMarginY = 18.0
local kCardOpacity = 0.86
local kCardDarkAnchor = { r = 0.012, g = 0.016, b = 0.028, a = 1.0 }
local kCardDarkenAmount = 0.84
local kSignalWidth = 6.0

local function isVisibleCharacter(character)
    return mt.text.classify(character.text) ~= "space"
end

local function measureVisibleText(ctx)
    local minimumEdgeY = 0.5
    local maximumEdgeY = 0.5
    local hasVisibleCharacter = false
    local visibleCharacterCount = 0

    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if isVisibleCharacter(character) then
            local geometry = character.geometry
            local bottomEdge = geometry.bounds_center_y - geometry.bounds_height * 0.5
            local topEdge = geometry.bounds_center_y + geometry.bounds_height * 0.5
            if hasVisibleCharacter then
                minimumEdgeY = math.min(minimumEdgeY, bottomEdge)
                maximumEdgeY = math.max(maximumEdgeY, topEdge)
            else
                minimumEdgeY = bottomEdge
                maximumEdgeY = topEdge
                hasVisibleCharacter = true
            end
            visibleCharacterCount = visibleCharacterCount + 1
        end
    end

    return minimumEdgeY, maximumEdgeY, visibleCharacterCount, hasVisibleCharacter
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local minimumEdgeY, maximumEdgeY, visibleCharacterCount, hasVisibleCharacter =
        measureVisibleText(ctx)
    local introTime, remainingSeconds =
        resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, math.max(kCardDelay + kCardDuration, kTextDelay + math.max(math.ceil(visibleCharacterCount / kGroupSize) - 1, 0) * kGroupDelay + kTextSettleDuration), kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local outroElapsed = math.max(kOutroDuration - remainingSeconds, 0.0)

    local signalIn = mt.ease.out_cubic(mt.saturate(introTime / kSignalDuration))
    local cardIn = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate(
        (introTime - kCardDelay) / kCardDuration))
    local cardOut = mt.ease.in_cubic(mt.saturate(
        (outroElapsed - kCardOutDelay) / kCardOutDuration))
    local cardOpenAmount = mt.saturate(cardIn * (1.0 - cardOut))

    -- A bottom-anchored box turns the left edge into a short cue signal.
    -- Opening the shared bounds first lets the signal lead the card fill.
    local fontSizePixels = (ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent) * ctx.canvas.height
    local textHeightPixels = (maximumEdgeY - minimumEdgeY) * ctx.canvas.height
    local collapsedMarginY =
        -textHeightPixels / math.max(fontSizePixels, 1.0) * 50.0
    local boxOpenAmount = mt.saturate(signalIn * (1.0 - cardOut))
    local animatedMarginY = mt.lerp(collapsedMarginY, kCardMarginY, boxOpenAmount)
    local bottomAnchorOffsetY = kCardMarginY - animatedMarginY

    local baseColor = ctx.global.fill.color
    local accentColor = ctx.global.gradient.end_color
    local cardColor = mt.color.lerp(baseColor, kCardDarkAnchor, kCardDarkenAmount)

    ctx.bounding_box.enabled = hasVisibleCharacter and boxOpenAmount > 0.0
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_top = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_bottom = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_right = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_left = true
    ctx.bounding_box.color = accentColor
    ctx.bounding_box.width = kSignalWidth * signalIn * (1.0 - cardOut)
    ctx.bounding_box.start_cap = "round"
    ctx.bounding_box.end_cap = "round"
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_x = kCardMarginX
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_y = animatedMarginY
    ctx.bounding_box.stroke_offset_y = bottomAnchorOffsetY
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_enabled = true
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_color = cardColor
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_opacity = kCardOpacity * cardOpenAmount
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_offset_x = -(1.0 - cardOpenAmount) * kTextSlideDistance
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_offset_y = bottomAnchorOffsetY

    local safeVisibleCount = math.max(visibleCharacterCount, 1)
    local groupCount = math.max(math.ceil(safeVisibleCount / kGroupSize), 1)
    local visibleOrder = 0

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local visible = isVisibleCharacter(character)
        if visible then
            visibleOrder = visibleOrder + 1
        end

        local groupIndex = math.floor((math.max(visibleOrder, 1) - 1) / kGroupSize) + 1
        local landingProgress = mt.stagger_pattern(
            introTime - kTextDelay,
            groupIndex,
            groupCount,
            "asc",
            kGroupDelay,
            kTextSettleDuration)
        local landing = mt.ease.out_back(landingProgress)
        local landingFlash = math.sin(landingProgress * math.pi)

        local exitProgress = mt.stagger_pattern(
            outroElapsed,
            index,
            math.max(ctx.char_count, 1),
            "desc",
            kTextOutDelay,
            kTextOutDuration)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(exitProgress)

        character.offset_x = character.offset_x
            - (1.0 - landing) * kTextSlideDistance
            - exit * kTextOutDistance
        character.stretch_x = character.stretch_x * (mt.lerp(kIntroStretchX, 1.0, landing))
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (mt.saturate(landingProgress * 2.2) * (1.0 - exitProgress))

        local resolvedColor, fillMode = mt.color.resolve_fill(ctx, character)
        if fillMode ~= "transparent" then
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(
                resolvedColor,
                accentColor,
                landingFlash * kLandingColorAmount)
        end
    end
end

name: STY009_opal_loom.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id STY009
-- @duration 6.0
-- @required 3d
-- @title Opal Loom
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.45
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.2
--[[ @description
Opal shards open radially, shimmer under a camera orbit, and weave back into depth.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
オパール風のパーツが放射状に開き、カメラの周回と虹色の光をまとって奥行きへ織り込まれる演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。パーツの数や分かれ方はフォントの輪郭に依存します。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.45
local kOutroDuration = 1.2
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kIntroStaggerAmount = 0.42
local kOutroStaggerAmount = 0.32

local kFoldScale = 0.12
local kFoldRotationTurns = 0.42
local kFoldDepth = 0.42
local kFoldSideDrift = 0.025
local kEdgeOnMinimum = 72.0
local kEdgeOnMaximum = 104.0

local kCameraYawAmplitude = 5.0
local kCameraPitchAmplitude = 2.4
local kCameraYawFrequency = 0.09
local kCameraPitchFrequency = 0.13
local kCameraPerspective = 0.24
local kCameraZoom = 1.03

local kInterferenceScalePrimary = 13.0
local kInterferenceScaleSecondary = 17.0
local kInterferenceSpeedPrimary = 1.35
local kInterferenceSpeedSecondary = 0.92
local kHueBase = 0.57
local kHueSpatialRange = 0.19
local kHueDriftSpeed = 0.025
local kCausticSharpness = 5.0
local kFacetDepth = 0.028
local kFacetTilt = 5.5

local kStrokeWidth = 0.006
local kStrokeGap = 0.001
local kStrokeDark = { r = 0.045, g = 0.055, b = 0.09, a = 0.92 }
local kStrokeGlint = { r = 1.0, g = 0.86, b = 0.55, a = 0.98 }

local kRibbonLeft = 0.12
local kRibbonRight = 0.88
local kRibbonAmplitude = 0.052
local kRibbonTurns = 1.35
local kRibbonPhaseSpeed = 0.55
local kRibbonStretchX = 0.24
local kRibbonStretchY = 0.055
local kRibbonDepth = -0.18
local kRibbonEdgeOn = 82.0
local kRibbonFadeStart = 0.68

local kTwoPi = math.pi * 2.0
local kCenterEpsilon = 1e-5

local function rotateAspectCorrected(positionX, positionY, angle, aspectRatio)
    local worldPositionX = positionX * aspectRatio
    local cosine = math.cos(angle)
    local sine = math.sin(angle)
    local rotatedWorldX = worldPositionX * cosine - positionY * sine
    local rotatedPositionY = worldPositionX * sine + positionY * cosine
    return rotatedWorldX / aspectRatio, rotatedPositionY
end

local function sharpenPositiveWave(value)
    return math.max(value, 0.0) ^ kCausticSharpness
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local settledAmount = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount))

    ctx.camera.yaw = ctx.camera.yaw + mt.wave(ctx.time, kCameraYawFrequency, 0.0)
        * kCameraYawAmplitude
        * settledAmount
    ctx.camera.pitch = ctx.camera.pitch + mt.wave(ctx.time, kCameraPitchFrequency, 0.25)
        * kCameraPitchAmplitude
        * settledAmount
    ctx.camera.perspective = kCameraPerspective
    ctx.camera.zoom = kCameraZoom

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.05, g = 0.16, b = 0.32, a = 0.5 }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local partCount = math.max(ctx.part_count, 1)
    local aspectRatio = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local instanceSeed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local ribbonPhase = ctx.time * kRibbonPhaseSpeed

    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local geometry = part.geometry
        local partOrder = mt.distribute(index, partCount)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Bloom: unfold a character-local opal rose window
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introStagger =
            mt.random_range(instanceSeed, index, 0.0, kIntroStaggerAmount)
        local introProgress = mt.saturate(introAmount * (1.0 + introStagger) - introStagger)
        local bloomAmount = mt.ease.out_back(introProgress)

        local localPositionX = geometry.local_center_x
        local localPositionY = geometry.local_center_y
        local localDistance =
            math.sqrt(localPositionX * localPositionX + localPositionY * localPositionY)
        local fallbackAngle =
            mt.random_range(instanceSeed, index + partCount, 0.0, kTwoPi)
        local radialAngle = fallbackAngle
        if localDistance > kCenterEpsilon then
            radialAngle = math.atan(localPositionY, localPositionX * aspectRatio)
        end

        local foldDirection =
            mt.random_range(instanceSeed, index + partCount * 2, 0.0, 1.0) < 0.5 and -1.0 or 1.0
        local foldAngle = foldDirection * kFoldRotationTurns * kTwoPi
        local foldedPositionX, foldedPositionY = rotateAspectCorrected(
            localPositionX * kFoldScale,
            localPositionY * kFoldScale,
            foldAngle,
            aspectRatio
        )
        foldedPositionX = foldedPositionX + math.cos(radialAngle) * kFoldSideDrift
        foldedPositionY = foldedPositionY + math.sin(radialAngle) * kFoldSideDrift

        local bloomPositionX = mt.lerp(foldedPositionX, localPositionX, bloomAmount)
        local bloomPositionY = mt.lerp(foldedPositionY, localPositionY, bloomAmount)
        local bloomOffsetX = bloomPositionX - localPositionX
        local bloomOffsetY = bloomPositionY - localPositionY

        local edgeOnAngle = mt.random_range(
            instanceSeed,
            index + partCount * 3,
            kEdgeOnMinimum,
            kEdgeOnMaximum
        )
        local introYaw = foldDirection * edgeOnAngle * (1.0 - bloomAmount)
        local introPitch = -foldDirection * edgeOnAngle * 0.55 * (1.0 - bloomAmount)
        local introRotation = math.deg(foldAngle) * (1.0 - bloomAmount)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Living glass: moving polarized interference and caustics
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local worldPositionX = (geometry.canvas_center_x - 0.5) * aspectRatio
        local worldPositionY = geometry.canvas_center_y - 0.5
        local interferencePrimary = math.sin(
            worldPositionX * kInterferenceScalePrimary
                + worldPositionY * kInterferenceScalePrimary * 0.62
                - ctx.time * kInterferenceSpeedPrimary
                + fallbackAngle
        )
        local interferenceSecondary = math.sin(
            -worldPositionX * kInterferenceScaleSecondary * 0.48
                + worldPositionY * kInterferenceScaleSecondary
                + ctx.time * kInterferenceSpeedSecondary
        )
        local interference = (interferencePrimary + interferenceSecondary) * 0.25 + 0.5
        local caustic = sharpenPositiveWave(interferencePrimary * interferenceSecondary)
        local hue = mt.wrap(
            kHueBase
                + (interference - 0.5) * kHueSpatialRange
                + partOrder * 0.08
                + ctx.time * kHueDriftSpeed,
            0.0,
            1.0
        )

        local deepOpal = mt.color.from_oklch(0.5, 0.15, hue, 1.0)
        local livingOpal = mt.color.from_oklch(0.78 + interference * 0.1, 0.18, hue, 1.0)
        local pearlGlint = mt.color.from_oklch(0.985, 0.025, hue, 1.0)
        local settledColor = mt.color.lerp(deepOpal, livingOpal, bloomAmount)
        local opalColor = mt.color.lerp(settledColor, pearlGlint, caustic)

        local idleYaw = interferencePrimary * kFacetTilt * bloomAmount
        local idlePitch = interferenceSecondary * kFacetTilt * bloomAmount
        local idleDepth = -caustic * kFacetDepth * bloomAmount

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Loom: weave every facet into a two-strand aurora ribbon
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local outroStagger = (1.0 - partOrder) * kOutroStaggerAmount
        local outroProgress = mt.saturate(outroAmount * (1.0 + outroStagger) - outroStagger)
        local weaveAmount = mt.ease.in_out_cubic(outroProgress)
        local strandDirection = (index % 2 == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local strandAngle = (partOrder * kRibbonTurns + ribbonPhase) * kTwoPi
        local ribbonPositionX = mt.lerp(kRibbonLeft, kRibbonRight, partOrder)
        local ribbonPositionY =
            0.5 + math.sin(strandAngle) * kRibbonAmplitude * strandDirection
        local ribbonOffsetX = ribbonPositionX - geometry.canvas_center_x
        local ribbonOffsetY = ribbonPositionY - geometry.canvas_center_y
        local ribbonSlope = math.cos(strandAngle)
            * kRibbonAmplitude
            * strandDirection
            * kRibbonTurns
            * kTwoPi
            / ((kRibbonRight - kRibbonLeft) * aspectRatio)
        local ribbonRotation = -math.deg(math.atan(ribbonSlope))
        local ribbonFlare = mt.smoothstep(0.18, 0.62, weaveAmount)
            * (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.62, 1.0, weaveAmount))

        part.offset_x = part.offset_x + mt.lerp(bloomOffsetX, ribbonOffsetX, weaveAmount)
        part.offset_y = part.offset_y + mt.lerp(bloomOffsetY, ribbonOffsetY, weaveAmount)
        part.rotation = part.rotation + (mt.lerp(introRotation, ribbonRotation, weaveAmount))
        part.yaw = mt.lerp(introYaw + idleYaw, strandDirection * kRibbonEdgeOn, weaveAmount)
        part.pitch = mt.lerp(introPitch + idlePitch, 0.0, weaveAmount)
        part.z = mt.lerp((1.0 - bloomAmount) * kFoldDepth + idleDepth, kRibbonDepth, weaveAmount)
        part.scale = part.scale * (mt.lerp(kFoldScale + (1.0 - kFoldScale) * bloomAmount, 1.0, weaveAmount))
        part.stretch_x = part.stretch_x * (mt.lerp(1.0, kRibbonStretchX, weaveAmount))
        part.stretch_y = part.stretch_y * (mt.lerp(1.0, kRibbonStretchY, weaveAmount))

        local introOpacity = mt.saturate(introProgress * 4.0)
        local outroOpacity = 1.0
            - mt.smoothstep(kRibbonFadeStart, 1.0, outroProgress)
        part.opacity = part.opacity * (introOpacity * outroOpacity)

        part.fill.use = true
        part.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(opalColor, pearlGlint, ribbonFlare)
        part.stroke.use = true
        part.stroke.width = kStrokeWidth
        part.stroke.gap = kStrokeGap
        part.stroke.color = mt.color.lerp(kStrokeDark, kStrokeGlint, caustic + ribbonFlare)
        part.shadow.use = true
        part.shadow.color = mt.color.with_alpha(opalColor, 0.28 + caustic * 0.32)
    end
end

name: STY010_sparkle_swap.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id STY010
-- @duration 7.5
-- @title Sparkle Swap
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.9
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.7
--[[ @description
Stars sweep in, flash into letters, twinkle beside the title, then scatter as stars.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
星が飛び込んで閃光とともに文字へ変わり、周囲がきらめいてから星に戻って散る演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kTau = math.pi * 2.0
local kFallbackClipLength = 7.5

local kIntroDuration = 1.9
local kOutroDuration = 1.7
local kFlyInShareOfIntro = 0.62
local kHoldShareOfOutro = 0.3
-- Canvas heights, so the ring clears any frame.
local kFlyInRingRadius = 1.5
local kScatterRingRadius = 1.6
local kStarScale = 1.05

local kSwapFlashHalfWidthSeconds = 0.34
local kSwapFlashSwell = 0.55
local kSwapFlashOvershoot = 0.42
local kSwapFlashSpin = 90.0

local kSparklePoolSize = 9
local kBurstPeriod = 2.4
local kLitShareOfBurstSlot = 0.62
local kBurstStartJitterShare = 0.45
local kBurstLengthJitterShare = 0.5
local kSparklesPerBurst = 3
local kSparkleLitShareOfBurst = 0.8
local kSparkleFadeShareOfLit = 0.22
-- Breathing room only: the offset itself comes from the two shapes' measured heights.
local kSparkleClearanceEm = 0.12
local kSparkleLeanRadians = 0.22
local kSparkleScale = 0.85
local kSparkleSeed = 20250814

local kStarColor = { r = 1.0, g = 0.74, b = 0.24, a = 1.0 }
local kSparkleColor = kStarColor
local kFlashColor = { r = 1.0, g = 1.0, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }

-- Adapted from Google Material Icons "star" and "auto_awesome" (Apache License 2.0).
-- Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
-- The rounded star that stands in for each letter during the intro and outro.
local roundedStarPath = mt.svg_path([[
M12 2.2
c0.5 0 0.95 0.3 1.15 0.76
l2.15 5.02
l5.44 0.47
c0.5 0.04 0.92 0.38 1.07 0.86
c0.16 0.48 0.01 1-0.37 1.33
l-4.12 3.57
l1.23 5.32
c0.11 0.49-0.08 1-0.49 1.29
c-0.41 0.3-0.96 0.32-1.39 0.06
LYR003 18.11
l-4.67 2.77
c-0.43 0.26-0.98 0.24-1.39-0.06
c-0.41-0.29-0.6-0.8-0.49-1.29
l1.23-5.32
l-4.12-3.57
c-0.38-0.33-0.53-0.85-0.37-1.33
c0.15-0.48 0.57-0.82 1.07-0.86
l5.44-0.47
l2.15-5.02
C11.05 2.5 11.5 2.2 12 2.2
Z
]], {
    view_box = { 0, 0, 24, 24 },
    em_scale = 0.86,
})

-- The four-point sparkle that twinkles around the finished title.
-- Four arms around (12,12): each tip is 10.4 units out, and the cubic control points sit on the
-- axes at 12 +/- 2.6 so every arm is the same shape and the waists meet cleanly on the diagonals.
local sparklePath = mt.svg_path([[
M12 1.6
C12 9.4 14.6 12 22.4 12
C14.6 12 12 14.6 12 22.4
C12 14.6 9.4 12 1.6 12
C9.4 12 12 9.4 12 1.6
Z
]], {
    view_box = { 0, 0, 24, 24 },
    em_scale = 0.5,
})

local starMarker, sparkleMarker
local sourceCharacterCount = 0
local starCharacterCount = 0
local sparkleCount = 0
local cachedOrderCount = -1
local cachedDrawOrder = ""

-- Sparkles paint behind the title, then the letters, then the stars that replace them.
local function backgroundFirstOrder(totalCharacterCount)
    if totalCharacterCount ~= cachedOrderCount then
        local order = {}
        local sparkleStart = sourceCharacterCount + starCharacterCount
        for sparkleIndex = 1, sparkleCount do
            order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | (sparkleStart + sparkleIndex)
        end
        for sourceIndex = 1, sourceCharacterCount do
            order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | sourceIndex
        end
        for starIndex = 1, starCharacterCount do
            order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | (sourceCharacterCount + starIndex)
        end
        cachedDrawOrder = mt.order_text(order)
        cachedOrderCount = totalCharacterCount
    end
    return cachedDrawOrder
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    sourceCharacterCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0

    local decorationBudget = math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - sourceCharacterCount, 0)
    starCharacterCount = math.min(sourceCharacterCount, decorationBudget)
    -- Keep the sparkle pool proportional to the title. A fixed pool would crowd a two-letter
    -- word, leaving no quiet gaps because too many sparkles share the same few letters.
    sparkleCount = sourceCharacterCount > 0 and math.min(kSparklePoolSize, sourceCharacterCount + 1,
        decorationBudget - starCharacterCount) or 0

    starMarker, sparkleMarker = nil, nil
    if starCharacterCount > 0 then
        starMarker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = roundedStarPath, advance_x = 0, advance_y = 0, bounds = {0, 0, 0, 0} })
    end
    if sparkleCount > 0 then
        sparkleMarker = ctx.glyphs:declare({ path = sparklePath, advance_x = 0, advance_y = 0, bounds = {0, 0, 0, 0} })
    end

    -- On a line of their own: tracking follows every marker, so on the title's last line they
    -- would widen it and shift it under centre or right alignment of multi-line text.
    local markers = string.rep(starMarker or "", starCharacterCount) .. string.rep(sparkleMarker or "", sparkleCount)
    if markers ~= "" then
        ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. "\n" .. markers
    end
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    sourceCharacterCount, starCharacterCount, sparkleCount = 0, 0, 0
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        if character.text == starMarker then starCharacterCount = starCharacterCount + 1
        elseif character.text == sparkleMarker then sparkleCount = sparkleCount + 1
        else sourceCharacterCount = sourceCharacterCount + 1 end
    end
    cachedOrderCount = -1
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    ctx.output.force_disable_3d_projection = true
    ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
    ctx.output.manual_order_text = backgroundFirstOrder(ctx.char_count)

    -- The whole title flips at once, and the stars sweep in and out as one group, so the title
    -- reads as a single word rather than letters popping in one by one.
    local lettersVisible = introAmount >= 1.0 and outroAmount <= 0.0

    -- Both swaps happen at known moments, so the flash is distance from the nearer one.
    local clipDuration = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipDuration / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.001))
    local nearestSwapDistance = math.min(
        introSeconds > 0.0 and math.abs(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression) or math.huge,
        outroSeconds > 0.0 and math.abs(ctx.time - (clipDuration - outroSeconds * compression)) or math.huge)
    local flash = 1.0 - mt.saturate(nearestSwapDistance / kSwapFlashHalfWidthSeconds)
    -- Cubed so the glare reads as a snap rather than a slow bloom.
    local flashPulse = flash * flash * flash

    -- The stars leave along the same ring they arrived on, so both legs are one signed distance
    -- from the letter: kFlyInRingRadius before they land, kScatterRingRadius once they leave.
    local arrival = mt.ease.out_expo(mt.saturate(introAmount / kFlyInShareOfIntro))
    local departure = mt.ease.in_expo(
        mt.saturate((outroAmount - kHoldShareOfOutro) / (1.0 - kHoldShareOfOutro)))
    local ringDistance = (1.0 - arrival) * kFlyInRingRadius + departure * kScatterRingRadius

    for sourceIndex, source, info in mt.each_char(ctx, { from = 1, to = sourceCharacterCount }) do
        source.opacity = lettersVisible and source.opacity or 0.0
        if lettersVisible then
            source.scale = source.scale * (1.0 + flashPulse * kSwapFlashOvershoot)
        end

        if sourceIndex <= starCharacterCount then
            local star = ctx.chars[sourceCharacterCount + sourceIndex]
            mt.layout.match_pose(ctx, star, source, {
                size = "match_bounds",
                size_scale_x = kStarScale,
                size_scale_y = kStarScale,
            })

            -- Every star sits on the same off-screen ring and converges on its letter together,
            -- so the group sweeps in as one flock instead of trickling in letter by letter.
            local restX, restY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, star)
            local flyAngle = info.progress * kTau * 1.7 + 0.6
            mt.layout.place_2d(ctx, star,
                restX + math.cos(flyAngle) * ringDistance / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio,
                restY + math.sin(flyAngle) * ringDistance)
            star.rotation = star.rotation
                + (1.0 - arrival) * 220.0
                + departure * 260.0
                + flashPulse * kSwapFlashSpin
            star.opacity = lettersVisible and 0.0 or 1.0
            star.scale = star.scale * (1.0 + flashPulse * kSwapFlashSwell)
            star.fill.use = true
            star.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(kStarColor, kFlashColor, flashPulse)
        end
    end

    -- Sparkles only live while the title is readable. Folding the burst number into the seed
    -- reshuffles every choice from one burst to the next.
    local sparkleStart = sourceCharacterCount + starCharacterCount
    local burstIndex = math.floor(ctx.time / kBurstPeriod)
    local burstSeed = kSparkleSeed + burstIndex
    local burstStart = mt.random(burstSeed, 1, "burst start") * kBurstStartJitterShare
    local burstLength = kLitShareOfBurstSlot * (1.0 - kBurstLengthJitterShare * 0.5
        + mt.random(burstSeed, 1, "burst length") * kBurstLengthJitterShare)
    -- Progress through this burst's window; values outside 0..1 mean the title is resting.
    local burstProgress = ((ctx.time / kBurstPeriod) % 1.0 - burstStart) / burstLength

    -- Never light the whole pool: leaving some dark is what makes a burst read as a few sparks,
    -- and on a short title it is what keeps the quiet gaps between bursts.
    local perBurst = math.max(1, math.min(kSparklesPerBurst, sparkleCount - 1))
    -- Spread the sparkles over distinct, non-adjacent letters. Choosing each one independently
    -- would let two share a letter, and neighbouring letters are close enough that their sparkles
    -- can still touch, so step across the title in even strides from a per-burst starting point:
    -- distinct indices in, well-separated letters out.
    local hostStride = math.max(1, math.floor(sourceCharacterCount / perBurst))
    local hostStart = math.floor(mt.random(burstSeed, 1, "host start") * sourceCharacterCount)
    -- Rotating the pool by a per-burst amount varies which sparkles fire each time.
    local burstOffset = math.floor(mt.random(burstSeed, 1, "burst offset") * sparkleCount)

    for sparkleIndex = 1, sparkleCount do
        local sparkle = ctx.chars[sparkleStart + sparkleIndex]
        local hostIndex = 1 + (hostStart + (sparkleIndex - 1) * hostStride) % sourceCharacterCount
        -- Above or below only: a sideways offset shorter than a full advance lands on the glyph.
        local above = mt.random(burstSeed, sparkleIndex, "side") < 0.5
        local sideJitter = (mt.random(burstSeed, sparkleIndex, "lean") - 0.5) * kSparkleLeanRadians
        local angle = (above and 0.75 or 0.25) * kTau + sideJitter
        local scaleJitter = 0.7 + mt.random(burstSeed, sparkleIndex, "size") * 0.6

        -- Clearance comes from the two shapes' measured ink heights, not a tuned constant, so it
        -- holds for any font, character, or size. bounds_height and em_size share canvas units.
        local host = ctx.chars[hostIndex]
        local letterHeightEm = host.geometry.bounds_height / ctx.font.em_size
        local sparkleHeightEm = sparkle.geometry.bounds_height / ctx.font.em_size
            * kSparkleScale * scaleJitter
        local distance = (letterHeightEm + sparkleHeightEm) * 0.5 + kSparkleClearanceEm
        local slot = (sparkleIndex + burstOffset) % sparkleCount
        -- Stagger the chosen ones across the part of the window their flash does not fill.
        local offsetInBurst = mt.random(burstSeed, sparkleIndex, "delay") * (1.0 - kSparkleLitShareOfBurst)

        -- Take the letter's position but not its size: match_bounds fits both axes to the glyph
        -- and copy inherits its stretch, so either would deform the sparkle. position_delta is in
        -- ems, so the gap scales with the type rather than the canvas.
        mt.layout.match_pose(ctx, sparkle, ctx.chars[hostIndex], {
            size = "none",
            position_delta_x = math.cos(angle) * distance,
            position_delta_y = math.sin(angle) * distance,
        })
        sparkle.stretch_x = 1.0
        sparkle.stretch_y = 1.0

        local blink = 0.0
        if slot < perBurst and burstProgress > 0.0 and burstProgress <= 1.0 then
            local localProgress = (burstProgress - offsetInBurst) / kSparkleLitShareOfBurst
            if localProgress > 0.0 and localProgress < 1.0 then
                if localProgress < kSparkleFadeShareOfLit then
                    blink = localProgress / kSparkleFadeShareOfLit
                elseif localProgress > 1.0 - kSparkleFadeShareOfLit then
                    blink = (1.0 - localProgress) / kSparkleFadeShareOfLit
                else
                    blink = 1.0
                end
            end
        end
        sparkle.opacity = lettersVisible and blink or 0.0
        -- One uniform scale for both axes keeps the sparkle square.
        sparkle.scale = kSparkleScale * scaleJitter * (0.35 + blink * 0.65)
        sparkle.rotation = sparkle.rotation + ctx.time * 40.0 + angle * 180.0 / math.pi
        sparkle.fill.use = true
        sparkle.fill.color = kSparkleColor
    end
end
description: Stars sweep in, flash into letters, twinkle beside the title, then scatter as stars.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id STY011
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Suit Badges
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input color 1 "Spade Color" default={0.91, 0.91, 0.93, 1.0}
-- @input color 2 "Heart Color" default={0.98, 0.42, 0.44, 1.0}
-- @input color 3 "Diamond Color" default={0.99, 0.78, 0.31, 1.0}
-- @input color 4 "Club Color" default={0.56, 0.85, 0.56, 1.0}
-- @input number 1 "Spade Scale" default=1.0
-- @input number 2 "Heart Scale" default=1.0
-- @input number 3 "Diamond Scale" default=1.0
-- @input number 4 "Club Scale" default=1.0
-- @input number 5 "Badge Depth" default=0.0
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
--[[ @description
Each letter receives a custom card-suit badge; letters and badges reveal together.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
各文字の背面にスペード・ハート・ダイヤ・クラブのバッジを置き、文字と一緒に表示する演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。Spade／Heart／Diamond／Club ColorとScaleで各バッジの色と大きさ、Badge Depthで奥行きを設定します。色・縁取り・影・素材を含む作例では、演出のために対応するInspector設定をスクリプトで変更します。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kIntroDuration = 0.4
local kOutroDuration = 0.4
-- How much of the intro one letter takes. The rest is the gap between letters, so a smaller
-- share means the letters arrive more separately.
local kLetterShareOfIntro = 0.45
-- Badge diameter as a multiple of the letter's advance. Under 1.0 so badges never touch.
local kBadgeDiameterPerAdvance = 0.98
local kBadgeOpacity = 0.9


-- Adapted from Google Material Symbols "playing_cards" (Apache License 2.0).
-- Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
-- Every suit is compiled to the same em_scale, so one badge scale means one size for all four.
local kSuitOptions = {
    view_box = { 0, 0, 24, 24 },
    em_scale = 0.92,
}
-- What one badge spans at scale 1.0, in ems: the compiled suits fill kSuitOptions.em_scale.
local kBadgeDiameterEm = kSuitOptions.em_scale

local spadePath = mt.svg_path([[
M12 2
C12 2 4 8.5 4 14
c0 3 2.2 5 4.8 5
c1.3 0 2.4-0.5 3.2-1.3
c0.8 0.8 1.9 1.3 3.2 1.3
C17.8 19 20 17 20 14
C20 8.5 12 2 12 2
Z
M10.5 22
h3
c0-2-0.9-3.2-1.5-3.8
C11.4 18.8 10.5 20 10.5 22
Z
]], kSuitOptions)

-- Shifted a unit down from the source icon, whose ink centres on y=11 while the other three
-- centre on the view box. Without it the heart alone rides high behind its letter.
local heartPath = mt.svg_path([[
M12 22
l-1.6-1.5
C4.7 15.4 1 12 1 7.9
C1 4.6 3.6 2 6.9 2
c1.9 0 3.7 0.9 4.9 2.3
C13 2.9 14.8 2 16.6 2
C20 2 22.6 4.6 22.6 7.9
c0 4.1-3.7 7.5-9.4 12.6
LYR003 22
Z
]], kSuitOptions)

local diamondPath = mt.svg_path([[
M12 1
L22 12
LYR003 23
L2 12
Z
]], kSuitOptions)

local clubPath = mt.svg_path([[
M12 2
c-2.5 0-4.5 2-4.5 4.5
c0 0.5 0.1 1 0.2 1.4
C7.2 7.7 6.6 7.5 6 7.5
C3.5 7.5 1.5 9.5 1.5 12
s2 4.5 4.5 4.5
c1.4 0 2.6-0.6 3.4-1.6
C9.2 17.4 8.2 19.6 7 22
h10
c-1.2-2.4-2.2-4.6-2.4-7.1
c0.8 1 2 1.6 3.4 1.6
c2.5 0 4.5-2 4.5-4.5
S20.5 7.5 18 7.5
c-0.6 0-1.2 0.2-1.7 0.4
c0.1-0.4 0.2-0.9 0.2-1.4
C16.5 4 14.5 2 12 2
Z
]], kSuitOptions)

local kBadgePaths = { spadePath, heartPath, diamondPath, clubPath }
-- Measured as a point, so a badge never widens the title's alignment box.
local kEmptyBounds = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }

local badgeMarkers = {}
local letterCount = 0
local badgeCount = 0
local cachedOrderCount = -1
local cachedDrawOrder = ""

-- Badges paint first so every letter reads on top of its own badge.
local function badgesBehindOrder(totalCharacterCount)
    if totalCharacterCount ~= cachedOrderCount then
        local order = {}
        for badgeIndex = 1, badgeCount do
            order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | (letterCount + badgeIndex)
        end
        for letterIndex = 1, letterCount do
            order[#order + 1] = mt.CHAR | letterIndex
        end
        cachedDrawOrder = mt.order_text(order)
        cachedOrderCount = totalCharacterCount
    end
    return cachedDrawOrder
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    letterCount = utf8.len((ctx.global.text:gsub("[\r\n]", ""))) or 0
    badgeCount = math.min(letterCount,
        math.max(ctx.meta.limits.max_characters - letterCount, 0))

    badgeMarkers = {}
    if badgeCount == 0 then return end

    -- Zero advances keep the badges out of the text flow, and empty bounds keep them out of the
    -- alignment box. A badge's bounds join the title's own box when the layout is aligned, and
    -- because the markers carry no advance they all stack at the line end: the ink of the last
    -- one would push the box out to the right and drag the title off centre. Declaring the
    -- bounds empty measures each badge as a point while `path` still draws the whole suit.
    local markers = {}
    for suitIndex = 1, math.min(#kBadgePaths, badgeCount) do
        local path = kBadgePaths[suitIndex]
        markers[suitIndex] = ctx.glyphs:declare({
            path = path,
            advance_x = 0,
            advance_y = 0,
            bounds = kEmptyBounds,
        })
    end

    badgeMarkers = {}
    for _, marker in ipairs(markers) do badgeMarkers[marker] = true end
    local badgeText = {}
    for badgeIndex = 1, badgeCount do
        badgeText[badgeIndex] = markers[(badgeIndex - 1) % #markers + 1]
    end
    ctx.global.text = ctx.global.text .. table.concat(badgeText)

    -- Tracking is added per character on top of every advance, including the badges' zero
    -- advance, so the appended markers would widen the line and drag the title off centre.
    local margins = {}
    for letterIndex = 1, letterCount do
        margins[letterIndex] = ctx.global.margins[letterIndex] or 0.0
    end
    for markerIndex = letterCount + 1, letterCount + badgeCount do
        margins[markerIndex] = -ctx.global.tracking
    end
    ctx.global.margins = margins
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    letterCount, badgeCount = 0, 0
    for _, character in ipairs(ctx.chars) do
        if badgeMarkers[character.text] then badgeCount = badgeCount + 1
        else letterCount = letterCount + 1 end
    end
    cachedOrderCount = -1
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    ctx.output.manual_order_enabled = true
    ctx.output.manual_order_text = badgesBehindOrder(ctx.char_count)

    -- One Inspector colour and scale per suit, in the same order the badges cycle through.
    local suitColors = {
        ctx.inputs.colors[1], ctx.inputs.colors[2], ctx.inputs.colors[3], ctx.inputs.colors[4],
    }
    local suitScales = {
        ctx.inputs.numbers[1], ctx.inputs.numbers[2], ctx.inputs.numbers[3], ctx.inputs.numbers[4],
    }
    -- Positive z is away from the camera, so a positive depth pushes every badge further behind
    -- its letter. It only reaches Native rendering on the 3D tier.
    local badgeDepth = ctx.meta.capabilities.has_3d and ctx.inputs.numbers[5] or 0.0

    for letterIndex, letter, info in mt.each_char(ctx, { from = 1, to = letterCount }) do
        -- info.progress runs 0 to 1 in reading order, so staggering by it reveals the letters
        -- from the left. The outro staggers the same way, clearing them from the left too.
        local entry = mt.ease.in_out_circ(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kLetterShareOfIntro))
        local exit = mt.ease.in_out_circ(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kLetterShareOfIntro))
        local visible = entry * (1.0 - exit)

        letter.opacity = letter.opacity * visible

        if letterIndex <= badgeCount then
            local badge = ctx.chars[letterCount + letterIndex]
            -- Size from the advance so neighbouring badges never touch. Take only the letter's
            -- position: match_bounds would fit both axes to the glyph and squash the shape.
            -- advance_x is normalized by canvas width while em_size is normalized by canvas
            -- height, so the aspect ratio converts one into the other before they can be divided.
            local advanceEm = letter.geometry.advance_x * ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio / ctx.font.em_size
            local suitIndex = (letterIndex - 1) % #kBadgePaths + 1
            mt.layout.match_pose(ctx, badge, letter, { size = "none" })
            badge.stretch_x = 1.0
            badge.stretch_y = 1.0
            -- scale 1.0 draws the badge at kBadgeDiameterEm across, so convert the target
            -- diameter into a scale rather than assuming the two are the same number.
            badge.scale = advanceEm * kBadgeDiameterPerAdvance / kBadgeDiameterEm
                * suitScales[suitIndex]
            badge.z = badge.z + badgeDepth
            badge.opacity = kBadgeOpacity * visible
            badge.fill.use = true
            badge.fill.color = suitColors[suitIndex]
        end
    end
end
description: Each letter receives a custom card-suit badge; letters and badges reveal together.

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id TYP001
-- @duration 5
-- @title Typewriter
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
--[[ @description
Characters appear one by one and disappear in sequence at the end.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字が一つずつ現れ、最後に順番に消えます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local position = info.progress
        local threshold = (position * math.max(ctx.char_count - 1, 0) + 1.0) / math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
        local visible = introProgress >= threshold and (outroProgress == 0.0 or outroProgress < threshold)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (visible and 1.0 or 0.0)
    end
end
description: Characters appear one by one and disappear in sequence at the end.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id TYP002
-- @duration 5
-- @title Word Reveal
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
--[[ @description
Words appear in sequence and stay visible until the exit.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
単語が順番に現れ、退場するまで表示されます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function orderedPosition(ctx, index, count)
    local position = mt.distribute(index, count)
    local order = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    if order == 2 then
        position = 1.0 - position
    elseif order == 3 then
        position = math.abs(position * 2.0 - 1.0)
    elseif order == 4 then
        position = mt.random_range(ctx.meta.instance_seed, index, 0.0, 1.0)
    end
    return position
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local tokenByCharacter = {}
    local tokenCount = 0
    local previousLine = -1
    local insideToken = false
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local whitespace = mt.text.classify(character.text) == "space"
        if whitespace then
            insideToken = false
        else
            if not insideToken or character.line_index ~= previousLine then
                tokenCount = tokenCount + 1
            end
            tokenByCharacter[index] = tokenCount
            insideToken = true
        end
        previousLine = character.line_index
    end
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local token = tokenByCharacter[index]
        if token then
            local position = orderedPosition(ctx, token, tokenCount)
            local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
            character.opacity = character.opacity * mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
                * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outro))
        else
            character.opacity = character.opacity * mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress)
                * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress))
        end
    end
end
description: Words appear in sequence and stay visible until the exit.

descriptions.ja: 単語が順番に現れ、退場するまで表示されます。

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id VRT001
-- @duration 5
-- @title Vertical Fade
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend vertical true
-- @recommend text "夜空に\n光る星\n夢の中"
-- @recommend lang ja
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 4 "Stagger" default=0.25
-- @input number 6 "Order (1=Forward 2=Reverse 3=Center 4=Random)" default=1
--[[ @description
Characters fade in from top to bottom across successive columns.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
文字が上から下へ、右の列から左の列へ順番に現れます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function iterationOptions(ctx)
    local orders = { "asc", "desc", "center", "random" }
    local selection = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    return { order = orders[selection], seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed }
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx, iterationOptions(ctx)) do
        local position = info.progress
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
    end

--[[ @description
Columns slide in from the right and appear in reading order.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
列が右から滑り込み、右の列から左の列へ順番に現れます。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 5.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function orderedPosition(ctx, index, count)
    local position = mt.distribute(index, count)
    local order = math.floor(mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[6], 1.0, 4.0) + 0.5)
    if order == 2 then
        position = 1.0 - position
    elseif order == 3 then
        position = math.abs(position * 2.0 - 1.0)
    elseif order == 4 then
        position = mt.random_range(ctx.meta.instance_seed, index, 0.0, 1.0)
    end
    return position
end

local function itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
    local stagger = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[4], 0.0, 0.9)
    return mt.stagger_progress(introProgress, position, stagger),
        mt.stagger_progress(outroProgress, position, stagger)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 3.0)
    local horizontal, vertical = -1.0, 0.0
    local lines = mt.layout.group_by_line(ctx)
    for lineIndex, line in ipairs(lines) do
        local position = orderedPosition(ctx, lineIndex, #lines)
        local intro, outro = itemProgress(ctx, introProgress, outroProgress, position)
        local entrance = mt.ease.out_cubic(intro)
        local exit = mt.ease.in_cubic(outro)
        local distance = 0.08 * amount * (exit - (1.0 - entrance))
        for _, character in ipairs(line.items) do
            character.offset_x = character.offset_x + horizontal * distance
            character.offset_y = character.offset_y + vertical * distance
            character.opacity = character.opacity * entrance * (1.0 - exit)
        end
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id VRT007
-- @duration 6
-- @title Vertical Lyric Highlight
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @recommend vertical true
-- @recommend text "夜空に\n光る星\n夢の中"
-- @recommend lang ja
-- @input boolean 1 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 2 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 1 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.6
-- @input number 2 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.4
-- @input number 7 "Cue Fade (s)" default=0.15
-- @input text 1 "Lyric Cues (start,end,first,last)" default="0.5,1.8,1,3;2.2,3.5,4,6;3.8,5.2,7,9"
-- @input number 3 "Amount" default=1.0
-- @input color 1 "Accent Color" default={1.0, 0.55, 0.25, 1.0}
--[[ @description
Sung phrases change color at the times in a manual cue sheet.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
時刻表に合わせて、歌っている句の色を順番に強調します。
]]

local kFallbackDuration = 6.0
local kMaximumDuration = 60.0

local function transitionProgress(ctx)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[1]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[1], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[2]
        and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[2], 0.0, kMaximumDuration) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, kFallbackDuration)
end

local function parseCues(ctx)
    local cues = {}
    local sheet = ctx.inputs.texts[1]
    local valid = true
    for row in sheet:gmatch("[^;\r\n]+") do
        if row:match("%S") then
            local startText, endText, firstText, lastText =
                row:match("^%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([^,]+)%s*$")
            local startTime, endTime = tonumber(startText), tonumber(endText)
            local firstCharacter, lastCharacter = tonumber(firstText), tonumber(lastText)
            if startTime and endTime and firstCharacter and lastCharacter
                and startTime >= 0.0 and endTime > startTime and endTime < math.huge
                and firstCharacter >= 1 and lastCharacter >= firstCharacter
                and lastCharacter <= ctx.char_count
                and firstCharacter % 1 == 0 and lastCharacter % 1 == 0 then
                cues[#cues + 1] = {
                    start_time = startTime, end_time = endTime,
                    first_character = firstCharacter, last_character = lastCharacter,
                }
            else
                valid = false
            end
        end
    end
    if not valid then cues = {} end
    return cues
end

local function cueEnvelope(ctx, cue)
    local duration = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[7], 0.0, 10.0)
    duration = math.min(duration, (cue.end_time - cue.start_time) * 0.5)
    local envelope = 0.0
    if ctx.time >= cue.start_time and ctx.time < cue.end_time then
        envelope = 1.0
        if duration > 0.0 then
            envelope = mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, ctx.time - cue.start_time)
                * mt.smoothstep(0.0, duration, cue.end_time - ctx.time)
        end
    end
    return envelope
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = transitionProgress(ctx)
    local visibility = mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroProgress))
    local cues = parseCues(ctx)
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local activeAmount = 0.0
        for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do
            if index >= cue.first_character and index <= cue.last_character then
                activeAmount = math.max(activeAmount, cueEnvelope(ctx, cue))
            end
        end
        local amount = mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[3], 0.0, 1.0) * activeAmount
        if amount > 0.0 then
            local baseColor = character.fill.use and character.fill.color or ctx.global.fill.color
            local accent = ctx.inputs.colors[1]
            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = {
                r = mt.lerp(baseColor.r, accent.r, amount),
                g = mt.lerp(baseColor.g, accent.g, amount),
                b = mt.lerp(baseColor.b, accent.b, amount),
                a = baseColor.a,
            }
        end
        character.opacity = character.opacity * visibility
    end
end
description: Sung phrases change color at the times in a manual cue sheet.

descriptions.ja: 時刻表に合わせて、歌っている句の色を順番に強調します。

-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id VRT009
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend vertical true
-- @duration 12
-- @recommend pos 0.5 0.5 bg #aabbcc
-- @recommend text "花鳥風月\n山紫水明"
-- @title Vertical Ink
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=2.0
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.0
--[[ @description
Vertical glyph parts reveal like wet ink and dry before drifting away. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
縦書きのパーツが濡れた墨のように太く現れ、乾いて落ち着いた後に流れ去る筆順風の演出です。筆画の自動認識は行いません。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で筆順全体と退場の秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。パーツの数や分かれ方はフォントの輪郭に依存します。
]]


local function resolveTransitionClocks(ctx, originalIntro, originalOutro, fallbackSeconds)
    local introSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroSeconds = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local clipSeconds = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, fallbackSeconds)
    local compression = math.min(1.0, clipSeconds / math.max(introSeconds + outroSeconds, 0.000001))
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introTime = originalIntro * introProgress + math.max(ctx.time - introSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    local outroRemaining = originalOutro * (1.0 - outroProgress)
        + math.max(mt.timeline.remaining(ctx, fallbackSeconds) - outroSeconds * compression, 0.0)
    return introTime, outroRemaining, introProgress, outroProgress
end

local kSecondsPerStroke = 0.13 -- preferred writing rate, anchored to the clip start
local kDryDuration = 1.1 -- seconds a stroke takes to dry
local kWetSwell = 0.07 -- extra scale while the ink is wet
local kMistLead = 1.0 -- seconds before clip end the mist fade starts
local kMistDuration = 0.6 -- seconds each character takes to dissolve
local kMistStagger = 0.5 -- dissolve cascade in writing order
local kMistRise = 0.04 -- canvas fraction drifted upward while dissolving
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kWetInk = { r = 0.04, g = 0.04, b = 0.09, a = 1.0 }
local kDriedInk = { r = 0.22, g = 0.22, b = 0.26, a = 1.0 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local partCount = math.max(ctx.part_count, 1)

    local introTime, remainingSeconds = resolveTransitionClocks(
        ctx, partCount * kSecondsPerStroke + kDryDuration, kMistLead, kFallbackClipLength)
    local secondsPerStroke = kSecondsPerStroke

    local writtenStrokes = mt.clamp(introTime / secondsPerStroke, 0.0, partCount)

    ctx.output.write_on_mode = "part"
    ctx.output.reorder_parts = true
    ctx.output.write_on_start = 0.0
    ctx.output.write_on_end = writtenStrokes / partCount

    -- Drying follows layout part indices, which approximate contour reveal order.
    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local sinceDrawn = introTime - index * secondsPerStroke
        local dried = mt.ease.out_quad(mt.saturate(sinceDrawn / kDryDuration))

        part.scale = part.scale * (1.0 + (1.0 - dried) * kWetSwell)
        part.fill.use = true
        part.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(kWetInk, kDriedInk, dried)
    end

    local mistAmount =
        mt.saturate(1.0 - (remainingSeconds - (kMistLead - kMistDuration)) / kMistDuration)
    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local dissolve = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(mistAmount, info.progress, kMistStagger))

        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + dissolve * kMistRise
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (1.0 - dissolve)
    end
end
description: Vertical glyph parts reveal like wet ink and dry before drifting away. Toggle Intro/Outro and set durations in Inputs.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id VRT010
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend vertical true
-- @duration 5
-- @recommend pos 0.5 0.5 bg #1e1e1e
-- @recommend text "春はあけぼの\nやうやうしろく"
-- @title Vertical Unroll
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.1
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.9
--[[ @description
A soft front unrolls vertical text downward and rolls it up on exit.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
掛け軸を下へ開くように縦書きの文字が現れ、退場時は下から巻き戻る演出です。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.1 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.9 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kEdgeSoftness = 0.07 -- canvas fraction over which the front feathers
local kCurlLag = 0.015 -- canvas fraction of the upward curl near the front

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    -- Text extents in canvas space (Y-up), padded so the feathered
    -- fronts fully clear both ends.
    local topEdge = -math.huge
    local bottomEdge = math.huge
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        topEdge = math.max(topEdge, geometry.bounds_center_y + geometry.bounds_height * 0.5)
        bottomEdge = math.min(bottomEdge, geometry.bounds_center_y - geometry.bounds_height * 0.5)
    end
    topEdge = topEdge + kEdgeSoftness
    bottomEdge = bottomEdge - kEdgeSoftness

    -- Unroll front descends from the top; roll-up front climbs from the
    -- bottom (canvas Y grows upward, so descending means decreasing).
    local unrollFront = topEdge
        - mt.ease.in_out_sine(introAmount) * (topEdge - bottomEdge)
    local rollUpFront = bottomEdge
        + mt.ease.in_out_sine(outroAmount) * (topEdge - bottomEdge)

    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local positionY = character.geometry.bounds_center_y

        local revealed = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kEdgeSoftness, positionY - unrollFront)
        local hidden = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kEdgeSoftness, rollUpFront - positionY)
        if outroAmount <= 0.0 then
            hidden = 0.0
        end

        -- Paper curl: characters right at the front sit a touch high,
        -- easing down as the roller moves past them.
        local frontDistance = positionY - unrollFront
        local curl = mt.falloff(frontDistance, kEdgeSoftness) * kCurlLag

        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + curl * (1.0 - mt.saturate(introAmount * 2.0 - 1.0))
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (revealed * (1.0 - hidden))
    end
end
description: A soft front unrolls vertical text downward and rolls it up on exit.

name: VRT011_vertical_sway.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id VRT011
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend vertical true
-- @duration 8
-- @recommend pos 0.5 0.5 bg #1e1e1e
-- @recommend text "たなばたさま\nささのはさらさら"
-- @title Vertical Sway
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=0.8
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=0.8
--[[ @description
Vertical columns swing like paper strips suspended from their upper edges.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
縦書きの列が上端から吊った短冊のように揺れる演出です。下の文字ほど大きく動き、列ごとに位相が異なります。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 0.8 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 0.8 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kSwaySpeed = 0.22 -- swings per second
local kSwayDegrees = 3.0 -- character tilt at the deepest point
local kSwayDrift = 0.055 -- horizontal drift per unit of hanging depth
local kColumnPhase = 1.4 -- radians between neighboring columns
local kDepthLag = 2.6 -- radians of wave lag per unit of hanging depth
local kBreezeSpeed = 0.11 -- slow noise that varies the breeze strength
local kFadeStagger = 0.3 -- entrance/exit cascade across characters

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    if ctx.char_count == 0 then
        return
    end

    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    -- The tie point: the top edge of the laid-out text (canvas Y-up).
    local topEdge = -math.huge
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        topEdge = math.max(topEdge, geometry.bounds_center_y + geometry.bounds_height * 0.5)
    end

    -- The breeze swells and dies on smooth noise, shared by all strips.
    local breeze = 0.6 + 0.4 * mt.noise1(ctx.time * kBreezeSpeed, 61)

    for _, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local depth = math.max(topEdge - character.geometry.bounds_center_y, 0.0)
        local phase = character.line_index * kColumnPhase - depth * kDepthLag
        local swing = mt.wave(ctx.time, kSwaySpeed, phase) * breeze

        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + swing * depth * kSwayDrift
        character.rotation = character.rotation + (swing * kSwayDegrees * mt.saturate(depth * 3.0))

        local appear = mt.ease.out_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        local vanish = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kFadeStagger))
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (appear * (1.0 - vanish))
    end
end
description: Vertical columns swing like paper strips suspended from their upper edges.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @animation_id VRT012
-- @font_lang ja
-- @recommend vertical true
-- @duration 5
-- @recommend pos 0.5 0.5 bg #1e1e1e
-- @recommend text "ゆらゆらと\nたちのぼる"
-- @title Vertical Smoke
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 12
-- @input boolean 3 "Intro" default=true
-- @input boolean 4 "Outro" default=true
-- @input number 8 "Intro Duration (s)" default=1.2
-- @input number 9 "Outro Duration (s)" default=1.1
--[[ @description
Vertical letters materialize with smoky sway, then rise and thin into the air.
]]
--[[ @description.ja
縦書きの文字が煙のように揺れながら現れ、退場時は上へ漂い細くなって消えます。

本文には通常のテキストを入力します。改行はInspectorの組版に従います。Intro／Outroで入退場を切り替え、各Duration (s)で秒数を指定します。短いクリップでは区間を比例圧縮します。その他の演出定数はスクリプト内のkから始まる設定で調整できます。
]]


local function resolveTransitions(ctx, introSeconds, outroSeconds, fallbackSeconds)
    local introDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[3] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[8], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    local outroDuration = ctx.inputs.booleans[4] and mt.clamp(ctx.inputs.numbers[9], 0.0, 60.0) or 0.0
    return mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, introDuration, outroDuration, fallbackSeconds)
end

local kIntroDuration = 1.2 -- seconds
local kOutroDuration = 1.1 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kStaggerAmount = 0.55 -- reading-order cascade across characters
local kRiseDistance = 0.12 -- canvas fraction climbed during the intro
local kDisperseDistance = 0.16 -- canvas fraction drifted up during the outro
local kSwayAmount = 0.018 -- canvas fraction of the smoke sway while loose
local kIdleSwayAmount = 0.002 -- residual sway while settled
local kSwaySpeed = 0.6 -- sway noise time scale
local kDisperseStretch = 0.25 -- vertical thinning while dispersing

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        resolveTransitions(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local settle = mt.ease.out_cubic(
            mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, info.progress, kStaggerAmount))
        local disperse = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, info.progress, kStaggerAmount))

        -- Loose = how smoke-like the character currently is: fully loose
        -- while rising and again while dispersing, near zero at rest.
        local loose = math.max(1.0 - settle, disperse)
        local swayStrength = kIdleSwayAmount + (kSwayAmount - kIdleSwayAmount) * loose
        local sway = mt.noise1(ctx.time * kSwaySpeed + index * 2.7, 71) * swayStrength

        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + sway
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y - (1.0 - settle) * kRiseDistance + disperse * kDisperseDistance
        character.stretch_y = character.stretch_y * (1.0 + disperse * kDisperseStretch)
        character.opacity = character.opacity * (settle * (1.0 - disperse))
    end
end
